```cpp
};
)";

const ShaderHooks& Hooks() {
    static const ShaderHooks plain;
    return g_shader_hooks ? *g_shader_hooks : plain;
}

std::string Common() { return kCommonHead + Hooks().Constants() + kCommonTail; }

// vertex programs

const char* kVsHelpers = R"(
float4 mac_mul(float4 a, float4 b) { return (a == 0 || b == 0) ? (float4)0 : a * b; }
int mac_arl(float v) { return (int)floor(v + 1e-3); }
// magnitude clamped between 1 / 2^64 and 2^64, sign kept
float magclamp(float v) { float m = clamp(abs(v), 5.42101e-20, 1.84467e+19); return v < 0 ? -m : m; }
float4 ilu_rcp(float v) { return (1.0 / v).xxxx; }
float4 ilu_rcc(float v) { return magclamp(1.0 / v).xxxx; }
float4 ilu_rsq(float v) { return v == 0 ? (1.#INF).xxxx : (rsqrt(abs(v))).xxxx; }
// 2^floor(v), fraction, 2^v
float4 ilu_exp(float v) {
    float whole = floor(v);
    return float4(exp2(whole), v - whole, exp2(v), 1);
}
// exponent, mantissa, log2 of |v|; zero logs to negative infinity
float4 ilu_log(float v) {
    float mag = abs(v), l2 = log2(mag), ex = floor(l2);
    return mag == 0 ? float4(-1.#INF, 1, -1.#INF, 1) : float4(ex, mag / exp2(ex), l2, 1);
}
// power clamped to 128 less 1/256
float4 ilu_lit(float4 s) {
    const float cap = 127.99609375;
    float diffuse = max(s.x, 0);
    float spec = exp2(clamp(s.w, -cap, cap) * log2(max(s.y, 0)));
    return float4(1, diffuse, diffuse > 0 ? spec : 0, 1);
}
float fogfactor(float d) {
    if (fogp.w == 3) return (fogp.y - d) / (fogp.y - fogp.x);
    if (fogp.w == 1) return exp(-d * fogp.z);
    if (fogp.w == 2) return exp(-(d * fogp.z) * (d * fogp.z));
    return 1;
}
)";

struct Tok {
    const uint32_t* t;
    uint32_t f(int sub, int bit, int len) const { return (t[sub] >> bit) & ((1u << len) - 1); }
};

const char* kMask[16] = {"", "w", "z", "zw", "y", "yw", "yz", "yzw", "x", "xw", "xz", "xzw", "xy", "xyw", "xyz", "xyzw"};
const char* kLanes[5] = {"", "x", "xy", "xyz", "xyzw"};  // oFog takes one lane per mask bit, from x
const char* kOut[16] = {"oPos", "", "", "oD0", "oD1", "oFog", "oPts", "oB0", "oB1", "oT0", "oT1", "oT2", "oT3", "", "", ""};

// operand A 0, B 1, C 2
std::string Src(const Tok& k, int which, uint16_t regs) {
    uint32_t neg, sw[4], reg, mux;
    if (which == 0) {
        neg = k.f(1, 8, 1);
        sw[0] = k.f(1, 6, 2), sw[1] = k.f(1, 4, 2), sw[2] = k.f(1, 2, 2), sw[3] = k.f(1, 0, 2);
        reg = k.f(2, 28, 4), mux = k.f(2, 26, 2);
    } else if (which == 1) {
        neg = k.f(2, 25, 1);
        sw[0] = k.f(2, 23, 2), sw[1] = k.f(2, 21, 2), sw[2] = k.f(2, 19, 2), sw[3] = k.f(2, 17, 2);
        reg = k.f(2, 13, 4), mux = k.f(2, 11, 2);
    } else {
        neg = k.f(2, 10, 1);
        sw[0] = k.f(2, 8, 2), sw[1] = k.f(2, 6, 2), sw[2] = k.f(2, 4, 2), sw[3] = k.f(2, 2, 2);
        reg = k.f(2, 0, 2) << 2 | k.f(3, 30, 2), mux = k.f(3, 28, 2);
        uint32_t ilu = k.f(1, 25, 3);
        if (ilu >= 2 && ilu <= 6) sw[1] = sw[2] = sw[3] = sw[0];  // scalar ops read x
    }
    // mux: 1 temporary (R12 reads oPos), 2 input, 3 constant
    std::string base;
    if (mux == 1) {
        base = reg == 12 ? "oPos" : F("R%u", reg);
    } else if (mux == 2) {
        uint32_t v = k.f(1, 9, 4);
        base = (regs >> v) & 1 ? F("i.v%u", v) : (v == 3 ? "float4(1,1,1,1)" : "float4(0,0,0,1)");
    } else {
        uint32_t cr = k.f(1, 13, 8);
        base = k.f(3, 1, 1) ? F("c[clamp(a0 + %u, 0, 191)]", cr) : F("c[%u]", cr);
    }
    const char* xyzw = "xyzw";
    std::string s = F("(%s(%s).%c%c%c%c)", neg ? "-" : "", base.c_str(), xyzw[sw[0]], xyzw[sw[1]], xyzw[sw[2]], xyzw[sw[3]]);
    return s;
}

// MAC opcodes from 1: mov mul add mad dp3 dph dp4 dst min max slt sge arl
std::string MacExpr(uint32_t op, const std::string& a, const std::string& b, const std::string& c) {
    switch (op) {
        case 1: return a;
        case 2: return "mac_mul(" + a + ", " + b + ")";
        case 3: return "(" + a + " + " + c + ")";
        case 4: return "(mac_mul(" + a + ", " + b + ") + " + c + ")";
        case 5: return "dot(" + a + ".xyz, " + b + ".xyz).xxxx";
        case 6: return "dot(float4(" + a + ".xyz, 1), " + b + ").xxxx";
        case 7: return "dot(" + a + ", " + b + ").xxxx";
        case 8: return "float4(1, " + a + ".y * " + b + ".y, " + a + ".z, " + b + ".w)";
        case 9: return "min(" + a + ", " + b + ")";
        case 10: return "max(" + a + ", " + b + ")";
        case 11: return "(float4)(" + a + " < " + b + ")";
        case 12: return "(float4)(" + a + " >= " + b + ")";
        case 13: return a;
        default: return "(float4)0";
    }
}

// ILU opcodes from 1: mov rcp rcc rsq exp log lit
std::string IluExpr(uint32_t op, const std::string& c) {
    switch (op) {
        case 1: return c;
        case 2: return "ilu_rcp(" + c + ".x)";
        case 3: return "ilu_rcc(" + c + ".x)";
        case 4: return "ilu_rsq(" + c + ".x)";
        case 5: return "ilu_exp(" + c + ".x)";
        case 6: return "ilu_log(" + c + ".x)";
        case 7: return "ilu_lit(" + c + ")";
        default: return "(float4)0";
    }
}

std::string RegDest(uint32_t r) { return r == 12 ? "oPos" : F("R%u", r); }

std::string VsInputStruct(uint16_t regs) {
    std::string s = "struct VIn {\n";
    for (int r = 0; r < 16; r++)
        if ((regs >> r) & 1) s += F("    float4 v%d : ATTR%d;\n", r, r);
    if (!regs) s += "    uint id : SV_VertexID;\n";
    return s + "};\n";
}

// the input struct and the head of main: elements read raw are finished into float4 i.vN first
std::string VsInputs(uint16_t regs, uint64_t decode) {
    if (!decode) return VsInputStruct(regs) + "VOut main(VIn i) {\n";
    std::string raw = "struct VRaw {\n", in = "struct VIn {\n", body;
    bool packed = false;
    for (int r = 0; r < 16; r++) {
        if (!((regs >> r) & 1)) continue;
        uint32_t d = uint32_t(decode >> (r * 4)) & 15;
        const char* type = d == kDecodeInt || d == kDecodeIntW1 ? "int4" : d == kDecodePacked ? "uint" : "float4";
        raw += F("    %s v%d : ATTR%d;\n", type, r, r);
        in += F("    float4 v%d;\n", r);
        packed |= d == kDecodePacked;
        switch (d) {
            case kDecodeW1: body += F("    i.v%d = float4(ri.v%d.xyz, 1);\n", r, r); break;
            case kDecodeInt: body += F("    i.v%d = float4(ri.v%d);\n", r, r); break;
            case kDecodeIntW1: body += F("    i.v%d = float4(float3(ri.v%d.xyz), 1);\n", r, r); break;
            case kDecodePacked: body += F("    i.v%d = UnpackNp3(ri.v%d);\n", r, r); break;
            case kDecodeFloat2H: body += F("    i.v%d = float4(ri.v%d.xy, 0, ri.v%d.z);\n", r, r, r); break;
            default: body += F("    i.v%d = ri.v%d;\n", r, r); break;
        }
    }
    std::string s = raw + "};\n" + in + "};\n";
    if (packed)
        s += "float4 UnpackNp3(uint u) {\n"
             "    int3 v = int3(int(u << 21) >> 21, int(u << 10) >> 21, int(u) >> 22);\n"
             "    return float4(max(float3(v) / float3(1023, 1023, 511), -1), 1);\n"
             "}\n";
    return s + "VOut main(VRaw ri) {\n    VIn i;\n" + body;
}

const char* kVsEpilogue = R"(
    VOut o;
    precise float4 p = oPos;
    p.w = magclamp(p.w);
    precise float4 q;
    // the console's pixel centres are at whole coordinates, Vulkan's at halves: everything half a console pixel
    // right and down (as xemu has it), so pieces meeting at x.5 meet without a gap, sprites sample texel for
    // texel, and full screen passes drawn from -0.5 cover the target exactly
    // the menus and HUD in their own shape on a screen of another: narrowed about x = ext.y by ext.x, and
    // shortened about y = ext.w by ext.z (src/d3d/vk/backend.cpp; set only for screen-space draws into the
    // back buffer)
    if (ext.x > 0) p.x = ext.y + (p.x - ext.y) * ext.x;
    if (ext.z > 0) p.y = ext.w + (p.y - ext.w) * ext.z;
    p.xy += 0.5;
    q.x = p.x * 2 / surf.x - 1;
    q.y = 1 - p.y * 2 / surf.y;
    q.z = p.z * surf.z;
    q.xyz *= p.w;
    q.w = p.w;
    o.pos = q;
    o.d0 = saturate(oD0);
    o.d1 = saturate(oD1);
    o.b0 = saturate(oB0);
    o.b1 = saturate(oB1);
    o.tc0 = oT0;
    o.tc1 = oT1;
    o.tc2 = oT2;
    o.tc3 = oT3;
    o.fogamt = fogfactor(oFog.x);
    return o;
}
)";

const char* kVsPrologue = R"(
    int a0 = 0;
    // precise: EQUAL depth passes need bit exact positions
    precise float4 R0 = 0, R1 = 0, R2 = 0, R3 = 0, R4 = 0, R5 = 0, R6 = 0, R7 = 0, R8 = 0, R9 = 0, R10 = 0, R11 = 0;
    precise float4 oPos = 0;
    float4 oD0 = float4(0, 0, 0, 1), oD1 = 0, oB0 = float4(0, 0, 0, 1), oB1 = 0, oFog = 0, oPts = 1;
    float4 oT0 = float4(0, 0, 0, 1), oT1 = float4(0, 0, 0, 1), oT2 = float4(0, 0, 0, 1), oT3 = float4(0, 0, 0, 1);
)";

// combiners

struct In {
    uint32_t reg, chan, mod;
};
In ParseIn(uint32_t v) { return {v & 0xF, v & 0x10, v & 0xE0}; }

struct Ps {
    const PixelKey& k;
    int stage = 0;
    std::string e, f;  // final combiner E F for EF_PROD
    bool clamp_sum = false, inv_v1 = false, inv_r0 = false;
    std::string code;

    std::string Var(uint32_t reg) {
        uint32_t flags = k.count >> 8;  // PS_COMBINERCOUNT flags: 0x10 unique C0 per stage, 0x100 unique C1
        switch (reg) {
            case 0: return "float4(0,0,0,0)";
            case 1: return F("pc[%d]", stage == 8 ? 16 : ((flags & 0x10) ? stage * 2 : 0));
            case 2: return F("pc[%d]", stage == 8 ? 17 : ((flags & 0x100) ? stage * 2 + 1 : 1));
            case 3: return "fogin";
            case 4: return "v0";
            case 5: return "v1";
            case 8: return "t0";
            case 9: return "t1";
            case 10: return "t2";
            case 11: return "t3";
            case 12: return "r0";
            case 13: return "r1";
            case 14:
                return F("%s(float4(%s.rgb + %s.rgb, 0))", clamp_sum ? "saturate" : "", inv_v1 ? "(1 - v1)" : "v1",
                         inv_r0 ? "(1 - r0)" : "r0");
            case 15: return "float4(" + e + " * " + f + ", 0)";
            default: return "float4(0,0,0,0)";
        }
    }

    std::string Input(In in, bool alpha) {
        std::string r = Var(in.reg);
        if (!alpha) r += in.chan ? ".aaa" : ".rgb";
        else r += in.chan ? ".a" : ".b";
        switch (in.mod) {
            // PS_INPUTMAPPING
            case 0x00: return "max(" + r + ", 0)";
            case 0x20: return "(1 - saturate(" + r + "))";
            case 0x40: return "(2 * max(" + r + ", 0) - 1)";
            case 0x60: return "(-2 * max(" + r + ", 0) + 1)";
            case 0x80: return "(max(" + r + ", 0) - 0.5)";
            case 0xA0: return "(-max(" + r + ", 0) + 0.5)";
            case 0xC0: return r;
            default: return "-" + r;
        }
    }

    static std::string Map(const std::string& v, uint32_t m) {
        switch (m) {
            // PS_COMBINEROUTPUT bias and shift
            case 0x08: return "(" + v + " - 0.5)";
            case 0x10: return "(" + v + " * 2)";
            case 0x18: return "((" + v + " - 0.5) * 2)";
            case 0x20: return "(" + v + " * 4)";
            case 0x30: return "(" + v + " / 2)";
            default: return v;
        }
    }

    static const char* Dest(uint32_t reg) {
        switch (reg) {
            case 4: return "v0";
            case 5: return "v1";
            case 8: return "t0";
            case 9: return "t1";
            case 10: return "t2";
            case 11: return "t3";
            case 12: return "r0";
            case 13: return "r1";
            default: return nullptr;
        }
    }

    // rgb and alpha halves read the registers before either writes, so the writes come back to the caller
    std::string Stage(uint32_t inputs, uint32_t output, bool alpha) {
        In d = ParseIn(inputs & 0xFF), c = ParseIn((inputs >> 8) & 0xFF), b = ParseIn((inputs >> 16) & 0xFF),
           a = ParseIn(inputs >> 24);
        // fl: 1 cd dot, 2 ab dot, 4 mux, 0x38 mapping, 0x40 and 0x80 blue to alpha
        uint32_t cd_dst = output & 0xF, ab_dst = (output >> 4) & 0xF, sum_dst = (output >> 8) & 0xF, fl = output >> 12;
        const char* m = alpha ? "a" : "rgb";
        const char* T = alpha ? "float" : "float3";
        const char* n = alpha ? "a" : "c";
        std::string A = Input(a, alpha), B = Input(b, alpha), C = Input(c, alpha), D = Input(d, alpha);
        std::string ab = (fl & 2) ? "dot(" + A + ", " + B + ")" : "(" + A + " * " + B + ")";
        std::string cd = (fl & 1) ? "dot(" + C + ", " + D + ")" : "(" + C + " * " + D + ")";
        uint32_t map = fl & 0x38;
        code += F("%s ab%s = clamp((%s)%s, -1, 1);\n", T, n, T, Map(ab, map).c_str());
        code += F("%s cd%s = clamp((%s)%s, -1, 1);\n", T, n, T, Map(cd, map).c_str());
        std::string sum = (fl & 4) ? F("((%s) ? (%s)%s : (%s)%s)",
                                       ((k.count >> 8) & 1) ? "r0.a >= 0.5" : "(uint(r0.a * 255) & 1) == 1", T,
                                       cd.c_str(), T, ab.c_str())
                                   : "(" + ab + " + " + cd + ")";
        code += F("%s ms%s = clamp((%s)%s, -1, 1);\n", T, n, T, Map(sum, map).c_str());
        std::string post;
        if (const char* r = Dest(ab_dst)) {
            post += F("%s.%s = ab%s;\n", r, m, n);
            if (!alpha && (fl & 0x80)) post += F("%s.a = abc.b;\n", r);
        }
        if (const char* r = Dest(cd_dst)) {
            post += F("%s.%s = cd%s;\n", r, m, n);
            if (!alpha && (fl & 0x40)) post += F("%s.a = cdc.b;\n", r);
        }
        if (const char* r = Dest(sum_dst)) post += F("%s.%s = ms%s;\n", r, m, n);
        return post;
    }
};

// a dot stage's operand: the source stage's rgb, raw or read back as signed bytes
std::string DotInput(uint32_t map, uint32_t src) {
    switch (map) {
        case 1: return F("sbyte(t%u.rgb, 128, 128, 127)", src);        // offset by 128
        case 2: return F("sbyte(t%u.rgb, -0.5, 255.5, 127.5)", src);  // two's complement, (2b + 1) / 255
        case 3: return F("sbyte(t%u.rgb, 0, 256, 127)", src);         // two's complement
        default: return F("t%u.rgb", src);
    }
}

// texture shader stage i, per its mode
std::string TexFetch(const PixelKey& k, int i) {
    uint32_t mode = (k.tex_modes >> (i * 5)) & 0x1F;
    const TexInfo& t = k.tex[i];
    uint32_t in = i == 1 ? 0 : i == 2 ? (k.input_texture >> 16) & 0xF : (k.input_texture >> 20) & 0xF;
    uint32_t dm = i == 0 ? 0 : (k.dot_mapping >> ((i - 1) * 4)) & 0xF;
    const std::string tc = F("tc%d", i);
    const char* q = tc.c_str();
    std::string norm = (t.rect ? F(" / texsize[%d].xy", i) : "") + F(" + texsize[%d].zw", i);
    auto put = [&](const std::string& v) { return F("float4 t%d = %s;\n", i, v.c_str()); };
    // dpN, or dpNn for stage N + 1's product taken early
    auto dp = [&](int n, int coord, uint32_t map, uint32_t src) {
        return F("float dp%d%s = dot(tc%d.xyz, %s);\n", n, coord == n ? "" : "n", coord, DotInput(map, src).c_str());
    };
    auto tex2d = [&](const std::string& uv) {
        if (t.flags & kTexWide) return F("spreadtap(tex%d, smp%d, %s, spread[%d], %s)", i, i, uv.c_str(), i, Hooks().ReadScale(t).c_str());
        return F("tex%d.Sample(smp%d, %s)", i, i, uv.c_str());
    };
    auto cube = [&](const std::string& dir) {
        std::string c = Hooks().Cube(t, i, dir);
        return c.empty() ? F("tex%d.Sample(smp%d, %s)", i, i, dir.c_str()) : c;
    };
    auto sample2 = [&](const std::string& uv) {
        if (t.kind == kTex2D) return tex2d(F("(%s)%s", uv.c_str(), norm.c_str()));
        if (t.kind == kTexCube) return cube("float3(" + uv + ", 1)");
        if (t.kind == kTex3D) return F("tex%d.Sample(smp%d, float3(%s, 0))", i, i, uv.c_str());
        return std::string("float4(0,0,0,1)");
    };
    auto sample3 = [&](const std::string& uvw) {
        if (t.kind == kTex2D) return tex2d(F("(%s).xy%s", uvw.c_str(), norm.c_str()));
        if (t.kind == kTexCube) return cube(uvw);
        if (t.kind == kTex3D) return F("tex%d.Sample(smp%d, %s)", i, i, uvw.c_str());
        return std::string("float4(0,0,0,1)");
    };
    auto depth = [&](const std::string& ref) {
        return put(F("shadow(tex%d, smp%d, (%s.xy / %s.w)%s, %s, %d, i.pos.xy, texsize[%d].xy)", i, i, q, q, norm.c_str(), ref.c_str(),
                     t.shadow, i));
    };
    std::string s;
    switch (mode) {
        // PS_TEXTUREMODES: 1 project2d, 2 project3d, 3 cubemap, 4 passthru, 5 clipplane, 6 and 7 bumpenvmap, 9 dot_st, 0xA dot_zw, 0xD dot_str_3d, 0xE dot_str_cube, 0xF dpndnt_ar, 0x10 dpndnt_gb, 0x11 dotproduct
        case 0: return put("float4(0,0,0,1)");
        case 1: return t.shadow ? depth("0") : put(sample2(F("%s.xy / %s.w", q, q)));
        case 2: return t.shadow ? depth(F("%s.z / %s.w", q, q)) : put(sample3(F("%s.xyz / %s.w", q, q)));
        case 3: return put(sample3(tc + ".xyz"));
        case 4: return put(tc);
        case 5:  // clip plane: a set compare_mode bit kills at >= 0, a clear one below 0
            s = put("0");
            for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) s += F("if (%s.%c %s 0) discard;\n", q, "xyzw"[j], ((k.compare_mode >> (i * 4 + j)) & 1) ? ">=" : "<");
            return s;
        case 6:
        case 7:  // bump env map: signed du dv through the 2x2 matrix, 7 scales by luminance
            s = (k.tex[in].flags & kTexSigned) ? F("float2 duv%d = max((t%u.bg * 255 - 128) / 127, -1);\n", i, in)
                                               : F("float2 duv%d = sbyte(t%u.bgr, 0, 256, 127).xy;\n", i, in);
            s += put(sample2(F("%s.xy + float2(dot(bumpmat[%d].xz, duv%d), dot(bumpmat[%d].yw, duv%d))", q, i, i, i, i)));
            if (mode == 7) s += F("t%d *= bumplum[%d].x * t%u.r + bumplum[%d].y;\n", i, i, in, i);
            return s;
        case 9: return dp(i, i, dm, in) + put(sample2(F("float2(dp%d, dp%d)", i - 1, i)));
        case 0xA:
        case 0x11: return dp(i, i, dm, in) + put("0");
        case 0xB:  // reflect diffuse at stage 2: stage 3's product early for the normal
            s = dp(i, i, dm, in) + dp(i, i + 1, (k.dot_mapping >> 8) & 0xF, (k.input_texture >> 20) & 0xF);
            return s + put(sample3(F("float3(dp%d, dp%d, dp%dn)", i - 1, i, i)));
        case 0xC:  // reflect specular at stage 3: eye from the three w
            s = dp(i, i, dm, in);
            s += F("float3 nrm%d = float3(dp%d, dp%d, dp%d), eye%d = float3(tc%d.w, tc%d.w, tc%d.w);\n", i, i - 2, i - 1, i, i, i - 2,
                   i - 1, i);
            s += F("float3 refl%d = 2 * nrm%d * dot(nrm%d, eye%d) / dot(nrm%d, nrm%d) - eye%d;\n", i, i, i, i, i, i, i);
            return s + put(sample3(F("refl%d", i)));
        case 0xD:
        case 0xE: return dp(i, i, dm, in) + put(sample3(F("float3(dp%d, dp%d, dp%d)", i - 2, i - 1, i)));
        case 0xF: return put(sample2(F("t%u.ar", in)));
        case 0x10: return put(sample2(F("t%u.gb", in)));
        default: return put("0");
    }
}

const char* kPsSbyte = R"(
// unorm to byte b, less lo under 128 or hi from 128, over d
float3 sbyte(float3 u, float lo, float hi, float d) { float3 b = u * 255; return (b - (b >= 128 ? hi : lo)) / d; }
)";
const char* kPsTail = R"(float4 spreadtap(Texture2D t, SamplerState s, float2 uv, float4 w, float m) {
    float4 c = 0;
    int n = (int)w.z;
    for (int y = 0; y < n; y++)
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            float4 v = t.SampleLevel(s, uv + w.xy * (float2(x, y) - (n - 1) * 0.5), 0);
            c += float4(saturate(v.rgb * m), v.a);
        }
    return c / (n * n);
}
void alphatest(float a) {
    int f = (int)misc.y;
    int v = (int)round(a * 255), r = (int)misc.x;
    bool ok = f == 0 ? false : f == 1 ? v < r : f == 2 ? v == r : f == 3 ? v <= r : f == 4 ? v > r : f == 5 ? v != r : f == 6 ? v >= r : true;
    if (!ok) discard;
}
)";

std::string PsHelpers() { return kPsSbyte + Hooks().Shadow() + kPsTail; }

// fixed function texture stage arguments, D3DTA
std::string FfArg(uint32_t a, int stage, bool alpha) {
    std::string v;
    switch (a & 0xF) {
        case 0: v = "v0"; break;
        case 1: v = "cur"; break;
        case 2: v = F("t%d", stage); break;
        case 3: v = "tfactor"; break;
        case 4: v = "v1"; break;
        case 5: v = "tmp"; break;
        default: v = "cur"; break;
    }
    if (a & 0x20) v = "(" + v + ").aaaa";
    if (a & 0x10) v = "(1 - " + v + ")";
    return "(" + v + ")" + (alpha ? ".a" : ".rgb");
}

// D3DTOP
std::string FfOp(uint32_t op, const std::string& a1, const std::string& a2, const std::string& a0, int stage, bool alpha) {
    switch (op) {
        case 2: return a1;
        case 3: return a2;
        case 4: return a1 + " * " + a2;
        case 5: return a1 + " * " + a2 + " * 2";
        case 6: return a1 + " * " + a2 + " * 4";
        case 7: return a1 + " + " + a2;
        case 8: return a1 + " + " + a2 + " - 0.5";
        case 9: return "(" + a1 + " + " + a2 + " - 0.5) * 2";
        case 10: return a1 + " - " + a2;
        case 11: return a1 + " + " + a2 + " * (1 - " + a1 + ")";
        case 12: return "lerp(" + a2 + ", " + a1 + ", v0.a)";
        case 13: return "lerp(" + a2 + ", " + a1 + ", cur.a)";
        case 14: return F("lerp(%s, %s, t%d.a)", a2.c_str(), a1.c_str(), stage);
        case 15: return "lerp(" + a2 + ", " + a1 + ", tfactor.a)";
        case 16: return F("%s + %s * (1 - t%d.a)", a1.c_str(), a2.c_str(), stage);
        case 18: return alpha ? a1 : a1 + " + " + a2 + " * " + a1.substr(0, a1.size() - 4) + ".a";
        case 19: return alpha ? a1 : a1 + " * " + a2 + " + " + a1.substr(0, a1.size() - 4) + ".a";
        case 20: return alpha ? a1 : a1 + " + " + a2 + " * (1 - " + a1.substr(0, a1.size() - 4) + ".a)";
        case 21: return alpha ? a1 : "(1 - " + a1 + ") * " + a2 + " + " + a1.substr(0, a1.size() - 4) + ".a";
        case 22: return F("saturate(dot((%s - 0.5) * 2, (%s - 0.5) * 2))", alpha ? ("float3(" + a1 + ",0,0)").c_str() : a1.c_str(),
                          alpha ? ("float3(" + a2 + ",0,0)").c_str() : a2.c_str());
        case 23: return a0 + " + " + a1 + " * " + a2;
        case 24: return "lerp(" + a2 + ", " + a1 + ", " + a0 + ")";
        default: return alpha ? "cur.a" : "cur.rgb";
    }
}

}  // namespace

bool PixelKey::operator==(const PixelKey& o) const { return std::memcmp(this, &o, sizeof(*this)) == 0; }

std::string ShaderHooks::Constants() const { return "    float4 ext;\n"; }

std::string ShaderHooks::Shadow() const {
    return R"(// the sampler compares, a linear filter blends the four results like the console does
float4 shadow(Texture2D<float> t, SamplerComparisonState s, float2 uv, float z, int fmt, float2 px, float2 size) {
    float mx = fmt == 2 ? 65535.0 : 16777215.0;
    return t.SampleCmpLevelZero(s, uv, clamp(z, 0, mx) / mx).xxxx;
}
)";
}

std::string ShaderHooks::Output() const { return "outc.rgb = saturate(outc.rgb);\n"; }

uint64_t Hash(const void* p, size_t n, uint64_t h) {
    // 16 bytes a step through a 64 x 64 -> 128 bit multiply: it runs over textures every frame and keys every draw
    constexpr uint64_t k0 = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull, k1 = 0xE7037ED1A0B428DBull;
    auto mix = [](uint64_t a, uint64_t b) {
        unsigned __int128 r = static_cast<unsigned __int128>(a) * b;
        return uint64_t(r) ^ uint64_t(r >> 64);
    };
    const uint8_t* b = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(p);
    uint64_t seed = h ^ k0;
    size_t i = 0;
    for (; i + 16 <= n; i += 16) {
        uint64_t x, y;
        std::memcpy(&x, b + i, 8);
        std::memcpy(&y, b + i + 8, 8);
        seed = mix(x ^ k1, y ^ seed);
    }
    if (size_t r = n - i) {
        uint64_t x = 0, y = 0;
        if (r >= 8) {
            std::memcpy(&x, b + i, 8);
            std::memcpy(&y, b + n - 8, 8);
        } else {
            std::memcpy(&x, b + i, r);
        }
        seed = mix(x ^ k1, y ^ seed ^ r);
    }
    return mix(seed ^ k0, uint64_t(n) ^ k1);
}

PixelKey MakePixelKey(const State& s, const TexInfo tex[4]) {
    PixelKey k;
    std::memset(&k, 0, sizeof(k));
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        k.tex[i] = tex[i];
        if (s.tss[size_t(i)][kTssAlphaKill] == 4) k.alphakill |= 1u << i;  // D3DTALPHAKILL_ENABLE
    }
    k.flat = s.simple[kMShadeMode >> 2] == 0x1D00;  // D3DSHADE_FLAT
    k.two_sided = s.rs[kRsTwoSidedLighting] != 0;
    if (s.ps) {
        const uint32_t* d = s.ps->def;
        k.programmable = 1;
        // D3DPIXELSHADERDEF dwords: alpha inputs 0, final 8 and 9, alpha outputs 26, rgb inputs 34, compare mode 42, rgb outputs 45, count 53, dot mapping 55, input texture 56
        k.count = d[53];
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            k.a_in[i] = d[i];
            k.a_out[i] = d[26 + i];
            k.rgb_in[i] = d[34 + i];
            k.rgb_out[i] = d[45 + i];
        }
        k.final_abcd = d[8];
        k.final_efg = d[9];
        // the stage modes follow the bound textures, as D3D's lazy shader stage setup does
        uint32_t modes = s.rs[kRsPsTextureModes];
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            uint32_t m = (modes >> (i * 5)) & 0x1F;
            const TexInfo& t = tex[i];
            if (!t.kind && m != 4 && m != 5 && m != 0xA && m != 0x11) m = 0;
            else if (m >= 1 && m <= 3) m = t.kind == kTexCube ? 3 : (t.kind == kTex3D || t.shadow) ? 2 : 1;
            else if (m == 0xD || m == 0xE) m = t.kind == kTexCube ? 0xE : 0xD;
            k.tex_modes |= m << (i * 5);
        }
        k.dot_mapping = d[55];
        k.input_texture = d[56];
        k.compare_mode = d[42];
        return k;
    }
    // the console's stages divide by q; a vertex program's q is its own
    bool program = (s.vs_handle & 1) && s.vs && !s.vs->program.empty();
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const auto& t = s.tss[size_t(i)];
        uint32_t v[9] = {t[kTssColorOp], t[kTssColorArg1], t[kTssColorArg2], t[kTssColorArg0], t[kTssAlphaOp],
                         t[kTssAlphaArg1],  t[kTssAlphaArg2], t[kTssAlphaArg0], t[kTssResultArg]};
        std::memcpy(k.ff[i], v, sizeof(v));
        if (program || (t[kTssTextureTransformFlags] & 0x100)) k.proj |= 1u << i;  // D3DTTFF_PROJECTED
        if (t[kTssColorOp] <= 1) break;
    }
    return k;
}

std::string VertexProgramHlsl(const std::vector<uint32_t>& prog, uint16_t regs, uint64_t decode) {
    std::string s = Common();
    s += kVsHelpers;
    s += VsInputs(regs, decode);
    s += kVsPrologue;
    for (size_t n = 0; n + 4 <= prog.size(); n += 4) {
        Tok k{&prog[n]};
        uint32_t mac = k.f(1, 21, 4), ilu = k.f(1, 25, 3);
        if (mac || ilu) {
            std::string a = Src(k, 0, regs), b = Src(k, 1, regs), c = Src(k, 2, regs);
            s += "    {\n";
            if (mac) s += "        precise float4 mr = " + MacExpr(mac, a, b, c) + ";\n";
            if (ilu) s += "        precise float4 ir = " + IluExpr(ilu, c) + ";\n";
            uint32_t r = k.f(3, 20, 4), omask = k.f(3, 12, 4);
            if (mac == 13) {
                s += "        a0 = mac_arl(mr.x);\n";
            } else if (mac) {
                uint32_t m = k.f(3, 24, 4);
                if (ilu && r == 1) m = 0;
                if (m && r <= 12) s += F("        %s.%s = mr.%s;\n", RegDest(r).c_str(), kMask[m], kMask[m]);
            }
            if (ilu) {
                uint32_t m = k.f(3, 16, 4), ir = mac ? 1 : r;
                if (m && ir <= 12) s += F("        %s.%s = ir.%s;\n", RegDest(ir).c_str(), kMask[m], kMask[m]);
            }
            bool use_ilu = k.f(3, 2, 1) == 1;
            if (omask && k.f(3, 11, 1) && ((use_ilu && ilu) || (!use_ilu && mac && mac != 13))) {
                uint32_t o = k.f(3, 3, 8) & 0xF;
                const char* src = use_ilu ? "ir" : "mr";
                if (kOut[o][0]) {
                    const char* msk = o == 5 ? kLanes[std::popcount(omask)] : kMask[omask];
                    s += F("        %s.%s = %s.%s;\n", kOut[o], msk, src, msk);
                }
            }
            s += "    }\n";
        }
        if (k.f(3, 0, 1)) break;  // last instruction
    }
    s += kVsEpilogue;
    return s;
}

FixedKey MakeFixedKey(const State& s) {
    FixedKey f;
    if (s.rs[kRsLighting]) {
        f.light = 1 | (s.rs[kRsSpecularEnable] ? 2 : 0) | (s.rs[kRsLocalViewer] ? 4 : 0) | (s.rs[kRsNormalizeNormals] ? 8 : 0);
        if (s.rs[kRsColorVertex])
            f.light |= (s.rs[kRsDiffuseMaterialSource] & 3) << 8 | (s.rs[kRsSpecularMaterialSource] & 3) << 10 |
                       (s.rs[kRsAmbientMaterialSource] & 3) << 12 | (s.rs[kRsEmissiveMaterialSource] & 3) << 14;
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
            if ((s.light_enable >> i) & 1) f.types |= (s.lights[size_t(i)][0] & 3) << (i * 2);
    }
    for (int t = 0; t < 4; t++) {
        uint32_t tci = s.tss[size_t(t)][kTssTexCoordIndex], ttf = s.tss[size_t(t)][kTssTextureTransformFlags];
        uint32_t set = tci & 3, size = 2;
        if (s.vs && (s.vs_handle & 1)) {
            uint32_t ty = s.vs->inputs[9 + set].type;
            size = ty == 0x16 ? 3 : std::min<uint32_t>(ty >> 4, 4);  // 0x16 NORMPACKED3
            if (ty >> 4 > 4) size = 3;
            if (!size) size = 2;
        } else {
            uint32_t code = (s.vs_handle >> (16 + set * 2)) & 3;
            size = code == 0 ? 2 : code == 1 ? 3 : code == 2 ? 4 : 1;
        }
        f.tex[t] = set | ((tci >> 16) & 7) << 4 | (ttf & 7) << 8 | (ttf & 0x100 ? 0x800 : 0) | size << 12;
    }
    f.blend = s.rs[kRsVertexBlend] <= 6 ? s.rs[kRsVertexBlend] : 0;
    return f;
}

// D3D's fixed function vertex pipeline: transform, lighting in view space, texture coordinate generation and transforms
std::string FixedVertexHlsl(uint16_t regs, bool pretransformed, uint64_t decode, const FixedKey& f) {
    std::string s = Common();
    s += kVsHelpers;
    s += VsInputs(regs, decode);
    s += kVsPrologue;
    auto v = [&](int r, const char* def) { return (regs >> r) & 1 ? F("i.v%d", r) : std::string(def); };
    bool lit = !pretransformed && (f.light & 1);
    if (pretransformed) {
        s += "    float4 rhw = " + v(0, "float4(0,0,0,1)") + ";\n";
        s += "    float w = rhw.w == 0 ? 1 : 1 / rhw.w;\n";
        s += "    oPos = float4(rhw.xy, rhw.z / surf.z, w);\n";
    } else if (f.blend) {
        // vertex blending (skinned characters): position and normal through world matrices 0-3 in view
        // space, weighted by v1; modes 1, 3, 5 give one weight fewer than matrices, the last 1 - the rest
        bool mix = f.blend & 1;
        int count = mix ? int(f.blend + 3) / 2 : int(f.blend / 2 + 1);
        s += "    float4 ip = float4(" + v(0, "float4(0,0,0,1)") + ".xyz, 1);\n";
        s += "    float4 bw = " + v(1, "float4(0,0,0,0)") + ";\n";
        s += "    float4 in_n = float4(" + v(2, "float4(0,0,0,0)") + ".xyz, 0);\n";
        s += "    float3 vp = 0, vn = 0;\n";
        if (mix) s += "    float wl = 1;\n";
        for (int m = 0; m < count; m++) {
            std::string w = !mix || m < count - 1 ? F("bw[%d]", m) : std::string("wl");
            if (mix && m < count - 1) s += F("    wl -= bw[%d];\n", m);
            s += F("    vp += mul(ip, wvb[%d]).xyz * %s;\n", m, w.c_str());
            s += F("    vn += mul(in_n, wvbn[%d]).xyz * %s;\n", m, w.c_str());
        }
        s += "    float4 cp = mul(float4(vp, 1), pv);\n";
        if (f.light & 8) s += "    vn = dot(vn, vn) > 0 ? normalize(vn) : vn;\n";
    } else {
        s += "    float4 ip = float4(" + v(0, "float4(0,0,0,1)") + ".xyz, 1);\n";
        s += "    float4 cp = mul(ip, wvp);\n";
        s += "    float3 vp = mul(ip, wv).xyz;\n";
        s += "    float3 vn = mul(float4(" + v(2, "float4(0,0,0,0)") + ".xyz, 0), wvn).xyz;\n";
        if (f.light & 8) s += "    vn = dot(vn, vn) > 0 ? normalize(vn) : vn;\n";
    }
    if (lit) {
        // D3DMCS: 1 the vertex diffuse, 2 its specular, else the material
        auto src = [&](int field, const char* mat) {
            uint32_t m = (f.light >> (8 + field * 2)) & 3;
            if (m == 1 && ((regs >> 3) & 1)) return std::string("i.v3");
            if (m == 2 && ((regs >> 4) & 1)) return std::string("i.v4");
            return std::string(mat);
        };
        s += "    float4 md = " + src(0, "mat[0]") + ", ms = " + src(1, "mat[2]") + ", ma = " + src(2, "mat[1]") +
             ", me = " + src(3, "mat[3]") + ";\n";
        s += "    float3 la = 0, ld = 0, ls = 0;\n";
        // towards the viewer: the camera looks down +z here, so a viewer at infinity is at -z (with +z the
        // highlights faced away from the camera and all but vanished, #22)
        s += (f.light & 4) ? "    float3 eye = -normalize(vp);\n" : "    float3 eye = float3(0, 0, -1);\n";
        for (int n = 0; n < 8; n++) {
            uint32_t type = (f.types >> (n * 2)) & 3;  // D3DLIGHTTYPE: 1 point, 2 spot, 3 directional
            if (!type) continue;
            int b = n * 7;
            s += "    {\n        float3 l;\n        float att = 1;\n";
            if (type == 3) {
                s += F("        l = -normalize(lt[%d].xyz);\n", b + 4);
            } else {
                s += F("        float3 d = lt[%d].xyz - vp;\n        float dist = length(d);\n        l = d / max(dist, 1e-6);\n", b + 3);
                s += F("        att = dist > lt[%d].w ? 0 : 1 / max(lt[%d].x + lt[%d].y * dist + lt[%d].z * dist * dist, 1e-6);\n", b + 3, b + 5,
                       b + 5, b + 5);
                if (type == 2) {
                    s += F("        float rho = dot(-l, normalize(lt[%d].xyz));\n", b + 4);
                    s += F("        att *= rho > lt[%d].x ? 1 : rho <= lt[%d].y ? 0 : pow(saturate((rho - lt[%d].y) / (lt[%d].x - lt[%d].y)), lt[%d].w);\n",
                           b + 6, b + 6, b + 6, b + 6, b + 6, b + 4);
                }
            }
            s += F("        la += att * lt[%d].rgb;\n", b + 2);
            s += "        float nl = dot(vn, l);\n";
            s += F("        ld += att * lt[%d].rgb * max(nl, 0);\n", b);
            if (f.light & 2) s += F("        if (nl > 0) ls += att * lt[%d].rgb * pow(max(dot(vn, normalize(l + eye)), 0), mat[4].x);\n", b + 1);
            s += "    }\n";
        }
        s += "    oD0 = float4(me.rgb + ma.rgb * (amb.rgb + la) + md.rgb * ld, md.a);\n";
        s += (f.light & 2) ? "    oD1 = float4(ms.rgb * ls, ms.a);\n" : "    oD1 = float4(0,0,0,0);\n";
    } else {
        s += "    oD0 = " + v(3, "float4(1,1,1,1)") + ";\n";
        s += "    oD1 = " + v(4, "float4(0,0,0,0)") + ";\n";
    }
    s += "    oB0 = oD0;\n    oB1 = oD1;\n";
    for (int t = 0; t < 4; t++) {
        uint32_t u = f.tex[t], set = u & 3, gen = (u >> 4) & 7, count = (u >> 8) & 7, size = (u >> 12) & 7;
        std::string in = v(9 + int(set), "float4(0,0,0,1)");
        if (pretransformed || (!gen && !count)) {
            s += F("    oT%d = %s;\n", t, in.c_str());
            continue;
        }
        // generated coordinates are view space; a transform takes the set with 1 after its last element
        std::string c = gen == 1 ? "float4(vn, 1)" : gen == 2 ? "float4(vp, 1)" : gen == 3 ? "float4(reflect(normalize(vp), vn), 1)"
                        : size == 1 ? F("float4(%s.x, 1, 0, 0)", in.c_str()) : size == 2 ? F("float4(%s.xy, 1, 0)", in.c_str())
                        : size == 3 ? F("float4(%s.xyz, 1)", in.c_str()) : in;
        if (!count) {
            s += F("    oT%d = %s;\n", t, c.c_str());
            continue;
        }
        s += F("    {\n        float4 tc = mul(%s, tm[%d]);\n", c.c_str(), t);
        if (u & 0x800) s += F("        oT%d = float4(tc.xy, tc.z, tc[%u]);\n", t, std::min<uint32_t>(count, 4) - 1);
        else s += F("        oT%d = float4(tc.xy, %s, 1);\n", t, count >= 3 ? "tc.z" : "0");
        s += "    }\n";
    }
    s += "    oFog = " + v(5, "float4(0,0,0,0)") + ";\n";
    if (pretransformed) return s + kVsEpilogue;
    s += R"(
    VOut o;
    o.pos = cp;   // (half a console pixel right and down already: in wvp)
    o.d0 = saturate(oD0);
    o.d1 = saturate(oD1);
    o.b0 = o.d0;
    o.b1 = o.d1;
    o.tc0 = oT0;
    o.tc1 = oT1;
    o.tc2 = oT2;
    o.tc3 = oT3;
    o.fogamt = fogfactor(abs(cp.z));
    return o;
}
)";
    return s;
}

std::string PixelHlsl(const PixelKey& k) {
    std::string s = Common();
    s += PsHelpers();
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const TexInfo& t = k.tex[i];
        const char* type = t.shadow ? "Texture2D<float>" : t.kind == kTex3D ? "Texture3D" : t.kind == kTexCube ? "TextureCube" : "Texture2D";
        s += F("%s tex%d : register(t%d);\n%s smp%d : register(s%d);\n", type, i, i, t.shadow ? "SamplerComparisonState" : "SamplerState", i, i);
    }
    s += F("float4 main(VOut i, bool front : SV_IsFrontFace) : SV_Target {\n");
    s += "    float4 tc0 = i.tc0, tc1 = i.tc1, tc2 = i.tc2, tc3 = i.tc3;\n";
    s += k.two_sided ? "    float4 v0 = front ? i.d0 : i.b0, v1 = front ? i.d1 : i.b1;\n" : "    float4 v0 = i.d0, v1 = i.d1;\n";
    s += "    if (misc.w == 0) v1 = float4(0, 0, 0, 1);\n";
    s += "    float4 fogin = float4(fogcolor.rgb, saturate(i.fogamt));\n";
    std::string body;
    if (k.programmable) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            body += TexFetch(k, i);
            body += Hooks().Fetched(k.tex[i], i);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            uint32_t m = (k.tex_modes >> (i * 5)) & 0x1F;
            bool fetch = m && m != 4 && m != 5 && m != 0xA && m != 0x11;
            if (fetch && ((k.alphakill >> i) & 1)) body += F("if (t%d.a == 0) discard;\n", i);
        }
        uint32_t mode0 = k.tex_modes & 0x1F;
        body += F("float4 r0 = float4(0, 0, 0, %s), r1 = 0;\n", mode0 ? "t0.a" : "1");
        Ps ps{k};
        uint32_t n = std::min<uint32_t>(k.count & 0xFF, 8);
        for (uint32_t st = 0; st < n; st++) {
            ps.stage = int(st);
            ps.code += "{\n";
            std::string wc = ps.Stage(k.rgb_in[st], k.rgb_out[st], false);
            std::string wa = ps.Stage(k.a_in[st], k.a_out[st], true);
            ps.code += wc + wa + "}\n";
        }
        body += ps.code;
        if (k.final_abcd || k.final_efg) {
            ps.stage = 8;
            uint32_t fl = k.final_efg & 0xFF;
            ps.clamp_sum = fl & 0x80;
            ps.inv_v1 = fl & 0x40;
            ps.inv_r0 = fl & 0x20;
            ps.e = ps.Input(ParseIn(k.final_efg >> 24), false);
            ps.f = ps.Input(ParseIn((k.final_efg >> 16) & 0xFF), false);
            std::string A = ps.Input(ParseIn(k.final_abcd >> 24), false), B = ps.Input(ParseIn((k.final_abcd >> 16) & 0xFF), false),
                        C = ps.Input(ParseIn((k.final_abcd >> 8) & 0xFF), false), D = ps.Input(ParseIn(k.final_abcd & 0xFF), false),
                        G = ps.Input(ParseIn((k.final_efg >> 8) & 0xFF), true);
            body += "float4 outc;\n";
            body += "outc.rgb = " + D + " + lerp(" + C + ", " + B + ", " + A + ");\n";
            body += "outc.a = " + G + ";\n";
        } else {
            body += "float4 outc = float4(lerp(fogin.rgb, r0.rgb, fogin.a), r0.a);\n";
        }
    } else {
        body += "float4 cur = v0, tmp = 0;\n";
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            const uint32_t* f = k.ff[i];
            if (f[0] <= 1) break;
            const TexInfo& t = k.tex[i];
            // a stage reading a texture with none bound is off, as the console's D3D sets up its combiners:
            // the game's fades are drawn TEXTURE x TFACTOR without a texture, and show their vertex colour.
            // Only the arguments its operations read count: a leftover TEXTURE in one SELECTARG2 ignores
            // turned the stage, and the alpha it does compute, on and off as attacks changed that slot --
            // windows and candles flickering (#48, found by HammerD72). Ops: 2 arg1, 3 arg2, 23-24 arg0
            // too, 14 and 16 the texture's alpha, the rest arg1 and arg2.
            auto reads_tex = [&](int base) {
                uint32_t op = f[base];
                auto is_tex = [&](int j) { return (f[base + j] & 0xF) == 2; };
                if (op <= 1) return false;
                if (op == 2) return is_tex(1);
                if (op == 3) return is_tex(2);
                if (op == 14 || op == 16) return true;
                return is_tex(1) || is_tex(2) || ((op == 23 || op == 24) && is_tex(3));
            };
            if (!t.kind && (reads_tex(0) || reads_tex(4)))
                break;
            std::string norm = (t.rect ? F(" / texsize[%d].xy", i) : "") + F(" + texsize[%d].zw", i);
            std::string uv = (k.proj >> i) & 1 ? F("(tc%d.xy / tc%d.w)%s", i, i, norm.c_str()) : F("tc%d.xy%s", i, norm.c_str());
            std::string cube;
            if (t.shadow)
                body += F("float4 t%d = shadow(tex%d, smp%d, (tc%d.xy / tc%d.w)%s, tc%d.z / tc%d.w, %d, i.pos.xy, texsize[%d].xy);\n", i, i,
                          i, i, i, norm.c_str(), i, i, t.shadow, i);
            else if (t.kind == kTex2D && (t.flags & kTexWide))
                body += F("float4 t%d = spreadtap(tex%d, smp%d, %s, spread[%d], %s);\n", i, i, i, uv.c_str(), i, Hooks().ReadScale(t).c_str());
            else if (t.kind == kTex2D) body += F("float4 t%d = tex%d.Sample(smp%d, %s);\n", i, i, i, uv.c_str());
            else if (t.kind == kTexCube && !(cube = Hooks().Cube(t, i, F("tc%d.xyz", i))).empty()) body += F("float4 t%d = %s;\n", i, cube.c_str());
            else if (t.kind) body += F("float4 t%d = tex%d.Sample(smp%d, tc%d.xyz);\n", i, i, i, i);
            else body += F("float4 t%d = float4(1,1,1,1);\n", i);
            body += Hooks().Fetched(t, i);
            if ((k.alphakill >> i) & 1) body += F("if (t%d.a == 0) discard;\n", i);
            const char* dst = f[8] == 5 ? "tmp" : "cur";
            std::string rgb = FfOp(f[0], FfArg(f[1], i, false), FfArg(f[2], i, false), FfArg(f[3], i, false), i, false);
            std::string a = f[4] <= 1 ? std::string("cur.a") : FfOp(f[4], FfArg(f[5], i, true), FfArg(f[6], i, true), FfArg(f[7], i, true), i, true);
            body += F("{ float3 c3 = saturate(%s); float c1 = saturate(%s); %s = float4(c3, c1); }\n", rgb.c_str(), a.c_str(), dst);
        }
        body += "cur.rgb = saturate(cur.rgb + v1.rgb);\n";
        body += "float4 outc = float4(lerp(fogin.rgb, cur.rgb, fogin.a), cur.a);\n";
    }
    body += "alphatest(outc.a);\n" + Hooks().Output() + "return outc;\n}\n";
    s += body;
    return k.quad ? QuadHlsl(std::move(s)) : s;
}

// A point list's vertex shader (#51): Vulkan draws a point only as large as the shader says, so the
// size D3D gives -- D3DRS_POINTSIZE, scaled with the distance when D3DRS_POINTSCALEENABLE is on, in the
// console's pixels -- goes out in the render scale's, with the point's centre and size for a sprite's
// pixel shader. kind: 0 a vertex program (its oPts), 1 fixed function (vp in view space), 2 pretransformed.
// The fixed function sizes come in c[190] (size, min, max, scaling on) and c[191] (A, B, C, viewport
// height), registers its draws leave unused.
std::string PointHlsl(std::string s, int kind) {
    auto put = [&](const char* at, const std::string& add, bool before) {
        size_t i = s.find(at);
        if (i != std::string::npos) s.insert(before ? i : i + std::strlen(at), add);
    };
    put("    float fogamt : TEXCOORD4;\n", "    [[vk::builtin(\"PointSize\")]] float psize : PSIZE;\n    float4 ptc : TEXCOORD5;\n", false);
    std::string size;
    if (kind == 0) {
        size = "    float psz = oPts.x;\n";
    } else {
        size = "    float psz = c[190].x;\n";
        if (kind == 1)   // D3D: Vh * size * sqrt(1 / (A + B De + C De^2)), De the distance from the eye
            size += "    if (c[190].w != 0) psz *= c[191].w * rsqrt(max(c[191].x + c[191].y * length(vp) + c[191].z * dot(vp, vp), 1e-20));\n";
        size += "    psz = clamp(psz, c[190].y, c[190].z);\n";
    }
    size += "    o.psize = max(psz * surf.w, 1);\n    o.ptc = float4(p.xy * surf.w, o.psize, 0);\n";
    put("    o.fogamt = fogfactor(oFog.x);\n    return o;\n", size, true);
    return s;
}

// A point sprite's pixel shader: every stage's coordinates run 0 to 1 across the point, top left first.
std::string SpriteHlsl(std::string s) {
    size_t i = s.find("    float fogamt : TEXCOORD4;\n");
    if (i != std::string::npos) s.insert(i + std::strlen("    float fogamt : TEXCOORD4;\n"), "    float4 ptc : TEXCOORD5;\n");
    const char* tc = "    float4 tc0 = i.tc0, tc1 = i.tc1, tc2 = i.tc2, tc3 = i.tc3;\n";
    i = s.find(tc);
    if (i != std::string::npos)
        s.replace(i, std::strlen(tc), "    float4 spr = float4((i.pos.xy - i.ptc.xy) / i.ptc.z + 0.5, 0, 1);\n"
                                      "    float4 tc0 = spr, tc1 = spr, tc2 = spr, tc3 = spr;\n");
    return s;
}

std::string QuadHlsl(std::string s) {
    // Full screen passes once had their far edges pulled out half a pixel, and their texture coordinates
    // put back; with the console's pixel centres kept (the vertex epilogue) they cover the target as drawn.
    return s;
}
}  // namespace gpu
```

`src/d3d/gpu/shaders.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "gpu/state.h"

// HLSL for the title's shaders and for its fixed function state, per the XDK's definitions of both
namespace gpu {

enum TexKind : uint8_t { kTexNone, kTex2D, kTex3D, kTexCube };

struct TexInfo {
    uint8_t kind = kTexNone;
    uint8_t rect = 0;    // linear texture, coordinates in texels
    uint8_t shadow = 0;  // depth texture: 1 D24, 2 D16
    uint8_t flags = 0;   // kTexWide; bits 0 and 1 are a backend extension's
};
enum : uint8_t {
    kTexWide = 4,  // an upscaled target shrunk by the pass: each tap averaged over console texels
    kTexSigned = 8,  // a bump map read from its offset binary copy: b g are du dv + 128 (in bytes)
};

struct PixelKey {
    uint32_t programmable = 0;
    // combiners, straight from D3DPIXELSHADERDEF
    uint32_t count = 0, rgb_in[8] = {}, rgb_out[8] = {}, a_in[8] = {}, a_out[8] = {}, final_abcd = 0, final_efg = 0;
    uint32_t tex_modes = 0, dot_mapping = 0, input_texture = 0, compare_mode = 0;
    // fixed function stages: colorop, arg1, arg2, arg0, alphaop, arg1, arg2, arg0, result
    uint32_t ff[4][9] = {};
    TexInfo tex[4];
    uint32_t alphakill = 0;  // bit per stage
    uint32_t flat = 0, two_sided = 0;
    uint32_t proj = 0;       // fixed function: bit per stage sampled at coordinates divided by w
    uint32_t quad = 0;       // a screen quad: QuadHlsl
    bool operator==(const PixelKey& o) const;
};

uint64_t Hash(const void* p, size_t n, uint64_t h = 1469598103934665603ull);

PixelKey MakePixelKey(const State& s, const TexInfo tex[4]);

// vertex program microcode to HLSL, regs is the bit mask of v registers the draw supplies
// decode: VertexDecode per register, 4 bits each, for elements the input assembler hands over raw
std::string VertexProgramHlsl(const std::vector<uint32_t>& program, uint16_t regs, uint64_t decode = 0);
// fixed function vertex state a shader is built for
struct FixedKey {
    uint32_t light = 0;    // bit 0 lighting, 1 specular, 2 local viewer, 3 normalize, then D3DMCS 2 bits each from bit 8:
                           // diffuse, specular, ambient, emissive (material when the vertex lacks that colour)
    uint32_t types = 0;    // D3DLIGHTTYPE per light, 2 bits each, 0 off
    uint32_t tex[4] = {};  // per stage: coordinate set, texgen at bit 4, D3DTTFF count at bit 8, projected bit 11, set size at bit 12
    uint32_t blend = 0;    // D3DVERTEXBLENDFLAGS (the NV2A skin mode): 1, 3, 5 n weights for n + 1 matrices, the last
                           // 1 - the others; 2, 4, 6 a weight for each of 2, 3, 4 matrices
};
FixedKey MakeFixedKey(const State& s);
std::string FixedVertexHlsl(uint16_t regs, bool pretransformed, uint64_t decode = 0, const FixedKey& f = {});
std::string PixelHlsl(const PixelKey& k);
// a screen quad's vertex or pixel shader: texture coordinates as the quad was drawn, before its far edges were pulled out
std::string QuadHlsl(std::string s);
std::string PointHlsl(std::string s, int kind);
std::string SpriteHlsl(std::string s);

// HLSL a backend extension adds; the defaults write the console path
struct ShaderHooks {
    virtual ~ShaderHooks() = default;
    // the cbuffer line for DrawConstants::ext
    virtual std::string Constants() const;
    // float4 shadow(Texture2D<float> t, SamplerComparisonState s, float2 uv, float z, int fmt, float2 px, float2 size)
    virtual std::string Shadow() const;
    // what spreadtap scales a render target's colour by
    virtual std::string ReadScale(const TexInfo&) const { return "1"; }
    // a cube sampled along dir at stage i, empty for a plain sample
    virtual std::string Cube(const TexInfo&, int, const std::string&) const { return {}; }
    // after stage i's fetch
    virtual std::string Fetched(const TexInfo&, int) const { return {}; }
    // outc to the target, after the alpha test
    virtual std::string Output() const;
};
inline const ShaderHooks* g_shader_hooks = nullptr;

// the constant buffer layout both stages share, register b1
struct DrawConstants {
    float surf[4];      // target width, height, 1 / depth scale, 0
    float fog[4];       // start, end, density, mode
    float fog_color[4];
    float misc[4];      // alpha ref, alpha func, shadow func, specular
    float pc[18][4];    // combiner c0 c1 per stage, then final c0 c1
    float tfactor[4];
    float texsize[4][4];
    float bump[4][4];   // 00 01 10 11
    float bumpl[4][4];  // scale offset
    float wvp[16];      // fixed function
    float ext[4];       // a backend extension's, declared by ShaderHooks::Constants
    float spread[4][4]; // kTexWide: tap step in uv, taps per axis
    // fixed function, lit in view space
    float wv[16];
    float wvn[16];       // normals: inverse transpose of wv
    float tm[4][16];     // texture transforms
    float mat[5][4];     // material diffuse, ambient, specular, emissive, power
    float amb[4];        // D3DRS_AMBIENT
    float lt[8][7][4];   // per light: diffuse, specular, ambient, position range, direction falloff, attenuation, cos theta/2 phi/2
    // vertex blending: world n x view for world matrices 0-3, their normal matrices, and projection x viewport
    float wvb[4][16];
    float wvbn[4][16];
    float pv[16];
};

}  // namespace gpu
```

```h
// texture stage state indices

    kTssAddressU = 0, kTssAddressV, kTssAddressW, kTssMagFilter, kTssMinFilter, kTssMipFilter, kTssMipLodBias,
    kTssMaxMipLevel, kTssMaxAnisotropy, kTssColorKeyOp, kTssColorSign, kTssAlphaKill, kTssColorOp, kTssColorArg0,
    kTssColorArg1, kTssColorArg2, kTssAlphaOp, kTssAlphaArg0, kTssAlphaArg1, kTssAlphaArg2, kTssResultArg,

struct VertexShader {
    uint32_t handle = 0;       // guest handle, record address | 1
    std::vector<uint32_t> decl;
    std::vector<uint32_t> program;  // 4 dwords per instruction
    uint32_t program_type = 0;      // 0x2078 vertex, 0x7378 state, 0x7778 read/write
    uint64_t hash = 0;
    // stream layout parsed from the declaration: register -> stream, offset, type
    struct Input {
        int stream = -1;
        uint32_t offset = 0;
        uint32_t type = 0;  // D3DVSDT
    };
    std::array<Input, 16> inputs{};
    std::array<uint32_t, 16> stream_stride{};  // bytes consumed per stream by the declaration
    std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, std::array<float, 4>>> constants;  // D3DVSD_CONST tokens
};

struct PixelShader {
    uint32_t handle = 0;
    uint32_t def[0xF0 / 4] = {};  // D3DPIXELSHADERDEF
};

struct Viewport {
    uint32_t x = 0, y = 0, w = 640, h = 480;
    float min_z = 0, max_z = 1;
};

struct Surface {
    uint32_t header = 0;  // guest D3DSurface
    uint32_t data = 0, format = 0, size = 0;
};

struct State {
    std::array<uint32_t, 0x800> simple{};  // simple render states indexed by method / 4
    std::array<uint32_t, kRsMax> rs{};     // deferred and complex render states by D3DRS
    std::array<std::array<uint32_t, kTssCount>, 4> tss{};
    std::array<uint32_t, 4> textures{};    // guest D3DBaseTexture pointers
    std::array<uint32_t, 4> palettes{};    // guest D3DPalette pointers, the colours of the stage's P8 texture
    struct Stream {
        uint32_t vb = 0;  // guest D3DVertexBuffer
        uint32_t stride = 0;
    };
    std::array<Stream, 16> streams{};
    uint32_t index_buffer = 0, index_data = 0, base_vertex = 0;
    uint32_t vs_handle = 0;  // programmable when bit 0 set, otherwise an FVF
    std::shared_ptr<VertexShader> vs;
    std::shared_ptr<PixelShader> ps;
    std::array<std::array<float, 4>, 192> vsc{};  // hardware order: D3D register + 96
    std::array<std::array<float, 4>, 16> psc{};
    Viewport viewport;
    Surface rt, zs;
    uint32_t scissor_count = 0;
    std::array<uint32_t, 4 * 8> scissors{};
    // fixed function
    std::array<std::array<float, 16>, 512> transforms{};  // by D3DTRANSFORMSTATETYPE
    std::array<float, 17> material{};
    std::array<std::array<uint32_t, 26>, 8> lights{};  // D3DLIGHT8
    uint32_t light_enable = 0;                         // bit per light
    float ss_offset_x = 0, ss_offset_y = 0;
    float zscale = 16777215.0f;  // depth buffer units per 1.0
};

}  // namespace gpu
```

```cpp
    {0x2D, {"F16", 16, true, false, true, Host::R32F}},
    {0x2E, {"LIN_D24S8", 32, false, false, true, Host::R32F}},
    {0x2F, {"LIN_F24S8", 32, false, false, true, Host::R32F}},
    {0x30, {"LIN_D16", 16, false, false, true, Host::R32F}},
    {0x31, {"LIN_F16", 16, false, false, true, Host::R32F}},
    {0x32, {"L16", 16, true, false, false, Host::BGRA8}},
    {0x33, {"V16U16", 32, true, false, false, Host::BGRA8}},
    {0x35, {"LIN_L16", 16, false, false, false, Host::BGRA8}},
    {0x36, {"LIN_V16U16", 32, false, false, false, Host::BGRA8}},
    {0x37, {"LIN_L6V5U5", 16, false, false, false, Host::BGRA8}},
    {0x38, {"R5G5B5A1", 16, true, false, false, Host::BGRA8}},
    {0x39, {"R4G4B4A4", 16, true, false, false, Host::BGRA8}},
    {0x3A, {"A8B8G8R8", 32, true, false, false, Host::BGRA8}},
    {0x3B, {"B8G8R8A8", 32, true, false, false, Host::BGRA8}},
    {0x3C, {"R8G8B8A8", 32, true, false, false, Host::BGRA8}},
    {0x3D, {"LIN_R5G5B5A1", 16, false, false, false, Host::BGRA8}},
    {0x3E, {"LIN_R4G4B4A4", 16, false, false, false, Host::BGRA8}},
    {0x3F, {"LIN_A8B8G8R8", 32, false, false, false, Host::BGRA8}},
    {0x40, {"LIN_B8G8R8A8", 32, false, false, false, Host::BGRA8}},
    {0x41, {"LIN_R8G8B8A8", 32, false, false, false, Host::BGRA8}},
};

uint32_t Log2(uint32_t v) {
    uint32_t n = 0;
    while ((1u << n) < v) n++;
    return n;
}

// Morton order: bits of x, y and z interleave from the lowest, an axis drops out once its size is used up
void SwizzleMasks(uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t d, uint32_t& mx, uint32_t& my, uint32_t& mz) {
    mx = my = mz = 0;
    uint32_t bit = 1, lx = Log2(w), ly = Log2(h), lz = Log2(d);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; bit && (i < lx || i < ly || i < lz); i++) {
        if (i < lx) {
            mx |= bit;
            bit <<= 1;
        }
        if (i < ly) {
            my |= bit;
            bit <<= 1;
        }
        if (i < lz) {
            mz |= bit;
            bit <<= 1;
        }
    }
}

uint32_t Deposit(uint32_t v, uint32_t mask) {
    uint32_t r = 0;
    for (uint32_t bit = 1; mask; bit <<= 1) {
        uint32_t low = mask & (~mask + 1);
        if (v & bit) r |= low;
        mask &= mask - 1;
    }
    return r;
}

uint8_t Expand5(uint32_t v) { return uint8_t((v << 3) | (v >> 2)); }
uint8_t Expand6(uint32_t v) { return uint8_t((v << 2) | (v >> 4)); }
uint8_t Expand4(uint32_t v) { return uint8_t(v * 17); }
uint8_t Clamp255(int v) { return uint8_t(v < 0 ? 0 : v > 255 ? 255 : v); }

// one texel to B, G, R, A
void Texel(uint32_t fmt, const uint8_t* p, uint8_t* o) {
    uint16_t s16;
    std::memcpy(&s16, p, 2);
    switch (fmt) {
        case 0x00: case 0x13:
            o[0] = o[1] = o[2] = p[0];
            o[3] = 255;
            break;
        case 0x01: case 0x1B:
            o[0] = o[1] = o[2] = o[3] = p[0];
            break;
        case 0x19: case 0x1F:
            o[0] = o[1] = o[2] = 255;
            o[3] = p[0];
            break;
        case 0x1A: case 0x20:
            o[0] = o[1] = o[2] = p[0];
            o[3] = p[1];
            break;
        case 0x02: case 0x10:
            o[0] = Expand5(s16 & 31);
            o[1] = Expand5((s16 >> 5) & 31);
            o[2] = Expand5((s16 >> 10) & 31);
            o[3] = (s16 & 0x8000) ? 255 : 0;
            break;
        case 0x03: case 0x1C:
            o[0] = Expand5(s16 & 31);
            o[1] = Expand5((s16 >> 5) & 31);
            o[2] = Expand5((s16 >> 10) & 31);
            o[3] = 255;
            break;
        case 0x04: case 0x1D:
            o[0] = Expand4(s16 & 15);
            o[1] = Expand4((s16 >> 4) & 15);
            o[2] = Expand4((s16 >> 8) & 15);
            o[3] = Expand4(s16 >> 12);
            break;
        case 0x05: case 0x11:
            o[0] = Expand5(s16 & 31);
            o[1] = Expand6((s16 >> 5) & 63);
            o[2] = Expand5(s16 >> 11);
            o[3] = 255;
            break;
        case 0x06: case 0x12:
            std::memcpy(o, p, 4);
            break;
        case 0x07: case 0x1E:
            std::memcpy(o, p, 3);
            o[3] = 255;
            break;
        case 0x3A: case 0x3F:  // memory R G B A
            o[0] = p[2];
            o[1] = p[1];
            o[2] = p[0];
            o[3] = p[3];
            break;
        case 0x3B: case 0x40:  // memory A R G B
            o[0] = p[3];
            o[1] = p[2];
            o[2] = p[1];
            o[3] = p[0];
            break;
        case 0x3C: case 0x41:  // memory A B G R
            o[0] = p[1];
            o[1] = p[2];
            o[2] = p[3];
            o[3] = p[0];
            break;
        case 0x38: case 0x3D:
            o[3] = (s16 & 1) ? 255 : 0;
            o[0] = Expand5((s16 >> 1) & 31);
            o[1] = Expand5((s16 >> 6) & 31);
            o[2] = Expand5(s16 >> 11);
            break;
        case 0x39: case 0x3E:
            o[3] = Expand4(s16 & 15);
            o[0] = Expand4((s16 >> 4) & 15);
            o[1] = Expand4((s16 >> 8) & 15);
            o[2] = Expand4(s16 >> 12);
            break;
        case 0x28: case 0x17:  // two channels, low byte then high byte
            o[2] = p[0];
            o[1] = p[1];
            o[0] = p[0];
            o[3] = p[1];
            break;
        case 0x29: case 0x16:
            o[2] = p[1];
            o[1] = p[0];
            o[0] = p[0];
            o[3] = p[1];
            break;
        case 0x27: case 0x37:
            o[2] = Expand5(s16 & 31);
            o[1] = Expand5((s16 >> 5) & 31);
            o[0] = Expand6(s16 >> 10);
            o[3] = 255;
            break;
        case 0x32: case 0x35:
            o[0] = o[1] = o[2] = p[1];
            o[3] = 255;
            break;
        case 0x33: case 0x36:
            o[2] = p[1];
            o[1] = p[3];
            o[0] = 0;
            o[3] = 255;
            break;
        default:
            o[0] = o[1] = o[2] = p[0];
            o[3] = 255;
            break;
    }
}

float DepthTexel(uint32_t fmt, const uint8_t* p) {
    uint32_t v;
    uint16_t s;
    std::memcpy(&v, p, 4);
    std::memcpy(&s, p, 2);
    switch (fmt) {
        case 0x2A: case 0x2E: return float(v >> 8) / 16777215.0f;
        case 0x2C: case 0x30: return float(s) / 65535.0f;
        case 0x2B: case 0x2F: {  // unsigned, 8 bit exponent, 16 bit mantissa: a float32 missing its low bits
            uint32_t exponent = v >> 24, mantissa = (v >> 8) & 0xFFFF;
            return std::bit_cast<float>(exponent << 23 | mantissa << 7);
        }
        default: {  // unsigned, 4 bit exponent biased 7, 12 bit mantissa, over its max 511.9375
            uint32_t exponent = (s >> 12) + 120u, mantissa = s & 0xFFFu;
            return std::bit_cast<float>(exponent << 23 | mantissa << 11) / 511.9375f;
        }
    }
}

std::mutex g_dirty_lock;
std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint64_t> g_dirty;
uint64_t g_epoch = 1;

}  // namespace

const FormatInfo& Format(uint32_t f) {
    for (auto& e : kFormats)
        if (e.id == f) return e.info;
    return kUnknown;
}

bool Describe(uint32_t header, TextureDesc& d) {
    using namespace kernel;
    if (!header) return false;
    uint32_t common = R32(header);
    uint32_t type = common & 0x70000;  // 0x40000 texture, 0x50000 surface
    if (type != 0x40000 && type != 0x50000) return false;
    // D3DPixelContainer: Common, Data, Lock, Format, Size
    uint32_t fmt = R32(header + 12), size = R32(header + 16);
    d.data = mem::VirtualFromPhysical(R32(header + 4));
    // Format: cube bit 2, dimensions bits 4 to 7, format 8 to 15, levels 16 to 19, log2 sizes from bit 20
    d.format = (fmt >> 8) & 0xFF;
    d.cube = fmt & 4;
    uint32_t dims = (fmt >> 4) & 0xF;
    d.levels = std::max<uint32_t>((fmt >> 16) & 0xF, 1);
    if (size) {
        d.width = (size & 0xFFF) + 1;
        d.height = ((size >> 12) & 0xFFF) + 1;
        d.pitch = ((size >> 24) + 1) * 64;
        d.depth = 1;
        d.levels = 1;
        d.linear = true;
    } else {
        d.width = 1u << ((fmt >> 20) & 0xF);
        d.height = 1u << ((fmt >> 24) & 0xF);
        d.depth = dims == 3 ? 1u << ((fmt >> 28) & 0xF) : 1;
        d.linear = !Format(d.format).swizzled && !Format(d.format).compressed;
        d.pitch = d.width * Format(d.format).bits / 8;
    }
    return true;
}

bool DescribeSurface(const Surface& s, TextureDesc& d) {
    if (!s.header) return false;
    return Describe(s.header, d);
}

uint32_t LevelSize(const TextureDesc& d, uint32_t level) {
    const FormatInfo& f = Format(d.format);
    if (d.linear) return d.pitch * d.height;
    uint32_t w = std::max(d.width >> level, 1u), h = std::max(d.height >> level, 1u), z = std::max(d.depth >> level, 1u);
    if (f.compressed) return std::max(1u, (w + 3) / 4) * std::max(1u, (h + 3) / 4) * f.bits * z;
    return w * h * z * f.bits / 8;
}

uint32_t LevelOffset(const TextureDesc& d, uint32_t level) {
    uint32_t off = 0;
    for (uint32_t l = 0; l < level; l++) off += LevelSize(d, l);
    return off;
}

uint32_t FaceSize(const TextureDesc& d) { return (LevelOffset(d, d.levels) + 127) & ~127u; }

uint32_t TotalSize(const TextureDesc& d) { return d.cube ? FaceSize(d) * 6 : LevelOffset(d, d.levels); }

void DecodeLevel(const TextureDesc& d, uint32_t level, uint32_t face, const uint8_t* guest, const uint32_t* palette,
                 std::vector<uint8_t>& out, uint32_t& row_pitch) {
    const FormatInfo& f = Format(d.format);
    uint32_t w = d.linear ? d.width : std::max(d.width >> level, 1u);
    uint32_t h = d.linear ? d.height : std::max(d.height >> level, 1u);
    uint32_t z = d.linear ? 1 : std::max(d.depth >> level, 1u);
    const uint8_t* src = guest + (d.cube ? face * FaceSize(d) : 0) + LevelOffset(d, level);
    if (f.compressed) {
        uint32_t bw = std::max(1u, (w + 3) / 4), bh = std::max(1u, (h + 3) / 4);
        row_pitch = bw * f.bits;
        out.assign(src, src + size_t(row_pitch) * bh * z);
        return;
    }
    if (f.host == Host::R32F) {
        row_pitch = w * 4;
        out.resize(size_t(row_pitch) * h * z);
        float* o = reinterpret_cast<float*>(out.data());
        uint32_t bpp = f.bits / 8;
        uint32_t mx, my, mz;
        SwizzleMasks(w, h, z, mx, my, mz);
        for (uint32_t y = 0; y < h; y++)
            for (uint32_t x = 0; x < w; x++) {
                uint32_t off = d.linear ? y * d.pitch + x * bpp : (Deposit(x, mx) | Deposit(y, my)) * bpp;
                o[y * w + x] = DepthTexel(d.format, src + off);
            }
        return;
    }
    row_pitch = w * 4;
    out.resize(size_t(row_pitch) * h * z);
    uint32_t bpp = f.bits / 8;
    if (d.format == 0x24 || d.format == 0x25) {
        // packed 4:2:2, two pixels share chroma
        bool yuy2 = d.format == 0x24;
        for (uint32_t y = 0; y < h; y++)
            for (uint32_t x = 0; x + 1 < w + 1; x += 2) {
                const uint8_t* p = src + y * d.pitch + x * 2;
                int y0 = yuy2 ? p[0] : p[1], u = yuy2 ? p[1] : p[0], y1 = yuy2 ? p[2] : p[3], v = yuy2 ? p[3] : p[2];
                for (int k = 0; k < 2 && x + uint32_t(k) < w; k++) {
                    int c = (k ? y1 : y0) - 16, dd = u - 128, e = v - 128;  // BT.601 studio range
                    uint8_t* o = &out[(y * w + x + uint32_t(k)) * 4];
                    o[2] = Clamp255((298 * c + 409 * e + 128) >> 8);
                    o[1] = Clamp255((298 * c - 100 * dd - 208 * e + 128) >> 8);
                    o[0] = Clamp255((298 * c + 516 * dd + 128) >> 8);
                    o[3] = 255;
                }
            }
        return;
    }
    if (d.linear) {
        for (uint32_t y = 0; y < h; y++)
            for (uint32_t x = 0; x < w; x++) Texel(d.format, src + y * d.pitch + x * bpp, &out[(y * w + x) * 4]);
        return;
    }
    uint32_t mx, my, mz;
    SwizzleMasks(w, h, z, mx, my, mz);
    std::vector<uint32_t> xo(w), yo(h), zo(z);
    for (uint32_t x = 0; x < w; x++) xo[x] = Deposit(x, mx);
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < h; y++) yo[y] = Deposit(y, my);
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < z; k++) zo[k] = Deposit(k, mz);
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < z; k++)
        for (uint32_t y = 0; y < h; y++)
            for (uint32_t x = 0; x < w; x++) {
                const uint8_t* p = src + size_t(xo[x] | yo[y] | zo[k]) * bpp;
                uint8_t* o = &out[((size_t(k) * h + y) * w + x) * 4];
                if (d.format == 0x0B && palette) {
                    uint32_t c = palette[p[0]];
                    std::memcpy(o, &c, 4);
                } else {
                    Texel(d.format, p, o);
                }
            }
}

uint32_t LinearColorFormat(uint32_t f) {
    switch (f) {
        case 0x06: return 0x12;
        case 0x07: return 0x1E;
        case 0x05: return 0x11;
        case 0x02: return 0x10;
        case 0x03: return 0x1C;
        default: return Format(f).swizzled ? 0x1E : (f ? f : 0x1E);
    }
}

uint32_t LinearDepthFormat(uint32_t f) {
    switch (f) {
        case 0x2A: return 0x2E;
        case 0x2B: return 0x2F;
        case 0x2C: return 0x30;
        case 0x2D: return 0x31;
        default: return Format(f).depth ? f : 0x2E;
    }
}

void SurfaceSize(const Surface& s, uint32_t& w, uint32_t& h) {
    TextureDesc d;
    if (Describe(s.header, d)) {
        w = d.width;
        h = d.height;
    } else {
        w = 640;
        h = 480;
    }
}

void MarkDirty(uint32_t res) {
    if (!res) return;
    uint32_t data = mem::VirtualFromPhysical(kernel::R32(res + 4));
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_dirty_lock);
    g_dirty[data] = ++g_epoch;
}

uint64_t DirtyEpoch(uint32_t data) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_dirty_lock);
    auto it = g_dirty.find(data);
    return it == g_dirty.end() ? 0 : it->second;
}

bool CopySurfaceMemory(const Surface& src, const Surface& dst, uint32_t count, uint32_t rects, uint32_t points) {
    TextureDesc a, b;
    if (!DescribeSurface(src, a) || !DescribeSurface(dst, b)) return false;
    const FormatInfo &fa = Format(a.format), &fb = Format(b.format);
    // DXT copies whole 4x4 blocks, rows of blocks in memory
    bool block = fa.compressed;
    if (block != fb.compressed || (block && a.format != b.format) || fa.bits != fb.bits || fa.bits < 8) return false;
    uint32_t bpp = block ? fa.bits : fa.bits / 8, u = block ? 4 : 1;
    uint32_t ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz;
    SwizzleMasks(a.width, a.height, 1, ax, ay, az);
    SwizzleMasks(b.width, b.height, 1, bx, by, bz);
    auto addr = [&](const TextureDesc& d, uint32_t mx, uint32_t my, uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
        if (block) return d.data + (y * ((d.width + 3) / 4) + x) * bpp;
        return d.data + (d.linear ? y * d.pitch + x * bpp : (Deposit(x, mx) | Deposit(y, my)) * bpp);
    };
    int32_t aw = int32_t((a.width + u - 1) / u), ah = int32_t((a.height + u - 1) / u);
    int32_t bw = int32_t((b.width + u - 1) / u), bh = int32_t((b.height + u - 1) / u);
    uint32_t n = count && rects ? count : 1;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int32_t x0 = 0, y0 = 0, x1 = int32_t(a.width), y1 = int32_t(a.height), dx = 0, dy = 0;
        if (count && rects) {
            uint32_t r = rects + i * 16;
            x0 = int32_t(kernel::R32(r));
            y0 = int32_t(kernel::R32(r + 4));
            x1 = int32_t(kernel::R32(r + 8));
            y1 = int32_t(kernel::R32(r + 12));
            dx = x0;
            dy = y0;
        }
        if (points) {
            dx = int32_t(kernel::R32(points + i * 8));
            dy = int32_t(kernel::R32(points + i * 8 + 4));
        }
        int32_t U = int32_t(u);
        x0 /= U, y0 /= U, dx /= U, dy /= U, x1 = (x1 + U - 1) / U, y1 = (y1 + U - 1) / U;
        for (int32_t y = std::max(y0, 0); y < std::min(y1, ah); y++)
            for (int32_t x = std::max(x0, 0); x < std::min(x1, aw); x++) {
                int32_t tx = dx + x - x0, ty = dy + y - y0;
                if (tx < 0 || ty < 0 || tx >= bw || ty >= bh) continue;
                std::memcpy(kernel::HostPtr(addr(b, bx, by, uint32_t(tx), uint32_t(ty))),
                            kernel::HostPtr(addr(a, ax, ay, uint32_t(x), uint32_t(y))), bpp);
            }
    }
    MarkDirty(dst.header);
    return true;
}

// declarations

static uint32_t TypeSize(uint32_t t) {
    uint32_t kind = t & 15, count = (t >> 4) & 15;
    switch (kind) {
        case 0: return 4;                // D3DCOLOR
        case 1: case 5: return 2 * count;  // shorts
        case 2: return 4 * count;        // floats
        case 4: return count;            // bytes
        case 6: return 4;                // packed 11:11:10
        default: return 4 * count;
    }
}

void ParseDeclaration(VertexShader& vs) {
    int stream = 0;
    uint32_t offset = 0;
    vs.stream_stride.fill(0);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vs.decl.size(); i++) {
        uint32_t t = vs.decl[i];
        if (t == 0xFFFFFFFF) break;  // D3DVSD_END
        uint32_t kind = t >> 29;
        if (kind == 1) {  // STREAM
            if (t & (1u << 28)) continue;  // tessellator stream
            vs.stream_stride[size_t(stream)] = std::max(vs.stream_stride[size_t(stream)], offset);
            stream = int(t & 15);
            offset = vs.stream_stride[size_t(stream)];
        } else if (kind == 2) {  // STREAMDATA
            if (t & (1u << 28)) {
                // SKIP counts dwords, SKIPBYTES bytes
                uint32_t n = (t >> 16) & 0xFF;
                offset += (t & (1u << 27)) ? n : n * 4;
            } else {
                uint32_t reg = t & 15, type = (t >> 16) & 0xFF;
                if (type != 0x02) vs.inputs[reg] = {stream, offset, type};  // 0x02 D3DVSDT_NONE
                offset += type == 0x02 ? 0 : TypeSize(type);
            }
        } else if (kind == 4) {  // CONSTMEM
            uint32_t count = (t >> 25) & 15, reg = t & 0xFF;
            for (uint32_t c = 0; c < count && i + 4 < vs.decl.size(); c++) {
                std::array<float, 4> v;
                std::memcpy(v.data(), &vs.decl[i + 1], 16);
                vs.constants.push_back({reg + c, v});
                i += 4;
            }
        }
    }
    vs.stream_stride[size_t(stream)] = std::max(vs.stream_stride[size_t(stream)], offset);
}

// pixel shader constants

uint32_t PackColor(const std::array<float, 4>& c) {
    auto q = [](float v) { return uint32_t(std::clamp(v, 0.0f, 1.0f) * 255.0f + 0.5f); };
    return q(c[3]) << 24 | q(c[0]) << 16 | q(c[1]) << 8 | q(c[2]);
}

// PSC0Mapping and PSC1Mapping give each combiner stage the D3D constant its C0 and C1 read,
// PSFinalCombinerConstants does the same for the final combiner. 0xF leaves the literal in place.
void ApplyPixelConstants(State& s, uint32_t first, uint32_t count) {
    if (!s.ps) return;
    const uint32_t* d = s.ps->def;
    uint32_t c0map = d[57], c1map = d[58], fmap = d[59];
    auto mine = [&](uint32_t m) { return m >= first && m < first + count && m < 8; };
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        uint32_t m0 = (c0map >> (i * 4)) & 0xF, m1 = (c1map >> (i * 4)) & 0xF;
        if (mine(m0)) s.simple[(kMPsConstant0 >> 2) + i] = PackColor(s.psc[m0]);
        if (mine(m1)) s.simple[(kMPsConstant1 >> 2) + i] = PackColor(s.psc[m1]);
    }
    uint32_t f0 = fmap & 0xF, f1 = (fmap >> 4) & 0xF;
    if (mine(f0)) s.simple[kMPsFinalConstant0 >> 2] = PackColor(s.psc[f0]);
    if (mine(f1)) s.simple[kMPsFinalConstant1 >> 2] = PackColor(s.psc[f1]);
}

}  // namespace gpu
```

```h
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

#include "gpu/state.h"

namespace gpu {

// What the renderer uploads a console texture format as
enum class Host : uint8_t { BGRA8, BC1, BC2, BC3, R32F, R16Unorm, None };

struct FormatInfo {
    const char* name;
    uint8_t bits;      // per texel, 4 or 8 bytes per block for the DXT formats
    bool swizzled;     // Morton order in memory
    bool compressed;   // 4x4 blocks
    bool depth;
    Host host;
};

const FormatInfo& Format(uint32_t xbox_format);

// a D3DPixelContainer decoded
struct TextureDesc {
    uint32_t data = 0;  // guest virtual address of level 0
    uint32_t format = 0;
    uint32_t width = 1, height = 1, depth = 1, levels = 1;
    uint32_t pitch = 0;  // linear formats only
    bool cube = false;
    bool linear = false;
};

bool Describe(uint32_t header, TextureDesc& out);
bool DescribeSurface(const Surface& s, TextureDesc& out);
uint32_t LevelSize(const TextureDesc& d, uint32_t level);
uint32_t LevelOffset(const TextureDesc& d, uint32_t level);
uint32_t FaceSize(const TextureDesc& d);  // cube face stride
uint32_t TotalSize(const TextureDesc& d);

// converts one level (one face) from guest memory into what Host describes, rows tightly packed
void DecodeLevel(const TextureDesc& d, uint32_t level, uint32_t face, const uint8_t* guest, const uint32_t* palette,
                 std::vector<uint8_t>& out, uint32_t& row_pitch);

uint32_t LinearColorFormat(uint32_t fmt);
uint32_t LinearDepthFormat(uint32_t fmt);
void SurfaceSize(const Surface& s, uint32_t& w, uint32_t& h);

// CopyRects done in guest memory, false when the formats do not allow it
bool CopySurfaceMemory(const Surface& src, const Surface& dst, uint32_t count, uint32_t rects, uint32_t points);

// the title locked a resource, the next bind re-uploads it
void MarkDirty(uint32_t resource);
uint64_t DirtyEpoch(uint32_t data_va);

// vertex declarations and pixel shader constant routing, both follow the XDK's definitions
void ParseDeclaration(VertexShader& vs);
// SetPixelShaderConstant: the stages of the current shader mapped to these registers take the values
void ApplyPixelConstants(State& s, uint32_t first, uint32_t count);
uint32_t PackColor(const std::array<float, 4>& c);

}  // namespace gpu
```
