`src/d3d/gpu/vertex.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "gpu/vertex.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

#include <dxgiformat.h>

#include "core/log.h"
#include "kernel/kernel.h"

namespace gpu {

namespace {

constexpr uint32_t kTypeFloat2H = 0x72;  // FLOAT2H
// D3DVSDT_NONE: a FLOAT with no components, the register reads no stream data
constexpr uint32_t kTypeNone = 0x02;

// D3DVSDT: low nibble the kind, high nibble the component count
void Convert(uint32_t type, const uint8_t* p, float* o) {
    o[0] = 0;
    o[1] = 0;
    o[2] = 0;
    o[3] = 1;
    uint32_t kind = type & 15;
    uint32_t n = std::min<uint32_t>((type >> 4) & 15, 4);
    if (type == kTypeFloat2H) {
        float v[3];
        std::memcpy(v, p, 12);
        o[0] = v[0];
        o[1] = v[1];
        o[3] = v[2];
        return;
    }
    switch (kind) {
        case 0:  // D3DCOLOR, bytes B G R A
            o[0] = p[2] / 255.0f;
            o[1] = p[1] / 255.0f;
            o[2] = p[0] / 255.0f;
            o[3] = p[3] / 255.0f;
            break;
        case 1:  // NORMSHORT
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                int16_t s;
                std::memcpy(&s, p + i * 2, 2);
                o[i] = std::max(s / 32767.0f, -1.0f);
            }
            break;
        case 2:  // FLOAT
            std::memcpy(o, p, n * 4);
            break;
        case 4:  // PBYTE
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) o[i] = p[i] / 255.0f;
            break;
        case 5:  // SHORT
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                int16_t s;
                std::memcpy(&s, p + i * 2, 2);
                o[i] = s;
            }
            break;
        case 6: {  // NORMPACKED3, 11 11 10 signed
            uint32_t v;
            std::memcpy(&v, p, 4);
            int32_t x = int32_t(v << 21) >> 21;
            int32_t y = int32_t(v << 10) >> 21;
            int32_t z = int32_t(v) >> 22;
            o[0] = std::max(x / 1023.0f, -1.0f);
            o[1] = std::max(y / 1023.0f, -1.0f);
            o[2] = std::max(z / 511.0f, -1.0f);
            break;
        }
        default:
            break;
    }
}

// A/B switch: 0 converts every vertex on the CPU, the older path
#ifndef XBE_RAW_VERTICES
#define XBE_RAW_VERTICES 1
#endif
constexpr bool kRawVertices = XBE_RAW_VERTICES;

// D3DVSDT type as the input assembler reads it: DXGI format, what the vertex shader does after, bytes the format reads
struct HostElement {
    uint8_t format = 0;
    uint8_t decode = kDecodeNone;
    uint8_t bytes = 0;
};
HostElement HostFormat(uint32_t type) {
    switch (type) {
        case 0x12: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT, kDecodeNone, 4};
        case 0x22: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT, kDecodeNone, 8};
        case 0x32: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_FLOAT, kDecodeNone, 12};
        case 0x42: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT, kDecodeNone, 16};
        case kTypeFloat2H: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_FLOAT, kDecodeFloat2H, 12};
        case 0x40: return {DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM, kDecodeNone, 4};  // D3DCOLOR, bytes B G R A
        case 0x11: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R16_SNORM, kDecodeNone, 2};
        case 0x21: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_SNORM, kDecodeNone, 4};
        case 0x31: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SNORM, kDecodeW1, 8};
        case 0x41: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SNORM, kDecodeNone, 8};
        case 0x14: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R8_UNORM, kDecodeNone, 1};
        case 0x24: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8_UNORM, kDecodeNone, 2};
        case 0x34: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, kDecodeW1, 4};
        case 0x44: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, kDecodeNone, 4};
        case 0x15: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R16_SINT, kDecodeInt, 2};
        case 0x25: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_SINT, kDecodeInt, 4};
        case 0x35: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SINT, kDecodeIntW1, 8};
        case 0x45: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SINT, kDecodeInt, 8};
        case 0x16: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R32_UINT, kDecodePacked, 4};
        default: return {};
    }
}

// the index list for a primitive the input assembler has no topology for, or for converted vertices
template <typename F>
void ListIndices(uint32_t prim, uint32_t count, F local, std::vector<uint32_t>& ix, Topology& topology) {
    ix.reserve(size_t(count) * 3);
    topology = Topology::Triangles;
    switch (prim) {
        case 1:  // points
            topology = Topology::Points;
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++) ix.push_back(local(i));
            break;
        case 2:  // line list
            topology = Topology::Lines;
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i + 1 < count; i += 2) ix.insert(ix.end(), {local(i), local(i + 1)});
            break;
        case 3:  // line loop
        case 4:  // line strip
            topology = Topology::Lines;
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i + 1 < count; i++) ix.insert(ix.end(), {local(i), local(i + 1)});
            if (prim == 3 && count > 2) ix.insert(ix.end(), {local(count - 1), local(0)});
            break;
        case 5:  // triangle list
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i + 2 < count; i += 3) ix.insert(ix.end(), {local(i), local(i + 1), local(i + 2)});
            break;
        case 6:  // triangle strip
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i + 2 < count; i++) {
                if (i & 1) ix.insert(ix.end(), {local(i + 1), local(i), local(i + 2)});
                else ix.insert(ix.end(), {local(i), local(i + 1), local(i + 2)});
            }
            break;
        case 7:   // fan
        case 10:  // polygon
            for (uint32_t i = 1; i + 1 < count; i++) ix.insert(ix.end(), {local(0), local(i), local(i + 1)});
            break;
        case 8:  // quad list
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i + 3 < count; i += 4) {
                ix.insert(ix.end(), {local(i), local(i + 1), local(i + 2), local(i), local(i + 2), local(i + 3)});
            }
            break;
        case 9:  // quad strip
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i + 3 < count; i += 2) {
                ix.insert(ix.end(), {local(i), local(i + 1), local(i + 2), local(i + 1), local(i + 3), local(i + 2)});
            }
            break;
    }
}

uint32_t TypeBytes(uint32_t t) {
    if (t == kTypeFloat2H) return 12;
    uint32_t kind = t & 15;
    uint32_t n = (t >> 4) & 15;
    switch (kind) {
        case 0: return 4;
        case 1: case 5: return 2 * n;
        case 4: return n;
        case 6: return 4;
        default: return 4 * n;
    }
}

constexpr uint32_t kResData = 4;

void ResetAssembled(Assembled& out) {
    out.vertices.clear();
    out.indices.clear();
    out.regs = 0;
    out.vertex_count = 0;
    out.topology = Topology::Triangles;
    out.strip = false;
    out.decode = 0;
    out.buffer_count = 0;
    out.index_src = nullptr;
    out.index16 = false;
    out.draw_count = 0;
    out.index_count = 0;
    out.base_vertex = 0;
}

// the draw as Assemble got it, plus the vertex range it reads
struct DrawRange {
    uint32_t prim = 0;
    uint32_t start = 0;
    uint32_t count = 0;
    const uint8_t* ip = nullptr;
    uint32_t first = 0;         // lowest index
    uint32_t first_vertex = 0;  // first vertex read, base vertex applied
    uint32_t span = 0;
};

// the input registers fed by a bound stream and the layout they come from
struct Inputs {
    const VertexShader& layout;
    const int* regs;
    int nregs;
};

struct IndexBounds {
    uint32_t first = 0;
    uint32_t last = 0;
};

// the declaration's register layout, or the one an FVF handle stands for, built into fvf_layout
const VertexShader* PickLayout(const State& s, VertexShader& fvf_layout) {
    if (!(s.vs_handle & 1)) {
        FvfInputs(s.vs_handle, fvf_layout);
        return &fvf_layout;
    }
    return s.vs.get();
}

// D3DFVF: an FVF handle with position XYZRHW
bool Pretransformed(const State& s) {
    return !(s.vs_handle & 1) && (s.vs_handle & 0xE) == 0x4;
}

IndexBounds IndexRange(const uint8_t* ip, uint32_t count) {
    uint16_t lo16 = 0xFFFF;
    uint16_t hi16 = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        uint16_t v;
        std::memcpy(&v, ip + i * 2, 2);
        lo16 = std::min(lo16, v);
        hi16 = std::max(hi16, v);
    }
    return {lo16, hi16};
}

// logical vertex numbers in draw order
uint32_t DrawVertex(const State& s, const DrawRange& d, uint32_t i) {
    if (!d.ip) return d.start + i;
    uint16_t v;
    std::memcpy(&v, d.ip + i * 2, 2);
    return v + s.base_vertex;
}

// the input registers fed by a bound stream, also marked in out.regs
int CollectRegs(const State& s, const VertexShader& layout, int* regs, Assembled& out) {
    int nregs = 0;
    for (int r = 0; r < 16; r++) {
        const auto& in = layout.inputs[size_t(r)];
        if (in.stream < 0 || !in.type || in.type == kTypeNone) continue;
        const auto& st = s.streams[size_t(in.stream)];
        if (!st.vb) continue;
        regs[nregs++] = r;
        out.regs |= uint16_t(1u << r);
    }
    return nregs;
}

uint32_t StrideOf(const State& s, const VertexShader& layout, const VertexShader::Input& in) {
    const auto& st = s.streams[size_t(in.stream)];
    return st.stride ? st.stride : layout.stream_stride[size_t(in.stream)];
}

constexpr uint32_t kStrideAlign = 4;            // the input assembler reads strides in dwords
constexpr uint32_t kElementOffsetEnd = 0x10000;  // the element offset is stored as uint16_t

bool RawReadable(const State& s, const Inputs& inputs) {
    for (int k = 0; k < inputs.nregs; k++) {
        const auto& in = inputs.layout.inputs[size_t(inputs.regs[k])];
        HostElement he = HostFormat(in.type);
        uint32_t stride = StrideOf(s, inputs.layout, in);
        bool readable = he.format && stride && stride % kStrideAlign == 0 && in.offset < kElementOffsetEnd &&
                        in.offset % std::min<uint32_t>(he.bytes, 4) == 0;
        if (!readable) {
            LOG_FIRST(32, "vertex: converted on the CPU: v%d type %02X offset %u stride %u", inputs.regs[k], in.type,
                      in.offset, stride);
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

// sparse indices: the vertices they read, copied in draw order
void GatherVertices(const State& s, const DrawRange& d, const uint8_t* data, uint32_t stride,
                    std::vector<uint8_t>& g) {
    g.resize(size_t(d.count) * stride);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < d.count; i++) {
        std::memcpy(&g[size_t(i) * stride], data + size_t(DrawVertex(s, d, i)) * stride, stride);
    }
}

// returns the buffer slot the stream got
int AddRawBuffer(const State& s, const VertexShader& layout, const VertexShader::Input& in, const DrawRange& d,
                 bool dense, Assembled& out) {
    using namespace kernel;
    const auto& st = s.streams[size_t(in.stream)];
    uint32_t stride = StrideOf(s, layout, in);
    const uint8_t* data = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(HostPtr(mem::ResourceData(st.vb)));
    int slot = int(out.buffer_count);
    if (dense) {
        out.buffers[out.buffer_count++] = {data + size_t(d.first_vertex) * stride, d.span * stride, stride};
    } else {
        auto& g = out.gathered[out.buffer_count];
        GatherVertices(s, d, data, stride, g);
        out.buffers[out.buffer_count++] = {g.data(), d.count * stride, stride};
    }
    return slot;
}

// primitives the input assembler draws without a rebuilt index list
bool NativePrimitive(uint32_t prim) {
    return prim == 1 || prim == 2 || prim == 4 || prim == 5 || prim == 6;
}

Topology NativeTopology(uint32_t prim) {
    if (prim == 1) return Topology::Points;
    if (prim <= 4) return Topology::Lines;
    return Topology::Triangles;
}

uint32_t MinVertices(uint32_t prim) {
    if (prim == 1) return 1u;
    if (prim <= 4) return 2u;
    return 3u;
}

bool DrawNative(const DrawRange& d, bool dense, Assembled& out) {
    out.strip = d.prim == 4 || d.prim == 6;
    out.topology = NativeTopology(d.prim);
    if (d.ip && dense) {
        out.index_src = d.ip;
        out.index16 = true;
        out.index_count = d.count;
        out.base_vertex = -int32_t(d.first);
    } else {
        out.draw_count = d.count;
    }
    return d.count >= MinVertices(d.prim);
}

bool UseIndexList(Assembled& out) {
    out.index_src = out.indices.data();
    out.index_count = uint32_t(out.indices.size());
    return out.index_count != 0;
}

// a vertex range at most this far over the draw's count is read in place, a sparser one gathered
constexpr uint64_t kDenseSpanPerVertex = 4;
constexpr uint64_t kDenseSpanSlack = 1024;

bool AssembleRaw(const State& s, const Inputs& inputs, const DrawRange& d, Assembled& out) {
    bool dense = uint64_t(d.span) <= uint64_t(d.count) * kDenseSpanPerVertex + kDenseSpanSlack;
    int slot[16];
    std::fill(std::begin(slot), std::end(slot), -1);
    for (int k = 0; k < inputs.nregs; k++) {
        int reg = inputs.regs[k];
        const auto& in = inputs.layout.inputs[size_t(reg)];
        if (slot[in.stream] < 0) {
            slot[in.stream] = AddRawBuffer(s, inputs.layout, in, d, dense, out);
        }
        HostElement he = HostFormat(in.type);
        out.elements[size_t(reg)] = {he.format, uint8_t(slot[in.stream]), uint16_t(in.offset)};
        out.decode |= uint64_t(he.decode) << (reg * 4);
    }
    out.vertex_count = dense ? d.span : d.count;
    if (NativePrimitive(d.prim)) return DrawNative(d, dense, out);
    auto local = [&](uint32_t i) { return dense ? DrawVertex(s, d, i) - d.first_vertex : i; };
    ListIndices(d.prim, d.count, local, out.indices, out.topology);
    return UseIndexList(out);
}

// a vertex range at most this far over the draw's count is converted whole, in range order
constexpr uint64_t kRangedSpanPerVertex = 2;
constexpr uint64_t kRangedSpanSlack = 64;

// converted on the CPU: each element to a float4, vertices in range order when the indices are dense
bool AssembleConverted(const State& s, const Inputs& inputs, const DrawRange& d, Assembled& out) {
    using namespace kernel;
    int nregs = inputs.nregs;
    std::vector<uint32_t> seq(d.count);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < d.count; i++) seq[i] = DrawVertex(s, d, i);
    bool ranged = uint64_t(d.span) <= uint64_t(d.count) * kRangedSpanPerVertex + kRangedSpanSlack;
    uint32_t n = ranged ? d.span : d.count;
    out.vertex_count = n;
    out.vertices.resize(size_t(n) * nregs * 4);
    for (int k = 0; k < nregs; k++) {
        const auto& in = inputs.layout.inputs[size_t(inputs.regs[k])];
        const auto& st = s.streams[size_t(in.stream)];
        uint32_t data = mem::ResourceData(st.vb);
        uint32_t stride = StrideOf(s, inputs.layout, in);
        const uint8_t* src = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(HostPtr(data + in.offset));
        for (uint32_t v = 0; v < n; v++) {
            uint32_t id = ranged ? d.first_vertex + v : seq[v];
            Convert(in.type, src + size_t(id) * stride, &out.vertices[(size_t(v) * nregs + k) * 4]);
        }
        out.elements[size_t(inputs.regs[k])] = {DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT, 0, uint16_t(k * 16)};
    }
    out.buffer_count = 1;
    const uint8_t* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(out.vertices.data());
    out.buffers[0] = {bytes, uint32_t(out.vertices.size() * 4), uint32_t(nregs * 16)};
    auto local = [&](uint32_t i) { return ranged ? seq[i] - d.first_vertex : i; };
    ListIndices(d.prim, d.count, local, out.indices, out.topology);
    return UseIndexList(out);
}

}  // namespace

void FvfInputs(uint32_t fvf, VertexShader& vs) {
    vs.inputs.fill({});
    uint32_t off = 0;
    auto add = [&](int reg, uint32_t type) {
        vs.inputs[size_t(reg)] = {0, off, type};
        off += TypeBytes(type);
    };
    // D3DFVF: position 0xE, normal 0x10, point size 0x20, diffuse 0x40, specular 0x80, texture count bits 8 to 11,
    // sizes from bit 16
    switch (fvf & 0xE) {
        case 0x2: add(0, 0x32); break;
        case 0x4: add(0, 0x42); break;
        case 0x6: case 0x8: case 0xA: case 0xC: {
            add(0, 0x32);
            uint32_t weights = ((fvf & 0xE) - 0x4) / 2;
            add(1, 0x02 | (weights << 4));
            break;
        }
        default: break;
    }
    if (fvf & 0x10) add(2, 0x32);
    if (fvf & 0x20) add(6, 0x12);
    if (fvf & 0x40) add(3, 0x40);
    if (fvf & 0x80) add(4, 0x40);
    uint32_t tex = (fvf >> 8) & 15;
    static const uint32_t kTexType[4] = {0x22, 0x32, 0x42, 0x12};
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < tex && i < 4; i++) add(int(9 + i), kTexType[(fvf >> (16 + i * 2)) & 3]);
    vs.stream_stride.fill(0);
    vs.stream_stride[0] = off;
}

bool Assemble(const State& s, uint32_t prim, uint32_t start, uint32_t count, const uint8_t* ip, Assembled& out) {
    ResetAssembled(out);
    if (!count || prim < 1 || prim > 10) return false;

    VertexShader fvf_layout;
    const VertexShader* layout = PickLayout(s, fvf_layout);
    out.pretransformed = Pretransformed(s);
    if (!layout) return false;

    // the vertex range the draw reads
    IndexBounds bounds = {0, count - 1};
    if (ip) bounds = IndexRange(ip, count);
    DrawRange d;
    d.prim = prim;
    d.start = start;
    d.count = count;
    d.ip = ip;
    d.first = bounds.first;
    d.first_vertex = ip ? bounds.first + s.base_vertex : start;
    d.span = bounds.last - bounds.first + 1;

    int regs[16];
    int nregs = CollectRegs(s, *layout, regs, out);
    if (!nregs) return false;
    Inputs inputs = {*layout, regs, nregs};

    // the guest's own vertices when the input assembler can read every element of them
    bool raw = kRawVertices && RawReadable(s, inputs);
    if (raw) return AssembleRaw(s, inputs, d, out);
    return AssembleConverted(s, inputs, d, out);
}

}  // namespace gpu

```

`src/d3d/gpu/vertex.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

#include "gpu/state.h"

namespace gpu {

enum class Topology : uint8_t { Points, Lines, Triangles };

// how the vertex shader finishes an element the input assembler reads raw, 4 bits per register in Assembled::decode
enum VertexDecode : uint8_t {
    kDecodeNone,
    kDecodeW1,       // 3 components read as 4: w = 1
    kDecodeInt,      // SHORT: integers to float
    kDecodeIntW1,    // SHORT3
    kDecodePacked,   // NORMPACKED3, 11:11:10 signed in a uint
    kDecodeFloat2H,  // x y w as 3 floats
};

// a buffer the draw reads: guest vertices as they are, or the float4 copy converted on the CPU
struct VertexBuffer {
    const uint8_t* src = nullptr;
    uint32_t bytes = 0, stride = 0;
};

// where input register r comes from: host vertex format (a DXGI_FORMAT), buffer, byte offset in the vertex
struct VertexElement {
    uint8_t format = 0, buffer = 0;
    uint16_t offset = 0;
};

// one draw's vertices and indices as the input assembler takes them
struct Assembled {
    std::vector<float> vertices;    // converted path: vertex_count * regs * 4
    std::vector<uint32_t> indices;  // converted path, or the list rebuilt for fans, quads and loops
    uint16_t regs = 0;              // input registers present, bit per v register
    uint32_t vertex_count = 0;
    Topology topology = Topology::Triangles;
    bool strip = false;             // line or triangle strip, drawn as a strip
    bool pretransformed = false;    // FVF XYZRHW
    uint64_t decode = 0;            // VertexDecode per register, 4 bits each
    std::array<VertexElement, 16> elements{};
    std::array<VertexBuffer, 16> buffers{};
    uint32_t buffer_count = 0;
    const void* index_src = nullptr;  // the title's 16 bit indices, or indices
    bool index16 = false;
    uint32_t index_count = 0;         // 0: an unindexed draw of draw_count vertices
    uint32_t draw_count = 0;
    int32_t base_vertex = 0;
    std::array<std::vector<uint8_t>, 16> gathered;  // raw vertices copied in draw order when the indices are sparse
};

// the FVF bits translated to the register layout the XDK's declarations use
void FvfInputs(uint32_t fvf, VertexShader& out);

// false when there is nothing to draw
// indices: the title's 16 bit indices, null for an unindexed draw
bool Assemble(const State& s, uint32_t prim, uint32_t start, uint32_t count, const uint8_t* indices, Assembled& out);

}  // namespace gpu

```

`src/d3d/hle.cpp`:

```cpp
// The title's Direct3D calls as state for the renderer (docs/renderer.md). Ported from
// SCDA-XBERecomp's xdk/d3d8.cpp (see NOTICE) to Ninja Gaiden Black's XDK 5849 D3D8LTCG build:
// its own calling conventions (src/d3d/d3d_funcs.h), vertex programs loaded into the GPU's
// program memory (LoadVertexShader / SelectVertexShader), and pre-recorded index push buffers
// (RunPushBuffer).
//
// NGB_RENDERER=mirror: every call still goes to the recompiled Direct3D (xemu draws and shows the
// game); this keeps a copy of the state and draws it with the renderer as well, for comparing.
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <unordered_map>

#include "d3d_funcs.h"
#include "gpu/backend.h"
#include "gpu/state.h"
#include "gpu/texture.h"
#include "gpu/vertex.h"
#include "kernel/kernel.h"

extern "C" uint32_t xbox_HeapAlloc(uint32_t size, uint32_t align);

using kernel::HostPtr;
using kernel::R32;
using kernel::W32;

namespace {

enum Reg { EAX, ECX, EDX, EBX, ESP, EBP, ESI, EDI };

// the call: registers as the hook saw them, stack arguments above the return address
struct Call {
    uint32_t* r;
    uint32_t a(int i) const { return R32(r[ESP] + 4 + 4 * i); }
    float af(int i) const { uint32_t v = a(i); float f; std::memcpy(&f, &v, 4); return f; }
};

// Direct3D's globals in this build (XbSymbolDatabase's names)
constexpr uint32_t kRenderState = 0x3D83D8;      // D3D__RenderState[166]
constexpr uint32_t kTextureState = 0x3D5D10;     // D3D__TextureState[4][32]
constexpr uint32_t kDevicePtr = 0x3D83C8;       // D3D__pDevice
constexpr uint32_t kVsConstants = 0x3D8678;      // the device's copy of c[0..191], hardware order
constexpr uint32_t kSimpleEncode = 0x3E9278;     // D3D__SimpleRenderStateEncode[92]: each simple state's method

gpu::State g_state;
std::recursive_mutex g_lock;
std::unique_ptr<gpu::Backend> g_backend;
uint32_t g_vis_index;   // D3DDevice_EndVisibilityTest's index (in eax), for its report slot after the body ran
bool g_mirror = true;

std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::shared_ptr<gpu::VertexShader>> g_vs;
std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::shared_ptr<gpu::PixelShader>> g_ps;

// CreateVertexShader / CreatePixelShader: the arguments, until the recompiled body wrote the handle
uint32_t g_new_decl, g_new_func, g_new_out;

// the GPU's vertex program memory, 136 instructions of 4 dwords, as LoadVertexShader fills it
uint32_t g_program[136][4];
std::shared_ptr<gpu::VertexShader> g_selected;   // SelectVertexShader's program and declaration

void SyncDeferred() {
    // deferred states live in the title's memory, which the inline SetRenderState and
    // SetTextureStageState write; so do the vertex shader constants
    // deferred and complex alike: the XDK keeps every one in D3D__RenderState, and inlined code
    // writes there without any function of ours seeing it
    for (uint32_t i = gpu::kRsDeferredFirst; i < gpu::kRsMax; i++) g_state.rs[i] = R32(kRenderState + i * 4);
    // the simple states too, as SetRenderState keeps them (the device's defaults were set before
    // the hooks saw anything); not the pixel shader's, which SetPixelShader loads from its definition
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < gpu::kRsDeferredFirst; i++) {
        uint32_t method = R32(kSimpleEncode + i * 4) & 0x1FFC;
        if ((method >= 0x300 && method < 0x400) || method == 0x1D78)
            g_state.simple[method >> 2] = R32(kRenderState + i * 4);
    }
    for (int s = 0; s < 4; s++)
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < gpu::kTssBumpEnvMat00; i++) g_state.tss[s][i] = R32(kTextureState + (s * 32 + i) * 4);
    std::memcpy(g_state.vsc.data(), HostPtr(kVsConstants), sizeof(g_state.vsc));
    // fixed function: the transforms (view, projection, texture 0-3, world 0-3 at +0xC60) and the
    // material (+0xF00) are written into the device by inlined code
    uint32_t dev = R32(kDevicePtr);
    if (dev) {
        for (uint32_t t = 0; t < 10; t++) {
            uint32_t pc = t < 2 ? t + 2 : t < 6 ? t + 14 : t + 250;
            std::memcpy(g_state.transforms[pc].data(), HostPtr(dev + 0xC60 + t * 64), 64);
        }
        std::memcpy(g_state.material.data(), HostPtr(dev + 0xF00), 17 * 4);
    }
}

void UpdateViewportConstants() {
    auto& v = g_state.viewport;
    float hw = v.w * 0.5f, hh = v.h * 0.5f;
    g_state.vsc[58] = {hw, -hh, (v.max_z - v.min_z) * g_state.zscale, 0};
    g_state.vsc[59] = {v.x + g_state.ss_offset_x + hw, v.y + g_state.ss_offset_y + hh, v.min_z * g_state.zscale, 0};
}

gpu::Surface SurfaceOf(uint32_t header) {
    gpu::Surface s;
    s.header = header;
    if (header) {
        s.data = R32(header + 4);
        s.format = R32(header + 12);
        s.size = R32(header + 16);
    }
    return s;
}

std::shared_ptr<gpu::VertexShader> ReadVertexShader(uint32_t decl, uint32_t func) {
    auto vs = std::make_shared<gpu::VertexShader>();
    if (decl)
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 1024; i++) {
            uint32_t t = R32(decl + i * 4);
            vs->decl.push_back(t);
            if (t == 0xFFFFFFFF) break;
        }
    if (func) {
        uint32_t hdr = R32(func);
        vs->program_type = hdr & 0xFFFF;
        uint32_t n = hdr >> 16;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n * 4; i++) vs->program.push_back(R32(func + 4 + i * 4));
        if (std::getenv("NGB_D3D_VPLOG"))   // debugging: where the vertex programs come from
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[VP] func %08X n %u first %08X %08X %08X %08X\n", func, n, n ? vs->program[0] : 0,
                         n ? vs->program[1] : 0, n ? vs->program[2] : 0, n ? vs->program[3] : 0);
    }
    gpu::ParseDeclaration(*vs);
    return vs;
}

void Draw(uint32_t prim, uint32_t start, uint32_t count, const uint8_t* indices) {
    SyncDeferred();
    static bool nolight = std::getenv("NGB_D3D_NOLIGHT") != nullptr;   // debugging
    if (nolight) g_state.rs[gpu::kRsLighting] = 0;
    static bool nofog = std::getenv("NGB_D3D_NOFOG") != nullptr;       // debugging
    if (nofog) g_state.rs[gpu::kRsFogEnable] = 0;
    static int fogn = std::getenv("NGB_D3D_FOGLOG") ? 1 : 0;
    static uint32_t fog_last[5];
    uint32_t fog_now[5] = { g_state.rs[gpu::kRsFogEnable], g_state.rs[gpu::kRsFogStart], g_state.rs[gpu::kRsFogEnd],
                            g_state.rs[gpu::kRsFogColor], g_state.rs[gpu::kRsFogTableMode] };
    if (fogn > 0 && std::memcmp(fog_now, fog_last, sizeof fog_now)) {
        std::memcpy(fog_last, fog_now, sizeof fog_now);
        float st, en, de;
        std::memcpy(&st, &g_state.rs[gpu::kRsFogStart], 4);
        std::memcpy(&en, &g_state.rs[gpu::kRsFogEnd], 4);
        std::memcpy(&de, &g_state.rs[gpu::kRsFogDensity], 4);
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[D3D] fog table %u start %g end %g density %g color %08X range %u\n",
                     g_state.rs[gpu::kRsFogTableMode], st, en, de, g_state.rs[gpu::kRsFogColor],
                     g_state.rs[gpu::kRsRangeFogEnable]);
    }
    UpdateViewportConstants();
    if (g_backend) g_backend->Draw(g_state, prim, start, count, indices);
}

// A pushed index list (RunPushBuffer): BEGIN (0x17FC) with the primitive, then 16-bit index
// pairs (0x1800) or 32-bit indices (0x1808), END (BEGIN 0). Anything else is reported once.
void RunPushBuffer(uint32_t pb) {
    uint32_t data = R32(pb + 4) | 0x80000000u, size = R32(pb + 0xC);
    std::vector<uint16_t> idx;
    uint32_t prim = 0;
    for (uint32_t o = 0; o + 4 <= size;) {
        uint32_t h = R32(data + o), count = (h >> 18) & 0x7FF, method = h & 0x1FFC;
        if ((h & 0xE0000003) == 0x20000000 || (h & 3) == 1) break;   // jump or call: not expected
        const uint32_t* v = static_cast<const uint32_t*>(HostPtr(data + o + 4));
        if (method == 0x17FC) {
            if (v[0]) {
                prim = v[0];
                idx.clear();
            } else if (prim) {
                Draw(prim, 0, uint32_t(idx.size()), reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(idx.data()));
                prim = 0;
            }
        } else if (method == 0x1800) {
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                idx.push_back(uint16_t(v[i]));
                idx.push_back(uint16_t(v[i] >> 16));
            }
        } else if (method == 0x1808) {
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++) idx.push_back(uint16_t(v[i]));
        } else {
            static uint32_t seen[64];
            static int n;
            bool known = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) known |= seen[i] == method;
            if (!known && n < 64) {
                seen[n++] = method;
                std::fprintf(stderr, "[D3D] push buffer method %04X x%u not drawn\n", method, count);
            }
        }
        o += 4 + 4 * count;
    }
    // a buffer that ends without END still draws what it began
    if (prim && !idx.empty()) Draw(prim, 0, uint32_t(idx.size()), reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(idx.data()));
}

// before the call: false to let the recompiled body run (always, mirroring)
bool Before(int fn, Call c) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    switch (fn) {
    // render states
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_SetRenderState_Simple:
        g_state.simple[(c.r[ECX] & 0x1FFC) >> 2] = c.r[EDX];
        break;
#define COMPLEX(name, index) case D3DF_D3DDevice_SetRenderState_##name: g_state.rs[index] = c.a(0); break;
    COMPLEX(PSTextureModes, gpu::kRsPsTextureModes)
    COMPLEX(VertexBlend, gpu::kRsVertexBlend)
    COMPLEX(FogColor, gpu::kRsFogColor)
    COMPLEX(FillMode, gpu::kRsFillMode)
    COMPLEX(BackFillMode, gpu::kRsBackFillMode)
    COMPLEX(TwoSidedLighting, gpu::kRsTwoSidedLighting)
    COMPLEX(NormalizeNormals, gpu::kRsNormalizeNormals)
    COMPLEX(ZEnable, gpu::kRsZEnable)
    COMPLEX(StencilEnable, gpu::kRsStencilEnable)
    COMPLEX(StencilFail, gpu::kRsStencilFail)
    COMPLEX(FrontFace, gpu::kRsFrontFace)
    COMPLEX(CullMode, gpu::kRsCullMode)
    COMPLEX(TextureFactor, gpu::kRsTextureFactor)
    COMPLEX(LogicOp, gpu::kRsLogicOp)
    COMPLEX(EdgeAntiAlias, gpu::kRsEdgeAntiAlias)
    COMPLEX(MultiSampleAntiAlias, gpu::kRsMultiSampleAntiAlias)
    COMPLEX(MultiSampleMask, gpu::kRsMultiSampleMask)
    COMPLEX(MultiSampleMode, gpu::kRsMultiSampleMode)
    COMPLEX(MultiSampleRenderTargetMode, gpu::kRsMultiSampleRenderTargetMode)
    COMPLEX(ShadowFunc, gpu::kRsShadowFunc)
    COMPLEX(LineWidth, gpu::kRsLineWidth)
    COMPLEX(SampleAlpha, gpu::kRsSampleAlpha)
    COMPLEX(Dxt1NoiseEnable, gpu::kRsDxt1NoiseEnable)
    COMPLEX(YuvEnable, gpu::kRsYuvEnable)
    COMPLEX(OcclusionCullEnable, gpu::kRsOcclusionCullEnable)
    COMPLEX(StencilCullEnable, gpu::kRsStencilCullEnable)
    COMPLEX(RopZCmpAlwaysRead, gpu::kRsRopZCmpAlwaysRead)
    COMPLEX(RopZRead, gpu::kRsRopZRead)
    COMPLEX(DoNotCullUncompressed, gpu::kRsDoNotCullUncompressed)
#undef COMPLEX

    // texture stage states: (stage eax, type edx, value ecx), BumpEnv (stage eax; type, value),
    // TexCoordIndex (stage esi; value), BorderColor and ColorKeyColor (stage eax, value ebx)
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_SetTextureStageStateNotInline:
        if (c.r[EDX] < gpu::kTssCount) g_state.tss[c.r[EAX] & 3][c.r[EDX]] = c.r[ECX];
        break;
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_SetTextureState_BumpEnv:
        if (c.a(0) >= gpu::kTssBumpEnvMat00 && c.a(0) <= gpu::kTssBumpEnvLOffset)
            g_state.tss[c.r[EAX] & 3][c.a(0)] = c.a(1);
        break;
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_SetTextureState_TexCoordIndex:
        g_state.tss[c.r[ESI] & 3][gpu::kTssTexCoordIndex] = c.a(0);
        break;
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_SetTextureState_BorderColor:
        g_state.tss[c.r[EAX] & 3][gpu::kTssBorderColor] = c.r[EBX];
        break;
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_SetTextureState_ColorKeyColor:
        g_state.tss[c.r[EAX] & 3][gpu::kTssColorKeyColor] = c.r[EBX];
        break;

    // fixed function: SetTransform (type eax, matrix edx), SetLight (index, light), LightEnable
    // (index eax; on)
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_SetTransform: {
        uint32_t t = c.r[EAX];
        if (t < 10) {
            uint32_t pc = t < 2 ? t + 2 : t < 6 ? t + 14 : t + 250;
            std::memcpy(g_state.transforms[pc].data(), HostPtr(c.r[EDX]), 64);
        }
        break;
    }
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_SetLight:
        if (c.a(0) < 8 && c.a(1)) std::memcpy(g_state.lights[c.a(0)].data(), HostPtr(c.a(1)), 26 * 4);
        break;
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_LightEnable:
        if (c.r[EAX] < 8)
            g_state.light_enable = c.a(0) ? g_state.light_enable | 1u << c.r[EAX] : g_state.light_enable & ~(1u << c.r[EAX]);
        break;

    // resources: SetTexture (stage eax; texture), SetPalette (stage eax; palette), SetStreamSource
    // (stream eax, buffer ebx; stride)
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_SetTexture:
        g_state.textures[c.r[EAX] & 3] = c.a(0);
        break;
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_SetPalette:
        g_state.palettes[c.r[EAX] & 3] = c.a(0);
        break;
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_SetStreamSource:
        g_state.streams[c.r[EAX] & 15] = {c.r[EBX], c.a(0)};
        break;

    // shaders
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_CreateVertexShader:
        g_new_decl = c.a(0);
        g_new_func = c.a(1);
        g_new_out = c.a(2);
        break;
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_CreatePixelShader:
        g_new_decl = c.a(0);
        g_new_out = c.a(1);
        break;
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_SetVertexShader: {
        uint32_t h = c.a(0);
        g_state.vs_handle = h;
        g_state.vs = nullptr;
        if (h & 1) {
            auto it = g_vs.find(h);
            if (it != g_vs.end()) g_state.vs = it->second;
        }
        break;
    }
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_LoadVertexShader: {          // (handle eax; address): its program into memory
        auto it = g_vs.find(c.r[EAX]);
        uint32_t at = c.a(0);
        if (it != g_vs.end())
            for (size_t i = 0; i < it->second->program.size() / 4 && at + i < 136; i++)
                std::memcpy(g_program[at + i], &it->second->program[i * 4], 16);
        break;
    }
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_SelectVertexShader: {        // (handle eax, address ebx): run from there
        uint32_t h = c.r[EAX], at = c.r[EBX];
        auto vs = std::make_shared<gpu::VertexShader>();
        auto it = g_vs.find(h);
        if (it != g_vs.end()) {
            vs->decl = it->second->decl;
            vs->inputs = it->second->inputs;
            vs->stream_stride = it->second->stream_stride;
        }
        vs->program_type = 0x2078;
        for (uint32_t i = at; i < 136; i++) {
            vs->program.insert(vs->program.end(), g_program[i], g_program[i] + 4);
            if (g_program[i][3] & 1) break;          // the final instruction
        }
        vs->handle = h;
        g_selected = vs;
        g_state.vs_handle = h | 1;
        g_state.vs = vs;
        break;
    }
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_SetPixelShader: {
        // the handle is the PixelShader object: 12 bytes of header, then its copy of the
        // definition (CreatePixelShader allocates 0xFC and copies 0x3C dwords to +0xC); the
        // game made most of its shaders before the hooks recorded any, so read it from there
        g_state.ps = nullptr;
        uint32_t h = c.r[EAX];
        if (!h) break;
        const uint32_t* def = static_cast<const uint32_t*>(HostPtr(h + 0xC));
        auto& ps = g_ps[h];
        if (!ps || std::memcmp(ps->def, def, sizeof(ps->def)) != 0) {
            ps = std::make_shared<gpu::PixelShader>();
            std::memcpy(ps->def, def, sizeof(ps->def));
            ps->handle = h;
        }
        g_state.ps = ps;
        const uint32_t* d = ps->def;
        auto put = [&](uint32_t method, uint32_t v) { g_state.simple[method >> 2] = v; };
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            put(gpu::kMPsAlphaInputs + i * 4, d[0 + i]);
            put(gpu::kMPsConstant0 + i * 4, d[10 + i]);
            put(gpu::kMPsConstant1 + i * 4, d[18 + i]);
            put(gpu::kMPsAlphaOutputs + i * 4, d[26 + i]);
            put(gpu::kMPsRgbInputs + i * 4, d[34 + i]);
            put(gpu::kMPsRgbOutputs + i * 4, d[45 + i]);
        }
        put(gpu::kMPsFinalAbcd, d[8]);
        put(gpu::kMPsFinalEfgh, d[9]);
        put(gpu::kMPsCompareMode, d[42]);
        put(gpu::kMPsFinalConstant0, d[43]);
        put(gpu::kMPsFinalConstant1, d[44]);
        put(gpu::kMPsCombinerCount, d[53]);
        put(gpu::kMPsDotMapping, d[55]);
        put(gpu::kMPsInputTexture, d[56]);
        g_state.rs[gpu::kRsPsTextureModes] = d[54];
        break;
    }
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_SetPixelShaderConstant: {    // (register ecx; source; count eax)
        uint32_t reg = c.r[ECX], src = c.a(0), n = c.r[EAX];
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n && reg + i < 16; i++) std::memcpy(g_state.psc[reg + i].data(), HostPtr(src + i * 16), 16);
        gpu::ApplyPixelConstants(g_state, reg, n);
        break;
    }

    // targets and the viewport
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_SetRenderTarget: {
        if (c.a(0)) g_state.rt = SurfaceOf(c.a(0));
        g_state.zs = SurfaceOf(c.a(1));
        uint32_t w, h;
        gpu::SurfaceSize(g_state.rt, w, h);
        static int rtlog = std::getenv("NGB_D3D_RTLOG") ? 400 : 0;   // debugging: the targets as they are set
        if (rtlog > 0) {
            uint32_t zw = 0, zh = 0;
            gpu::SurfaceSize(g_state.zs, zw, zh);
            if (!c.a(0) || zw != w || zh != h) {
                rtlog--;
                std::fprintf(stderr, "[RT] SetRenderTarget rt %08X (data %08X fmt %08X %ux%u) zs %08X (data %08X fmt %08X %ux%u)\n",
                             c.a(0), g_state.rt.data, g_state.rt.format, w, h, c.a(1), g_state.zs.data, g_state.zs.format, zw, zh);
            }
        }
        g_state.viewport = {0, 0, w, h, 0.0f, 1.0f};
        uint32_t f = g_state.zs.header ? (g_state.zs.format >> 8) & 0xFF : 0x2E;
        g_state.zscale = f == 0x2C || f == 0x30 ? 65535.0f : 16777215.0f;
        break;
    }
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_SetViewport: {
        uint32_t v = c.a(0);
        float mn, mx;
        std::memcpy(&mn, HostPtr(v + 16), 4);
        std::memcpy(&mx, HostPtr(v + 20), 4);
        g_state.viewport = {R32(v), R32(v + 4), R32(v + 8), R32(v + 12), mn, mx};
        static int vplog = std::getenv("NGB_D3D_RTLOG") ? 400 : 0;
        if (vplog > 0 && (g_state.viewport.w <= 256 || !g_state.rt.data)) {
            vplog--;
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[RT] SetViewport %u %u %u %u z %g..%g (rt data %08X)\n", g_state.viewport.x, g_state.viewport.y,
                         g_state.viewport.w, g_state.viewport.h, mn, mx, g_state.rt.data);
        }
        // clamped to the target, as the XDK does: SetRenderTarget sets a 0x7FFFFFFF square
        uint32_t w, h;
        gpu::SurfaceSize(g_state.rt, w, h);
        if (w && h) {
            g_state.viewport.x = std::min(g_state.viewport.x, w);
            g_state.viewport.y = std::min(g_state.viewport.y, h);
            g_state.viewport.w = std::min(g_state.viewport.w, w - g_state.viewport.x);
            g_state.viewport.h = std::min(g_state.viewport.h, h - g_state.viewport.y);
        }
        g_state.scissor_count = 0;
        break;
    }
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_SetScissors:
        g_state.scissor_count = std::min<uint32_t>(c.a(0), 8);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_state.scissor_count * 4; i++) g_state.scissors[i] = R32(c.a(2) + i * 4);
        break;
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_SetScreenSpaceOffset:
        g_state.ss_offset_x = c.af(0);
        g_state.ss_offset_y = c.af(1);
        if (std::getenv("NGB_D3D_SSLOG")) {
            static float lx = -1e9f, ly = -1e9f;
            if (g_state.ss_offset_x != lx || g_state.ss_offset_y != ly)
                std::fprintf(stderr, "[D3D] screen space offset %g %g\n", g_state.ss_offset_x, g_state.ss_offset_y);
            lx = g_state.ss_offset_x;
            ly = g_state.ss_offset_y;
        }
        break;

    // drawing: DrawVerticesUP (prim, count, data, stride), DrawIndexedVertices (prim, count,
    // indices), DrawVertices (prim; start ecx, count eax), RunPushBuffer (buffer, fixups)
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_DrawVerticesUP: {
        uint32_t prim = c.a(0), count = c.a(1), data = c.a(2), stride = c.a(3);
        if (!count || !stride || !g_backend) break;
        // stream 0 points at the vertices through a vertex buffer header of ours, its data
        // address a virtual one (Common bit 31, mem::ResourceData)
        auto saved = g_state.streams[0];
        static uint32_t guest_header;
        if (!guest_header) guest_header = xbox_HeapAlloc(20, 16);
        W32(guest_header, 0x80000001u);
        W32(guest_header + 4, data);
        g_state.streams[0] = {guest_header, stride};
        Draw(prim, 0, count, nullptr);
        g_state.streams[0] = saved;
        break;
    }
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_DrawIndexedVertices:
        if (c.a(2)) Draw(c.a(0), 0, c.a(1), static_cast<const uint8_t*>(HostPtr(c.a(2))));
        break;
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_DrawVertices:
        Draw(c.a(0), c.r[ECX], c.r[EAX], nullptr);
        break;
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_RunPushBuffer:
        RunPushBuffer(c.a(0));
        break;

    case D3DF_D3DDevice_Clear: {                     // (count, rects, flags, color, z, stencil)
        if (!g_backend) break;
        const uint8_t* rects = c.a(0) && c.a(1) ? static_cast<const uint8_t*>(HostPtr(c.a(1))) : nullptr;
        g_backend->Clear(g_state, c.a(0), rects, c.a(2), c.a(3), c.af(4), c.a(5));
        break;
    }
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_CopyRects:                   // (source, rects, count, destination, points)
        if (g_backend) g_backend->Copy(SurfaceOf(c.a(0)), SurfaceOf(c.a(3)), c.a(2), c.a(1), c.a(4));
        break;
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_Swap:
        if (std::getenv("NGB_ASPECT_LOG")) {   // debugging: the projection's aspect (m22 / m11)
            static unsigned n;
            const auto& m = g_state.transforms[3];
            float m11, m22;
            std::memcpy(&m11, &m[0], 4);
            std::memcpy(&m22, &m[5], 4);
            if (n++ % 120 == 0) std::fprintf(stderr, "[ASPECT] projection m11 %.4f m22 %.4f aspect %.4f\n", m11, m22, m22 / m11);
        }
        if (g_backend) g_backend->Present(g_state.rt);
        break;
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_SetGammaRamp:
        if (g_backend) g_backend->SetGamma(static_cast<const uint8_t*>(HostPtr(c.a(1))));
        break;
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_EndVisibilityTest:
        g_vis_index = c.r[EAX];
        break;
    default:
        break;
    }
    return false;
}

// after the recompiled body: what it made
void After(int fn, Call c) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    switch (fn) {
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_CreateVertexShader: {
        uint32_t h = g_new_out ? R32(g_new_out) : 0;
        if (h) {
            auto vs = ReadVertexShader(g_new_decl, g_new_func);
            vs->handle = h;
            g_vs[h] = vs;
        }
        break;
    }
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_CreatePixelShader: {
        uint32_t h = g_new_out ? R32(g_new_out) : 0;
        if (h && g_new_decl) {
            auto ps = std::make_shared<gpu::PixelShader>();
            std::memcpy(ps->def, HostPtr(g_new_decl), sizeof(ps->def));
            ps->handle = h;
            g_ps[h] = ps;
        }
        break;
    }
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_SetRenderTarget:             // the default target when the argument was 0
        break;
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_EndVisibilityTest: {
        // its report slot: 16 bytes in the device's pages of them (allocated by the body as needed), where the
        // GPU writes the count; the renderer writes it there instead, once the frame's draws are done
        uint32_t dev = R32(kDevicePtr), page = dev ? R32(dev + 0x7D4 + (g_vis_index >> 8) * 4) : 0;
        if (g_backend && !g_mirror && page) g_backend->VisibilityEnd(page + (g_vis_index & 0xFF) * 16);
        break;
    }
    case D3DF_D3DDevice_Swap:
        // the swap turns the back buffer's surface to the other buffer's memory: the frame's first
        // clear (made before any SetRenderTarget) goes there, not into the picture just shown -- the
        // picture a cut's cross-fade copies at the next frame
        if (g_state.rt.header) g_state.rt = SurfaceOf(g_state.rt.header);
        break;
    default:
        break;
    }
}

extern "C" [[noreturn]] void ngb_renderer_fatal(const char* detail);  // src/ingame_menu.c

bool g_started;

void Start() {
    g_started = true;
    const char* e = std::getenv("NGB_RENDERER");
    g_mirror = !e || std::strcmp(e, "d3d") != 0;
    g_state = gpu::State{};
    g_backend = gpu::CreateBackend();
    if (g_backend && !g_backend->Init(640, 480)) {
        g_backend.reset();
        if (gpu::g_init_retry) {   // the NV2A renderer's device is not up yet: at the next call
            gpu::g_init_retry = false;
            g_started = false;
            return;
        }
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[D3D] renderer init failed\n");
        if (!g_mirror) ngb_renderer_fatal("The renderer could not start on this GPU (details above in the log).");
    }
    std::fprintf(stderr, "[D3D] renderer on (%s)\n", g_mirror ? "mirroring the NV2A emulation" : "drawing to the window");
}

}  // namespace

extern "C" int d3d_hle_call(int fn, uint32_t regs[8]) {
    if (!g_started) Start();
    return Before(fn, Call{regs}) ? 1 : 0;
}

// D3DDevice_BeginVisibilityTest, inlined into the title (src/d3d/d3d_hooks.c)
extern "C" void d3d_visibility_begin(void) {
    if (!g_started) Start();
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    if (g_backend && !g_mirror) g_backend->VisibilityBegin();
}

extern "C" void d3d_hle_after(int fn, const uint32_t regs[8]) {
    if (!g_started) Start();
    After(fn, Call{const_cast<uint32_t*>(regs)});
}

```

// The renderer on Vulkan (docs/renderer.md): the state the title handed Direct3D (gpu/state.h)
// drawn with shaders gpu/shaders.cpp writes. Modelled on SCDA-XBERecomp's gpu/d3d12.cpp (see
// NOTICE), without its Splinter Cell specifics (HDR, ambient occlusion, SMAA).
//
// Everything runs on the calling (game) thread and is submitted in one command buffer per frame,
// waited for at Present. Render targets live on the GPU, keyed by their guest memory; textures
// are decoded from guest memory and kept while their bytes are the same.
//
// NGB_D3D_DUMP=dir writes each presented frame (and NGB_D3D_DUMP_FROM=n, NGB_D3D_DUMP_COUNT=n

    o[1] = ((argb >> 8) & 255) / 255.0f;
    o[2] = (argb & 255) / 255.0f;
    o[3] = (argb >> 24) / 255.0f;
}

VkBlendFactor Blend(uint32_t v, bool alpha) {
    switch (v) {
    case 0: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ZERO;
    case 1: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE;
    case 0x300: return alpha ? VK_BLEND_FACTOR_SRC_ALPHA : VK_BLEND_FACTOR_SRC_COLOR;
    case 0x301: return alpha ? VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA : VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_SRC_COLOR;
    case 0x302: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_SRC_ALPHA;
    case 0x303: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA;
    case 0x304: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_DST_ALPHA;
    case 0x305: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_DST_ALPHA;
    case 0x306: return alpha ? VK_BLEND_FACTOR_DST_ALPHA : VK_BLEND_FACTOR_DST_COLOR;
    case 0x307: return alpha ? VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_DST_ALPHA : VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_DST_COLOR;
    case 0x308: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_SRC_ALPHA_SATURATE;
    case 0x8001: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_CONSTANT_COLOR;
    case 0x8002: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_CONSTANT_COLOR;
    case 0x8003: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_CONSTANT_ALPHA;
    case 0x8004: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_CONSTANT_ALPHA;
    default: return VK_BLEND_FACTOR_ONE;
    }
}

    case 0x800B: return VK_BLEND_OP_REVERSE_SUBTRACT;
    case 0x8007: return VK_BLEND_OP_MIN;
    case 0x8008: return VK_BLEND_OP_MAX;

    }

constexpr VkFormat kColorFormat = VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM;

// DXT1-5 blocks (w x h texels, rows of 4x4 blocks) to BGRA8, for a texture whose mipmaps are made here
void DecodeBC(Host h, const uint8_t* src, uint32_t w, uint32_t h_, std::vector<uint8_t>& out) {
    out.assign(size_t(w) * h_ * 4, 0);
    uint32_t bw = (w + 3) / 4, bh = (h_ + 3) / 4, bsize = h == Host::BC1 ? 8 : 16;
    for (uint32_t by = 0; by < bh; by++)
        for (uint32_t bx = 0; bx < bw; bx++) {
            const uint8_t* b = src + (size_t(by) * bw + bx) * bsize;
            const uint8_t* c = h == Host::BC1 ? b : b + 8;
            uint16_t c0 = uint16_t(c[0] | c[1] << 8), c1 = uint16_t(c[2] | c[3] << 8);
            uint8_t pal[4][4];   // B G R A
            auto rgb = [](uint16_t v, uint8_t* o) {
                o[2] = uint8_t((v >> 11) * 255 / 31);
                o[1] = uint8_t(((v >> 5) & 63) * 255 / 63);
                o[0] = uint8_t((v & 31) * 255 / 31);
                o[3] = 255;
            };
            rgb(c0, pal[0]);
            rgb(c1, pal[1]);
            bool four = h != Host::BC1 || c0 > c1;
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
                pal[2][k] = uint8_t(four ? (2 * pal[0][k] + pal[1][k]) / 3 : (pal[0][k] + pal[1][k]) / 2);
                pal[3][k] = uint8_t(four ? (pal[0][k] + 2 * pal[1][k]) / 3 : 0);
            }
            pal[2][3] = 255;
            pal[3][3] = four ? 255 : 0;
            uint32_t idx = uint32_t(c[4] | c[5] << 8 | c[6] << 16 | uint32_t(c[7]) << 24);
            uint8_t alpha[16];
            if (h == Host::BC2) {
                for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) alpha[i] = uint8_t(((b[i / 2] >> ((i & 1) * 4)) & 15) * 17);
            } else if (h == Host::BC3) {
                uint8_t a0 = b[0], a1 = b[1], ap[8] = {a0, a1};
                for (int i = 2; i < 8; i++)
                    ap[i] = a0 > a1 ? uint8_t(((8 - i) * a0 + (i - 1) * a1) / 7)
                            : i < 6 ? uint8_t(((6 - i) * a0 + (i - 1) * a1) / 5) : (i == 6 ? 0 : 255);
                uint64_t bits = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) bits |= uint64_t(b[2 + i]) << (8 * i);
                for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) alpha[i] = ap[(bits >> (3 * i)) & 7];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
                uint32_t x = bx * 4 + uint32_t(i & 3), y = by * 4 + uint32_t(i >> 2);
                if (x >= w || y >= h_) continue;
                uint8_t* o = &out[(size_t(y) * w + x) * 4];
                std::memcpy(o, pal[(idx >> (2 * i)) & 3], 4);
                if (h != Host::BC1) o[3] = alpha[i];
            }
        }
}

// an image of ours: a render target or a texture
struct Image {
    VkImage image = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VmaAllocation mem = nullptr;
    VkImageView view = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkFormat format = VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
    VkImageLayout layout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    uint32_t w = 0, h = 0, layers = 1, levels = 1, samples = 1;
    bool depth = false;
};

    uint32_t gw = 0, gh = 0;   // guest size
    uint32_t samples = 1;

struct Tex {

    Image sgn;                 // V8U8 (G8B8's code) for a bump map stage: its bytes ^ 0x80 (offset binary)
    int gen = -1;              // made with generated mipmaps (1), or as given (0)
    uint64_t sig = 0;          // the guest bytes (and palette) it was made from
    uint32_t used = 0;         // frame last used
    TexInfo info;
};

struct PipeKey {
    uint64_t vs, ps;
    uint32_t regs, elements[16], strides[16];
    uint32_t topo, strip;
    uint32_t blend, src, dst, op, wmask;
    uint32_t zen, zwrite, zfunc, sten, sfunc, smask, swmask, sfail, szfail, spass;
    int32_t zbias;
    float zslope;
    uint32_t cull, ccw, cullfront, fill;
    uint32_t has_rt, has_ds, ds_format, samples;
    bool operator==(const PipeKey& o) const { return std::memcmp(this, &o, sizeof(*this)) == 0; }
};
struct PipeHash {
    size_t operator()(const PipeKey& k) const { return size_t(Hash(&k, sizeof(k))); }
};

// a texture's top level to dir: DDS for DXT, PPM for BGRA8 (alpha dropped); name_or_null: tex_<addr>_<w>x<h>
void DumpTexture(const TextureDesc& d, const FormatInfo& fi, const uint8_t* guest, const uint32_t* palette,
                 const char* dir, const char* name) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> blk;
    uint32_t pitch0 = 0;
    DecodeLevel(d, 0, 0, guest, palette, blk, pitch0);
    char path[512], base[128];
    if (!name) {
        std::snprintf(base, sizeof(base), "tex_%08X_%ux%u", d.data, d.width, d.height);
        name = base;
    }
    if (fi.host == Host::BC1 || fi.host == Host::BC3 || fi.host == Host::BC2) {
        std::snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s/%s.dds", dir, name);
        if (FILE* f = std::fopen(path, "wb")) {
            uint32_t h[32] = {};
            h[0] = 0x20534444;  // "DDS "
            h[1] = 124;
            h[2] = 0x1007;
            h[3] = d.height;
            h[4] = d.width;
            h[5] = uint32_t(blk.size());
            h[19] = 32;
            h[20] = 4;
            h[21] = fi.host == Host::BC1 ? 0x31545844 : fi.host == Host::BC2 ? 0x33545844 : 0x35545844;
            h[27] = 0x1000;
            std::fwrite(h, 4, 32, f);
            std::fwrite(blk.data(), 1, blk.size(), f);
            std::fclose(f);
        }
    } else if (fi.host == Host::BGRA8 && blk.size() >= size_t(d.width) * d.height * 4) {
        std::snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s/%s.ppm", dir, name);
        if (FILE* f = std::fopen(path, "wb")) {
            std::fprintf(f, "P6\n%u %u\n255\n", d.width, d.height);
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < d.width * d.height; i++) {
                uint8_t rgb[3] = {blk[i * 4 + 2], blk[i * 4 + 1], blk[i * 4]};
                std::fwrite(rgb, 1, 3, f);
            }
            std::fclose(f);
        }
    }
}

class VulkanBackend final : public Backend {
public:
    ~VulkanBackend() override;
    bool Init(uint32_t width, uint32_t height) override;
    void Clear(const State& s, uint32_t count, const uint8_t* rects, uint32_t flags, uint32_t color, float z,
               uint32_t stencil) override;
    void Draw(const State& s, uint32_t prim, uint32_t start, uint32_t count, const uint8_t* indices) override;
    void Copy(const Surface& src, const Surface& dst, uint32_t count, uint32_t src_rects, uint32_t dst_points) override;
    void Present(const Surface& front) override;
    void Sync(uint32_t, uint32_t) override {}
    void SyncLate(uint32_t) override {}
    void Flush() override { Submit(); }
    void SetGamma(const uint8_t* ramp) override;
    void VisibilityBegin() override { vis_on_ = true; vis_test_++; }
    void VisibilityEnd(uint32_t report_va) override;

private:
    // device: the NV2A renderer's, shared, when NGB_RENDERER=d3d (its presenter then shows our
    // frames in the game window); else one of our own, drawing unseen (mirror mode)
    bool CreateInstance();
    bool CreateDevice();
    bool AdoptDevice(const nv2a_vk_shared& sh);
    bool FinishDevice();
    bool shared_ = false;
    void QueueSubmit(const VkSubmitInfo& si, VkFence fence);
    Image display_[3];   // copies of the front buffer for the presenter, in turn
    // the title's gamma ramp (D3DDevice_SetGammaRamp: its Screen Adjustment -- gamma, brightness,
    // contrast), applied as the front buffer is copied for the presenter; identity: a plain copy
    uint8_t gamma_[768] = {};
    bool gamma_on_ = false, gamma_dirty_ = false;
    Image gamma_lut_;    // 256 x 1, each channel its ramp
    // src into dst through the gamma ramp (gamma_on_), with black beyond the middle's edges (bars: the
    // picture's part at each side, 0 none)
    void GammaCopy(Image& src, Image& dst, float bars = 0, float bars_y = 0);
    // The bars beside a 2D screen filled with its own colours, still: the picture's edges (16 bands a side,
    // rows left, right, top, bottom), blended in over the screen's first 2 s, then kept as they are --
    // a menu's animation does not move them (copied each frame, the sides flickered with it)
    Image edge_;
    VkSampler edge_sampler_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    uint32_t edge_frames_ = 0;
    bool edge_use_ = false;   // (else the bars black: null2d_, cleared)
    void EdgeSample(Image& src, float bars, float bars_y);
    int display_next_ = 0;
    // the quality settings (nv2a_quality_get), read once a frame: display-sized targets render
    // at scale_ times their size, small depth-only ones (shadow maps) at shadow_ times
    int scale_ = 1, shadow_ = 1, aniso_level_ = 0, msaa_ = 1;
    bool anisotropy_ = false;
    bool wide_lines_ = false;   // lines wider than a pixel (the sparks of a hit are 2.7 to 3, #51)
    float point_max_ = 1.0f;    // the largest point (largePoints): the particles are point sprites (#51)
    float line_max_ = 1.0f;
    VkSampleCountFlags ms_counts_ = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;   // the device's for colour and depth together
    void ReadQuality();
    float hud_cover_ = 0;      // this frame's 2D picture area, in screens
    bool hud_menu_ = false;    // the frame before was a full-screen menu (most of it 2D pictures)
    float gauge_x_[4][2] = {}, gauge_prev_[4][2] = {};   // tall HUD gauges' columns (this frame, the one before)
    // The HUD in play on a screen not 16:9 (HudPlace): this frame's pieces, and the elements -- pieces near
    // each other, together -- of the frame before, each with the side it keeps to
    struct HudBox { float x0, x1, y0, y1; uint32_t at; };   // (at: the draw's number in its frame)
    struct HudElem { float x0, x1, y0, y1, ax, ay; uint32_t seen; bool gauge; };
    std::vector<HudBox> hud_boxes_;
    std::vector<HudBox> hud_gauge_boxes_;   // the frame before's pieces of tall side gauges (hud_gauge_piece)
    std::vector<HudElem> hud_elems_, hud_memory_;   // the frame before's; and those of the last half minute
    // the frame's last 3D draw into the back buffer (its number): the HUD is drawn after it, what is drawn in
    // screen space before it is the 3D's (mist, spray) -- not grouped as the HUD (a draw cannot know it as it
    // is made: how many 3D draws a frame has changes from frame to frame)
    uint32_t last3d_now_ = 0;
    float hud_box_cover_ = 0;
    // a menu over the paused game (the save statue's): the paused picture drawn this frame, and how much of
    // the screen the 2D drawn over it covers -- little, and the game shows across the screen instead of bars
    bool paused_now_ = false;
    bool covered_now_ = false;   // this frame drew an opaque colour over the whole screen (so far)
    uint32_t pic_tex_ = 0;   // this frame's opaque picture across the screen so far: its texture, its right end
    float pic_x1_ = -1;
    float paused_cover_ = 0;   // how much of the screen the frame before's HUD pieces covered (the trace's)
    // a screen of panels over the game (a chapter clear's): an element large and about the middle, for 4 frames
    // running; over once there has been none for 8
    bool hud_panel_ = false;
    int hud_panel_count_ = 0;
    HudBox hud_panel_box_{}, hud_panel_seen_{};   // the panel's box (the union of the frames it was seen in)
    void HudPlace(float x0, float x1, float y0, float y1, float w, float h, float& ax, float& ay);
    void HudGroup(float w, float h);
    int gauges_now_ = 0;
    uint32_t offscreen3d_ = 0;   // this frame's 3D draws into smaller targets (shadows, reflections, effects)
    uint32_t threed_ = 0, threed_prev_ = 0;   // 3D draws into the back buffer, this frame and the one before:
                                              // a screen with them is play (an underwater overlay is no menu)
    VolkDeviceTable d_{};
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, std::pair<uint64_t, uint64_t>> sig_memo_;   // texture bytes' signature this frame

    // the title's visibility tests (the sun's lens flare, #35): each draw in one counted by an occlusion query,
    // per frame slot; when the slot's frame is done, the counts summed per test, in console pixels, and
    // written to each ended test's report slot as the GPU would (xemu's renderer, not drawing, would say 0)
    static constexpr uint32_t kVisQueries = 512;
    struct VisQuery { uint32_t test; float div; };
    VkQueryPool vis_pool_[2] = {};
    std::vector<VisQuery> vis_q_[2];
    std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t>> vis_end_[2];   // test, report slot
    std::unordered_map<uint32_t, double> vis_sum_;
    uint32_t vis_test_ = 0;
    bool vis_on_ = false;
    void VisResults(int slot);
    VkInstance inst_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkPhysicalDevice phys_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkDevice dev_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkQueue queue_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    uint32_t qfam_ = 0;
    VmaAllocator vma_ = nullptr;
    VkFormat ds_format_ = VK_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT;

    // the frame's commands
    VkCommandPool pool_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    // two frames in flight: the game records the next while the GPU draws the last; cmd_, fence_ and
    // the ring's half are the recording slot's
    VkCommandBuffer cmd_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkFence fence_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkCommandBuffer cmds_[2] = {};
    VkFence fences_[2] = {};
    bool submitted_[2] = {};
    int slot_ = 0;
    void EndFrame();
    // images no longer used, destroyed once no frame in flight can use them
    struct Retired { Image img; VkImageView view; uint32_t frame; };
    std::vector<Retired> graveyard_;
    void Retire(Image& img, VkImageView extra = VK_NULL_HANDLE);
    bool recording_ = false;
    void Begin();
    void Submit();
    uint32_t frame_ = 0;

    // the upload ring
    VkBuffer ring_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VmaAllocation ring_mem_ = nullptr;
    uint8_t* ring_cpu_ = nullptr;
    VkDeviceSize ring_pos_ = 0;
    VkDeviceSize ringAlign_ = 256;
    VkDeviceSize Upload(const void* data, VkDeviceSize bytes, VkDeviceSize align);

    // images
    bool CreateImage(Image& img, VkFormat fmt, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t layers, uint32_t levels, bool depth,
                     bool cube, VkImageUsageFlags usage, uint32_t samples = 1, bool mutable_format = false);
    void DestroyImage(Image& img);
    void Barrier(Image& img, VkImageLayout to);

    // targets
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, Target> targets_;
    Target* EnsureTarget(const Surface& s, bool depth);
    Target* MakeTarget(const Surface& s, bool depth, uint64_t key, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t iw, uint32_t ih,
                       uint32_t samples);
    Target* bound_rt_ = nullptr;
    Target* bound_ds_ = nullptr;
    bool rendering_ = false;
    void BeginRendering(Target* rt, Target* ds);
    void EndRendering();
    void FillMs(Target& t);    // MSAA image from the plain one (a picture kept across a setting change)
    VkSampler fill_sampler_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;

    // textures
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, Tex> textures_;
    VkImageView BindTexture(const State& s, int stage, TexInfo& info, bool& from_target);
    Image null2d_, nullcube_, null3d_;
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, VkSampler> samplers_;
    VkSampler Sampler(const State& s, int stage, const TexInfo& info);

    // shaders and pipelines
    VkDescriptorSetLayout set_layout_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkPipelineLayout pipe_layout_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, VkShaderModule> modules_;
    std::unordered_map<PipeKey, VkPipeline, PipeHash> pipelines_;
    VkShaderModule Module(uint64_t key, const std::function<std::string()>& src, bool vertex);
    VkPipeline Pipeline(const PipeKey& k);

    Assembled asm_;
    // the shader cache (ShaderCache below): how each module was made, its SPIR-V, the pipelines
    std::recursive_mutex cache_mu_;   // modules_ and pipelines_ (the prewarm thread fills them too)
    std::mutex compile_mu_;           // glslang, one at a time
    std::string cache_dir_;
    FILE* recipes_ = nullptr;         // cache_dir_/recipes.bin: modules' inputs, pipeline keys (appended)
    FILE* spirv_ = nullptr;           // cache_dir_/spirv.bin: SPIR-V by the hash of its HLSL (appended)
    FILE* seed_out_ = nullptr;        // NGB_D3D_SEED_RECORD: the same records, for a shipped seed
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, std::vector<uint32_t>> spirv_by_src_;
    VkPipelineCache pcache_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    uint32_t pcache_saved_ = 0;
    std::atomic<uint32_t> pipes_since_save_{0};
    std::thread saver_;                      // the periodic save of pcache_, off the frame (CacheSavePipelinesSoon)
    std::atomic<bool> saving_{false};
    // shaders and pipelines a draw needs and nothing has made yet: made on a thread of their own while the
    // draw is left out (a frame or two), instead of the frame waiting for them (a hitch). NGB_D3D_SYNC_COMPILE=1
    // makes them at once instead.
    struct Job { bool pipeline; uint64_t key; std::string hlsl; bool vertex; PipeKey pk; };
    std::thread compiler_;
    std::mutex job_mu_;
    std::condition_variable job_cv_;
    std::deque<Job> jobs_;
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, bool> pending_mods_;
    std::unordered_map<PipeKey, bool, PipeHash> pending_pipes_;
    std::unordered_map<PipeKey, bool, PipeHash> known_pipes_;   // the seed's and earlier sessions' (cache_mu_)
    bool async_ = true;      // the setting
    bool async_now_ = false; // for the draw being made (the backend's own passes make theirs at once)
    void Compiler();
    std::atomic<uint32_t> async_made_{0}, skipped_{0};
    std::thread prewarm_;
    std::atomic<bool> stop_{false};
    std::atomic<uint32_t> prewarm_done_{0};
    void CacheOpen();
    void CacheRecord(char kind, uint64_t key, const void* data, size_t n, FILE* only = nullptr);
    void CacheSavePipelines();
    void CacheSavePipelinesSoon();
    void CacheWritePipelines();
    void Prewarm();
    void WarmSamples(uint32_t samples);
    uint32_t warmed_samples_ = 0;
    std::atomic<uint32_t> warm_want_{0};   // the sample count being warmed: another stops the one under way
    bool Compile(const std::string& hlsl, bool vertex, std::vector<uint32_t>& spirv);
    bool SpirvKnown(const std::string& hlsl, bool vertex);
    VkShaderModule MakeModule(const std::vector<uint32_t>& spirv);
    VkPipeline MakePipeline(const PipeKey& k, VkShaderModule vs, VkShaderModule ps);
    std::string CurrentVertexProgramRecipe(const std::vector<uint32_t>& prog, uint16_t regs, uint64_t decode,
                                           uint32_t quad, std::vector<uint8_t>& out);
    uint64_t compile_us_ = 0;      // this frame's shader and pipeline making
    uint32_t compiles_ = 0, pipes_made_ = 0;

    // NGB_D3D_STATS: per frame, what the draws came to
    struct Stats { uint32_t draws, noasm, notarget, nopipe, drawn, clears, copies; } st_{};
    std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint32_t> rt_draws_;
    bool stats_ = false;

    // dumps
    std::string dump_dir_;
    FILE* trace_ = nullptr;   // F7's recording: draws.txt
    std::string trace_dir_;
    int trace_left_ = 0;
    uint32_t trace_pic_until_ = 0;   // NGB_TRACE_NOPIC=copy: pictures only around a copy into a 512x512 target
    Image trace_img_;         // the front buffer, small, for its picture
    void TraceFrame(Target& t);
    uint32_t dump_from_ = 0, dump_count_ = 0, presents_ = 0;
    void Dump(Target& t, const char* name = nullptr);
};

#define VKCHECK(x)                                                                  \
    do {                                                                            \
        VkResult r_ = (x);                                                          \
        if (r_ != VK_SUCCESS) {                                                     \
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[D3D] vulkan: %s failed (%d)\n", #x, int(r_));    \
            return false;                                                           \
        }                                                                           \
    } while (0)

bool VulkanBackend::CreateInstance() {
    if (volkGetInstanceVersion() == 0 && volkInitialize() != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
    VkApplicationInfo app{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO};
    app.pApplicationName = "Ninja Gaiden Black (Direct3D renderer)";
    app.apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_3;
    VkInstanceCreateInfo ci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO};
    ci.pApplicationInfo = &app;
#ifdef __APPLE__
    const char *extensions[] = {VK_KHR_PORTABILITY_ENUMERATION_EXTENSION_NAME};
    ci.enabledExtensionCount = 1;
    ci.ppEnabledExtensionNames = extensions;
    ci.flags |= VK_INSTANCE_CREATE_ENUMERATE_PORTABILITY_BIT_KHR;
#endif
    VKCHECK(vkCreateInstance(&ci, nullptr, &inst_));
    // the instance functions: shared with the NV2A renderer's when it has loaded them (loader
    // trampolines, good for either instance), else ours
    if (!volkGetLoadedInstance()) volkLoadInstanceOnly(inst_);
    return true;
}

bool VulkanBackend::CreateDevice() {
    uint32_t n = 0;
    vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(inst_, &n, nullptr);
    std::vector<VkPhysicalDevice> devs(n);
    vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(inst_, &n, devs.data());
    for (VkPhysicalDevice p : devs) {
        VkPhysicalDeviceProperties pr;
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(p, &pr);
        if (pr.apiVersion < VK_API_VERSION_1_3) continue;
        if (!phys_ || pr.deviceType == VK_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_TYPE_DISCRETE_GPU) phys_ = p;
    }
    if (!phys_) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[D3D] vulkan: no Vulkan 1.3 device\n");
        return false;
    }
    uint32_t qn = 0;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(phys_, &qn, nullptr);
    std::vector<VkQueueFamilyProperties> qf(qn);
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(phys_, &qn, qf.data());
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < qn; i++)
        if (qf[i].queueFlags & VK_QUEUE_GRAPHICS_BIT) {
            qfam_ = i;
            break;
        }
    float prio = 1.0f;
    VkDeviceQueueCreateInfo qci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_INFO};
    qci.queueFamilyIndex = qfam_;
    qci.queueCount = 1;
    qci.pQueuePriorities = &prio;
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan13Features f13{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_3_FEATURES};
    f13.dynamicRendering = VK_TRUE;
    f13.synchronization2 = VK_TRUE;
    VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 f2{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2};
    f2.pNext = &f13;
    f2.features.samplerAnisotropy = VK_TRUE;
    f2.features.fillModeNonSolid = VK_TRUE;
    f2.features.textureCompressionBC = VK_TRUE;
    {
        VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures have;
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures(phys_, &have);
        f2.features.wideLines = have.wideLines;
        f2.features.largePoints = have.largePoints;
    }
    const char* exts[] = {VK_KHR_PUSH_DESCRIPTOR_EXTENSION_NAME,
#ifdef __APPLE__
                          "VK_KHR_portability_subset",
#endif
    };
    VkDeviceCreateInfo dci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO};
    dci.pNext = &f2;
    dci.queueCreateInfoCount = 1;
    dci.pQueueCreateInfos = &qci;
    dci.enabledExtensionCount = sizeof(exts) / sizeof(exts[0]);
    dci.ppEnabledExtensionNames = exts;
    VKCHECK(vkCreateDevice(phys_, &dci, nullptr, &dev_));
    volkLoadDeviceTable(&d_, dev_);
    d_.vkGetDeviceQueue(dev_, qfam_, 0, &queue_);
    return FinishDevice();
}

bool VulkanBackend::AdoptDevice(const nv2a_vk_shared& sh) {
    if (volkGetInstanceVersion() == 0 && volkInitialize() != VK_SUCCESS) return false;
    inst_ = sh.instance;
    phys_ = sh.physical_device;
    dev_ = sh.device;
    qfam_ = sh.queue_family;
    queue_ = sh.queue;
    if (!volkGetLoadedInstance()) volkLoadInstanceOnly(inst_);
    volkLoadDeviceTable(&d_, dev_);
    shared_ = true;
    return FinishDevice();
}

bool VulkanBackend::FinishDevice() {
    VmaAllocatorCreateInfo ai{};
    ai.physicalDevice = phys_;
    ai.device = dev_;
    ai.instance = inst_;
    ai.vulkanApiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_3;
    VmaVulkanFunctions fns{};
    VKCHECK(vmaImportVulkanFunctionsFromVolk(&ai, &fns));
    ai.pVulkanFunctions = &fns;
    VKCHECK(vmaCreateAllocator(&ai, &vma_));

    // 24-bit depth, as the console has, where the device has it (Nvidia); else float (AMD). 0.9.17 gave
    // Nvidia float depth too, for the shadow blotches of #29: they stayed, and second passes over a drawn
    // surface came out flickering or missing on Nvidia (#51, #53). NGB_D3D_DEPTH32=1: float, to compare.
    VkFormatProperties fp;
    bool d32 = std::getenv("NGB_D3D_DEPTH32") != nullptr;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties(phys_, VK_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT, &fp);
    ds_format_ = !d32 && (fp.optimalTilingFeatures & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_BIT)
                     ? VK_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT : VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT;
    std::fprintf(stderr, "[D3D] depth: %s\n", ds_format_ == VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT ? "32-bit float" : "24-bit");
    VkPhysicalDeviceProperties pr;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(phys_, &pr);
    ringAlign_ = std::max<VkDeviceSize>(pr.limits.minUniformBufferOffsetAlignment, 16);
    VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures feat;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures(phys_, &feat);   // both devices enable it when it is there
    anisotropy_ = feat.samplerAnisotropy == VK_TRUE;
    wide_lines_ = feat.wideLines == VK_TRUE;
    line_max_ = pr.limits.lineWidthRange[1];
    point_max_ = feat.largePoints == VK_TRUE ? pr.limits.pointSizeRange[1] : 1.0f;
    ms_counts_ = pr.limits.framebufferColorSampleCounts & pr.limits.framebufferDepthSampleCounts &
                 pr.limits.framebufferStencilSampleCounts;
    ReadQuality();
    std::fprintf(stderr, "[D3D] vulkan: %s%s\n", pr.deviceName, shared_ ? " (the NV2A renderer's device)" : "");
    return true;
}

void VulkanBackend::ReadQuality() {
    int msaa = 1;
    nv2a_quality_get(&scale_, &aniso_level_, &shadow_, &msaa);
    while (msaa > 1 && !(ms_counts_ & uint32_t(msaa))) msaa /= 2;   // the most the device has
    msaa_ = msaa;
    // a new anti-aliasing setting: its pipelines made in the background once the startup ones are
    if (prewarm_done_ && warmed_samples_ != uint32_t(msaa)) {
        if (!warmed_samples_) {
            warmed_samples_ = uint32_t(msaa);   // the startup warm-up did this one
        } else {
            warmed_samples_ = uint32_t(msaa);
            warm_want_ = uint32_t(msaa);
            if (prewarm_.joinable()) prewarm_.join();
            prewarm_ = std::thread([this, msaa] { WarmSamples(uint32_t(msaa)); });
        }
    }
    if (const char* e = std::getenv("NGB_D3D_SCALE")) scale_ = std::clamp(std::atoi(e), 1, 10);   // debugging
    if (const char* e = std::getenv("NGB_D3D_QUALITY_FLIP")) {   // testing: MSAA and scale changing every n s
        static uint32_t start = presents_;
        uint32_t n = uint32_t(std::max(1, std::atoi(e)) * 60), k = (presents_ - start) / n;
        if (k & 1) {
            msaa_ = (ms_counts_ & 4) ? 4 : 1;
            scale_ = 3;
        }
    }
}

void VulkanBackend::QueueSubmit(const VkSubmitInfo& si, VkFence fence) {
    if (shared_) nv2a_vk_queue_lock();
    d_.vkQueueSubmit(queue_, 1, &si, fence);
    if (shared_) nv2a_vk_queue_unlock();
}

bool VulkanBackend::Init(uint32_t, uint32_t) {
    const char* mode = std::getenv("NGB_RENDERER");
    if (mode && !std::strcmp(mode, "d3d")) {
        nv2a_vk_shared sh{};
        int st = nv2a_vk_share(&sh);
        if (st == 0) {
            g_init_retry = true;   // the NV2A renderer is still starting
            return false;
        }
        if (st == 1 && sh.features13) {
            if (!AdoptDevice(sh)) return false;
            // the NV2A renderer keeps executing the pushbuffer (the title's fences, flips and
            // vertical blanks come from it) but no longer draws; NGB_D3D_KEEP_NV2A=1 keeps it
            // drawing (unseen) for comparisons
            if (!std::getenv("NGB_D3D_KEEP_NV2A")) nv2a_vk_set_draws_off(true);
        } else {
            ngb_renderer_fatal(st == 1 ? "The GPU's Vulkan driver has no Vulkan 1.3 dynamic rendering or push descriptors."
                                       : "No Vulkan device could be used.");
        }
    }
    if (!shared_ && (!CreateInstance() || !CreateDevice())) return false;

    VkCommandPoolCreateInfo pci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO};
    pci.flags = VK_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_RESET_COMMAND_BUFFER_BIT;
    pci.queueFamilyIndex = qfam_;
    VKCHECK(d_.vkCreateCommandPool(dev_, &pci, nullptr, &pool_));
    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo cai{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO};
    cai.commandPool = pool_;
    cai.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY;
    cai.commandBufferCount = 2;
    VKCHECK(d_.vkAllocateCommandBuffers(dev_, &cai, cmds_));
    VkFenceCreateInfo fci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO};
    VKCHECK(d_.vkCreateFence(dev_, &fci, nullptr, &fences_[0]));
    VKCHECK(d_.vkCreateFence(dev_, &fci, nullptr, &fences_[1]));
    cmd_ = cmds_[0];
    fence_ = fences_[0];

    VkBufferCreateInfo bci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO};
    bci.size = kRingSize;
    bci.usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_VERTEX_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_INDEX_BUFFER_BIT |
                VK_BUFFER_USAGE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT;
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo aci{};
    aci.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO;
    aci.flags = VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_HOST_ACCESS_SEQUENTIAL_WRITE_BIT | VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_MAPPED_BIT;
    VmaAllocationInfo info;
    VKCHECK(vmaCreateBuffer(vma_, &bci, &aci, &ring_, &ring_mem_, &info));
    ring_cpu_ = static_cast<uint8_t*>(info.pMappedData);

    // set 0: VC, DC, four textures, four samplers; pushed per draw
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding b[10] = {};
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        b[i].binding = uint32_t(i);
        b[i].descriptorCount = 1;
        b[i].stageFlags = VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT | VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT;
        b[i].descriptorType = i < 2 ? VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER
                              : i < 6 ? VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_SAMPLED_IMAGE : VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_SAMPLER;
    }
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo lci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO};
    lci.flags = VK_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_PUSH_DESCRIPTOR_BIT_KHR;
    lci.bindingCount = 10;
    lci.pBindings = b;
    VKCHECK(d_.vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(dev_, &lci, nullptr, &set_layout_));
    VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo plci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO};
    plci.setLayoutCount = 1;
    plci.pSetLayouts = &set_layout_;
    VKCHECK(d_.vkCreatePipelineLayout(dev_, &plci, nullptr, &pipe_layout_));

    // stand-ins for stages without a texture, of each kind
    VkImageUsageFlags u = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT;
    if (!CreateImage(null2d_, kColorFormat, 1, 1, 1, 1, false, false, u) ||
        !CreateImage(nullcube_, kColorFormat, 1, 1, 6, 1, false, true, u) ||
        !CreateImage(null3d_, kColorFormat, 1, 1, 1, 1, false, false, u))
        return false;

    stats_ = std::getenv("NGB_D3D_STATS") != nullptr;
    if (const char* e = std::getenv("NGB_D3D_DUMP")) {
        dump_dir_ = e;
        dump_from_ = std::getenv("NGB_D3D_DUMP_FROM") ? uint32_t(std::atoi(std::getenv("NGB_D3D_DUMP_FROM"))) : 0;
        dump_count_ = std::getenv("NGB_D3D_DUMP_COUNT") ? uint32_t(std::atoi(std::getenv("NGB_D3D_DUMP_COUNT"))) : 1u << 30;
    }
    VkQueryPoolCreateInfo qci{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_QUERY_POOL_CREATE_INFO};
    qci.queryType = VK_QUERY_TYPE_OCCLUSION;
    qci.queryCount = kVisQueries;
    for (auto& p : vis_pool_)
        if (d_.vkCreateQueryPool(dev_, &qci, nullptr, &p) != VK_SUCCESS) p = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    Begin();
    Barrier(null2d_, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
    Barrier(nullcube_, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
    Barrier(null3d_, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
    CacheOpen();
    return true;
}

VulkanBackend::~VulkanBackend() {
    stop_ = true;
    if (prewarm_.joinable()) prewarm_.join();
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> g(job_mu_);
        job_cv_.notify_all();
    }
    if (compiler_.joinable()) compiler_.join();
    if (saver_.joinable()) saver_.join();
    CacheSavePipelines();
    if (shared_) {
        nv2a_vk_set_draws_off(false);
        nv2a_present_set_external(VK_NULL_HANDLE, 0, 0);
        nv2a_vk_queue_lock();
        d_.vkDeviceWaitIdle(dev_);
        nv2a_vk_queue_unlock();
    } else if (dev_) {
        d_.vkDeviceWaitIdle(dev_);
    }
}

void VulkanBackend::Begin() {
    if (recording_) return;
