```c
    unsigned char desc[SECTOR];
    int rc = -1, found = 0;

    im.f = fopen(iso, "rb");
    if (!im.f) {
        fail("Cannot open %s: %s", iso, strerror(errno));
        return -1;
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof BASES / sizeof BASES[0]; i++) {
        im.base = BASES[i];
        if (read_at(&im, 32, desc, sizeof desc) == 0 &&
            !memcmp(desc, XDVDFS_MAGIC, sizeof XDVDFS_MAGIC)) {
            uint32_t root = desc[20] | desc[21] << 8 | desc[22] << 16 | (uint32_t)desc[23] << 24;
            uint32_t rsize = desc[24] | desc[25] << 8 | desc[26] << 16 | (uint32_t)desc[27] << 24;
            found = 1;
            fprintf(stderr, "Extracting the game from %s ...\n", iso);
            im.count_only = 1;
            rc = extract_dir(&im, root, rsize, dest);
            im.count_only = 0;
            if (rc == 0) {
                if (mkdirs(dest) != 0) {
                    fail("Cannot create the folder %s: %s", dest, strerror(errno));
                    rc = -1;
                } else {
                    rc = extract_dir(&im, root, rsize, dest);
                }
            }
            if (rc != 0 && !s_err[0])
                fail("The disc image could not be read.");
            if (rc == 0)
                fprintf(stderr, "  done: %llu files, %llu MB\n",
                        (unsigned long long)im.files, (unsigned long long)(im.bytes >> 20));
            break;
        }
    }
    if (!found)
        fail("%s is not an Xbox disc image.", iso);
    fclose(im.f);
    return rc;
}

/* ---- archives ---------------------------------------------------------- */

#if defined(_WIN32)
/* argv[0] with its arguments, quoted for the command line, run without a
 * console window; its exit status, or -1 when it cannot start. */
static int run(char *const argv[])
{
    char cmd[8192];
    size_t len = 0;
    STARTUPINFOA si = { sizeof si };
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi;
    DWORD status = 1;

    if (s_cancel)
        return -1;
    for (int i = 0; argv[i]; i++)
        len += (size_t)snprintf(cmd + len, len < sizeof cmd ? sizeof cmd - len : 0,
                                "%s\"%s\"", i ? " " : "", argv[i]);
    if (len >= sizeof cmd)
        return -1;
    if (!CreateProcessA(NULL, cmd, NULL, NULL, FALSE, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi))
        return -1;
    CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
    s_child = pi.hProcess;
    WaitForSingleObject(pi.hProcess, INFINITE);
    GetExitCodeProcess(pi.hProcess, &status);
    s_child = NULL;
    CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);
    return (int)status;
}
#else
static int run(char *const argv[])
{
    pid_t pid;
    int status, rc;
    if (s_cancel)
        return -1;
    pid = fork();
    if (pid == 0) {
        execvp(argv[0], argv);
        _exit(127);
    }
    s_child = pid;
    rc = pid < 0 || waitpid(pid, &status, 0) < 0 ? -1
         : WIFEXITED(status) ? WEXITSTATUS(status) : -1;
    s_child = 0;
    return rc;
}
#endif

static int find_iso(const char *dir, char *out, size_t n)
{
    DIR *d = opendir(dir);
    struct dirent *e;
    int found = 0;
    if (!d)
        return 0;
    while (!found && (e = readdir(d))) {
        const char *dot = strrchr(e->d_name, '.');
        if (dot && (!strcasecmp(dot, ".iso") || !strcasecmp(dot, ".xiso"))) {
            snprintf(out, n, "%s/%s", dir, e->d_name);
            found = 1;
        }
    }
    closedir(d);
    return found;
}

/* Unpack an archive with whatever the system has: bsdtar (libarchive, on
 * SteamOS and most desktops; Windows' own tar.exe is one) reads .7z and .zip,
 * else 7z/7za (on Windows also 7-Zip where its installer puts it). */
static int unpack_archive(const char *archive, const char *tmp)
{
#if defined(_WIN32)
    char *bsdtar[] = { "tar", "-xf", (char *)archive, "-C", (char *)tmp, NULL };
    char sevenzip[MAX_PATH + 32];
    const char *pf = getenv("ProgramFiles");
    char *installed[] = { sevenzip, "x", "-y", NULL, (char *)archive, NULL };
#else
    char *bsdtar[] = { "bsdtar", "-xf", (char *)archive, "-C", (char *)tmp, NULL };
#endif
    char opt[4200];
    char *sevenz[] = { "7z", "x", "-y", opt, (char *)archive, NULL };
    char *sevenza[] = { "7za", "x", "-y", opt, (char *)archive, NULL };

    snprintf(opt, sizeof opt, "-o%s", tmp);
    fprintf(stderr, "Unpacking %s (this needs about 8 GB free for a while) ...\n", archive);
    if (run(bsdtar) == 0 || run(sevenz) == 0 || run(sevenza) == 0)
        return 0;
#if defined(_WIN32)
    snprintf(sevenzip, sizeof sevenzip, "%s\\7-Zip\\7z.exe", pf && *pf ? pf : "C:\\Program Files");
    installed[3] = opt;
    if (!s_cancel && run(installed) == 0)
        return 0;
#endif
    if (s_cancel) {
        fail("Cancelled.");
        return -1;
    }
    fail("Cannot unpack %s: install bsdtar (libarchive) or 7-Zip, "
         "or extract the .iso from it yourself and choose that.", archive);
    return -1;
}

static void remove_tree(const char *path)
{
    DIR *d = opendir(path);
    struct dirent *e;
    if (d) {
        while ((e = readdir(d))) {
            char p[4096];
            if (!strcmp(e->d_name, ".") || !strcmp(e->d_name, ".."))
                continue;
            snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", path, e->d_name);
            if (is_dir(p))
                remove_tree(p);
            else
                unlink(p);
        }
        closedir(d);
    }
    rmdir(path);
}

/* ---- the picker -------------------------------------------------------- */

#if defined(_WIN32)
static void to_slashes(char *p)
{
    for (; *p; p++)
        if (*p == '\\')
            *p = '/';
}

/* The first start: what the game needs, then the choice -- a disc image, a folder of
 * extracted files, or quitting (0 quit, 1 image, 2 folder). A task dialog (common
 * controls 6, packaging/windows/ngb.manifest); a message box where there is none. */
static int win_welcome(const char *installed, int *portable)
{
    typedef HRESULT(WINAPI * TaskDialogIndirectFn)(const TASKDIALOGCONFIG *, int *, int *, BOOL *);
    char path[1024], text[2048];
    wchar_t wtext[2048];
    const char *lad = getenv("LOCALAPPDATA");
    size_t ln = lad ? strlen(lad) : 0;
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s", installed);
    for (char *q = path; *q; q++)
        if (*q == '/')
            *q = '\\';
    if (ln && strncasecmp(path, lad, ln) == 0 && (path[ln] == '\\' || !path[ln])) {   /* short */
        char rest[1024];
        snprintf(rest, sizeof rest, "%s", path + ln);
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%%LOCALAPPDATA%%%s", rest);
    }
    snprintf(text, sizeof text,
             "The game itself is not included. To play, choose your own copy of the "
             "Xbox game (the retail USA release):\n\n"
             "\u2022  a disc image: .iso, including a full Redump dump, or the .7z / .zip it came in\n"
             "\u2022  or a folder of extracted files, with default.xbe\n\n"
             "A disc image is installed once (about 6 GB) into\n%s\n"
             "and the game starts from there from then on.", path);
    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, text, -1, wtext, 2048);

    HMODULE cc = LoadLibraryA("comctl32.dll");
    TaskDialogIndirectFn td = cc ? (TaskDialogIndirectFn)(void *)GetProcAddress(cc, "TaskDialogIndirect") : NULL;
    if (td) {
        TASKDIALOG_BUTTON buttons[] = {
            { 101, L"Choose disc image..." },
            { 102, L"Choose folder..." },
        };
        TASKDIALOGCONFIG c = { sizeof c };
        int pressed = 0;
        c.hInstance = GetModuleHandleA(NULL);
        c.dwFlags = TDF_ALLOW_DIALOG_CANCELLATION;
        c.cxWidth = 300;   /* dialog units: the lines unbroken */
        c.dwCommonButtons = TDCBF_CLOSE_BUTTON;
        c.pszWindowTitle = L"Ninja Gaiden Black - Setup";
        c.pszMainIcon = MAKEINTRESOURCEW(1);
        c.pszMainInstruction = L"Ninja Gaiden Black";
        c.pszContent = wtext;
        c.cButtons = 2;
        c.pButtons = buttons;
        c.nDefaultButton = 101;
        BOOL checked = FALSE;
        if (!getenv("NGB_PORTABLE"))   /* not already portable (issue #4) */
            c.pszVerificationText = L"Keep the game, saves and settings next to the program (portable)";
        if (SUCCEEDED(td(&c, &pressed, NULL, &checked))) {
            *portable = checked != FALSE;
            return pressed == 101 ? 1 : pressed == 102 ? 2 : 0;
        }
    }
    strncat(text, "\n\nYes: choose a disc image.   No: choose a folder.", sizeof text - strlen(text) - 1);
    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, text, -1, wtext, 2048);
    switch (MessageBoxW(NULL, wtext, L"Ninja Gaiden Black - Setup", MB_YESNOCANCEL | MB_ICONINFORMATION)) {
    case IDYES:
        return 1;
    case IDNO:
        return 2;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* A folder of extracted files, with the shell's folder dialog. */
static int pick_folder(char *out, size_t n)
{
    BROWSEINFOA bi = { 0 };
    LPITEMIDLIST id;
    char path[MAX_PATH];
    int ok = 0;
    CoInitializeEx(NULL, COINIT_APARTMENTTHREADED);
    bi.lpszTitle = "Choose the folder with the game's files (default.xbe)";
    bi.ulFlags = BIF_RETURNONLYFSDIRS | BIF_NEWDIALOGSTYLE | BIF_NONEWFOLDERBUTTON;
    id = SHBrowseForFolderA(&bi);
    if (id) {
        if (SHGetPathFromIDListA(id, path)) {
            snprintf(out, n, "%s", path);
            to_slashes(out);
            ok = 1;
        }
        CoTaskMemFree(id);
    }
    CoUninitialize();
    return ok;
}

/* Ask with the standard Open dialog. The path comes back with '/' separators. */
static int pick_disc(char *out, size_t n)
{
    OPENFILENAMEA ofn = { sizeof ofn };
    out[0] = 0;
    ofn.lpstrFilter = "Xbox disc image (.iso, .7z, .zip) or default.xbe\0"
                      "*.iso;*.xiso;*.7z;*.zip;default.xbe\0All files\0*.*\0";
    ofn.lpstrFile = out;
    ofn.nMaxFile = (DWORD)n;
    ofn.lpstrTitle = "Ninja Gaiden Black: choose your disc image";
    ofn.Flags = OFN_FILEMUSTEXIST | OFN_PATHMUSTEXIST | OFN_NOCHANGEDIR | OFN_EXPLORER;
    if (!GetOpenFileNameA(&ofn))
        return 0;
    to_slashes(out);
    return 1;
}
#else
/* Ask with a desktop file dialog when there is one (zenity, kdialog). */
static int pick_disc(char *out, size_t n)
{
    const char *cmds[] = {
        "zenity --file-selection --title='Ninja Gaiden Black: choose your disc image "
        "(.iso, .7z, .zip) or its default.xbe' 2>/dev/null",
        "kdialog --title 'Ninja Gaiden Black: choose your disc image' "
        "--getopenfilename \"$HOME\" '*.iso *.xiso *.7z *.zip default.xbe' 2>/dev/null",
    };
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof cmds / sizeof cmds[0]; i++) {
        FILE *p = popen(cmds[i], "r");
        if (!p)
            continue;
        if (fgets(out, (int)n, p)) {
            out[strcspn(out, "\r\n")] = 0;
            if (pclose(p) == 0 && *out)
                return 1;
        } else {
            pclose(p);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
#endif

static int install_image(const char *src, const char *dest);

/* Install from src (an image, an archive, or a directory/default.xbe) into
 * dest: extracted beside it first and moved there whole, so an install cut
 * short never looks like a game. 0 on success, 1 for a folder to run from
 * where it is. */
static int install_from(const char *src, const char *dest)
{
    char part[4200];
    const char *dot = strrchr(src, '.');
    int rc;

    if (!(dot && (!strcasecmp(dot, ".iso") || !strcasecmp(dot, ".xiso") ||
                  !strcasecmp(dot, ".7z") || !strcasecmp(dot, ".zip"))))
        return install_image(src, dest);
    snprintf(part, sizeof part, "%s.partial", dest);
    remove_tree(part);
    s_cancel = 0;
    rc = install_image(src, part);
    if (rc == 0 && ngb_check_xbe(part) == 1 && !getenv("NGB_ANY_XBE")) {
        fail("This is not the retail USA Ninja Gaiden Black (NTSC) this "
             "build was made from.");
        rc = -1;
    }
    if (rc == 0) {
        remove_tree(dest);
        if (rename(part, dest) != 0) {
            fail("Cannot move the game into %s: %s", dest, strerror(errno));
            rc = -1;
        }
    }
    if (rc != 0)
        remove_tree(part);
    return rc;
}

static int install_image(const char *src, const char *dest)
{
    char dir[4096];
    const char *dot = strrchr(src, '.');

    /* A default.xbe or a folder of extracted files: run from there. */
    if (is_dir(src) && has_xbe(src))
        return 1;
    snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s", src);
    if (dot && !strcasecmp(dot, ".xbe")) {
        char *slash = strrchr(dir, '/');
        if (slash) *slash = 0;
        if (has_xbe(dir))
            return 1;
        fail("There is no default.xbe in %s.", dir);
        return -1;
    }
    if (dot && (!strcasecmp(dot, ".iso") || !strcasecmp(dot, ".xiso")))
        return extract_iso(src, dest);
    if (dot && (!strcasecmp(dot, ".7z") || !strcasecmp(dot, ".zip"))) {
        char tmp[4200], iso[4400];
        int rc = -1;
        snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s.unpack", dest);
        remove_tree(tmp);
        progress(0, 0);   /* no measure of an unpacker's progress */
        if (mkdirs(tmp) == 0 && unpack_archive(src, tmp) == 0) {
            if (find_iso(tmp, iso, sizeof iso))
                rc = extract_iso(iso, dest);
            else
                fail("There is no .iso inside %s.", src);
        }
        remove_tree(tmp);
        return rc;
    }
    fail("%s is not a disc image, an archive or a game folder.", src);
    return -1;
}

int ngb_install(const char *src, const char *installed, char *out, size_t n)
{
    s_err[0] = 0;
    if (is_dir(src) && has_xbe(src)) {
        snprintf(out, n, "%s", src);
    } else {
        int rc = install_from(src, installed);
        if (rc < 0)
            return -1;
        if (rc == 1) {   /* a folder or default.xbe: use it in place */
            snprintf(out, n, "%s", src);
            if (!is_dir(src)) {
                char *slash = strrchr(out, '/');
                if (slash) *slash = 0;
            }
        } else {
            snprintf(out, n, "%s", installed);
        }
    }

    switch (ngb_check_xbe(out)) {
    case 0:
        return 0;
    case 1:
        if (getenv("NGB_ANY_XBE"))
            return 0;
        fail("%s/default.xbe is not the retail USA Ninja Gaiden Black (NTSC) "
             "this build was made from.", out);
        return -1;
    default:
        fail("There is no default.xbe in %s.", out);
        return -1;
    }
}

#if !defined(_WIN32)
/* The setup window (ngb-setup, Qt) beside the executable: it asks for the
 * disc, installs it into installed and prints the game folder. 1 when it
 * did, 0 when the player closed it, -1 when it could not run. */
static int run_setup(const char *exe_dir, const char *installed,
                     char *out, size_t n)
{
    char cmd[8400];
    FILE *p;
    int status;

    snprintf(cmd, sizeof cmd, "%sngb-setup", exe_dir);
    if (access(cmd, X_OK) != 0)
        return -1;
    /* Its own Qt's plugins only (a bundled Qt), not the desktop's. */
    snprintf(cmd, sizeof cmd, "env -u QT_PLUGIN_PATH '%sngb-setup' --install-to '%s'%s",
             exe_dir, installed, getenv("NGB_PORTABLE") ? "" : " --portable");
    if (strchr(exe_dir, '\'') || strchr(installed, '\''))
        return -1;
    p = popen(cmd, "r");
    if (!p)
        return -1;
    out[0] = 0;
    if (fgets(out, (int)n, p))
        out[strcspn(out, "\r\n")] = 0;
    status = pclose(p);
    if (!WIFEXITED(status) || WEXITSTATUS(status) > 1)
        return -1;      /* no display, missing libraries: the fallbacks */
    if (WEXITSTATUS(status) == 0 && !strncmp(out, "portable:", 9))
    if (WEXITSTATUS(status) == 0 && !strncmp(out, "portable:", 9)) {
        restart_portable(out + 9);   /* portable mode chosen (the setup made portable.txt) */
        out[0] = 0;
    }
    return WEXITSTATUS(status) == 0 && out[0] ? 1 : 0;
}
#endif

#if defined(_WIN32)
/* A small window with a progress bar while ngb_install runs on a worker
 * thread; closing it cancels. A failure is told in a message box. */
typedef struct {
    const char *src, *installed;
    char *out;
    size_t n;
    int rc;
    HWND wnd, bar;
} WinJob;

#define WM_NGB_PROGRESS (WM_APP + 1)   /* wParam: per mille, or -1 for no measure */
#define WM_NGB_DONE     (WM_APP + 2)

static void win_progress(uint64_t done, uint64_t total, void *ud)
{
    WinJob *job = ud;
    static int last = -2;
    int pm = total ? (int)(done * 1000 / total) : -1;
    if (pm != last) {
        last = pm;
        PostMessageA(job->wnd, WM_NGB_PROGRESS, (WPARAM)pm, 0);
    }
}

static DWORD WINAPI win_worker(LPVOID arg)
{
    WinJob *job = arg;
    job->rc = ngb_install(job->src, job->installed, job->out, job->n);
    PostMessageA(job->wnd, WM_NGB_DONE, 0, 0);
    return 0;
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK win_proc(HWND h, UINT msg, WPARAM wp, LPARAM lp)
{
    WinJob *job = (WinJob *)GetWindowLongPtrA(h, GWLP_USERDATA);
    switch (msg) {
    case WM_NGB_PROGRESS:
        if ((int)wp < 0) {
            SetWindowLongA(job->bar, GWL_STYLE, GetWindowLongA(job->bar, GWL_STYLE) | PBS_MARQUEE);
            SendMessageA(job->bar, PBM_SETMARQUEE, TRUE, 30);
        } else {
            SendMessageA(job->bar, PBM_SETMARQUEE, FALSE, 0);
            SetWindowLongA(job->bar, GWL_STYLE, GetWindowLongA(job->bar, GWL_STYLE) & ~PBS_MARQUEE);
            SendMessageA(job->bar, PBM_SETPOS, wp, 0);
        }
        return 0;
    case WM_NGB_DONE:
        DestroyWindow(h);
        return 0;
    case WM_CLOSE:
        ngb_install_cancel();   /* the worker fails and posts WM_NGB_DONE */
        return 0;
    case WM_DESTROY:
        PostQuitMessage(0);
        return 0;
    }
    return DefWindowProcA(h, msg, wp, lp);
}

static int win_install(const char *src, const char *installed, char *out, size_t n)
{
    WinJob job = { src, installed, out, n, -1, NULL, NULL };
    INITCOMMONCONTROLSEX icc = { sizeof icc, ICC_PROGRESS_CLASS };
    WNDCLASSA wc = { 0 };
    HINSTANCE inst = GetModuleHandleA(NULL);
    HFONT font = (HFONT)GetStockObject(DEFAULT_GUI_FONT);
    HWND text;
    HANDLE th;
    MSG m;
    RECT r = { 0, 0, 440, 96 };

    InitCommonControlsEx(&icc);
    wc.lpfnWndProc = win_proc;
    wc.hInstance = inst;
    wc.hCursor = LoadCursorA(NULL, (LPCSTR)IDC_ARROW);
    wc.hbrBackground = (HBRUSH)(COLOR_BTNFACE + 1);
    wc.lpszClassName = "NgbInstall";
    RegisterClassA(&wc);
    AdjustWindowRect(&r, WS_CAPTION | WS_SYSMENU, FALSE);
    job.wnd = CreateWindowA("NgbInstall", "Ninja Gaiden Black", WS_CAPTION | WS_SYSMENU,
                            CW_USEDEFAULT, CW_USEDEFAULT, r.right - r.left, r.bottom - r.top,
                            NULL, NULL, inst, NULL);
    if (!job.wnd)
        return ngb_install(src, installed, out, n);
    SetWindowLongPtrA(job.wnd, GWLP_USERDATA, (LONG_PTR)&job);
    text = CreateWindowA("STATIC", "Installing the game from your disc image. This takes a minute or two.",
                         WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE, 16, 16, 408, 20, job.wnd, NULL, inst, NULL);
    SendMessageA(text, WM_SETFONT, (WPARAM)font, TRUE);
    job.bar = CreateWindowA(PROGRESS_CLASSA, NULL, WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE,
                            16, 48, 408, 22, job.wnd, NULL, inst, NULL);
    SendMessageA(job.bar, PBM_SETRANGE, 0, MAKELPARAM(0, 1000));
    ShowWindow(job.wnd, SW_SHOW);

    ngb_install_set_progress(win_progress, &job);
    th = CreateThread(NULL, 0, win_worker, &job, 0, NULL);
    if (!th) {
        DestroyWindow(job.wnd);
        ngb_install_set_progress(NULL, NULL);
        return ngb_install(src, installed, out, n);
    }
    while (GetMessageA(&m, NULL, 0, 0) > 0) {
        TranslateMessage(&m);
        DispatchMessageA(&m);
    }
    WaitForSingleObject(th, INFINITE);
    CloseHandle(th);
    ngb_install_set_progress(NULL, NULL);
    return job.rc;
}

static void win_tell(const char *msg)
{
    MessageBoxA(NULL, msg, "Ninja Gaiden Black", MB_OK | MB_ICONERROR);
}
#endif

int ngb_portable_base(char *dir, size_t n)
{
    const char *appimage = getenv("APPIMAGE");
    char *slash;

    if (appimage && *appimage)
        snprintf(dir, n, "%s", appimage);
    else if (ngb_exe_path(dir, n) <= 0)
        return 0;
    if (!(slash = strrchr(dir, '/')))
        return 0;
    *slash = 0;
#ifdef __APPLE__
    const char *bundle = strstr(dir, ".app/Contents/MacOS");
    if (bundle && !bundle[strlen(".app/Contents/MacOS")]) {
        dir[bundle - dir + 4] = 0;
        if (!(slash = strrchr(dir, '/')))
            return 0;
        *slash = 0;
    }
#endif
    return 1;
}

int ngb_portable_enable(void)
{
    char dir[4096], p[4200];
    FILE *f;

    if (!ngb_portable_base(dir, sizeof dir))
        return 0;
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/portable.txt", dir);
    if (!(f = fopen(p, "w")))
        return 0;   /* not writable there (Program Files, a read-only mount) */
    fprintf(f, "This file makes Ninja Gaiden Black keep its game files, saves and settings in the "
               "\"userdata\" folder here. Delete it to use your profile's folders again.\n");
    fclose(f);
    return 1;
}

/* Portable mode just chosen in the setup: the program starts again -- its folders are picked at the very
 * start (src/main.c) -- with the disc image or folder chosen, so it is not asked for twice. */
static void restart_portable(const char *src)
{
#if defined(_WIN32)
    wchar_t self[MAX_PATH], wsrc[4096], cmd[8400];
    STARTUPINFOW si;
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi;

    memset(&si, 0, sizeof si);
    si.cb = sizeof si;
    if (!GetModuleFileNameW(NULL, self, MAX_PATH) || !MultiByteToWideChar(CP_ACP, 0, src, -1, wsrc, 4096))
        return;
    _snwprintf(cmd, 8400, L"\"%ls\" \"%ls\"", self, wsrc);
    if (CreateProcessW(self, cmd, NULL, NULL, FALSE, 0, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi)) {
        CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
        CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);
        TerminateProcess(GetCurrentProcess(), 0);
    }
#else
    char self[4096];
    const char *appimage = getenv("APPIMAGE");
    char *argv[2];

    if (appimage && *appimage)
        snprintf(self, sizeof self, "%s", appimage);
    else if (ngb_exe_path(self, sizeof self) <= 0)
        return;
    setenv("NGB_SETUP_AUTO", src, 1);   /* the setup window installs it straight away (src/setup) */
    argv[0] = self;
    argv[1] = NULL;
    execv(self, argv);
#endif
    fprintf(stderr, "Could not start again for portable mode; carrying on as before.\n");
}

/* A folder of extracted files the player picked runs where it is -- and was asked for again at the
 * next start, since only the installed copy and a "game" folder beside the program were looked for
 * (issue #14). Its path is kept in the save folder, and found there first. */
static void location_file(const char *save_dir, char *p, size_t n)
{
    snprintf(p, n, "%s/game-location.txt", save_dir);
}

static int remembered_game(const char *save_dir, char *out, size_t n)
{
    char p[4200], line[4096];
    FILE *f;

    location_file(save_dir, p, sizeof p);
    if (!(f = fopen(p, "r")))
        return 0;
    if (!fgets(line, sizeof line, f))
        line[0] = 0;
    fclose(f);
    line[strcspn(line, "\r\n")] = 0;
    if (!line[0] || !has_xbe(line))
        return 0;   /* moved or deleted: asked for again */
    snprintf(out, n, "%s", line);
    return 1;
}

static void remember_game(const char *save_dir, const char *installed, const char *dir)
{
    char p[4200];
    FILE *f;

    if (!strcmp(dir, installed))
        return;   /* installed: found there anyway */
    location_file(save_dir, p, sizeof p);
    if ((f = fopen(p, "w"))) {
        fprintf(f, "%s\n", dir);
        fclose(f);
    }
}

int ngb_find_game(const char *arg, const char *save_dir, const char *exe_dir,
                  char *out, size_t n)
{
    char installed[4096], beside[4096], picked[4096];
    const char *env = getenv("NGB_GAME_DIR");
    const char *src = arg && *arg ? arg : NULL;

    snprintf(installed, sizeof installed, "%s/game", save_dir);
    snprintf(beside, sizeof beside, "%sgame", exe_dir);

    int from_env = 0;

    if (!src && env && *env) {
        src = env;
        from_env = 1;
    }
    if (!src) {
        if (has_xbe(installed)) { snprintf(out, n, "%s", installed); goto check; }
        if (has_xbe(beside))    { snprintf(out, n, "%s", beside);    goto check; }
        if (remembered_game(save_dir, out, n)) goto check;
#if !defined(_WIN32)
        switch (run_setup(exe_dir, installed, out, n)) {
        case 1:
            remember_game(save_dir, installed, out);   /* a folder picked: found there next time */
            return 0;   /* installed and checked there */
        case 0:
            return -1;  /* closed */
        }
        if (pick_disc(picked, sizeof picked))
            src = picked;
#else
        int portable = 0;
        for (;;) {   /* the welcome again when a picker is closed */
            int how = win_welcome(installed, &portable);
            if (how == 0)
                return -1;  /* quit */
            if (how == 1 ? pick_disc(picked, sizeof picked) : pick_folder(picked, sizeof picked))
                break;
        }
        src = picked;
        if (portable) {
            if (ngb_portable_enable())
                restart_portable(src);   /* does not come back when it works */
            else
                win_tell("Portable mode needs a folder the program can write to (not Program Files). "
                         "The game is installed in your profile instead.");
        }
#endif
        if (!src) {
            fprintf(stderr,
                "No game files found. Run it once with your disc image:\n"
                "  NinjaGaidenBlack /path/to/disc.iso   (or the .7z, or a folder "
                "of extracted files)\n"
                "It is installed into %s and found there from then on.\n", installed);
            return -1;
        }
    }
#if defined(_WIN32)
    if (win_install(src, installed, out, n) == 0) {
        if (!from_env)
            remember_game(save_dir, installed, out);
        return 0;
    }
    {
        char msg[1200];
        snprintf(msg, sizeof msg, "The game could not be installed.\n\n%s", ngb_install_error());
        win_tell(msg);
    }
    return -1;
#else
    if (ngb_install(src, installed, out, n) != 0)
        return -1;
    if (!from_env)
        remember_game(save_dir, installed, out);
    return 0;
#endif

check:
    switch (ngb_check_xbe(out)) {
    case 0:
        return 0;
    case 1:
        fprintf(stderr, "%s/default.xbe is not the retail USA Ninja Gaiden Black "
                        "this build was made from.\n", out);
        if (getenv("NGB_ANY_XBE"))
            return 0;
#if defined(_WIN32)
        win_tell("The installed game is not the retail USA Ninja Gaiden Black (NTSC) "
                 "this build was made from.");
#endif
        return -1;
    default:
        fprintf(stderr, "No default.xbe in %s\n", out);
        return -1;
    }
}
```

`src/keyboard.c`:

```c
/*
 * keyboard.c -- Ninja Gaiden Black on the keyboard and mouse.
 *
 * The runtime (xboxrecomp src/input) switches between the controllers and
 * the keyboard and mouse by which was touched last; while the keyboard and
 * mouse are in use, this is how they press the pad (the game's default
 * actions in brackets):
 *
 *   W A S D        left stick (move)       mouse, numpad 8456  right stick
 *   left mouse, J  X (attack)              right mouse, K      Y (special attack)
 *   Space          A (jump)                E                   B (projectile)
 *   F              Y+B (ninpo)             C                   X+A (wind run)
 *   Shift          L (guard)               Q, middle mouse     R (center camera)
 *   Tab            Black (map)             R                   White (karma window)
 *   Esc, Enter     START                   Backspace           BACK
 *   arrows         d-pad                   Z / V               left / right stick click
 *
 * These are the defaults: in play the keys and mouse buttons are as the
 * Controls page has bound them (src/bindings.c; NGB_FIXED_KEYS=1 keeps these).
 * In the game's menus Esc is B (src/ingame_menu.c), Q and E are L and R
 * (the pause menu's tabs) and the mouse points (src/menu_mouse.c); in play the mouse is captured, its motion the right
 * stick. The pointer is hidden except in the menus with the keyboard and mouse in use. The button prompts become keys (src/pause_tab.c).
 */
#include <SDL.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "input/xinput_xbox.h"

int ngb_menu_up(void);   /* src/menu_mouse.c */

static SHORT axis(const Uint8 *k, int neg, int pos)
{
    return (SHORT)((k[pos] ? 32767 : 0) - (k[neg] ? 32767 : 0));
}

void ngb_bind_play_state(const Uint8 *k, Uint32 mouse, XBOX_INPUT_STATE *st, int look_x, int look_y);

/* A button that skips a movie or cutscene: Start, A or B on the pad (or the keys bound to them),
 * from the first pad's state as the title reads it. */
int ngb_skip_button(void)
{
    XBOX_INPUT_STATE st;
    if (xbox_InputGetState(0, &st) != 0)
        return 0;
    return (st.Gamepad.wButtons & XBOX_GAMEPAD_START) || st.Gamepad.bAnalogButtons[0] > 0x40 ||
           st.Gamepad.bAnalogButtons[1] > 0x40;
}

int xbox_keyboard_map(const Uint8 *k, Uint32 mouse, XBOX_INPUT_STATE *st)
{
    int menu = ngb_menu_up();
    if (!menu && !getenv("NGB_FIXED_KEYS")) {   /* in play: as bound (src/bindings.c, the Controls page) */
        SHORT mx = 0, my = 0;
        if (SDL_GetRelativeMouseMode())
            xbox_InputMouseStick(900.0f, &mx, &my);
        ngb_bind_play_state(k, mouse, st, mx, my);
        return 1;
    }
    WORD b = 0;
    if (k[SDL_SCANCODE_UP])        b |= XBOX_GAMEPAD_DPAD_UP;
    if (k[SDL_SCANCODE_DOWN])      b |= XBOX_GAMEPAD_DPAD_DOWN;
    if (k[SDL_SCANCODE_LEFT])      b |= XBOX_GAMEPAD_DPAD_LEFT;
    if (k[SDL_SCANCODE_RIGHT])     b |= XBOX_GAMEPAD_DPAD_RIGHT;
    if (k[SDL_SCANCODE_RETURN] || k[SDL_SCANCODE_KP_ENTER] || (k[SDL_SCANCODE_ESCAPE] && !menu))
        b |= XBOX_GAMEPAD_START;
    if (k[SDL_SCANCODE_BACKSPACE]) b |= XBOX_GAMEPAD_BACK;
    if (k[SDL_SCANCODE_Z])         b |= XBOX_GAMEPAD_LEFT_THUMB;
    if (k[SDL_SCANCODE_V])         b |= XBOX_GAMEPAD_RIGHT_THUMB;
    st->Gamepad.wButtons = b;

    /* In the menus the mouse's buttons are the pointer's (src/menu_mouse.c). */
    int lmb = !menu && (mouse & SDL_BUTTON(SDL_BUTTON_LEFT));
    int rmb = !menu && (mouse & SDL_BUTTON(SDL_BUTTON_RIGHT));
    int mmb = !menu && (mouse & SDL_BUTTON(SDL_BUTTON_MIDDLE));
    int ninpo = k[SDL_SCANCODE_F], windrun = k[SDL_SCANCODE_C];
    BYTE *an = st->Gamepad.bAnalogButtons;
    an[XBOX_BUTTON_X] = (lmb || k[SDL_SCANCODE_J] || windrun) ? 255 : 0;
    an[XBOX_BUTTON_Y] = (rmb || k[SDL_SCANCODE_K] || ninpo) ? 255 : 0;
    an[XBOX_BUTTON_A] = (k[SDL_SCANCODE_SPACE] || windrun) ? 255 : 0;
    if (menu) {   /* Q and E change tabs (L, R); Esc is B (src/ingame_menu.c) */
        an[XBOX_BUTTON_B] = 0;
        an[XBOX_BUTTON_LTRIGGER] = k[SDL_SCANCODE_Q] ? 255 : 0;
        an[XBOX_BUTTON_RTRIGGER] = k[SDL_SCANCODE_E] ? 255 : 0;
    } else {
        an[XBOX_BUTTON_B] = (k[SDL_SCANCODE_E] || ninpo) ? 255 : 0;
        an[XBOX_BUTTON_LTRIGGER] = (k[SDL_SCANCODE_LSHIFT] || k[SDL_SCANCODE_RSHIFT]) ? 255 : 0;
        an[XBOX_BUTTON_RTRIGGER] = (k[SDL_SCANCODE_Q] || mmb) ? 255 : 0;
    }
    an[XBOX_BUTTON_BLACK] = k[SDL_SCANCODE_TAB] ? 255 : 0;
    an[XBOX_BUTTON_WHITE] = k[SDL_SCANCODE_R] ? 255 : 0;

    st->Gamepad.sThumbLX = axis(k, SDL_SCANCODE_A, SDL_SCANCODE_D);
    st->Gamepad.sThumbLY = axis(k, SDL_SCANCODE_S, SDL_SCANCODE_W);
    SHORT mx = 0, my = 0;
    if (!menu && SDL_GetRelativeMouseMode())
        xbox_InputMouseStick(900.0f, &mx, &my);
    int rx = axis(k, SDL_SCANCODE_KP_4, SDL_SCANCODE_KP_6) + mx;
    int ry = axis(k, SDL_SCANCODE_KP_5, SDL_SCANCODE_KP_8) + my;
    st->Gamepad.sThumbRX = (SHORT)(rx > 32767 ? 32767 : rx < -32767 ? -32767 : rx);
    st->Gamepad.sThumbRY = (SHORT)(ry > 32767 ? 32767 : ry < -32767 ? -32767 : ry);
    return 1;
}

/* The window's thread, each pump: the mouse captured in play while it is
 * the device in use, given back in the menus and to the controller. */
static volatile Uint64 s_capture_changed;

void nv2a_window_tick(void)
{
    static int captured;
    SDL_Window *w = SDL_GetKeyboardFocus();
    int want = w && xbox_InputKeyboardActive() && !ngb_menu_up() && !getenv("NGB_NO_MOUSE_CAPTURE");
    if (want != captured) {
        captured = want;
        s_capture_changed = SDL_GetTicks64();
        SDL_SetRelativeMouseMode(want ? SDL_TRUE : SDL_FALSE);
    }
    /* The pointer shows only where it points at something: in the game's
     * menus, with the keyboard and mouse in use. */
    static int shown = -1;
    int show = xbox_InputKeyboardActive() && ngb_menu_up();
    if (show != shown) {
        shown = show;
        SDL_ShowCursor(show ? SDL_ENABLE : SDL_DISABLE);
    }
}

/* Just after the capture changed the pointer moves by itself (SDL puts it
 * back): not the player pointing at a menu item. */
int ngb_mouse_settling(void)
{
    return SDL_GetTicks64() - s_capture_changed < 300;
}
```

`src/launcher.c`:

```c
/*
 * launcher.c -- the settings screen shown before the game starts.
 *
 * Its own small SDL window with an SDL_Renderer (the game's window is a
 * Vulkan one, created afterwards), driven by keyboard, mouse or controller
 * so it works the same at a desk and on a Steam Deck. Text comes from a
 * bitmap font baked into launcher_font.h (tools/font/gen_font.py).
 *
 * The choices live in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/NinjaGaidenBlack/settings.ini; the
 * environment variables of the same meaning (NGB_WIDESCREEN, NGB_FULLSCREEN,
 * NGB_VSYNC, NV2A_SCALE) still override them, for testing.
 */
#include <SDL.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>

#include "launcher.h"
#include "launcher_font.h"
#include "port.h"

/* ---------- settings file ---------- */

static void config_path(char *out, size_t n, int make_dir)
{
    char dir[1024];
    ngb_config_dir(dir, sizeof dir, make_dir);
    snprintf(out, n, "%s/settings.ini", dir);
}

static const char *const ASPECT_NAMES[ASPECT_COUNT] = { "4:3", "16:9", "16:10", "21:9" };

/* Window sizes offered for each aspect ratio, smallest first. */
static const int SIZES_4_3[][2] = {
    { 960, 720 }, { 1024, 768 }, { 1280, 960 }, { 1440, 1080 },
    { 1600, 1200 }, { 1920, 1440 }, { 2880, 2160 }, { 0, 0 } };
static const int SIZES_16_9[][2] = {
    { 1280, 720 }, { 1600, 900 }, { 1920, 1080 }, { 2560, 1440 },
    { 3200, 1800 }, { 3840, 2160 }, { 0, 0 } };
static const int SIZES_16_10[][2] = {
    { 1280, 800 }, { 1440, 900 }, { 1680, 1050 }, { 1920, 1200 },
    { 2560, 1600 }, { 3840, 2400 }, { 0, 0 } };
static const int SIZES_21_9[][2] = {     /* the "21:9" of the displays: 64:27 (2560 x 1080), 43:18 (3440 x 1440) */
    { 1720, 720 }, { 2560, 1080 }, { 3440, 1440 }, { 5120, 2160 }, { 0, 0 } };

static const int (*sizes_for(int aspect))[2]
{
    return aspect == ASPECT_4_3 ? SIZES_4_3
         : aspect == ASPECT_16_10 ? SIZES_16_10 : aspect == ASPECT_21_9 ? SIZES_21_9 : SIZES_16_9;
}

static int nsizes(int aspect)
{
    int n = 0;
    while (sizes_for(aspect)[n][0])
        n++;
    return n;
}

static int size_index(const NgbSettings *s)
{
    const int (*z)[2] = sizes_for(s->aspect);
    for (int i = 0; z[i][0]; i++)
        if (z[i][0] == s->width && z[i][1] == s->height)
            return i;
    return -1;
}

int ngb_settings_size_count(int aspect) { return nsizes(aspect); }

void ngb_settings_size_at(int aspect, int i, int *w, int *h)
{
    *w = sizes_for(aspect)[i][0];
    *h = sizes_for(aspect)[i][1];
}

int ngb_settings_size_index(const NgbSettings *s) { return size_index(s); }

/* A window size of the current aspect: the listed one nearest in height. */
static void snap_size(NgbSettings *s)
{
    const int (*z)[2] = sizes_for(s->aspect);
    int best = 0;
    if (size_index(s) >= 0)
        return;
    for (int i = 1; z[i][0]; i++)
        if (abs(z[i][1] - s->height) < abs(z[best][1] - s->height))
            best = i;
    s->width = z[best][0];
    s->height = z[best][1];
}

void ngb_settings_snap_size(NgbSettings *s) { snap_size(s); }

void ngb_settings_load(NgbSettings *s)
{
    char path[1100], line[256];
    FILE *f;

    memset(s, 0, sizeof *s);   /* off unless set: All Costumes, All Difficulties, 4:3 movies... */
    s->aspect = ASPECT_16_9;
    s->width = 1280;
    s->height = 720;
    s->fullscreen = 0;
    s->scale = 1;
    s->vsync = 0;
    s->show_fps = 0;
    s->anisotropy = 16;
    s->msaa = 1;
    s->shadow_scale = 4;
    s->skip_intro = 0;
    s->show_launcher = 1;

    config_path(path, sizeof path, 0);
    f = fopen(path, "r");
    printf("Settings: %s%s\n", path, f ? "" : " (not there yet: the defaults)");
    if (!f)
        return;
    s->width = s->height = 0;
    while (fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) {
        char key[64], val[128];
        if (sscanf(line, " %63[^= ] = %127[^\r\n]", key, val) != 2)
            continue;
        if (!strcmp(key, "aspect")) {
            for (int i = 0; i < ASPECT_COUNT; i++)
                if (!strcmp(val, ASPECT_NAMES[i]))
                    s->aspect = i;
        } else if (!strcmp(key, "window")) {
            int w, h;
            if (sscanf(val, "%dx%d", &w, &h) == 2 && w >= 320 && h >= 200) {
                s->width = w;
                s->height = h;
            }
        } else if (!strcmp(key, "fullscreen")) {
            s->fullscreen = atoi(val) < 0 ? 0 : atoi(val) > 2 ? 2 : atoi(val);
        } else if (!strcmp(key, "render_scale")) {
            int v = atoi(val);
            s->scale = v < 1 ? 1 : v > 10 ? 10 : v;
        } else if (!strcmp(key, "vsync")) {
            s->vsync = atoi(val) < 0 ? 0 : atoi(val) > 3 ? 3 : atoi(val);
        } else if (!strcmp(key, "shadow_resolution")) {
            int v = atoi(val);
            s->shadow_scale = v >= 10 ? 10 : v >= 8 ? 8 : v >= 4 ? 4 : v >= 2 ? 2 : 1;
        } else if (!strcmp(key, "texture_filter")) {          /* before anisotropic_filtering */
            s->anisotropy = strcmp(val, "original") ? 16 : 0;
        } else if (!strcmp(key, "anisotropic_filtering")) {
            int v = atoi(val);
            s->anisotropy = v >= 16 ? 16 : v >= 8 ? 8 : v >= 4 ? 4 : v >= 2 ? 2 : 0;
        } else if (!strcmp(key, "msaa")) {
            int v = atoi(val);
            s->msaa = v >= 8 ? 8 : v >= 4 ? 4 : v >= 2 ? 2 : 1;
        } else if (!strcmp(key, "unlock_all_difficulties")) {
            s->all_difficulties = atoi(val) != 0;
        } else if (!strcmp(key, "unlock_all_costumes")) {
            s->all_costumes = atoi(val) != 0;
        } else if (!strcmp(key, "movie_ratio")) {
            s->movie_43 = !strcmp(val, "4:3");
        } else if (!strcmp(key, "show_fps")) {
            s->show_fps = atoi(val) != 0;
        } else if (!strcmp(key, "skip_intro")) {
            s->skip_intro = atoi(val) != 0;
        } else if (!strcmp(key, "show_settings_at_startup")) {
            s->show_launcher = atoi(val) != 0;
        }
    }
    fclose(f);
    snap_size(s);
}

void ngb_settings_save(const NgbSettings *s)
{
    char path[1100];
    FILE *f;

    config_path(path, sizeof path, 1);
    f = fopen(path, "w");
    if (!f) {
        fprintf(stderr, "settings: cannot write %s: %s\n", path, strerror(errno));
        return;
    }
    fprintf(f, "# Ninja Gaiden Black settings (the settings screen writes this file)\n");
    fprintf(f, "aspect = %s\n", ASPECT_NAMES[s->aspect]);
    fprintf(f, "window = %dx%d\n", s->width, s->height);
    fprintf(f, "fullscreen = %d\n", s->fullscreen);
    fprintf(f, "render_scale = %d\n", s->scale);
    fprintf(f, "vsync = %d\n", s->vsync);
    fprintf(f, "show_fps = %d\n", s->show_fps);
    fprintf(f, "anisotropic_filtering = %d\n", s->anisotropy);
    fprintf(f, "msaa = %d\n", s->msaa);
    fprintf(f, "unlock_all_difficulties = %d\n", s->all_difficulties);
    fprintf(f, "unlock_all_costumes = %d\n", s->all_costumes);
    fprintf(f, "movie_ratio = %s\n", s->movie_43 ? "4:3" : "16:9");
    fprintf(f, "shadow_resolution = %d\n", s->shadow_scale);
    fprintf(f, "skip_intro = %d\n", s->skip_intro);
    fprintf(f, "show_settings_at_startup = %d\n", s->show_launcher);
    fclose(f);
}

double ngb_settings_aspect_ratio(const NgbSettings *s)
{
    switch (s->aspect) {
    case ASPECT_4_3:   return 4.0 / 3.0;
    case ASPECT_16_10: return 16.0 / 10.0;
    case ASPECT_21_9:  return 64.0 / 27.0;
    default:           return 16.0 / 9.0;
    }
}

/* ---------- drawing ---------- */

#define LW 960            /* logical size of the screen */
#define LH 748

static SDL_Texture *s_font;
static int s_glyph_x[95];

const char *ngb_vsync_name(int v)
{
    return v == 1 ? "Mailbox" : v == 2 ? "Adaptive" : v == 3 ? "FIFO" : "Off";
}

int ngb_vsync_step(int v, int dir)
{
    static const int order[4] = { 0, 1, 3, 2 };
    int i = 0;
    while (i < 3 && order[i] != v)
        i++;
    return order[(i + (dir < 0 ? 3 : 1)) % 4];
}

static int font_init(SDL_Renderer *r)
{
    int total = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 95; i++) {
        s_glyph_x[i] = total;
        total += launcher_font_w[i];
    }
    uint32_t *px = calloc((size_t)total * LAUNCHER_FONT_H_PX, 4);
    if (!px)
        return -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 95; i++) {
        int w = launcher_font_w[i];
        const uint8_t *g = launcher_font_px + launcher_font_off[i];
        for (int y = 0; y < LAUNCHER_FONT_H_PX; y++)
            for (int x = 0; x < w; x++)
                px[y * total + s_glyph_x[i] + x] =
                    ((uint32_t)g[y * w + x] << 24) | 0x00FFFFFFu;
    }
    s_font = SDL_CreateTexture(r, SDL_PIXELFORMAT_ARGB8888,
                               SDL_TEXTUREACCESS_STATIC, total, LAUNCHER_FONT_H_PX);
    if (!s_font) {
        free(px);
        return -1;
    }
    SDL_UpdateTexture(s_font, NULL, px, total * 4);
    SDL_SetTextureBlendMode(s_font, SDL_BLENDMODE_BLEND);
    SDL_SetTextureScaleMode(s_font, SDL_ScaleModeLinear);
    free(px);
    return 0;
}

static int text_width(const char *t, float size)
{
    float w = 0;
    for (; *t; t++) {
        int c = (unsigned char)*t;
        if (c < 32 || c > 126) c = '?';
        w += launcher_font_w[c - 32] * size / LAUNCHER_FONT_H_PX;
    }
    return (int)w;
}

/* align: 0 left, 1 centre, 2 right of x */
static void draw_text(SDL_Renderer *r, const char *t, int x, int y, float size,
                      SDL_Color col, int align)
{
    float fx = (float)x;
    if (align == 1) fx -= text_width(t, size) / 2.0f;
    if (align == 2) fx -= (float)text_width(t, size);
    SDL_SetTextureColorMod(s_font, col.r, col.g, col.b);
    SDL_SetTextureAlphaMod(s_font, col.a);
    for (; *t; t++) {
        int c = (unsigned char)*t;
        if (c < 32 || c > 126) c = '?';
        int w = launcher_font_w[c - 32];
        SDL_Rect src = { s_glyph_x[c - 32], 0, w, LAUNCHER_FONT_H_PX };
        SDL_FRect dst = { fx, (float)y, w * size / LAUNCHER_FONT_H_PX, size };
        SDL_RenderCopyF(r, s_font, &src, &dst);
        fx += dst.w;
    }
}

static void fill(SDL_Renderer *r, int x, int y, int w, int h, SDL_Color c)
{
    SDL_Rect rc = { x, y, w, h };
    SDL_SetRenderDrawColor(r, c.r, c.g, c.b, c.a);
    SDL_RenderFillRect(r, &rc);
}

/* ---------- the screen ---------- */

enum { ROW_ASPECT, ROW_SIZE, ROW_DISPLAY, ROW_SCALE, ROW_TEXFILTER, ROW_MSAA, ROW_SHADOW,
       ROW_VSYNC, ROW_FPS, ROW_SKIP, ROW_START, ROW_QUIT, NROWS };
_Static_assert(ROW_START == NGB_SETTINGS_ITEMS, "settings rows");

void ngb_settings_change(NgbSettings *s, int row, int dir)
{
    switch (row) {
    case ROW_ASPECT:
        s->aspect = (s->aspect + dir + ASPECT_COUNT) % ASPECT_COUNT;
        snap_size(s);
        break;
    case ROW_SIZE: {
        int n = nsizes(s->aspect), i = size_index(s);
        if (i < 0) i = dir > 0 ? -1 : n;
        i = (i + dir + n) % n;
        s->width = sizes_for(s->aspect)[i][0];
        s->height = sizes_for(s->aspect)[i][1];
        break;
    }
    case ROW_DISPLAY: s->fullscreen = (s->fullscreen + (dir < 0 ? 2 : 1)) % 3; break;
    case ROW_SCALE:   s->scale = (s->scale - 1 + dir + 10) % 10 + 1; break;
    case ROW_VSYNC:   s->vsync = ngb_vsync_step(s->vsync, dir); break;
    case ROW_FPS:     s->show_fps = !s->show_fps; break;
    case ROW_TEXFILTER: {
        static const int STEPS[] = { 0, 2, 4, 8, 16 };
        int i = 0;
        while (i < 4 && STEPS[i] != s->anisotropy) i++;
        s->anisotropy = STEPS[(i + dir + 5) % 5];
        break;
    }
    case ROW_MSAA: {
        static const int STEPS[] = { 1, 2, 4, 8 };
        int i = 0;
        while (i < 3 && STEPS[i] != s->msaa) i++;
        s->msaa = STEPS[(i + dir + 4) % 4];
        break;
    }
    case ROW_SHADOW: {
        static const int STEPS[] = { 1, 2, 4, 8, 10 };
        int i = 0;
        while (i < 4 && STEPS[i] != s->shadow_scale) i++;
        s->shadow_scale = STEPS[(i + dir + 5) % 5];
        break;
    }
    case ROW_SKIP:    s->skip_intro = !s->skip_intro; break;
    default: break;
    }
}

void ngb_settings_row_text(const NgbSettings *s, int row, const char **label, char *val, size_t n)
{
    static const char *const ASPECT_LABEL[ASPECT_COUNT] = { "4:3", "16:9", "16:10", "21:9" };
    static const char *const SCALE_LABEL[10] = {
        "Native (1x)", "2x", "3x", "4x", "5x", "6x", "7x", "8x", "9x", "10x" };
    val[0] = 0;
    switch (row) {
    case ROW_ASPECT:  *label = "Aspect ratio";  snprintf(val, n, "%s", ASPECT_LABEL[s->aspect]); break;
    case ROW_SIZE:    *label = "Window size";   snprintf(val, n, "%d x %d", s->width, s->height); break;
    case ROW_DISPLAY: *label = "Display";       snprintf(val, n, "%s", s->fullscreen == 2 ? "Borderless" : s->fullscreen ? "Fullscreen" : "Windowed"); break;
    case ROW_SCALE:   *label = "Render resolution"; snprintf(val, n, "%s", SCALE_LABEL[s->scale - 1]); break;
    case ROW_VSYNC:   *label = "V-Sync";        snprintf(val, n, "%s", ngb_vsync_name(s->vsync)); break;
    case ROW_FPS:     *label = "Show FPS";      snprintf(val, n, "%s", s->show_fps ? "On" : "Off"); break;
    case ROW_TEXFILTER: *label = "Anisotropic filtering"; if (s->anisotropy) snprintf(val, n, "%dx", s->anisotropy); else snprintf(val, n, "Off"); break;
    case ROW_MSAA:    *label = "Anti-aliasing (MSAA)"; if (s->msaa > 1) snprintf(val, n, "%dx", s->msaa); else snprintf(val, n, "Off"); break;
    case ROW_SHADOW:  *label = "Shadow resolution"; if (s->shadow_scale == 1) snprintf(val, n, "Original"); else snprintf(val, n, "%dx", s->shadow_scale); break;
    case ROW_SKIP:    *label = "Skip intros and warnings"; snprintf(val, n, "%s", s->skip_intro ? "Yes" : "No"); break;
    case ROW_START:   *label = "Start game"; break;
    case ROW_QUIT:    *label = "Quit"; break;
    }
}

#define ROW_Y0 128
#define ROW_H  44

static int row_at(int y)
{
    if (y < ROW_Y0)
        return -1;
    int r = (y - ROW_Y0) / ROW_H;
    if (r >= ROW_START)            /* a gap before the buttons */
        r = (y - ROW_Y0 - 16) / ROW_H;
    return r >= 0 && r < NROWS ? r : -1;
}

static int row_y(int row)
{
    return ROW_Y0 + row * ROW_H + (row >= ROW_START ? 16 : 0);
}

static void draw(SDL_Renderer *r, const NgbSettings *s, int sel)
{
    const SDL_Color white = { 235, 235, 235, 255 }, grey = { 150, 150, 155, 255 },
                    red = { 200, 32, 40, 255 }, bar = { 120, 16, 22, 200 },
                    dim = { 255, 255, 255, 18 };

    SDL_SetRenderDrawColor(r, 14, 14, 18, 255);
    SDL_RenderClear(r);
    fill(r, 0, 0, LW, 96, (SDL_Color){ 26, 8, 10, 255 });
    fill(r, 0, 94, LW, 2, red);
    draw_text(r, "NINJA GAIDEN BLACK", LW / 2, 18, 44, white, 1);
    draw_text(r, "Settings", LW / 2, 64, 22, grey, 1);

    for (int row = 0; row < NROWS; row++) {
        const char *label;
        char val[96];
        int y = row_y(row);
        ngb_settings_row_text(s, row, &label, val, sizeof val);
        if (row >= ROW_START) {
            int w = 260, x = LW / 2 - w / 2;
            fill(r, x, y + 2, w, ROW_H - 6, row == sel ? bar : dim);
            draw_text(r, label, LW / 2, y + 8, 26, row == sel ? white : grey, 1);
            continue;
        }
        if (row == sel)
            fill(r, 60, y + 2, LW - 120, ROW_H - 6, bar);
        else if (row % 2)
            fill(r, 60, y + 2, LW - 120, ROW_H - 6, dim);
        draw_text(r, label, 84, y + 9, 24, row == sel ? white : grey, 0);
        draw_text(r, "<", 560, y + 9, 24, row == sel ? white : grey, 0);
        draw_text(r, val, 736, y + 9, 24, white, 1);
        draw_text(r, ">", LW - 92, y + 9, 24, row == sel ? white : grey, 0);
    }
    draw_text(r, "Up/Down: choose    Left/Right: change    Enter / A: select    Start: play    Esc / B: quit",
              LW / 2, LH - 58, 17, grey, 1);
    draw_text(r, "In game: the pause menu's Settings tab has these options, F11 toggles fullscreen, F10 the FPS counter.",
              LW / 2, LH - 34, 15, grey, 1);
    SDL_RenderPresent(r);
}

int ngb_launcher_run(NgbSettings *s)
{
    SDL_Window *win;
    SDL_Renderer *r;
    SDL_GameController *pad = NULL;
    int sel = ROW_START, result = -1;
    Uint32 repeat_at = 0;
    int held_dir = 0;            /* stick/d-pad auto-repeat: -2 up, 2 down, -1/1 */

#if !defined(_WIN32)
    if (!getenv("SDL_VIDEODRIVER"))
        SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_VIDEODRIVER, "wayland,x11");
#endif
    if (SDL_InitSubSystem(SDL_INIT_VIDEO | SDL_INIT_GAMECONTROLLER) != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "settings screen: %s\n", SDL_GetError());
        return 1;                /* no screen: just start */
    }
    win = SDL_CreateWindow("Ninja Gaiden Black", SDL_WINDOWPOS_CENTERED,
                           SDL_WINDOWPOS_CENTERED, LW, LH,
                           SDL_WINDOW_RESIZABLE | SDL_WINDOW_ALLOW_HIGHDPI);
    r = win ? SDL_CreateRenderer(win, -1, SDL_RENDERER_ACCELERATED |
                                          SDL_RENDERER_PRESENTVSYNC) : NULL;
    if (r == NULL && win)
        r = SDL_CreateRenderer(win, -1, SDL_RENDERER_SOFTWARE);
    if (!win || !r || font_init(r) != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "settings screen unavailable: %s\n", SDL_GetError());
        if (r) SDL_DestroyRenderer(r);
        if (win) SDL_DestroyWindow(win);
        return 1;
    }
    SDL_RenderSetLogicalSize(r, LW, LH);
    Uint32 t_open = SDL_GetTicks();
    SDL_SetRenderDrawBlendMode(r, SDL_BLENDMODE_BLEND);
    for (int i = 0; i < SDL_NumJoysticks() && !pad; i++)
        if (SDL_IsGameController(i))
            pad = SDL_GameControllerOpen(i);

    while (result < 0) {
        SDL_Event ev;
        while (SDL_PollEvent(&ev)) {
            int act = 0, dir = 0, move = 0;
            switch (ev.type) {
            case SDL_QUIT:
                result = 0;
                break;
            case SDL_KEYDOWN:
                switch (ev.key.keysym.sym) {
                case SDLK_UP:    case SDLK_w: move = -1; break;
                case SDLK_DOWN:  case SDLK_s: move = 1; break;
                case SDLK_LEFT:  case SDLK_a: dir = -1; break;
                case SDLK_RIGHT: case SDLK_d: dir = 1; break;
                case SDLK_RETURN: case SDLK_KP_ENTER: case SDLK_SPACE: act = 1; break;
                case SDLK_ESCAPE: result = 0; break;
                default: break;
                }
                break;
            case SDL_CONTROLLERDEVICEADDED:
                if (!pad)
                    pad = SDL_GameControllerOpen(ev.cdevice.which);
                break;
            case SDL_CONTROLLERBUTTONDOWN:
                switch (ev.cbutton.button) {
                case SDL_CONTROLLER_BUTTON_DPAD_UP:    move = -1; held_dir = -2; break;
                case SDL_CONTROLLER_BUTTON_DPAD_DOWN:  move = 1;  held_dir = 2;  break;
                case SDL_CONTROLLER_BUTTON_DPAD_LEFT:  dir = -1;  held_dir = -1; break;
                case SDL_CONTROLLER_BUTTON_DPAD_RIGHT: dir = 1;   held_dir = 1;  break;
                case SDL_CONTROLLER_BUTTON_A: act = 1; break;
                case SDL_CONTROLLER_BUTTON_START: sel = ROW_START; act = 1; break;
                case SDL_CONTROLLER_BUTTON_B: result = 0; break;
                default: break;
                }
                repeat_at = SDL_GetTicks() + 400;
                break;
            case SDL_CONTROLLERBUTTONUP:
                held_dir = 0;
                break;
            case SDL_CONTROLLERAXISMOTION:
                if (ev.caxis.axis == SDL_CONTROLLER_AXIS_LEFTY ||
                    ev.caxis.axis == SDL_CONTROLLER_AXIS_LEFTX) {
                    int v = ev.caxis.value, y = ev.caxis.axis == SDL_CONTROLLER_AXIS_LEFTY;
                    int nd = v > 20000 ? (y ? 2 : 1) : v < -20000 ? (y ? -2 : -1) : 0;
                    if (nd && nd != held_dir) {
                        if (y) move = nd / 2; else dir = nd;
                        repeat_at = SDL_GetTicks() + 400;
                    }
                    if (nd || (y ? (held_dir == 2 || held_dir == -2)
                                 : (held_dir == 1 || held_dir == -1)))
                        held_dir = nd;
                }
                break;
            case SDL_MOUSEMOTION: {
                /* A pointer already resting over the window reports a
                 * motion at once; only a real move should select. */
                if (SDL_GetTicks() - t_open < 500)
                    break;
                int row = row_at(ev.motion.y);
                if (row >= 0) sel = row;
                break;
            }
            case SDL_MOUSEBUTTONDOWN: {
                int row = row_at(ev.button.y);
                if (row >= 0) {
                    sel = row;
                    if (row >= ROW_START) act = 1;
                    else dir = (ev.button.button == SDL_BUTTON_RIGHT ||
                                ev.button.x < 560 + 40) ? -1 : 1;
                }
                break;
            }
            default:
                break;
            }
            if (move)
                sel = (sel + move + NROWS) % NROWS;
            if (dir && sel < ROW_START)
                ngb_settings_change(s, sel, dir);
            if (act) {
                if (sel == ROW_START) result = 1;
                else if (sel == ROW_QUIT) result = 0;
                else ngb_settings_change(s, sel, 1);
            }
        }
        /* Held d-pad or stick: repeat after a pause. */
        if (held_dir && SDL_GetTicks() >= repeat_at) {
            if (held_dir == 2 || held_dir == -2)
                sel = (sel + held_dir / 2 + NROWS) % NROWS;
            else if (sel < ROW_START)
                ngb_settings_change(s, sel, held_dir);
            repeat_at = SDL_GetTicks() + 140;
        }
        draw(r, s, sel);
    }

    if (pad)
        SDL_GameControllerClose(pad);
    SDL_DestroyTexture(s_font);
    s_font = NULL;
    SDL_DestroyRenderer(r);
    SDL_DestroyWindow(win);
    if (result == 1)
        ngb_settings_save(s);
    return result;
}
```

`src/launcher.h`:

```h
/*
 * launcher.h -- the settings screen shown before the game, and the settings
 * file behind it ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/NinjaGaidenBlack/settings.ini).
 */
#ifndef NGB_LAUNCHER_H
#define NGB_LAUNCHER_H
#include <stddef.h>

enum { ASPECT_4_3, ASPECT_16_9, ASPECT_16_10, ASPECT_21_9, ASPECT_COUNT };

typedef struct NgbSettings {
    int aspect;          /* ASPECT_* */
    int width, height;   /* window size */
    int fullscreen;
    int scale;           /* render scale 1..10 */
    int vsync;
    int show_fps;        /* frame rate and frame time overlay */
    int anisotropy;      /* 0 the console's texture filtering; 2, 4, 8, 16 trilinear + anisotropic */
    int msaa;            /* MSAA samples: 1 (off), 2, 4, 8 */
    int shadow_scale;    /* shadow map resolution multiple: 1, 2, 4 or 8 */
    int skip_intro;
    int show_launcher;   /* show the settings screen at startup */
    int all_difficulties;
    int all_costumes;       /* every costume at New Game's Costume Selection */
    int movie_43;           /* the game's Movie Display Ratio 4:3 (kept here: src/pc_menu.c) */
    /* Hard, Very Hard and Master Ninja offered without clearing the one before */
} NgbSettings;

void ngb_settings_load(NgbSettings *s);
void ngb_settings_save(const NgbSettings *s);

/* The settings shown on the settings screens, in order: aspect, window
 * size, display, render resolution, anisotropic filtering, MSAA, shadow resolution,
 * V-Sync, FPS counter, skip intros. */
#define NGB_SETTINGS_ITEMS 10
/* Step setting item one way (dir -1/+1); its label and current value. */
void ngb_settings_change(NgbSettings *s, int item, int dir);
void ngb_settings_row_text(const NgbSettings *s, int item, const char **label,
                           char *val, size_t n);

/* V-Sync's values: 0 Off, 1 Mailbox (the newest frame at each refresh: least delay; what Nvidia calls Fast),
 * 2 Adaptive (FIFO relaxed), 3 FIFO (every frame in turn: classic V-Sync). Its name, and the next one the
 * menus step to, in the order Off, Mailbox, FIFO, Adaptive. */
const char *ngb_vsync_name(int v);
int ngb_vsync_step(int v, int dir);

/* The window sizes offered for an aspect ratio, smallest first; the index of
 * the settings' own (-1: none of them). */
int ngb_settings_size_count(int aspect);
void ngb_settings_size_at(int aspect, int i, int *w, int *h);
int ngb_settings_size_index(const NgbSettings *s);
void ngb_settings_snap_size(NgbSettings *s);   /* the nearest size of s's aspect */

/* Width/height of the aspect, for the presenter. */
double ngb_settings_aspect_ratio(const NgbSettings *s);

/* Runs the settings screen in its own window. Returns 1 to start the game,
 * 0 to quit. Saves the settings when the game is started. */
int ngb_launcher_run(NgbSettings *s);

/* The settings the game was started with, for the in-game menu (F1 or
 * Back+Start), which starts from them and changes them. */
void ngb_menu_set_running(const NgbSettings *s);

#endif
```

`src/main.c`:

```c
/**
 * Ninja Gaiden Black - static recompilation host entry point.
 *
 * Builds natively for Linux (x86-64) and Windows. Boots the recompiled XBE:
 * load default.xbe, map the Xbox address space, bring up the kernel HLE and
 * thunk table, then call the lifted entry point.
 *
 * XBE details (tools.xbe_parser):
 *   Title:       NINJA GAIDEN Black (Kunai.exe, release_ltcg)
 *   Title ID:    0x5443000D, region NA, XDK 5849
 *   Base addr:   0x00010000, image size 0x00DB6BC0
 *   Entry point: 0x0032B385
 *   Code:        .text 0x369480 bytes + D3D/DSOUND/XPP/XONLINE/XNET/DOLBY...
 *   Libraries:   D3D8LTCG, DSOUND, XAPILIB, XONLINES, LIBCMT/LIBCPMT, XGRAPHCL
 *   Kernel:      145 imports
 *
 * Game data: the extracted disc goes in a directory named "game" next to the
 * executable, or wherever NGB_GAME_DIR (or the first argument) points.
 */

#if defined(_WIN32)
#include <windows.h>
#include <dbghelp.h>
#include <mmsystem.h>
#include <unistd.h>   /* (mingw's: usleep) */
#include <pthread.h>
#include "platform/vcpu.h"
#else
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <execinfo.h>
#include <limits.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <semaphore.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include "platform/win32_compat.h"
#include "platform/vcpu.h"
#endif

#ifdef __linux__
#include <sys/prctl.h>
#endif
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <string.h>

#include <xbox/xboxrecomp.h>

#include "usb/ohci.h"
#include "usb/usb_gamepad.h"
extern void xbox_InputInit(void);
#if defined(NGB_NV2A_VK)
#include "launcher.h"

/* Skip intro movie: see src/movie_skip.c. The kernel's open hook tells it
 * which movie the title is about to play. */
extern int ngb_skip_intro;
extern void ngb_movie_read(const char *host_path);
extern void (*xbox_FileReadHook)(const char *host_path, uint64_t offset, size_t len);

/* The GPU model is running: it wakes a title waiting on the GPU's progress (src/d3d/d3d_orig.c). */
int g_ngb_gpu_model;

/* Skipping the boot "Warnings" screen (always; NGB_KEEP_WARNINGS=1 shows it). The screen reads
 * its assets from demo.afs (the last of them at offset 0x151000) and then
 * nothing until it ends; the title it leads to starts with more reads. So
 * after that read, press Start -- what a player does to skip it -- and
 * again only while nothing more has been read, so no press can reach the
 * title screen or a menu. It keeps trying for 15 s: on a slow first start
 * (pipelines being built) the screen takes Start only seconds later. The
 * music and sound streams, and demo.afs (read on behind the screen), do
 * not count as the title's reads. */
#if defined(NGB_NV2A_VK)
void nv2a_present_set_blank(_Bool blank);   /* nv2a_window.h */
#endif
static volatile int s_warning_reads;    /* reads seen since the trigger */
static volatile int s_warning_armed;

static void *warning_skip_thread(void *arg)
{
    (void)arg;
    for (int tries = 0; tries < 37; tries++) {
        usleep(tries ? 400000 : 500000);
        if (__atomic_load_n(&s_warning_reads, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE))
            break;                      /* moved on: done */
        usb_gamepad_inject |= 0x10;     /* Start */
        usleep(150000);
        usb_gamepad_inject &= ~0x10;
    }
#if defined(NGB_NV2A_VK)
    usleep(300000);                     /* the screen's fade out */
    nv2a_present_set_blank(false);
#endif
    return NULL;
}

#if defined(NGB_NV2A_VK)
/* The screen is drawn before it reads anything of its own, and before it
 * there is only black: with Skip intro the window stays black from the
 * start until the skip is done -- or, should it never start, 15 s. */
static void *warning_unblank_thread(void *arg)
{
    (void)arg;
    usleep(15000000);
    if (!__atomic_load_n(&s_warning_armed, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE))
        nv2a_present_set_blank(false);
    return NULL;
}
#endif

static void warning_read(const char *host_path, uint64_t off)
{
    const char *base = host_path;   /* the file's name: after the last / or (Windows) \ */
    for (const char *c = host_path; *c; c++)
        if (*c == '/' || *c == '\\')
            base = c + 1;
    if (__atomic_load_n(&s_warning_armed, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) {
        /* (demo.afs goes on being read behind the screen, the attract
         * demo's data streamed in 64 KB pieces: not the title) */
        if (strcmp(base, "bgm.afs") && strcmp(base, "sse.afs") && strcmp(base, "demo.afs"))
            __atomic_store_n(&s_warning_reads, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        return;
    }
    if (!strcmp(base, "demo.afs") && off == 0x151000) {
        static int once;

        pthread_t th;
        if (once++)
            return;
        __atomic_store_n(&s_warning_armed, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
#if defined(NGB_NV2A_VK)
        nv2a_present_set_blank(true);   /* skipped unseen */
#endif
        if (pthread_create(&th, NULL, warning_skip_thread, NULL) == 0)
            pthread_detach(th);
    }
}

static void movie_read_hook(const char *host_path, uint64_t off, size_t len)
{
    (void)len;
    if (host_path) {
        ngb_movie_read(host_path);
        warning_read(host_path, off);
    }
}
#endif
#include "install.h"
```
