```c
/* ── Global register state (defined in xbox_memory_layout.c) ── */

/* RECOMP_TLS is not optional: the runtime defines these thread-local, and a
 * plain extern would resolve to the TLS template rather than this thread's
 * copy, so the guest would start with every register at zero. */
extern RECOMP_TLS uint32_t g_eax, g_ecx, g_edx, g_esp;
extern RECOMP_TLS uint32_t g_ebx, g_esi, g_edi;
extern ptrdiff_t g_xbox_mem_offset;

#define NGB_ENTRY_POINT 0x0032B385u

/* Renderer choice (choose_renderer): the GPU model, and whether it has a window. */
static bool s_use_gpu, s_headless;
static bool s_widescreen;
static char s_game_dir[4096];
static int s_show_settings;
#define NGB_D3D_DEVICE_PTR 0x003D83C8u   /* D3D8LTCG global device pointer */

extern void xbe_entry_point(void);
extern int recomp_dispatch_init(void);   /* recomp_dispatch.c */

/* ── Crash reporting ───────────────────────────────────────── */

/* Name the host function a fault happened in. Every lifted function is a real
 * symbol (sub_XXXXXXXX), so this is the guest function as well. On Linux the
 * executable is linked with -rdynamic so dladdr can see them; the module
 * offset is printed too, for addr2line when it cannot. */
static void print_host_symbol(void *rip)
{
#if defined(_WIN32)
    char buf[sizeof(SYMBOL_INFO) + 256];
    SYMBOL_INFO *sym = (SYMBOL_INFO *)buf;
    DWORD64 disp = 0;

    memset(buf, 0, sizeof(buf));
    sym->SizeOfStruct = sizeof(SYMBOL_INFO);
    sym->MaxNameLen = 255;
    if (SymFromAddr(GetCurrentProcess(), (DWORD64)(uintptr_t)rip, &disp, sym))
        fprintf(stderr, "  in %s+0x%llX\n", sym->Name, (unsigned long long)disp);
    {   /* and which module: a fault in a driver or an overlay's DLL names it here (#39) */
        HMODULE mod = NULL;
        char path[MAX_PATH];
        if (GetModuleHandleExA(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS | GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT,
                               (LPCSTR)rip, &mod) && GetModuleFileNameA(mod, path, sizeof path))
            fprintf(stderr, "  in module %s+0x%llX\n", path,
                    (unsigned long long)((uintptr_t)rip - (uintptr_t)mod));
    }
#else
    Dl_info di;

    if (dladdr(rip, &di) && di.dli_fname) {
        fprintf(stderr, "  in %s+0x%lX (%s+0x%lX)\n",
                di.dli_sname ? di.dli_sname : "?",
                di.dli_saddr ? (unsigned long)((char *)rip - (char *)di.dli_saddr) : 0ul,
                di.dli_fname,
                (unsigned long)((char *)rip - (char *)di.dli_fbase));
    }
#endif
}

/* Recover the guest call chain: every lifted call pushes its guest return
 * address before jumping, so scanning the guest stack for values inside the
 * code range finds it. Over-reports (stale returns linger below esp), but
 * naming the caller is what a fault report needs. */
static void print_guest_stack(void)
{
    const uint32_t *sp;
    int i, shown = 0;

    if (!g_xbox_mem_offset || !g_esp)
        return;
    sp = (const uint32_t *)((uintptr_t)g_xbox_mem_offset + g_esp);
    fprintf(stderr, "  guest stack (return addresses, innermost first):\n");
    for (i = 0; i < 256 && shown < 24; i++) {
        uint32_t v = sp[i];
        if (v > g_xbox_code_lo && v < g_xbox_code_hi) {
            fprintf(stderr, "    [esp+%-4d] 0x%08X\n", i * 4, v);
            shown++;
        }
    }
    if (!shown) {
        extern volatile uint32_t g_icall_trace[16];
        extern volatile uint32_t g_icall_trace_idx;
        uint32_t k;

        fprintf(stderr, "    (no return addresses in range)\n  recent ICALL targets:");
        for (k = 0; k < 16; k++)
            fprintf(stderr, " %08X", g_icall_trace[(g_icall_trace_idx + k) & 15]);
        fprintf(stderr, "\n");
        for (i = 0; i < 20; i++)
            fprintf(stderr, "    raw[esp+%-4d] 0x%08X\n", i * 4, sp[i]);
    }
}

/* The emulated APU: its registers are unmapped when RECOMP_AC97_READY is set,
 * and every access arrives here to be decoded and serviced. */
typedef struct MCPXAPUState MCPXAPUState;
extern MCPXAPUState *mcpx_apu_init_standalone(uint8_t *ram_ptr);
extern MCPXAPUState *g_apu_state;
extern bool apu_hook_handle_mmio(PCONTEXT ctx, uintptr_t fault_addr,
                                 uint32_t fault_xbox_va, int is_write);
#define APU_TRAP_BASE 0xFE800000u
#define APU_TRAP_END  0xFE880000u

#define MEM32_HOST(va) (*(uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(g_xbox_mem_offset + (uint32_t)(va)))
/* NGB_WATCH_WRITE=va[:len]: report every write to guest [va, va+len) -- the
 * host function (a lifted sub_XXXXXXXX) and the guest return addresses --
 * by write-protecting the page and stepping over each write. */
static uint32_t s_watch_va, s_watch_len, s_watch_page;
static __thread int t_watch_stepping;
static unsigned long s_watch_hits;

static void watch_protect(int on)
{
    DWORD old;
    VirtualProtect((void *)(uintptr_t)(g_xbox_mem_offset + s_watch_page), 4096,
                   on ? PAGE_READONLY : PAGE_READWRITE, &old);
}

static void watch_arm(void)
{
    const char *e = getenv("NGB_WATCH_WRITE");
    char *end;
    if (!e || !*e)
        return;
#if defined(__APPLE__) && defined(__aarch64__)
    fprintf(stderr, "NGB_WATCH_WRITE requires x86 single-step support\n");
    return;
#endif
    s_watch_va = (uint32_t)strtoul(e, &end, 0);
    s_watch_len = *end == ':' ? (uint32_t)strtoul(end + 1, NULL, 0) : 4;
    s_watch_page = s_watch_va & ~0xFFFu;
    watch_protect(1);
    fprintf(stderr, "[WATCH] writes to 0x%08X+%u\n", s_watch_va, s_watch_len);
}

static LONG watch_exception(PEXCEPTION_POINTERS ep, uint32_t xbox_va, int is_write)
{
    if (ep->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionCode == EXCEPTION_SINGLE_STEP) {
        if (!t_watch_stepping)
            return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
        t_watch_stepping = 0;
        ep->ContextRecord->EFlags &= ~0x100u;
        watch_protect(1);
        return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION;
    }
    if (!s_watch_len || !is_write || (xbox_va & ~0xFFFu) != s_watch_page)
        return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
    static long long after = -1, t0;
    if (after < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("NGB_WATCH_AFTER");   /* ms before logging */
        after = e ? atoll(e) : 0;
        t0 = (long long)GetTickCount64();
    }
    if (xbox_va + 8 > s_watch_va && xbox_va < s_watch_va + s_watch_len &&
        (long long)GetTickCount64() - t0 >= after && s_watch_hits++ < 400) {
        void *rip = (void *)(uintptr_t)ep->ContextRecord->Rip;
#if defined(_WIN32)
        const char *who = "?";
#else
        Dl_info di;
        const char *who = dladdr(rip, &di) && di.dli_sname ? di.dli_sname : "?";
#endif
        fprintf(stderr, "[WATCH] write 0x%08X by %s at %p (esp=%08X ret %08X %08X %08X %08X)\n",
                xbox_va, who, rip, g_esp, MEM32_HOST(g_esp), MEM32_HOST(g_esp + 4),
                MEM32_HOST(g_esp + 8), MEM32_HOST(g_esp + 12));
#if !defined(_WIN32)
        if (getenv("NGB_WATCH_BT") && s_watch_hits % 50 == 1) {
            void *frames[64];
            int n = backtrace(frames, 64);
            backtrace_symbols_fd(frames, n, 2);
        }
#endif
    }
    watch_protect(0);
    t_watch_stepping = 1;
    ep->ContextRecord->EFlags |= 0x100u;
    return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION;
}

static LONG CALLBACK veh_handler(PEXCEPTION_POINTERS ep)
{
    uintptr_t fault_addr;
    uint32_t xbox_va;
    int is_write;

#if defined(_WIN32) && XBOX_HAS_VCPU
    vcpu_win_unredirect(ep);   /* the faulting instruction's context, not the preemption trampoline's */
#endif
    if (s_watch_len && (ep->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionCode == EXCEPTION_SINGLE_STEP ||
                        ep->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionCode == EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION)) {
        uintptr_t fa = ep->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionInformation[1];
        LONG r = watch_exception(ep, (uint32_t)(fa - (uintptr_t)g_xbox_mem_offset),
                                 ep->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionInformation[0] ? 1 : 0);
        if (r == EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION)
            return r;
    }
    if (ep->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionCode != EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION)
        return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;

    fault_addr = ep->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionInformation[1];
    is_write = ep->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionInformation[0] ? 1 : 0;
    xbox_va = (uint32_t)(fault_addr - (uintptr_t)g_xbox_mem_offset);

    if (g_apu_state && xbox_va >= APU_TRAP_BASE && xbox_va < APU_TRAP_END
            && apu_hook_handle_mmio(ep->ContextRecord, fault_addr, xbox_va, is_write))
        return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION;
    /* The USB host controllers (the controller ports). */
    if (xbox_OhciOwnsAddress(xbox_va) &&
        xbox_OhciHandleMmio(ep->ContextRecord, xbox_va))
        return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION;

    fprintf(stderr, "[CRASH] Access violation at RIP=0x%llX, fault addr=0x%llX (%s)\n",
            (unsigned long long)ep->ContextRecord->Rip,
            (unsigned long long)fault_addr, is_write ? "write" : "read");
    fprintf(stderr, "  Xbox VA of fault: 0x%08X\n", xbox_va);
    fprintf(stderr, "  Xbox regs: eax=%08X ecx=%08X edx=%08X ebx=%08X\n",
            g_eax, g_ecx, g_edx, g_ebx);
    fprintf(stderr, "             esi=%08X edi=%08X esp=%08X\n",
            g_esi, g_edi, g_esp);
    print_host_symbol((void *)(uintptr_t)ep->ContextRecord->Rip);
    print_guest_stack();
    fflush(stderr);
    return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
}

/* ── Hang sampling (Linux) ─────────────────────────────────── */

#if !defined(_WIN32)
/* `kill -USR1 <pid>` prints where the guest thread is: a host backtrace
 * (every lifted function is a named symbol) and its guest registers. No
 * ptrace, so it works where gdb cannot attach and where gdb would swallow the
 * TF single-steps the register traps depend on. Whichever thread the kernel
 * hands the signal to forwards it to the guest thread. */
static pthread_t s_guest_thread;
static sem_t *s_sample_done;

/* One external `kill -USR1` fans out to every guest thread (the boot thread
 * and everything CreateThread started); each prints its own host backtrace
 * and its own guest registers, which are thread-local. */
static void sample_on_signal(int sig, siginfo_t *si, void *uc)
{
    void *frames[48];
    int n;

    (void)uc;
#ifdef __APPLE__
    if (!pthread_equal(pthread_self(), s_guest_thread)) {
        pthread_kill(s_guest_thread, sig);
        return;
    }
#else
    if (si->si_code == SI_USER) {
        /* One at a time, so the backtraces do not interleave. */
        static sem_t done;
        static int inited;
        pthread_t th[256];
        int k = compat_thread_list(th, 256);
        if (!inited) { sem_init(&done, 0, 0); inited = 1; }
        s_sample_done = &done;
        th[k++] = s_guest_thread;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            if (pthread_equal(th[i], pthread_self()))
                continue;   /* cannot wait on itself; it is sampled last */
            if (pthread_kill(th[i], sig) == 0) {
                struct timespec ts;
                clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &ts);
                ts.tv_sec += 2;
                sem_timedwait(&done, &ts);
            }
        }
#if defined(NGB_NV2A_VK)
        if (s_use_gpu)
            nv2a_vk_sample_threads();
#endif
        xbox_PeekSample("sample");
        {   /* NGB_DUMP_RAM=path: the guest's low 64 MB, then the 128 MB
             * contiguous window, to path.N */
            const char *path = getenv("NGB_DUMP_RAM");
            static int seq;
            if (path && *path) {
                char name[600];
                FILE *f;
                snprintf(name, sizeof name, "%s.%d", path, seq++);
                f = fopen(name, "wb");
                if (f) {
                    fwrite((const void *)(uintptr_t)xbox_GetMemoryOffset(), 1,
                           64u << 20, f);
                    /* then the contiguous window (0x80000000), where the
                     * title's heaps live */
                    fwrite((const void *)((uintptr_t)xbox_GetMemoryOffset()
                                          + 0x80000000u), 1, 128u << 20, f);
                    fclose(f);
                    fprintf(stderr, "[DUMP] RAM -> %s\n", name);
                }
            }
        }
        {   /* NGB_DUMP=va:len[,va:len...]: hex+ascii dump on a sample */
            const char *d = getenv("NGB_DUMP");
            while (d && *d) {
                char *e;
                uint32_t va = (uint32_t)strtoul(d, &e, 0), len = 0;
                if (*e == ':') len = (uint32_t)strtoul(e + 1, &e, 0);
                for (uint32_t o = 0; o < len; o += 16) {
                    fprintf(stderr, "[DUMP] %08X:", va + o);
                    for (int j = 0; j < 16; j++)
                        fprintf(stderr, " %02X", ((const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)xbox_GetMemoryOffset())[va + o + j]);
                    fprintf(stderr, "  ");
                    for (int j = 0; j < 16; j++) {
                        uint8_t c = ((const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)xbox_GetMemoryOffset())[va + o + j];
                        fputc(c >= 32 && c < 127 ? c : '.', stderr);
                    }
                    fputc('\n', stderr);
                }
                d = *e == ',' ? e + 1 : e;
                if (e == d && *e) break;
            }
        }
        return;
    }
#endif
    n = backtrace(frames, 48);
    fprintf(stderr, "[SAMPLE] %s thread %lx prio %d%s: esp=%08X eax=%08X ecx=%08X "
                    "edx=%08X ebx=%08X esi=%08X edi=%08X\n",
            pthread_equal(pthread_self(), s_guest_thread) ? "boot" : "guest",
            (unsigned long)pthread_self(),
            vcpu_self() ? vcpu_get_priority(vcpu_self()) : -99,
            vcpu_holds_cpu() ? " (running)" : "",
            g_esp, g_eax, g_ecx, g_edx, g_ebx, g_esi, g_edi);
    backtrace_symbols_fd(frames, n, 2);
    if (s_sample_done)
        sem_post(s_sample_done);
}
#endif

/* ── Profiling (Linux) ─────────────────────────────────────── */

#if !defined(_WIN32)
#include <sys/time.h>
#ifdef __APPLE__
#include <sys/ucontext.h>
#else
#include <ucontext.h>
#endif
/* NGB_PROFILE=1: sample the instruction pointer of whichever thread is using
 * CPU every millisecond of process CPU time, and print the hottest functions
 * (every lifted guest function is a named symbol) when the process ends. */
#define PROF_SLOTS (1u << 20)
static uintptr_t *s_prof_pc;
static volatile unsigned long s_prof_n;

static void prof_signal(int sig, siginfo_t *si, void *uc_)
{
    ucontext_t *uc = uc_;
    unsigned long i = __atomic_fetch_add(&s_prof_n, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    (void)sig; (void)si;
    if (i < PROF_SLOTS)
#if defined(__APPLE__) && defined(__aarch64__)
        s_prof_pc[i] = uc->uc_mcontext->__ss.__pc;
#else
        s_prof_pc[i] = (uintptr_t)uc->uc_mcontext.gregs[REG_RIP];
#endif
}

typedef struct { const char *name; unsigned long n; } ProfEntry;

static int prof_cmp(const void *a, const void *b)
{
    const ProfEntry *x = a, *y = b;
    return (y->n > x->n) - (y->n < x->n);
}

static void prof_report(void)
{
    unsigned long n = s_prof_n < PROF_SLOTS ? s_prof_n : PROF_SLOTS, k = 0;
    ProfEntry *e;

    if (!n)
        return;
    /* NGB_PROFILE_RAW=<file>: every sample as its file and offset in it, for nm to name what dladdr
     * cannot (static functions) */
    if (getenv("NGB_PROFILE_RAW")) {
        FILE *raw = fopen(getenv("NGB_PROFILE_RAW"), "w");
        for (unsigned long i = 0; raw && i < n; i++) {
            Dl_info di;
            if (dladdr((void *)s_prof_pc[i], &di) && di.dli_fname)
                fprintf(raw, "%s %lx\n", di.dli_fname, (unsigned long)(s_prof_pc[i] - (uintptr_t)di.dli_fbase));
        }
        if (raw)
            fclose(raw);
    }
    e = calloc(n, sizeof(*e));
    for (unsigned long i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        Dl_info di;
        const char *name = "?";
        if (dladdr((void *)s_prof_pc[i], &di))
            name = di.dli_sname ? di.dli_sname : di.dli_fname;
        unsigned long j;
        for (j = 0; j < k; j++)
            if (e[j].name == name || !strcmp(e[j].name, name))
                break;
        if (j == k)
            e[k++].name = name;
        e[j].n++;
    }
    qsort(e, k, sizeof(*e), prof_cmp);
    fprintf(stderr, "[PROFILE] %lu samples (1 ms of CPU each)\n", n);
    for (unsigned long j = 0; j < k && j < 40; j++)
        fprintf(stderr, "  %5.1f%%  %s\n", 100.0 * e[j].n / n, e[j].name);
    free(e);
}

static void prof_exit_on_signal(int sig)
{
    struct itimerval off = { { 0, 0 }, { 0, 0 } };
    (void)sig;
    setitimer(ITIMER_PROF, &off, NULL);
    prof_report();
    _exit(0);   /* see feedback_on_signal */
}

static void prof_start(void)
{
    struct sigaction sa;
    struct itimerval it = { { 0, 1000 }, { 0, 1000 } };

    s_prof_pc = calloc(PROF_SLOTS, sizeof(*s_prof_pc));
    memset(&sa, 0, sizeof(sa));
    sa.sa_sigaction = prof_signal;
    sa.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO | SA_RESTART;
    sigaction(SIGPROF, &sa, NULL);
    setitimer(ITIMER_PROF, &it, NULL);
    atexit(prof_report);
}
#endif

/* ── Paths ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/* Directory holding the executable, with a trailing separator. */
static void exe_dir(char *out, size_t n)
{
    char *slash;
    if (ngb_exe_path(out, n) < 0) { out[0] = 0; return; }
    slash = strrchr(out, '/');
    if (slash) slash[1] = 0; else out[0] = 0;
}

/* Per-title save location (hard disk partition images, saves, cache):
 * NGB_SAVE_DIR, else $XDG_DATA_HOME or ~/.local/share on Linux and
 * %LOCALAPPDATA% on Windows, under NinjaGaidenBlack. */
static void save_dir_path(char *out, size_t n)
{
    const char *env = getenv("NGB_SAVE_DIR");
#if defined(_WIN32)
    const char *base = getenv("LOCALAPPDATA");
    if (env && *env) { snprintf(out, n, "%s", env); return; }
    snprintf(out, n, "%s/NinjaGaidenBlack", base && *base ? base : ".");
#else
    const char *xdg = getenv("XDG_DATA_HOME"), *home = getenv("HOME");
    if (env && *env) { snprintf(out, n, "%s", env); return; }
    if (xdg && *xdg)
        snprintf(out, n, "%s/NinjaGaidenBlack", xdg);
    else
#ifdef __APPLE__
        ngb_macos_dir(out, n, "saves", 1);
#else
        snprintf(out, n, "%s/.local/share/NinjaGaidenBlack", home && *home ? home : ".");
#endif
#endif
}

static bool load_file(const char *path, void **out_data, size_t *out_size)
{
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    long size;
    void *data;

    if (!f)
        return false;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    size = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    if (size <= 0 || !(data = malloc((size_t)size))) {
        fclose(f);
        return false;
    }
    if (fread(data, 1, (size_t)size, f) != (size_t)size) {
        free(data);
        fclose(f);
        return false;
    }
    fclose(f);
    *out_data = data;
    *out_size = (size_t)size;
    return true;
}

/* ── Entry ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/* Runtime switches this title needs to get past hardware it waits on, until
 * the hardware is modelled. Set only when absent, so any of them can still be
 * overridden (or turned off with an empty value) from the environment.
 *
 *   RECOMP_VBLANK      D3D blocks on its vblank event; raise the NV2A vblank
 *                      interrupt at 60 Hz.
 *   RECOMP_AC97_READY  DirectSound programs the APU directly; trap its
 *                      registers into the emulated APU.
 *   RECOMP_DSP_ACK     DirectSound's effects-image download posts command 3 to
 *                      the GP DSP mailbox and spins until the DSP clears it
 *                      (sub_0037DAAE). The DSP is not emulated, so complete it
 *                      at once. The mailbox is +0x810 into a contiguous block
 *                      whose address is deterministic for this build (it moves if the
 *                      contiguous allocator does: XBOX_CONTIG_ALLOC_BASE). */
static void set_default(const char *name, const char *value)
{
    if (getenv(name))
        return;
#if defined(_WIN32)
    _putenv_s(name, value);
#else
    setenv(name, value, 0);
#endif
}

/* NGB_RENDERER: "d3d" (default when built with the GPU model: the Direct3D
 * renderer, src/d3d, draws on the GPU model's device and window), "xemu"
 * (the GPU model's own NV2A renderer draws), "mirror" (xemu draws and shows,
 * the Direct3D renderer draws unseen, for comparing), "null" (the GPU model
 * without a window -- for headless runs), or "none" (no GPU model: the
 * plain-RAM aperture and the fence mirror, as before it existed). */

static void choose_renderer(void)
{
#if defined(NGB_NV2A_VK)
    set_default("NGB_RENDERER", "d3d");   /* read again by src/d3d (d3d.c, hle.cpp, vk/backend.cpp) */
    if (!strcmp(getenv("NGB_RENDERER"), "d3d") && !getenv("NGB_D3D_KEEP_NV2A"))
        set_default("NV2A_NO_PREWARM", "1");   /* xemu's renderer draws nothing: none of its pipelines */
#endif
    const char *r = getenv("NGB_RENDERER");
#if defined(NGB_NV2A_VK)
    s_use_gpu = !(r && !strcmp(r, "none"));
    s_headless = r && !strcmp(r, "null");
#else
    (void)r;
#endif
}

static void bringup_defaults(void)
{
    /* With the GPU model, vblank comes from its CRTC. */
    if (!s_use_gpu)
        set_default("RECOMP_VBLANK", "1");
    set_default("RECOMP_AC97_READY", "1");
    set_default("RECOMP_USB", "1");
    set_default("RECOMP_DSP_ACK", "0x86BF8810");   /* contiguous memory starts at 64 MB */
}

#if defined(RECOMP_ICALL_FEEDBACK)
/* A bring-up run usually ends at a timeout or ^C, not an orderly exit, and
 * atexit does not run on a signal. Dump on the way out of those too. */
static void feedback_on_signal(int sig)
{
    RECOMP_ICALL_FEEDBACK_DUMP();
    /* Straight out, as closing the window does: exit() would run library
     * destructors (the Vulkan driver's, SDL's audio) while the GPU and
     * audio threads still use them, and either hangs or crashes there. */
    _exit(128 + sig);
}
#endif

/* ── Boot (guest thread) ───────────────────────────────────── */


/* Everything from loading the XBE to the entry point runs on the thread that
 * will execute guest code: the guest register file and the TIB the kernel
 * sets up are per-thread. */
static void *guest_main(void *unused)
{
    char xbe_path[4200];
    void *xbe_data = NULL;
    size_t xbe_size = 0;

    (void)unused;
#if !defined(_WIN32)
    s_guest_thread = pthread_self();
#endif
#if XBOX_HAS_VCPU
    /* The boot thread runs the title's main thread inline: it is a guest
     * thread like the ones the title creates (platform/vcpu.h). */
    vcpu_attach(VCPU_PRIO_NORMAL);
#endif
    snprintf(xbe_path, sizeof(xbe_path), "%s/default.xbe", s_game_dir);
    if (!load_file(xbe_path, &xbe_data, &xbe_size)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Cannot read %s\n"
                        "Put the extracted disc in a 'game' directory next to the "
                        "executable, or pass its path.\n", xbe_path);
        exit(1);
    }
    printf("XBE loaded: %zu bytes\n", xbe_size);

    if (!xbox_MemoryLayoutInit(xbe_data, xbe_size)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Failed to initialize the Xbox memory layout.\n");
        exit(1);
    }
    g_xbox_mem_offset = xbox_GetMemoryOffset();
    printf("Xbox memory mapped. Offset: 0x%llX\n",
           (unsigned long long)g_xbox_mem_offset);

#if defined(NGB_NV2A_VK)
    if (s_use_gpu) {
        Nv2aVkOptions o = { .headless = s_headless };
        if (xbox_Nv2aVkStart(&o) != 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Cannot start the GPU.\n");
            exit(1);
        }
        g_ngb_gpu_model = 1;   /* D3D_BlockOnTime sleeps on its progress (src/d3d/d3d_orig.c) */
    } else
#endif
    {
        /* No GPU model: D3D8LTCG's pushbuffer fence never advances on its
         * own. The device pointer lives at 0x3D83C8; +0x2C is the write
         * sequence and +0x30 points at where the GPU reports how far it has
         * read. Mirror one into the other so space and fence waits
         * (sub_003CAA10) complete instead of spinning forever. */
        xbox_Nv2aMirrorFence(NGB_D3D_DEVICE_PTR, 0x2C, 0x30);
    }

    /* The APU and its register trap are only useful together: a trap with no
     * model declines every access, a model nothing traps into sees nothing. */
    if (getenv("RECOMP_AC97_READY")) {
        g_apu_state = mcpx_apu_init_standalone((uint8_t *)xbox_GetMemoryBase());
        fprintf(stderr, "[BOOT] emulated APU %s\n",
                g_apu_state ? "up" : "FAILED to initialise");
    }

    xbox_kernel_init();
    {
        extern void xbox_path_init(const char *game_dir, const char *save_dir);
        char save_dir[4096];
        save_dir_path(save_dir, sizeof(save_dir));
        printf("Save directory: %s\n", save_dir);
        xbox_path_init(s_game_dir, save_dir);
    }
    xbox_kernel_bridge_init();
    /* Controller ports: OHCI with an Xbox gamepad fed by SDL's game
     * controllers (src/usb). Inert unless RECOMP_USB is set. */
    xbox_OhciInit();
    g_esp = XBOX_STACK_TOP;

    /* Flat dispatch table: without it every indirect call binary-searches the
     * function table. Optional -- the search still works if this fails. */
    if (!recomp_dispatch_init())
        fprintf(stderr, "[BOOT] flat dispatch unavailable; "
                        "indirect calls will use the binary search\n");

    /* Inert unless RECOMP_WATCHDOG_SECS is set; must run on the guest thread. */
    xbox_WatchdogStart();

    watch_arm();
    printf("Entry point: 0x%08X, ESP: 0x%08X\nStarting game...\n",
           NGB_ENTRY_POINT, g_esp);
    {
        /* The PC settings in the game's Options menu (src/pc_menu.c). */
        extern void ngb_pc_menu_init(void);
        ngb_pc_menu_init();
    }
    xbe_entry_point();

    printf("Game returned.\n");
    exit(0);
    return NULL;
}

/* ── Entry (host main thread: window and events) ───────────── */

#if defined(_WIN32)
#include <tlhelp32.h>
#include <psapi.h>
/* NGB_HANG_DUMP=<seconds> (debugging, Windows): after that long, each thread's call stack, as
 * module+offset, into the log -- where a hang is, without a debugger. A thread is suspended only
 * while its frames are read into a buffer: nothing that takes a lock (stdio, the loader) runs
 * meanwhile, since the suspended thread may hold it. */
static DWORD WINAPI hang_dump_thread(LPVOID arg)
{
    static HMODULE mods[256];
    static char names[256][64];
    static char out[1 << 16];
    MODULEINFO mi[256];
    DWORD need = 0, pid = GetCurrentProcessId(), me = GetCurrentThreadId();
    int nmods, len = 0;
    HANDLE snap;
    THREADENTRY32 te;

    Sleep((DWORD)(uintptr_t)arg * 1000);
    for (int round = 0; round < 3; round++, Sleep(3000)) {
    len = 0;
    K32EnumProcessModules(GetCurrentProcess(), mods, sizeof mods, &need);
    nmods = (int)(need / sizeof(HMODULE));
    if (nmods > 256) nmods = 256;
    for (int i = 0; i < nmods; i++) {
        char path[MAX_PATH], *b;
        K32GetModuleInformation(GetCurrentProcess(), mods[i], &mi[i], sizeof mi[i]);
        K32GetModuleFileNameExA(GetCurrentProcess(), mods[i], path, sizeof path);
        b = strrchr(path, '\\');
        snprintf(names[i], sizeof names[i], "%s", b ? b + 1 : path);
    }
    snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD, 0);
    te.dwSize = sizeof te;
    for (BOOL ok = Thread32First(snap, &te); ok && len < (int)sizeof out - 4096; ok = Thread32Next(snap, &te)) {
        HANDLE h;
        CONTEXT c;
        if (te.th32OwnerProcessID != pid || te.th32ThreadID == me)
            continue;
        h = OpenThread(THREAD_SUSPEND_RESUME | THREAD_GET_CONTEXT | THREAD_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE,
                       te.th32ThreadID);
        if (!h)
            continue;
        (SuspendThread)(h);
        memset(&c, 0, sizeof c);
        c.ContextFlags = CONTEXT_FULL;
        if ((GetThreadContext)(h, &c)) {
            len += snprintf(out + len, sizeof out - len, "[HANG] thread %lu:", te.th32ThreadID);
            for (int f = 0; f < 20 && c.Rip; f++) {
                DWORD64 base = 0;
                PRUNTIME_FUNCTION fn = RtlLookupFunctionEntry(c.Rip, &base, NULL);
                int m = -1;
                for (int i = 0; i < nmods; i++)
                    if (c.Rip >= (DWORD64)mi[i].lpBaseOfDll &&
                        c.Rip < (DWORD64)mi[i].lpBaseOfDll + mi[i].SizeOfImage)
                        m = i;
                if (m >= 0)
                    len += snprintf(out + len, sizeof out - len, " %s+%llx", names[m],
                                    (unsigned long long)(c.Rip - (DWORD64)mi[m].lpBaseOfDll));
                else
                    len += snprintf(out + len, sizeof out - len, " %llx", (unsigned long long)c.Rip);
                if (fn) {
                    PVOID hd;
                    DWORD64 ef;
                    RtlVirtualUnwind(UNW_FLAG_NHANDLER, base, c.Rip, fn, &c, &hd, &ef, NULL);
                } else {
                    c.Rip = *(DWORD64 *)c.Rsp;
                    c.Rsp += 8;
                }
            }
            len += snprintf(out + len, sizeof out - len, "\n");
        }
        (ResumeThread)(h);
        CloseHandle(h);
    }
    CloseHandle(snap);
    {
        extern void nv2a_debug_state(char *buf, int n);
        extern void xbox_kernel_debug_counts(char *buf, int n, uint32_t watch_va);
        char gpu[512];
        nv2a_debug_state(gpu, sizeof gpu);
        len += snprintf(out + len, sizeof out - len, "%s\n", gpu);
        xbox_kernel_debug_counts(gpu, sizeof gpu, 0x3D83C8);   /* D3D's device pointer */
        len += snprintf(out + len, sizeof out - len, "%s\n", gpu);
        vcpu_debug_state(out + len, (int)sizeof out - len);   /* who holds the CPU, who waits */
        len += (int)strlen(out + len);
        /* NGB_HANG_MEM=va:bytes[,va:bytes...] (hex): guest memory, as words */
        if (getenv("NGB_HANG_MEM")) {
            char spec[512], *tok, *save = NULL;
            snprintf(spec, sizeof spec, "%s", getenv("NGB_HANG_MEM"));
            for (tok = strtok_r(spec, ",", &save); tok; tok = strtok_r(NULL, ",", &save)) {
                uint32_t va = (uint32_t)strtoul(tok, NULL, 16), n = 64;
                char *c = strchr(tok, ':');
                if (c) n = (uint32_t)strtoul(c + 1, NULL, 16);
                for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n && len < (int)sizeof out - 256; i += 32) {
                    len += snprintf(out + len, sizeof out - len, "[MEM] %08X:", va + i);
                    for (uint32_t j = i; j < i + 32 && j < n; j += 4)
                        len += snprintf(out + len, sizeof out - len, " %08X",
                                        *(uint32_t *)((uint8_t *)g_xbox_mem_offset + va + j));
                    len += snprintf(out + len, sizeof out - len, "\n");
                }
            }
        }
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "[HANG] sample %d\n", round + 1);
    fputs(out, stderr);
    fflush(stderr);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* NGB_MEM_TRACE=va:bytes[,...] (hex, debugging, Windows): those guest words every 50 ms for 20 s,
 * logged when they change -- what a game's state machine went through, against another run. */
static DWORD WINAPI mem_trace_thread(LPVOID arg)
{
    static uint32_t last[1024];
    char spec[512], *tok, *save = NULL;
    ULONGLONG t0 = GetTickCount64();
    (void)arg;
    while (GetTickCount64() - t0 < 20000) {
        int k = 0;
        Sleep(50);
        if (!g_xbox_mem_offset)
            continue;
        snprintf(spec, sizeof spec, "%s", getenv("NGB_MEM_TRACE"));
        for (tok = strtok_r(spec, ",", &save); tok; tok = strtok_r(NULL, ",", &save)) {
            uint32_t va = (uint32_t)strtoul(tok, NULL, 16), n = 64;
            char *c = strchr(tok, ':');
            if (c) n = (uint32_t)strtoul(c + 1, NULL, 16);
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n && k < 1024; i += 4, k++) {
                uint32_t v = *(uint32_t *)((uint8_t *)g_xbox_mem_offset + va + i);
                if (v != last[k]) {
                    fprintf(stderr, "[MEMT] %llu %08X: %08X -> %08X\n",
                            (unsigned long long)(GetTickCount64() - t0), va + i, last[k], v);
                    last[k] = v;
                }
            }
        }
        fflush(stderr);
    }
    return 0;
}
#endif

/* Portable mode (issue #4): a file named portable.txt beside the program -- beside the AppImage on
 * Linux -- keeps everything in a "userdata" folder there instead of the user's profile: the installed
 * game and the console's drive (about 11 GB), saves, settings, the shader cache and the log. Each
 * location set explicitly (NGB_SAVE_DIR and the rest) still wins. */
static void portable_init(void)
{
    char dir[4096], flag[4200], data[4200];
    FILE *f;

    if (!ngb_portable_base(dir, sizeof dir))
        return;
    snprintf(flag, sizeof flag, "%s/portable.txt", dir);
    if (!(f = fopen(flag, "r")))
        return;
    fclose(f);
    snprintf(data, sizeof data, "%s/userdata", dir);
    ngb_mkdir(data);
    setenv("NGB_PORTABLE", "1", 1);   /* the setup does not offer it again (src/install.c) */
    if (!getenv("NGB_SAVE_DIR"))
        setenv("NGB_SAVE_DIR", data, 1);
    if (!getenv("NGB_CONFIG_DIR"))
        setenv("NGB_CONFIG_DIR", data, 1);
    if (!getenv("NV2A_SHADER_CACHE")) {
        snprintf(flag, sizeof flag, "%s/shaders", data);
        setenv("NV2A_SHADER_CACHE", flag, 1);
    }
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    portable_init();   /* before anything picks a folder (the log's, first) */
#ifdef __APPLE__
    if (!getenv("NGB_TEST_HIDDEN") && !isatty(STDOUT_FILENO)) {
        char log[4200];
        save_dir_path(log, sizeof log - 16);
        ngb_mkdir(log);
        strcat(log, "/log.txt");
        if (freopen(log, "w", stdout)) {
            dup2(fileno(stdout), STDERR_FILENO);
            setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IOLBF, 0);
        }
    }
#endif
#if defined(_WIN32)
    /* Sleeps and waits to the millisecond, not the 15.6 ms default tick: the
     * virtual CPU's time slices, the kernel's timers and the frame pacing
     * all sleep briefly. */
    timeBeginPeriod(1);
    /* A GUI program, so no console window opens; started from one, its
     * output goes there, else to log.txt in the save folder. */
    if (AttachConsole(ATTACH_PARENT_PROCESS)) {
        freopen("CONOUT$", "w", stdout);
        freopen("CONOUT$", "w", stderr);
    } else {
        char log[4096];
        save_dir_path(log, sizeof log - 8);
        ngb_mkdir(log);
        strcat(log, "/log.txt");
        FILE *f = fopen(log, "w");      /* emptied, then both append */
        if (f) {
            fclose(f);
            freopen(log, "a", stdout);
            freopen(log, "a", stderr);
        }
    }
    if (getenv("NGB_MEM_TRACE"))
        CloseHandle(CreateThread(NULL, 0, mem_trace_thread, NULL, 0, NULL));
    if (getenv("NGB_HANG_DUMP"))
        CloseHandle(CreateThread(NULL, 0, hang_dump_thread,
                                 (LPVOID)(uintptr_t)atoi(getenv("NGB_HANG_DUMP")), 0, NULL));
#else
    /* NGB_PTRACE_ANY=1: let any process of this user attach a debugger
     * (Yama's ptrace_scope 1 allows only ancestors), for stack dumps. */
#ifdef __linux__
    if (getenv("NGB_PTRACE_ANY"))
        prctl(PR_SET_PTRACER, PR_SET_PTRACER_ANY, 0, 0, 0);
#endif
#endif
    /* --settings: show the settings screen before the game (the settings
     * are in the game's own menus; there is no screen otherwise). */
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++)
        if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--settings")) {
            s_show_settings = 1;
            memmove(&argv[i], &argv[i + 1], (size_t)(argc - i) * sizeof *argv);
            argc--;
            i--;
        }
#if defined(NGB_NV2A_VK)
    {
        extern void ngb_set_argv(char **argv);   /* src/ingame_menu.c: Return to Main Menu */
        ngb_set_argv(argv);
    }
#endif

    setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IONBF, 0);
    setvbuf(stderr, NULL, _IONBF, 0);
    choose_renderer();
    bringup_defaults();

    {
        /* A game folder, or a disc image/archive installed on first use. */
        char base[4096], save[4096];
        exe_dir(base, sizeof(base));
        save_dir_path(save, sizeof(save));
        if (ngb_find_game(argc > 1 ? argv[1] : NULL, save, base,
                          s_game_dir, sizeof(s_game_dir)) != 0)
            return 1;
    }

    printf("=== Ninja Gaiden Black - Static Recompilation ===\n");
    printf("Game directory: %s\n", s_game_dir);

#if defined(_WIN32)
    SymSetOptions(SYMOPT_DEFERRED_LOADS | SYMOPT_UNDNAME);
    SymInitialize(GetCurrentProcess(), NULL, TRUE);
#endif
    AddVectoredExceptionHandler(1, veh_handler);
#if !defined(_WIN32)
    {
        struct sigaction sa;
        memset(&sa, 0, sizeof(sa));
        sa.sa_sigaction = sample_on_signal;
        sa.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO | SA_RESTART;
        sigaction(SIGUSR1, &sa, NULL);
    }
#endif
#if !defined(_WIN32)
    if (getenv("NGB_PROFILE")) {
        prof_start();
        signal(SIGINT, prof_exit_on_signal);
        signal(SIGTERM, prof_exit_on_signal);
    }
#endif
#if defined(RECOMP_ICALL_FEEDBACK)
    RECOMP_ICALL_FEEDBACK_INIT();     /* atexit dump to icall_targets.dump */
    signal(SIGINT, feedback_on_signal);
    signal(SIGTERM, feedback_on_signal);
#endif

#if defined(NGB_NV2A_VK)
    /* The settings screen, then the settings. Environment variables of the
     * same meaning still win, for testing. */
    NgbSettings cfg;
    ngb_settings_load(&cfg);
    if (s_use_gpu && !s_headless && s_show_settings &&
        !getenv("NGB_NO_SETTINGS")) {
        if (!ngb_launcher_run(&cfg))
            return 0;
    }
    {
        const char *e;
        if ((e = getenv("NGB_WIDESCREEN")))
            cfg.aspect = *e == '0' ? ASPECT_4_3 : ASPECT_16_9;
        if ((e = getenv("NGB_FULLSCREEN")))
            cfg.fullscreen = *e == '0' ? 0 : *e == '2' ? 2 : 1;
        if ((e = getenv("NGB_VSYNC")))
            cfg.vsync = *e == '2' ? 2 : *e != '0';
        if (!getenv("NV2A_SCALE") && cfg.scale > 1) {
            char v[8];
            snprintf(v, sizeof v, "%d", cfg.scale);
            setenv("NV2A_SCALE", v, 1);
        }
        if (!getenv("NV2A_TEX_REPLACE")) {
            /* Texture packs: <data>/textures/<id>.png replace the title's
             * textures (NV2A_TEX_DUMP=dir writes the ids it uses). */
            char dir[4096];
            save_dir_path(dir, sizeof dir - 16);
            strcat(dir, "/textures");
            setenv("NV2A_TEX_REPLACE", dir, 1);
        }
        if (!getenv("NV2A_SHADER_CACHE")) {
            /* Compiled shaders, so a new effect only stutters once. */
            const char *xdg = getenv("XDG_CACHE_HOME"), *home = ngb_home();
            char dir[4096];
#if defined(_WIN32)
            if ((!xdg || !*xdg) && getenv("LOCALAPPDATA"))   /* %LOCALAPPDATA%\NinjaGaidenBlack\shaders */
                xdg = getenv("LOCALAPPDATA");
#endif
            if (xdg && *xdg)
                snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s/NinjaGaidenBlack/shaders", xdg);
            else if (home && *home) {
#ifdef __APPLE__
                ngb_macos_dir(dir, sizeof dir - 32, "cache", 1);
                strcat(dir, "/NinjaGaidenBlack/shaders");
#else
                snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s/.cache/NinjaGaidenBlack/shaders", home);
#endif
            } else
                dir[0] = 0;
            if (dir[0])
                setenv("NV2A_SHADER_CACHE", dir, 1);
        }
        if (!getenv("NV2A_SHADER_SEED")) {
            /* Shipped beside the binary: <prefix>/bin/NinjaGaidenBlack and
             * <prefix>/share/NinjaGaidenBlack/shader-seed (on Windows the folder's
             * share/NinjaGaidenBlack, beside the .exe). */
            char exe[4096], seed[4200];
            if (ngb_exe_path(exe, sizeof exe) > 0) {
                char *slash = strrchr(exe, '/');
                if (slash) {
                    *slash = 0;
                    snprintf(seed, sizeof seed,
                             "%s/../share/NinjaGaidenBlack/shader-seed", exe);
                    if (access(seed, 4) != 0)
                        snprintf(seed, sizeof seed, "%s/share/NinjaGaidenBlack/shader-seed", exe);
                    if (access(seed, 4) == 0)
                        setenv("NV2A_SHADER_SEED", seed, 1);
                }
            }
        }
        if (!getenv("NV2A_SHADER_SEED_XBE")) {
            /* The seed's vertex programs come from the user's own copy. */
            char xbe[4200];
            snprintf(xbe, sizeof xbe, "%s/default.xbe", s_game_dir);
            setenv("NV2A_SHADER_SEED_XBE", xbe, 1);
        }
        ngb_menu_set_running(&cfg);
        if (!getenv("NV2A_SHADOW_SCALE")) {
            char v[8];
            snprintf(v, sizeof v, "%d", cfg.shadow_scale);
            setenv("NV2A_SHADOW_SCALE", v, 1);
        }
        if (!getenv("NV2A_TEX_FILTER")) {
            char v[8];
            snprintf(v, sizeof v, "%d", cfg.anisotropy);
            setenv("NV2A_TEX_FILTER", cfg.anisotropy ? v : "original", 1);
        }
        nv2a_set_quality(cfg.scale, cfg.anisotropy, cfg.shadow_scale, cfg.msaa);
        {
            extern void ngb_set_all_difficulties(int on);   /* src/cheats.c */
            extern void ngb_set_all_costumes(int on);
            ngb_set_all_difficulties(cfg.all_difficulties);
            ngb_set_all_costumes(cfg.all_costumes);
        }
        if (cfg.show_fps && !getenv("NV2A_SHOW_FPS"))
            setenv("NV2A_SHOW_FPS", "1", 1);
        /* The boot "Warnings" screen is always skipped (its scrolling text drew badly, and it says only
         * what the box does); the boot movie with Skip intro. */
        if (cfg.skip_intro)
            ngb_skip_intro = 1;
        if (!getenv("NGB_KEEP_WARNINGS")) {
            if (!s_headless) {
                pthread_t th;
                nv2a_present_set_blank(true);
                if (pthread_create(&th, NULL, warning_unblank_thread, NULL) == 0)
                    pthread_detach(th);
            }
            xbox_FileReadHook = movie_read_hook;
        } else if (cfg.skip_intro) {
            xbox_FileReadHook = movie_read_hook;
        }
    }
    /* Widescreen (16:9 and 16:10 alike: the game's anamorphic mode, shown
     * at the chosen shape) unless 4:3. */
    s_widescreen = cfg.aspect != ASPECT_4_3;
#else
    {
        const char *ws = getenv("NGB_WIDESCREEN");
        s_widescreen = !(ws && *ws == '0');
    }
#endif
    if (s_widescreen)
        xbox_XcVideoFlags |= XC_VIDEO_FLAGS_WIDESCREEN;
#if defined(NGB_NV2A_VK)
    if (s_widescreen) {   /* the 3D's shape: the game is kept in its 4:3 mode on a wide screen (src/pc_menu.c) */
        extern void ngb_game_set_aspect_constant(double a);
        extern void ngb_game_aspect_init(int widescreen);
        ngb_game_set_aspect_constant(ngb_settings_aspect_ratio(&cfg));
        ngb_game_aspect_init(1);   /* widescreen for the boot movie, 4:3 from the title (src/pc_menu.c) */
    }
#endif
#if defined(NGB_NV2A_VK)
    if (s_use_gpu && !s_headless &&
        nv2a_window_create("Ninja Gaiden Black", cfg.width, cfg.height,
                           cfg.fullscreen, ngb_settings_aspect_ratio(&cfg),
                           cfg.vsync) != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Cannot open the game window.\n");
        return 1;
    }
    /* Controllers and keyboard, on the thread that pumps the window's
     * events (hotplug arrives there too). */
    if (s_use_gpu && !s_headless)
        xbox_InputInit();
#endif

#if defined(_WIN32)
    CloseHandle(CreateThread(NULL, 64u << 20,
                             (LPTHREAD_START_ROUTINE)guest_main, NULL, 0, NULL));
#else
    {
        /* Lifted code nests a host call per guest call; give it room. */
        pthread_attr_t attr;
        pthread_t th;
        pthread_attr_init(&attr);
        pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attr, 64u << 20);
        if (pthread_create(&th, &attr, guest_main, NULL) != 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Cannot start the guest thread.\n");
            return 1;
        }
        pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
    }
#endif

#if defined(NGB_NV2A_VK)
    if (s_use_gpu && !s_headless) {
        while (nv2a_window_pump())
            usleep(2000);
        printf("Window closed.\n");
        _exit(0);
    }
#endif
    for (;;)
#if defined(_WIN32)
        Sleep(INFINITE);
#else
        pause();
#endif
}
```

`src/main_menu.c`:

```c
/*
 * main_menu.c -- the main menu without Ranking.
 *
 * Ranking's scoreboards were Xbox Live's, long gone, and choosing it
 * leaves the game for the dashboard's account setup (dashupdate.xbe), which
 * is not here: the program ends. Its entry in the main menu's list is
 * hidden and not selectable (the list's entries: 8 bytes, byte 4 enabled,
 * byte 5 shown), as the game hides the entries it does not offer. The menu's drawer (sub_0017A010) is the
 * lifted one renamed, behind a wrapper; its list is at ebx.
 *
 * Options > General Settings without Flag Select (the country Ranking
 * wanted): the menu engine's General page (page 1 of the Options menu)
 * loses that row, the rows after it move up, and the page's drawer
 * (sub_0021C660, lifted, changes marked "no flag") draws six rows, Default
 * Settings and Exit in the flag's place and after. NGB_KEEP_RANKING=1
 * keeps both.
 *
 * Ranking's place in the list is "RECOMP SETTINGS" instead: its text in
 * the menu's text table (0x436184: id, English, Japanese) is ours, and
 * choosing it (the main menu's A handler, sub_0017B010, with the cursor at
 * 0x94 in the menu object) opens the Options menu as OPTIONS does (its id,
 * 7, at 0x90) but on the recomp's settings (src/pc_menu.c, RECOMP
 * SETTINGS), instead of Ranking's flag question and the dashboard's
 * account setup.
 *
 * The last entry is EXIT TO DESKTOP, behind an Are you sure? box
 * (src/pause_tab.c): OPTIONS moves up into COMING ATTRACTIONS' place (Xbox
 * Live's trailers, gone; it is never shown) -- its text there, and its
 * choice made as OPTIONS' (id 7) -- and OPTIONS' place has the new words.
 */
#define RECOMP_GENERATED_CODE
#include "recomp_funcs.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "xbox_memory_layout.h"

/* A debugging option from the environment, read once (these are asked per sprite or per frame). */
#define ENV_ONCE(name) (__extension__({ static const char *v_ = (const char *)1; \
    if (v_ == (const char *)1) v_ = getenv(name); v_; }))


static void items_draw(void);
static int s_back_to = -1;   /* the entry to return to from the Options menu (OPTIONS, RECOMP SETTINGS) */
static int s_no_flag;

/* Before the game starts (after src/pc_menu.c has its page table). */
void ngb_recomp_menu_enter(void);   /* src/pc_menu.c */
void ngb_recomp_menu_tick(void);

void ngb_general_page_init(void)
{
    if (getenv("NGB_KEEP_RANKING"))
        return;
    {   /* COMING ATTRACTIONS' text (0x4361AC: id 0x9000C) OPTIONS', OPTIONS' ours */
        static const char t[] = "EXIT TO DESKTOP";
        uint32_t va = xbox_HeapAlloc(sizeof t, 4);
        MEM32(0x4361B0) = MEM32(0x4361BC);
        MEM32(0x4361B4) = MEM32(0x4361C0);
        if (va) {
            memcpy((void *)XBOX_PTR(va), t, sizeof t);
            MEM32(0x4361BC) = va;
            MEM32(0x4361C0) = va;
        }
    }
    {   /* Ranking's text: "RECOMP SETTINGS" (English and Japanese) */
        static const char t[] = "RECOMP SETTINGS";
        uint32_t va = xbox_HeapAlloc(sizeof t, 4);
        if (va) {
            memcpy((void *)XBOX_PTR(va), t, sizeof t);
            MEM32(0x43618C) = va;
            MEM32(0x436190) = va;
        }
    }
    uint32_t pages = MEM32(0x42A28C);
    for (uint32_t p = pages; MEM8(p) != 0xFF; p += 0x18) {
        if (MEM8(p) != 1 || MEM8(p + 2) != 6)
            continue;
        uint32_t src = MEM32(p + 0xC), dst = xbox_HeapAlloc(0x1C * 8, 4);
        int n = 0;
        for (int i = 0; MEM8(src + 0x1C * i) != 0xFF; i++) {
            if (i == 4)
                continue;                              /* Flag Select */
            memcpy((void *)XBOX_PTR(dst + 0x1C * n), (void *)XBOX_PTR(src + 0x1C * i), 0x1C);
            MEM8(dst + 0x1C * n) = (uint8_t)n;
            n++;
        }
        memset((void *)XBOX_PTR(dst + 0x1C * n), 0, 0x1C);
        MEM8(dst + 0x1C * n) = 0xFF;
        MEM32(p + 0xC) = dst;
        MEM8(p + 2) = 5;
        s_no_flag = 1;
    }
}

int ngb_general_no_flag(void) { return s_no_flag; }

void sub_0017A010(void)
{
    uint32_t list = MEM32(ebx), n = MEM32(ebx + 4);
    if (n == 8) {
        extern void ngb_main_menu_seen(void);          /* src/ingame_menu.c */
        ngb_recomp_menu_tick();                        /* back from RECOMP SETTINGS */
        ngb_main_menu_seen();                          /* (after Return to Main Menu) */
    }
    if (ENV_ONCE("NGB_MENU_LOG") && n < 32) {
        static unsigned k;
        if (k++ % 300 == 0) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[MAINMENU] list %08X n %u:", list, n);
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++)
                fprintf(stderr, " [%08X %02X %02X %02X %02X]", MEM32(list + 8 * i), MEM8(list + 8 * i + 4),
                        MEM8(list + 8 * i + 5), MEM8(list + 8 * i + 6), MEM8(list + 8 * i + 7));
            fprintf(stderr, "\n");
        }
    }
    /* The main menu's list (NEW GAME, LOAD GAME, MISSIONS, RANKING, ...,
     * OPTIONS: eight): Ranking not shown. */
    if (n == 8 && ENV_ONCE("NGB_MENU_LOG")) {             /* the cursor (menu + 0x94), as it moves */
        static uint32_t last = ~0u;
        if (MEM32(ebx + 0x54) != last)
            fprintf(stderr, "[MAINMENU] cursor %u\n", last = MEM32(ebx + 0x54));
    }
    /* Back from the Options menu the game puts the cursor where OPTIONS was,
     * the last entry -- now EXIT TO DESKTOP: back on the entry chosen. */
    if (n == 8 && s_back_to >= 0 && MEM32(ebx + 0x54) == 7 && !ENV_ONCE("NGB_KEEP_RANKING")) {
        MEM32(ebx + 0x50) = (uint32_t)s_back_to;    /* where the highlight is drawn */
        MEM32(ebx + 0x54) = (uint32_t)s_back_to;
        if (MEM32(esp + 4) == 7)                    /* this frame's too: its caller passed the cursor */
            MEM32(esp + 4) = (uint32_t)s_back_to;
        s_back_to = -1;
    }
    if (n == 8 && ENV_ONCE("NGB_MENU_FORCE"))            /* a test: all unlocked */
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 8; i++)
            MEM8(list + 8 * i + 4) = MEM8(list + 8 * i + 5) = 1;
    if (n == 8 && !ENV_ONCE("NGB_KEEP_RANKING")) {
        MEM8(list + 8 * 3 + 4) = MEM8(list + 8 * 3 + 5) = 1;   /* "RECOMP SETTINGS": shown and chosen */
        MEM8(list + 8 * 6 + 4) = MEM8(list + 8 * 6 + 5) = 1;   /* OPTIONS, in COMING ATTRACTIONS' place */
        extern int ngb_main_menu_exit_tick(void);              /* src/pause_tab.c */
        if (ngb_main_menu_exit_tick()) {                       /* the Are you sure? box: */
            esp += 4;                                          /* alone, the entries not drawn */
            return;
        }
    }
    /* The difficulty selection (list 0xC074B8, sub_00178B50's) with Ninja Dog
     * too (src/cheats.c's All Difficulties): five rows, a case the game never
     * shows there. Its rows are centred on one line, spaced by the count
     * (0x45A9BA: 48 for four, 44 for five), and five at 44 reach up under
     * the header: spaced 38, they take the four's height. */
    uint32_t shown = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n && i < 32; i++)
        shown += MEM8(list + 8 * i + 5) != 0;
    if (ENV_ONCE("NGB_LIST_LOG")) {
        static uint32_t lb, ln, ls;
        if (ebx != lb || n != ln || shown != ls)
            fprintf(stderr, "[LIST] %08X n %u shown %u\n", lb = ebx, ln = n, ls = shown);
    }
    /* Kept 38 while that list is up, not only around its drawing: the highlight bar (sub_0017A620) places
     * itself by the same table, read in sub_0017A400, and slipped a row low by Very Hard (#42, found by
     * akirahayabusa). The game's value comes back once another list is drawn. */
    static int s_five;
    static uint16_t s_five_was;
    if (ebx == 0xC074E0 && shown == 5) {
        if (!s_five) {
            s_five_was = MEM16(0x45A9BA + 2 * 5);
            s_five = 1;
        }
        MEM16(0x45A9BA + 2 * 5) = 38;
        items_draw();
        return;
    }
    if (s_five) {
        MEM16(0x45A9BA + 2 * 5) = s_five_was;
        s_five = 0;
    }
    items_draw();
}

 * sub_0017A010

void sub_001E3400(void);
static void main_menu_select(void);

/* The main menu's choice: "RECOMP SETTINGS" (Ranking's place) opens the
 * Options menu on the recomp's settings. */
#define OPTIONS_ID 7
void sub_0017B010(void)
{
    if (getenv("NGB_MENU_LOG"))
        fprintf(stderr, "[MAINMENU] chosen: entry %u id %u\n", MEM32(esi + 0x94), MEM32(esi + 0x90));
    if (esi == 0xC075C0 && MEM32(esi + 0x94) == 3 && !getenv("NGB_KEEP_RANKING")) {
        s_back_to = 3;
        ngb_recomp_menu_enter();
        MEM32(esi + 0x90) = OPTIONS_ID;
    }
    if (esi == 0xC075C0 && MEM32(esi + 0x94) == 6 && !getenv("NGB_KEEP_RANKING")) {
        s_back_to = 6;
        MEM32(esi + 0x90) = OPTIONS_ID;                 /* OPTIONS, moved up */
    }
    if (esi == 0xC075C0 && MEM32(esi + 0x94) == 7 && !getenv("NGB_KEEP_RANKING")) {
        extern void ngb_main_menu_exit(void);           /* EXIT TO DESKTOP: Are you sure? */
        uint32_t sp = esp;
        PUSH32(esp, 0x40);                              /* the menu's "chosen" sound */
        PUSH32(esp, 6);
        PUSH32(esp, 0);
        sub_001E3400();
        esp = sp;
        ngb_main_menu_exit();
        esp += 4;   /* ret */
        return;
    }
    /* The bar slides from the chosen id (+0x90) while the choice flashes, and the Options menu's id, 7,
     * is EXIT TO DESKTOP's row now: once the game has read it, the row chosen again, or the highlight
     * flashed on EXIT TO DESKTOP (issue #27, found by akirahayabusa). Only this function reads +0x90. */
    int moved = esi == 0xC075C0 && MEM32(esi + 0x90) == OPTIONS_ID && MEM32(esi + 0x94) != OPTIONS_ID &&
                s_back_to >= 0;
    main_menu_select();
    if (moved && MEM32(0xC07650) == OPTIONS_ID)
        MEM32(0xC07650) = (uint32_t)s_back_to;
}

    edx = 0; /* xor self */
    _fa = (uint32_t)(edx) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); /* xor result */
    edi = edi;

loc_0017B0E0: ;
    ecx = MEM32(esp + edx * 4 + 0x10);

    if (CMP_NE(_fa, _fb)) goto loc_0017B0F1; /* jne: not equal / not zero */

loc_0017B0ED: ;
    MEM32(esp + 0xC) = MEM32(esp + 0xC) + 1;
    _fa = (uint32_t)(MEM32(esp + 0xC)) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fb = (_fa == 0x80000000u); /* inc result/SF/OF; CF unchanged */

loc_0017B0F1: ;

    _fa = (uint32_t)(edx) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fb = (_fa == 0x80000000u); /* inc result/SF/OF; CF unchanged */
    _fa = (uint32_t)(edx) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(5) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* cmp edx, 5 (32-bit) */
    if (CMP_B(_fa, _fb)) goto loc_0017B0E0; /* jb: below (unsigned <) */

loc_0017B0F7: ;
    _fa = (uint32_t)(MEM32(esp + 0xC)) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(ebp) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* cmp MEM32(esp + 0xC), ebp (32-bit) */
    if (CMP_NE(_fa, _fb)) goto loc_0017B13C; /* jne: not equal / not zero */

loc_0017B0FD: ;
    ebp = 0; /* xor self */
    _fa = (uint32_t)(ebp) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); /* xor result */
    edx = 0; /* xor self */
    _fa = (uint32_t)(edx) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); /* xor result */

loc_0017B101: ;
    ecx = MEM32(esp + edx * 4 + 0x24);
    PUSH32(esp, 0x0017B10Au); RECOMP_ABI_CALL(0x001DB520u, sub_001DB520); /* call 0x001DB520 */

loc_0017B10A: ;

loc_0017B10F: ;

    _fa = (uint32_t)(edx) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;

    _fa = (uint32_t)(edx) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(5) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* cmp edx, 5 (32-bit) */
    if (CMP_B(_fa, _fb)) goto loc_0017B101; /* jb: below (unsigned <) */

loc_0017B116: ;
    _fa = (uint32_t)(ebp) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(1) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* cmp ebp, 1 (32-bit) */
    if (CMP_NE(_fa, _fb)) goto loc_0017B13C; /* jne: not equal / not zero */

    PUSH32(esp, 0xFFFFFFFEu);

    MEM32(0xC0D034) = ebx;
    MEMF(0xC0D038) = xmm0.f[0]; /* movss */

loc_0017B139: ;
    _fb = (uint32_t)(0xC) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* add source, before the write */
    esp = esp + 0xC;
    _fa = (uint32_t)(esp) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); /* add result */

    MEM8(0x452904) = LO8(ebx);
    MEM8(0x452905) = 0xFF;

    _fa = (uint32_t)(eax) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(edi) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;

    _fa = (uint32_t)(eax) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); /* xor result */

    MEM32(esi + 0xBC) = eax;
    MEM32(esi + 0xC0) = 0x14;

loc_0017B1DD: ;
    ebx = 0; /* xor self */
    _fa = (uint32_t)(ebx) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); /* xor result */

loc_0017B1DF: ;
    eax = MEM32(esi + 0xD0);
    _fa = (uint32_t)(eax) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(ebx) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* cmp eax, ebx (32-bit) */
    if (CMP_NE(_fa, _fb)) goto loc_0017B1F3; /* jne: not equal / not zero */

loc_0017B1E9: ;
    xmm0 = XMM_SCALAR(MEMF(esi + 0xC8)); /* movss */
    goto loc_0017B225;

loc_0017B1F3: ;
    ecx = MEM32(esi + 0xC8);
    edx = MEM32(esi + 0xC4);
    xmm0.f[0] = (float)(int32_t)MEM32(esi + 0xCC); /* cvtsi2ss */
    PUSH32(esp, ecx);
    PUSH32(esp, edx);
    xmm1.f[0] = (float)(int32_t)eax; /* cvtsi2ss */

    PUSH32(esp, ecx);
    xmm0.f[0] = xmm0.f[0] / xmm1.f[0]; /* divss */
    MEMF(esp) = xmm0.f[0]; /* movss */
    PUSH32(esp, 0x0017B222u); RECOMP_ABI_CALL(0x00303C50u, sub_00303C50); /* call 0x00303C50 */

loc_0017B222: ;
    _fb = (uint32_t)(0xC) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* add source, before the write */
    esp = esp + 0xC;
    _fa = (uint32_t)(esp) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); /* add result */

loc_0017B225: ;
    POP32(esp, edi);
    MEMF(esi + 0xC4) = xmm0.f[0]; /* movss */
    xmm0 = XMM_ZERO(); /* xorps self = zero */
    POP32(esp, ebp);
    MEM32(esi + 0xCC) = ebx;
    MEM32(esi + 0xD4) = ebx;
    MEMF(esi + 0xC8) = xmm0.f[0]; /* movss */
    MEM32(esi + 0xD0) = 0x14;
    POP32(esp, ebx);
    _fb = (uint32_t)(0x2C) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* add source, before the write */
    esp = esp + 0x2C;
    _fa = (uint32_t)(esp) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); /* add result */
    esp += 4; return; /* ret */

}
```

`src/menu_font.c`:

```c
/*
 * menu_font.c -- which textures hold the menus' letters, for the mouse (src/menu_mouse.c finds the
 * menus' words by the sprites they are written with).
 *
 * The menus write with one font (sub_001E86A0): each character is a sprite -- for the font at
 * 0x4529FC, the glyph number the table at 0x430C48 gives a byte -- cut from a couple of textures of
 * white letters, the ones H, a and 0 come from.
 */
#define RECOMP_GENERATED_CODE
#include "recomp_funcs.h"

#define GLYPH_MAP 0x430C48        /* byte -> glyph (= sprite) number */
#define MAX_ATLAS 4

uint32_t ngb_sprite_def(uint32_t id);
uint32_t ngb_font_tex[MAX_ATLAS];   /* the font's textures */
int ngb_font_tex_n;

/* Each time the menus write (the font may be loaded again meanwhile). */
void ngb_menu_font_init(void)
{
    int n = 0;
    for (int q = 0; q < 3; q++) {
        uint32_t d = ngb_sprite_def(MEM32(GLYPH_MAP + 4 * (uint8_t)"Ha0"[q]));
        if (!d)
            continue;
        uint32_t t = MEM32(d + 0x10);
        int seen = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
            seen |= ngb_font_tex[j] == t;
        if (!seen && n < MAX_ATLAS)
            ngb_font_tex[n++] = t;
    }
    if (n)
        ngb_font_tex_n = n;
}

```

`src/menu_mouse.c`:

```c
/*
 * menu_mouse.c -- whether one of the game's menus is up.
 *
 * The menu engine's runner (sub_0017BB90: Options and the like), and the
 * text the menus write theirs with (sub_001E86A0: the main menu, the pause
 * menu, the game's message boxes; not drawn in play or cutscenes), each
 * mark the frame when they run. Both are the lifted functions (listed in
 * src/manual_functions.json) renamed, behind a wrapper. The host knows from
 * it that the game is in a menu: there mouse clicks and the wheel are the
 * pad's buttons (src/ingame_menu.c).
 */
#define RECOMP_GENERATED_CODE
#include "recomp_funcs.h"
#include <time.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "xbox_memory_layout.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

/* When a menu last ran, in ms of CLOCK_MONOTONIC. */
volatile uint64_t ngb_menu_ran_ms;

static void menu_runner(void);
static void menu_text(void);
static void text_draw(void);

/* A menu ran this frame (also from the pause menu's handler, which is not
 * always reached through the runner: src/pause_tab.c). */
void ngb_aspect_menu_running(void);   /* src/pc_menu.c: the game's widescreen mode for it */
void ngb_menu_mark(void)
{
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    ngb_menu_ran_ms = (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000 + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec / 1000000;
}

static uint64_t now_ms(void);
static volatile uint64_t s_engine_ms;

void sub_0017BB90(void)
{
    /* a menu of the engine runs (not text alone: sub_001E86A0 also draws play's prompts -- "Interact",
     * the karma -- which marked a menu for a frame and drew the HUD in the menus' 16:9 mode) */
    if (getenv("NGB_MENU_MODE_LOG"))
        fprintf(stderr, "[MENUMODE] engine\n");
    ngb_aspect_menu_running();
    ngb_menu_mark();
    s_engine_ms = now_ms();
    menu_runner();
}

/* The open page's rows: the first and how many (0 when no menu engine). */
int ngb_engine_rows(int *first)
{
    if (now_ms() - s_engine_ms > 150)
        return 0;
    int32_t depth = (int32_t)MEM32(0xDA41C0);
    if (depth < 0 || depth > 3)
        return 0;
    uint32_t st = 0xDA41D0 + (uint32_t)depth * 0x30, page = MEM32(st + 0x28);
    if (page < 0x10000 || page >= 0x4000000)
        return 0;
    int lo = MEM8(page + 1), hi = MEM8(page + 2);
    if (hi == 0xFF)
        hi = MEM8(0xDA41CC);
    *first = lo;
    return hi >= lo ? hi - lo + 1 : 0;
}

int ngb_engine_row(void)
{
    if (now_ms() - s_engine_ms > 150)
        return -1;
    int32_t depth = (int32_t)MEM32(0xDA41C0);
    if (depth < 0 || depth > 3)
        return -1;
    uint32_t st = 0xDA41D0 + (uint32_t)depth * 0x30;
    return MEM8(st + 1);
}

void ngb_menu_font_init(void);   /* src/menu_font.c */

void sub_001E86A0(void)
{
    ngb_menu_mark();
    ngb_menu_font_init();
    menu_text();
}


/* ---------- what the menus write, for the mouse ---------- */

/* Each piece of text drawn: where (its box in the 720x480, measured as
 * the game measures it), how bright (the chosen item is drawn brighter),
 * and which code drew it (the items of one list share it). Kept for the
 * last few frames; src/ingame_menu.c finds the item under the mouse. */
#include "menu_mouse.h"

static NgbTextItem s_items[MOUSE_ITEMS];
static volatile unsigned s_item_n;
static uint32_t s_scratch;        /* guest: a struct and a rect to measure with */

static uint64_t now_ms(void)
{
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000 + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec / 1000000;
}

static int text_log(void)
{
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0)
        on = getenv("NGB_TEXT_LOG") != NULL;
    return on;
}

static void record_text(uint32_t st, uint32_t caller)
{
    uint32_t str = MEM32(st + 0x10);
    if (!str || MEM32(st + 0x38) >= 3) {
        if (text_log())
            fprintf(stderr, "[TEXTLOG] %08X skipped: str %08X f%u\n", caller, str, MEM32(st + 0x38));
        return;
    }
    if (!s_scratch && !(s_scratch = xbox_HeapAlloc(0x80, 16)))
        return;
    /* Measure on a copy: the measurer writes to its struct. */
    memcpy((void *)XBOX_PTR(s_scratch), (void *)XBOX_PTR(st), 0x60);
    uint32_t sv_eax = eax, sv_ecx = ecx, sv_edx = edx, sv_ebx = ebx, sv_esi = esi,
             sv_edi = edi, sv_esp = esp, sv_ebp = g_ebp, sv_seh = g_seh_ebp;
    PUSH32(esp, s_scratch);
    PUSH32(esp, s_scratch + 0x60);
    PUSH32(esp, 0);
    menu_text();
    float rx = MEMF(s_scratch + 0x60), ry = MEMF(s_scratch + 0x64);
    float rw = MEMF(s_scratch + 0x68), rh = MEMF(s_scratch + 0x6C);
    eax = sv_eax; ecx = sv_ecx; edx = sv_edx; ebx = sv_ebx; esi = sv_esi; edi = sv_edi;
    esp = sv_esp; g_ebp = sv_ebp; g_seh_ebp = sv_seh;
    if (!(rw > 0 && rh > 0) || rw > 720 || rh > 200) {
        if (text_log())
        {
            fprintf(stderr, "[TEXTLOG] %08X not measured: %.0f %.0f %.0f %.0f f%u s3c %04X %04X %04X %04X '",
                    caller, rx, ry, rw, rh, MEM32(st + 0x38), MEM16(st + 0x3C), MEM16(st + 0x3E),
                    MEM16(st + 0x40), MEM16(st + 0x42));
            for (int k = 0; k < 120 && MEM8(str + k); k++) {
                uint8_t c = MEM8(str + k);
                if (c >= 32 && c < 127) fputc(c, stderr); else fprintf(stderr, "<%02X>", c);
            }
            fprintf(stderr, "'\n");
        }
        return;
    }
    uint8_t al = MEM8(st + 0x4A);
    float x0 = rx - ((al & 0xF) == 1 ? rw / 2 : (al & 0xF) == 2 ? rw : 0);
    float y0 = ry - ((al >> 4) == 1 ? rh / 2 : (al >> 4) == 2 ? rh : 0);
    unsigned i = __atomic_fetch_add(&s_item_n, 1, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL);
    NgbTextItem *it = &s_items[i % MOUSE_ITEMS];
    it->ms = now_ms();
    it->x0 = x0; it->y0 = y0; it->x1 = x0 + rw; it->y1 = y0 + rh;
    it->bright = MEMF(st + 0x14);                    /* the chosen one: 1, the rest dim */
    it->caller = caller;
    it->str = str;
    it->kind = 0;
    it->seq = i;
    if (text_log() && i % 600 < 24) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[TEXTLOG] %08X %.0f,%.0f-%.0f,%.0f b %.2f col %.2f %.2f %.2f %.2f '",
                caller, x0, y0, x0 + rw, y0 + rh, it->bright,
                MEMF(st + 0x14), MEMF(st + 0x18), MEMF(st + 0x1C), MEMF(st + 0x20));
        for (int k = 0; k < 30 && MEM8(str + k); k++) {
            uint8_t c = MEM8(str + k);
            fputc(c >= 32 && c < 127 ? c : '.', stderr);
        }
        fprintf(stderr, "'\n");
    }
}

/* Something else to point at: the pause menu's tabs (src/pause_tab.c). */
void ngb_menu_add_item(float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, float bright,
                       uint32_t group, uint32_t id, int kind)
{
    unsigned i = __atomic_fetch_add(&s_item_n, 1, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL);
    NgbTextItem *it = &s_items[i % MOUSE_ITEMS];
    it->ms = now_ms();
    it->x0 = x0; it->y0 = y0; it->x1 = x1; it->y1 = y1;
    it->bright = bright;
    it->caller = group;
    it->str = id;
    it->kind = kind;
    it->seq = i;
}

/* The letters of the menus, as the sprites they are drawn with (from the
 * sprite queue, src/pause_tab.c): joined into runs -- the letters of a line,
 * one after another at the same height -- each run an item, those at the
 * same depth and size one list. Whatever code wrote them. Game thread. */
static struct {
    float x0, y0, x1, y1, bright;
    uint32_t z;
    int n;
} s_run;

static void run_flush(void)
{
    if (s_run.n >= 2) {
        uint32_t h = (uint32_t)lroundf(s_run.y1 - s_run.y0);
        ngb_menu_add_item(s_run.x0, s_run.y0, s_run.x1, s_run.y1, s_run.bright,
                          0x6C000000u | (s_run.z & 0xFFFF) << 8 | (h & 0xFF),
                          (uint32_t)lroundf(s_run.y0) << 16 | (uint32_t)lroundf(s_run.x0 / 8) , 0);
    }
    s_run.n = 0;
}

void ngb_menu_glyph(float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, float bright, uint32_t z)
{
    float h = y1 - y0;
    if (!(h > 0) || h > 120 || x1 <= x0)
        return;
    if (s_run.n && z == s_run.z && fabsf(y0 - s_run.y0) < 2 && fabsf(h - (s_run.y1 - s_run.y0)) < 2 &&
        x0 >= s_run.x0 && x0 <= s_run.x1 + h * 0.9f) {
        if (x1 > s_run.x1) s_run.x1 = x1;
        if (bright > s_run.bright) s_run.bright = bright;
        s_run.n++;
        return;
    }
    run_flush();
    s_run.x0 = x0; s_run.y0 = y0; s_run.x1 = x1; s_run.y1 = y1;
    s_run.bright = bright;
    s_run.z = z;
    s_run.n = 1;
}

/* The items drawn in the newest frame (those within 20 ms of the newest);
 * returns how many were copied. Any thread. */
int ngb_menu_items(NgbTextItem *out, int max)
{
    unsigned n = __atomic_load_n(&s_item_n, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (!n)
        return 0;
    uint64_t newest = s_items[(n - 1) % MOUSE_ITEMS].ms;
    if (now_ms() - newest > 150)
        return 0;
    int k = 0;
    for (unsigned j = 0; j < MOUSE_ITEMS && j < n && k < max; j++) {
        NgbTextItem it = s_items[(n - 1 - j) % MOUSE_ITEMS];
        if (newest - it.ms > 20)                     /* a frame's worth */
            break;
        out[k++] = it;
    }
    return k;
}

void sub_001E6D30(void)
{
    record_text(MEM32(esp + 4), MEM32(esp));
    text_draw();
}

/* A game menu up: one ran in the last 150 ms. */
int ngb_menu_up(void)
{
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    uint64_t now = (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000 + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec / 1000000;
    return now - ngb_menu_ran_ms < 150;
}

/**
```

```h
    uint64_t ms;                  /* when (CLOCK_MONOTONIC ms) */

                                   * picture (a list only by the menu engine's row),
                                   * 3 a button prompt (str: the button) */
    unsigned seq;                 /* drawing order */
} NgbTextItem;

                       uint32_t group, uint32_t id, int kind);
```

```c
/*
 * movie_skip.c -- "Skip intro movie": sub_00344BE0 by hand.
 *
 * sub_00344BE0 is CRI Sofdec's mwPlyGetStat, which the title polls every
 * frame while a movie plays (sub_0031DA50); 3 (PLAYEND) makes it run its
 * own end-of-movie path, which also stops the narration (movie/ninja.aix)
 * and the subtitles. The body is the lifted one, kept here (listed in
 * src/manual_functions.json so the pipeline does not generate it), with one
 * change: while a movie the player chose to skip is playing, "playing"
 * reads as "ended".
 *
 * Skipped with Skip Intros: the boot movie (2_VI_WIDE_B.sfd / 4_VI_STD_B.sfd).
 * Not the New Game prologue (ninja_gaiden.sfd): it is the story's start, and
 * Start, A or B ends it like any movie (#28). Which movie is playing
 * comes from the movie file the title last read (ngb_movie_read, from the
 * kernel's read hook): it opens every movie at boot to probe them, so the
 * last one opened says nothing.
 *
 * And any movie, by pressing Start, A or B (ngb_skip_button, src/keyboard.c)
 * -- once every button has been let go since it began, so neither the press
 * that started it nor one held through it ends it.
 */
#define RECOMP_GENERATED_CODE
#include "recomp_funcs.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <strings.h>

int ngb_skip_intro;
static volatile int s_skip_current;
static int s_released;   /* the buttons let go since this movie began */
int ngb_skip_button(void);

void ngb_movie_read(const char *host_path)
{
    const char *base = NULL, *dir = NULL;   /* the name and the folder it is in (either separator) */
    for (const char *c = host_path; *c; c++)
        if (*c == '/' || *c == '\\') {
            dir = base;
            base = c;
        }
    if (!base || !dir || strncasecmp(dir + 1, "movie", 5) || base - dir != 6 || !strstr(base, ".sfd"))
        return;
    base++;
    s_released = 0;
    s_skip_current = ngb_skip_intro &&
        (!strcasecmp(base, "2_VI_WIDE_B.sfd") || !strcasecmp(base, "4_VI_STD_B.sfd"));
}

static int ngb_movie_skip_now(void)
{
    if (s_skip_current)
        return 1;
    if (!ngb_skip_button())
        s_released = 1;
    else if (s_released)
        s_skip_current = 1;   /* (until the next movie is read) */
    return s_skip_current;
}
```

`src/pause_tab.c`:

```c
/*
 * pause_tab.c -- Settings, a seventh tab in the pause menu.
 *
 * The pause menu (Start in game) is menu 1 of the game's menu engine (see
 * src/pc_menu.c for the engine): page 0 is its row of tabs -- Weapon,
 * Ninpo, Item, Info, Map, Exit, rows 0-5 -- and choosing one opens that
 * tab's own page, whose rows the engine moves over and whose handler draws
 * it. The tab row itself is drawn by sub_0020CDA0 from two lists of sprite
 * ids (the plates and the glowing label of the chosen one) at x positions
 * from a table, sub_00182240 saying how many there are.
 *
 * Here the tab row gets a seventh tab, Settings, before Exit: a row like
 * Exit's but doing nothing when chosen (so the engine opens no page of its
 * own for it). On it, A gives its page the pad -- the recomp's settings
 * (src/ingame_menu.c's ngb_pc_setting) in three categories, Graphics,
 * Display and Startup, on a strip at the top as the game's own tabs have
 * theirs: left and right on the strip choose one, up and down move between
 * it and the category's rows, left, right or A change a row -- and B gives
 * it back; meanwhile the game sees no pad (src/ingame_menu.c,
 * ngb_pause_tab_key). NGB_NO_SETTINGS_TAB=1 leaves the six tabs. Its
 * sprites are ours: the plate is the game's own Exit plate, read from the
 * player's copy at run time, with the lettering taken off and "Settings"
 * put on in a similar typeface (EB Garamond, SIL Open Font License, built
 * in); the page is
 * drawn into a texture of ours in the menu's colours, in the game's own
 * menu letters (Liberation Serif, the same licence, until they are loaded). The game draws them all as it draws its own: through its
 * sprite list, sized and faded with the rest of the menu.
 *
 * The five functions after this are the lifted ones (listed in
 * src/manual_functions.json, so the pipeline leaves them out) with each
 * change marked "Settings:". When the textures cannot be made -- the Exit
 * plate not where it was, or not in a format read here -- the menu is the
 * game's own, six tabs.
 */

/* The categories: the strip's words, their rows. */
#define CATS 5
#define CAT_ROWS 5
#define CAT_CTL 4                 /* Controls: the bindings' list (src/bindings.c), not settings */
static const char *const s_cat_name[CATS] = { "Graphics", "Display", "Startup", "Cheats", "Controls" };
static const signed char s_cat_rows[CATS][CAT_ROWS] = {
    { S_RENDER, S_TEXTURE, S_MSAA, S_SHADOW, -1 },
    { S_ASPECT, S_WINDOW, S_DISPLAY, S_VSYNC, S_FPS },
    { S_SKIP, S_ALLDIFF, S_ALLCOST, -1 },
    { S_HEALTH, S_NINPO, S_ESSENCE, S_SCARABS, -1 },
    { -1 },
};

#include "bindings.h"
#define CTL_INVX A_COUNT          /* the actions, then Invert Camera X and Y (#26), then Default Controls */
#define CTL_INVY (A_COUNT + 1)
#define CTL_DEF  (A_COUNT + 2)
#define CTL_ROWS (A_COUNT + 3)

static int cat_count(int c)
{
    if (c == CAT_CTL)
        return CTL_ROWS;
    int n = 0;
    while (n < CAT_ROWS && s_cat_rows[c][n] >= 0)
        n++;
    return n;
}

static void value_text(int row, char *out, size_t n)
{
    int v = ngb_pc_setting(row);
    switch (row) {
    case S_RENDER:  snprintf(out, n, v == 1 ? "1x (console)" : "%dx", v); break;
    case S_TEXTURE:
    case S_MSAA:    if (v > 1) snprintf(out, n, "%dx", v); else snprintf(out, n, "Off"); break;
    case S_SHADOW:  snprintf(out, n, v == 1 ? "1x (console)" : "%dx", v); break;
    case S_DISPLAY: snprintf(out, n, "%s", v == 2 ? "Borderless" : v ? "Fullscreen" : "Windowed"); break;
    case S_VSYNC:   snprintf(out, n, "%s", ngb_vsync_name(v)); break;
    case S_WINDOW: {
        int w = 0, h = 0;
        ngb_settings_size_at(v / 8, v % 8, &w, &h);
        snprintf(out, n, "%d x %d", w, h);
        break;
    }
    case S_ASPECT:  snprintf(out, n, "%s", v == 3 ? "21:9" : v == 2 ? "16:10" : v ? "16:9" : "4:3"); break;
    case S_SKIP:
    case S_ALLDIFF:
    case S_ALLCOST:
    case S_LAUNCHER: snprintf(out, n, "%s", v ? "Yes" : "No"); break;
    default:        snprintf(out, n, "%s", v ? "On" : "Off"); break;
    }
}

static void change(int row, int step)
{
    int v = ngb_pc_setting(row);
    switch (row) {
    case S_RENDER:
        v += step;
        ngb_pc_set_setting(0, v < 1 ? 10 : v > 10 ? 1 : v);
        break;
    case S_TEXTURE: {
        static const int steps[] = { 0, 2, 4, 8, 16 };
        int i = 0;
        while (i < 4 && steps[i] != v)
            i++;
        ngb_pc_set_setting(1, steps[(i + step + 5) % 5]);
        break;
    }
    case S_MSAA: {
        static const int steps[] = { 1, 2, 4, 8 };
        int i = 0;
        while (i < 3 && steps[i] != v)
            i++;
        ngb_pc_set_setting(S_MSAA, steps[(i + step + 4) % 4]);
        break;
    }
    case S_SHADOW: {
        static const int steps[] = { 1, 2, 4, 8, 10 };
        int i = 0;
        while (i < 4 && steps[i] != v)
            i++;
        ngb_pc_set_setting(2, steps[(i + step + 5) % 5]);
        break;
    }
    case S_DISPLAY:
        ngb_pc_set_setting(row, (v + (step > 0 ? 1 : 2)) % 3);
        break;
    case S_VSYNC:
        ngb_pc_set_setting(row, ngb_vsync_step(v, step));
        break;
    case S_ASPECT:
        ngb_pc_set_setting(row, (v + (step > 0 ? 1 : 3)) % 4);
        break;
    case S_WINDOW: {
        int n = ngb_settings_size_count(v / 8);
        ngb_pc_set_setting(row, v / 8 * 8 + (v % 8 + step + n) % n);
        break;
    }
    default:
        ngb_pc_set_setting(row, !v);
        break;
    }
}

/* ---------- pictures: RGBA (0xAARRGGBB) to and from the guest ---------- */

/* The console's texture layout: x and y bits interleaved, x first, the
 * longer side's left over at the top. */
static void swizzle_masks(unsigned w, unsigned h, uint32_t *mx, uint32_t *my)
{
    uint32_t bit = 1, m = 1;
    *mx = *my = 0;
    for (;;) {
        int more = 0;
        if (bit < w) { *mx |= m; m <<= 1; more = 1; }
        if (bit < h) { *my |= m; m <<= 1; more = 1; }
        if (!more)
            break;
        bit <<= 1;
    }
}

static uint32_t deposit(uint32_t v, uint32_t mask)
{
    uint32_t r = 0;
    for (uint32_t b = 1; mask; b <<= 1) {
        uint32_t low = mask & -mask;
        if (v & b)
            r |= low;
        mask &= mask - 1;
    }
    return r;
}

/* A texture of the game's (P8 or A8R8G8B8, swizzled) as RGBA; NULL if it
 * is neither. */
static uint32_t *read_texture(uint32_t hdr, uint32_t pal_hdr, int *w, int *h)
{
    uint32_t fmt = MEM32(hdr + 0xC), data = MEM32(hdr + 4) | 0x80000000u;
    unsigned kind = fmt >> 8 & 0xFF, lw = fmt >> 20 & 0xF, lh = fmt >> 24 & 0xF;
    uint32_t mx, my, *px;
    if ((kind != 0x0B && kind != 0x06) || lw > 10 || lh > 10)
        return NULL;
    if (kind == 0x0B && !pal_hdr)
        return NULL;
    *w = 1 << lw;
    *h = 1 << lh;
    px = malloc(sizeof *px * *w * *h);
    swizzle_masks(*w, *h, &mx, &my);
    for (int y = 0; y < *h; y++)
        for (int x = 0; x < *w; x++) {
            uint32_t o = deposit(x, mx) | deposit(y, my);
            if (kind == 0x0B) {
                uint32_t pal = MEM32(pal_hdr + 4) | 0x80000000u;
                px[y * *w + x] = MEM32(pal + 4 * MEM8(data + o));
            } else {
                px[y * *w + x] = MEM32(data + 4 * o);
            }
        }
    return px;
}

typedef struct {
    uint32_t hdr, data;           /* guest: the texture's header and texels */
    int w, h;
} GuestTex;

static GuestTex s_tex[PT_N];
static uint32_t s_dlg_def, s_dlg_entry;   /* guest: the box's sprite definition, texture entry */
static uint32_t s_entries;        /* guest: per texture {header, palette} */
static uint32_t s_defs;           /* guest: per sprite the game's definition */
static int s_ready = -1;          /* -1 not tried, 0 failed, 1 made */
static int s_enabled;             /* the engine's tables have the tab */

static int make_texture(GuestTex *t, int w, int h, uint32_t fmt_low)
{
    unsigned lw = 0, lh = 0;
    while ((1 << lw) < w) lw++;
    while ((1 << lh) < h) lh++;
    t->w = w;
    t->h = h;
    t->data = xbox_ContiguousAlloc((uint32_t)(4 * w * h), 4096);
    t->hdr = xbox_HeapAlloc(0x14, 16);
    if (!t->data || !t->hdr)
        return 0;
    MEM32(t->hdr) = 0x40001;                         /* a texture, one reference */
    MEM32(t->hdr + 4) = t->data & 0x0FFFFFFF;        /* physical */
    MEM32(t->hdr + 8) = 0;
    MEM32(t->hdr + 0xC) = (lh << 24) | (lw << 20) | (1 << 16) | (0x06 << 8) | fmt_low;
    MEM32(t->hdr + 0x10) = 0;
```
