```c
    if (s_drawn.page != 1 || s_focus != s_drawn.focused || shown != s_drawn.row) {
        draw_exit_page(s_focus, s_exit_row, s_exit_armed);
        s_drawn.page = 1;
        s_drawn.focused = s_focus;
        s_drawn.row = shown;
    }
    sprite(PT_SPRITE + 2, PAGE_X, PAGE_Y, 0x1CC, 0, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f);
}

/* What the mouse points at: 0 the Settings page, 1 Exit's, 2 the box. */
int ngb_pause_tab_page(void) { return s_dlg_open ? 2 : s_ov_open > 0 ? 3 : s_drawn.page == 1 ? 1 : 0; }

/* For the mouse: Exit's page's row at (x, y), or -1. */
int ngb_pause_exit_hit(float x, float y)
{
    x -= PAGE_X;
    y -= PAGE_Y;
    if (x < 0 || x >= PAGE_W || y < 12 || y >= 12 + EXIT_ROWS * (ROW_H + 4))
        return -1;
    return (int)((y - 12) / (ROW_H + 4));
}

/* ---------- the engine's tables ---------- */

/* A row table with one more row: Exit's, the last; the row before it,
 * where Exit was, is Options, doing nothing when chosen (so the engine
 * opens no page under the tabs for it). */
static uint8_t s_exit_action;

static uint32_t copy_rows(uint32_t src)
{
    int n = 0;
    while (MEM8(src + 0x1C * n) != 0xFF)
        n++;
    uint32_t va = xbox_HeapAlloc(0x1C * (n + 2), 4);
    memcpy((void *)XBOX_PTR(va), (void *)XBOX_PTR(src), 0x1C * (n + 1));
    uint32_t e = va + 0x1C * n;
    memcpy((void *)XBOX_PTR(e), (void *)XBOX_PTR(src + 0x1C * (n - 1)), 0x1C);
    MEM8(e) = (uint8_t)n;                             /* Exit, now the last */
    s_exit_action = MEM8(e + 1);
    memset((void *)XBOX_PTR(e + 0x1C), 0, 0x1C);
    MEM8(e + 0x1C) = 0xFF;
    return va;
}

/* Before the game starts: the pause menu's pages, the tab rows with the
 * seventh. Their last row stays 5 until the textures are made. */
static uint32_t s_pages;

void ngb_pause_tab_init(void)
{
    if (getenv("NGB_NO_SETTINGS_TAB"))  /* the game's six tabs */
        return;
    int n = 0;
    while (MEM8(PAUSE_PAGES + 0x18 * n) != 0xFF)
        n++;
    s_pages = xbox_HeapAlloc(0x18 * (n + 1), 4);
    memcpy((void *)XBOX_PTR(s_pages), (void *)XBOX_PTR(PAUSE_PAGES), 0x18 * (n + 1));
    uint32_t src[4] = { 0 }, dst[4] = { 0 };
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint32_t p = s_pages + 0x18 * i;
        if (MEM8(p) != 0 && MEM8(p) != 1 && MEM8(p) != 0x0E)
            continue;
        int k = 0;
        while (k < 4 && src[k] && src[k] != MEM32(p + 0xC))
            k++;
        if (k < 4 && !src[k]) {
            src[k] = MEM32(p + 0xC);
            dst[k] = copy_rows(src[k]);
        }
        if (k < 4)
            MEM32(p + 0xC) = dst[k];
    }
    for (int m = 0; m < 16; m++)
        if (MEM32(MENU_TABLES + 4 * m) == PAUSE_PAGES)
            MEM32(MENU_TABLES + 4 * m) = s_pages;
    s_enabled = 1;
}

/* The tab row's last row: 6 once there is a seventh tab to show; the row
 * before it Options (nothing: 0xFF, the engine opens no page) then, Exit's
 * own (close) while there is none. */
static void pt_rows(void)
{
    if (!s_pages)
        return;
    int seven = pt_tabs() == 7, last = pt_tabs() - 1;
    for (uint32_t p = s_pages; MEM8(p) != 0xFF; p += 0x18)
        if (MEM8(p) == 0 || MEM8(p) == 1 || MEM8(p) == 0x0E) {
            MEM8(p + 2) = (uint8_t)last;
            MEM8(MEM32(p + 0xC) + 0x1C * 5 + 1) = seven ? 0xFF : s_exit_action;
            if (seven)                                /* Exit: our page's, A does nothing */
                MEM8(MEM32(p + 0xC) + 0x1C * 6 + 1) = 0xFF;
        }
}


/* ---------- the lifted functions ---------- */

/**
 * sub_00182240
 * Original: 0x00182240 - 0x001823D3 (403 bytes, 119 insns)
 * CC: cdecl, 0 params, returns int_or_void
 * Frame: fpo_leaf
 */
void sub_00182240(void)
{
    RECOMP_ENTRY(0x00182240u);
    int _flags = 0; /* fallback flag var */
    uint32_t _fa = 0, _fb = 0;
    int32_t _fas = 0, _fbs = 0;
    (void)_fa; (void)_fb; (void)_fas; (void)_fbs;

loc_00182240: ;
    _fb = (uint32_t)(0x48) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* sub source, before the write */
    esp = esp - 0x48;
    _fa = (uint32_t)(esp) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); /* sub result */
    _fa = (uint32_t)(edi) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(0) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* cmp edi, 0 (32-bit) */
    eax = MEM32(0x41CCD8);
    PUSH32(esp, ebx);
    ebx = 2;
    MEM32(esp + 0x48) = eax;
    PUSH32(esp, esi);
    MEM8(esp + 0x44) = LO8(ebx);
    MEM8(esp + 0x45) = LO8(ebx);
    MEM8(esp + 0x46) = LO8(ebx);
    MEM8(esp + 0x47) = LO8(ebx);
    MEM8(esp + 0x48) = LO8(ebx);
    MEM8(esp + 0x49) = LO8(ebx);
    pt_rows();                                       /* Settings: */
    if (pt_tabs() == 7) MEM8(esp + 0x4A) = LO8(ebx); /* Settings: a seventh */
    if (CMP_EQ(_fa, _fb)) goto loc_00182278; /* je: equal / zero */

loc_0018226F: ;
    eax = ZX8(MEM8(edx + 1));
    MEM8(esp + eax + 0x44) = 3;

loc_00182278: ;
    SET_LO8(eax, MEM8(edx + 1));
    ecx = esp + 0x44;
    MEM32(esp + 0x10) = ecx;
    ecx = ZX8(LO8(eax));
    MEM32(esp + 0x20) = ecx;
    SET_LO8(ecx, MEM8(edx + 2));
    esi = ZX8(LO8(ecx));
    MEM32(esp + 0x24) = esi;
    esi = MEM32(0xDA41C8);
    _fa = (uint32_t)(esi) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(1) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* cmp esi, 1 (32-bit) */
    MEM16(esp + 0x36) = LO16(ebx);
    MEM16(esp + 0x38) = 0;
    MEM32(esp + 0x28) = (uint32_t)pt_tabs();         /* Settings: was 6 */
    if (CMP_NE(_fa, _fb)) goto loc_001822CE; /* jne: not equal / not zero */

loc_001822B3: ;
    _fa = (uint32_t)(LO8(eax)) & 0xFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(4) & 0xFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int8_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int8_t)(_fb); /* cmp LO8(eax), 4 (8-bit) */
    SET_LO16(ecx, LO16(ebx));
    MEM16(esp + 0x3E) = LO16(ecx);
    if (CMP_NE(_fa, _fb)) goto loc_0018232A; /* jne: not equal / not zero */

loc_001822BF: ;
    SET_LO8(eax, MEM8(0xDA420A));
    _fa = (uint32_t)(LO8(eax)) & 0xFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(0) & 0xFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int8_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int8_t)(_fb); /* cmp LO8(eax), 0 (8-bit) */
    if (CMP_EQ(_fa, _fb)) goto loc_0018232A; /* je: equal / zero */

loc_001822C8: ;
    SET_LO16(ecx, 0x11);
    goto loc_00182325;

loc_001822CE: ;
    _fa = (uint32_t)(esi) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(3) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* cmp esi, 3 (32-bit) */
    if (CMP_NE(_fa, _fb)) goto loc_001822D8; /* jne: not equal / not zero */

loc_001822D3: ;
    SET_LO16(ecx, LO16(esi));
    goto loc_00182325;

loc_001822D8: ;
    _fa = (uint32_t)(LO8(ecx)) & 0xFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(LO8(eax)) & 0xFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int8_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int8_t)(_fb); /* cmp LO8(ecx), LO8(eax) (8-bit) */
    if (CMP_EQ(_fa, _fb)) goto loc_001822E2; /* je: equal / zero */

loc_001822DC: ;
    SET_LO16(ecx, 9);

/**
 * sub_002216B0
 * Original: 0x002216B0 - 0x00221C6A (1466 bytes, 381 insns)
 * CC: cdecl, 0 params, returns int_or_void
 * Frame: fpo_leaf
 */
static void sprite_submit(void);

static int sprite_log(void)
{
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0)
        on = getenv("NGB_SPRITE_LOG") != NULL;
    return on;
}

/* Every sprite the game queues passes here: the letters of its menus are
 * noted for the mouse (src/menu_mouse.c), with where they were put. */
void ngb_menu_glyph(float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1, float bright, uint32_t z);
extern uint32_t ngb_font_tex[];
extern int ngb_font_tex_n;

/* The sprite's texture coordinates drawn in from its edges. The game's
 * sprites map texels to the console's pixels one to one, so a pixel never
 * samples past a sprite's edge; drawn larger, the pixels along the edge
 * sample there, and bilinear filtering blends in what lies beyond -- the
 * next picture in the texture, or (wrapping) the far edge: thin lines along
 * the seams of a menu's pieces and around its plates. Taking each edge in
 * by half a texel less half a pixel keeps every sample within the sprite,
 * and leaves the console's 1x as it was. A quad is four vertices of seven
 * dwords: x y z rhw colour u v. NGB_NO_EDGE_INSET=1 leaves them. */

static void edge_inset(uint32_t p, uint32_t verts)
{
    static int off = -1;
    if (off < 0)
        off = getenv("NGB_NO_EDGE_INSET") != NULL;
    int scale = ngb_pc_setting(0);
    if (scale <= 1 || off)
        return;
    uint32_t def = sprite_def(MEM32(p) & 0xFFFF);
    if (!def)
        return;
    uint32_t hdr = MEM32(0x8DBB28 + MEM32(def + 0x10) * 8);
    if (!hdr)
        return;
    uint32_t fmt = MEM32(hdr + 0xC);
    float tw = (float)(1 << (fmt >> 20 & 0xF)), th = (float)(1 << (fmt >> 24 & 0xF));
    for (int axis = 0; axis < 2; axis++) {
        uint32_t off = 20 + 4 * axis;
        float lo = MEMF(verts + off), hi = lo;
        for (int v = 1; v < 4; v++) {
            float t = MEMF(verts + v * 28 + off);
            if (t < lo) lo = t;
            if (t > hi) hi = t;
        }
        float size = axis ? th : tw, d = 0.5f / size * (1.0f - 1.0f / scale);
        if (hi - lo < 4 * d || hi > 4.0f || lo < -4.0f)  /* tiny, or not 0-1 coordinates */
            continue;
        for (int v = 0; v < 4; v++) {
            float t = MEMF(verts + v * 28 + off);
            MEMF(verts + v * 28 + off) = t == lo ? t + d : t == hi ? t - d : t;
        }
    }
}

void ngb_aspect_tick(void);   /* src/pc_menu.c */

void sub_002216B0(void)
{
    ngb_aspect_tick();
    uint32_t p = eax, verts = esi, def = 0;
    if (ngb_font_tex_n && (MEM32(p) & 0xFFFF) < 0x200) {
        def = sprite_def(MEM32(p) & 0xFFFF);
        int glyph = 0;
        for (int i = 0; def && i < ngb_font_tex_n; i++)
            glyph |= ngb_font_tex[i] == MEM32(def + 0x10);
        if (!glyph)
            def = 0;
    }
    if (!def && (MEM32(p) & 0xFFFF) == 0xC5) {        /* the title's PRESS START BUTTON */
        extern void ngb_title_seen(void);              /* (src/ingame_menu.c: Return to Main Menu) */
        ngb_title_seen();
    }
    kc_check(MEM32(p) & 0xFFFF);                       /* keys for the button icons (font glyphs too) */
    {   /* Our pages (Settings, Exit): the Weapon page's category strip (sprites 0x186-0x187, a dark band
         * with a light underline) is still drawn under them; above 1x its underline showed as a line
         * across the blade and through our page. Not drawn there. */
        uint32_t id = MEM32(p) & 0xFFFF;
        if ((id == 0x186 || id == 0x187) && pt_tabs() == 7 && (MEM8(0xDA41D1) == PT_TAB || MEM8(0xDA41D1) == 6) &&
            ngb_menu_up()) {
            eax = 0;
            esp += 4;
            return;
        }
    }
    if ((MEM32(p) & 0xFFFF) == 0x17B || (MEM32(p) & 0xFFFF) == 0x177)   /* Weapon's and Exit's plates: where */
        kc_tab_seen(MEM32(p) & 0xFFFF, MEMF(verts), MEMF(verts + 4), MEMF(verts + 7 * 4), MEMF(verts + 15 * 4));
    if (!def && ngb_recomp_menu_active()) {
        rp_check(MEM32(p) & 0xFFFF);                   /* RECOMP SETTINGS' header and words */
        if (rp_skip(MEM32(p) & 0xFFFF)) {              /* and four categories, not six */
            eax = 0;
            esp += 4;
            return;
        }
    }
    sprite_submit();
    if (eax && s_ov_open > 0 && (MEM32(p) & 0xFFFF) != OV_SPRITE) {   /* the Controls panel: what is under it */
        float cx = (MEMF(verts) + MEMF(verts + 7 * 4)) / 2, cy = (MEMF(verts + 4) + MEMF(verts + 15 * 4)) / 2;
        if (cx >= OV_X - 20 && cx < 690 && cy >= OV_Y - 8 && cy < OV_Y + OV_H * OV_S + 4)
            for (int v = 0; v < 4; v++) {              /* (the page's frame too) not drawn: off the screen */
                MEMF(verts + v * 28) = -4096.0f;
                MEMF(verts + v * 28 + 4) = -4096.0f;
            }
    }
    if (eax && !def && (s_tab_first[2] > 0 || ENV_ONCE("NGB_SPRITE_AT_ANY")) && ENV_ONCE("NGB_SPRITE_AT")) {   /* debugging: sprites at console row y (pause menu) */
        static int n;
        float y = (float)atof(ENV_ONCE("NGB_SPRITE_AT")), y0 = MEMF(verts + 4), y1 = MEMF(verts + 15 * 4);
        uint32_t d = sprite_def(MEM32(p) & 0xFFFF);
        static uint32_t seen[256];
        static int ns;
        uint32_t key = (MEM32(p) & 0xFFFF) << 16 ^ (uint32_t)lroundf(y0 * 7 + y1 * 13);
        int k = 0;
        while (k < ns && seen[k] != key) k++;
        if (k == ns && ns < 256 && n < 200 && ((fabsf(y0 - y) < 1.5f || fabsf(y1 - y) < 1.5f) ||
                       (y0 < y && y1 > y && MEMF(verts + 7 * 4) - MEMF(verts) > 150))) {
            seen[ns++] = key;
            n++;
            fprintf(stderr, "[AT] %04X tex %X x %.1f..%.1f y %.2f..%.2f v %.4f..%.4f def v %.4f..%.4f size %u\n",
                    MEM32(p) & 0xFFFF, d ? MEM32(d + 0x10) : 0, MEMF(verts), MEMF(verts + 7 * 4), y0, y1,
                    MEMF(verts + 24), MEMF(verts + 15 * 4 + 20), d ? MEMF(d + 4) : 0, d ? MEMF(d + 12) : 0,
                    d ? MEM16(d + 0x16) : 0);
        }
    }
    if (eax)
        edge_inset(p, verts);
    if (!def && eax && ENV_ONCE("NGB_SPRITE_DUMP")) {    /* debugging: a sprite's texture as PPM, once */
        static char done[0x800];
        uint32_t id = MEM32(p) & 0xFFFF, d = id < 0x800 && !done[id] ? sprite_def(id) : 0;
        char want[16];
        snprintf(want, sizeof want, ",%X,", id);
        char list[256];
        snprintf(list, sizeof list, ",%s,", ENV_ONCE("NGB_SPRITE_DUMP"));
        if (d && strstr(list, want)) {
            done[id] = 1;
            uint32_t ti = MEM32(d + 0x10);
            int w, h;
            uint32_t *px = read_texture(MEM32(0x8DBB28 + ti * 8), MEM32(0x8DBB2C + ti * 8), &w, &h);
            char path[96];
            snprintf(path, sizeof path, "sprite_%04X.ppm", id);   /* in the working directory */
            FILE *f = px ? fopen(path, "wb") : NULL;
            if (f) {
                fprintf(f, "P6\n%d %d\n255\n", w, h * 2);
                for (int i = 0; i < w * h; i++) {          /* colour over grey, then the alpha */
                    float a = (px[i] >> 24) / 255.0f;
                    for (int c = 2; c >= 0; c--)
                        fputc((int)lroundf((px[i] >> (8 * c) & 255) * a + 96 * (1 - a)), f);
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < w * h; i++)
                    for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++)
                        fputc(px[i] >> 24, f);
                fclose(f);
                fprintf(stderr, "[SPRITE] %04X texture %X %dx%d dumped; def uv %.3f %.3f %.3f %.3f size %u %u\n", id, ti, w, h,
                        MEMF(d), MEMF(d + 4), MEMF(d + 8), MEMF(d + 12), MEM16(d + 0x14), MEM16(d + 0x16));
            }
            free(px);
        }
    }
    if (!def && eax && sprite_log()) {
        static uint32_t seen[2048];
        static int ns;
        uint32_t id = MEM32(p) & 0xFFFF, d = sprite_def(id);
        int k = 0;
        while (k < ns && seen[k] != id) k++;
        if (k == ns && ns < 2048 && d) {
            seen[ns++] = id;
            uint32_t ti = MEM32(d + 0x10), hdr = MEM32(0x8DBB28 + ti * 8);
            fprintf(stderr, "[SPRITE] %04X tex %X data %08X fmt %08X uv %.3f %.3f %.3f %.3f at %.0f,%.0f-%.0f,%.0f\n",
                    id, ti, hdr ? MEM32(hdr + 4) : 0, hdr ? MEM32(hdr + 0xC) : 0,
                    MEMF(d), MEMF(d + 4), MEMF(d + 8), MEMF(d + 12),
                    MEMF(verts), MEMF(verts + 4), MEMF(verts + 7 * 4), MEMF(verts + 15 * 4));
        }
    }
    if (!def && eax && ngb_menu_up()) {                /* a button prompt's icon */
        uint32_t id = MEM32(p) & 0xFFFF;
        static const uint8_t button[6] = { 0x04, 0x08, 0x02, 0x01, 0x40, 0x80 };  /* X Y B A LT RT */
        uint32_t d = id >= 5 && id <= 10 ? sprite_def(id) : 0;
        if (d && MEM32(d + 0x10) == 0)
            ngb_menu_add_item(MEMF(verts), MEMF(verts + 4), MEMF(verts + 7 * 4),
                              MEMF(verts + 15 * 4), 1.0f, 0x8B000000u, button[id - 5], 3);
    }
    if (!def && eax && ngb_menu_up()) {                /* a pause menu tab: where it is */
        static const uint16_t tab_id[7] = { 0x17B, 0x17A, 0x178, 0x17C, 0x179, PT_SPRITE, 0x177 };
        uint32_t id = MEM32(p) & 0xFFFF;
        for (int t = 0; t < 7; t++)
            if (id == tab_id[t]) {
                ngb_menu_add_item(MEMF(verts), MEMF(verts + 4), MEMF(verts + 7 * 4),
                                  MEMF(verts + 15 * 4), t == MEM8(0xDA41D1) ? 1.0f : 0.4f,
                                  0x7AB00000u, (uint32_t)t, 1);
                break;
            }
    }
    if (!def && eax && ngb_menu_up() && ngb_engine_row() >= 0) {   /* plates and the like */
        float x0 = MEMF(verts), y0 = MEMF(verts + 4), x1 = MEMF(verts + 7 * 4), y1 = MEMF(verts + 15 * 4);
        float w = x1 - x0, h = y1 - y0;
        if (w > 8 && h > 8 && w < 600 && h < 200) {
            uint32_t g = 0x5B000000u | (MEM16(p + 8) & 0xFFF) << 12 |
                         ((uint32_t)lroundf(w / 4) & 0x3F) << 6 | ((uint32_t)lroundf(h / 4) & 0x3F);
            ngb_menu_add_item(x0, y0, x1, y1, MEMF(p + 0x1C) * MEMF(p + 0x20), g,
                              (uint32_t)lroundf(y0) << 16 | ((uint32_t)lroundf(x0) & 0xFFFF), 2);
        }
    }
    if (def && eax) {
        uint32_t tex = MEM32(def + 0x10);
        for (int i = 0; i < ngb_font_tex_n; i++)
            if (ngb_font_tex[i] == tex) {
                ngb_menu_glyph(MEMF(verts), MEMF(verts + 4), MEMF(verts + 7 * 4),
                               MEMF(verts + 15 * 4), MEMF(p + 0x1C) * MEMF(p + 0x20),
                               MEM16(p + 8));
                break;
            }
    }
}

static void sprite_submit(void)
{
    RECOMP_ENTRY(0x002216B0u);
    uint32_t ebp = 0;
    ebp = g_ebp;  /* frameless: caller's frame */
    int _flags = 0; /* fallback flag var */
    uint32_t _fa = 0, _fb = 0;
    int32_t _fas = 0, _fbs = 0;
    (void)_fa; (void)_fb; (void)_fas; (void)_fbs;
    double _fca = 0.0, _fcb = 0.0;
    (void)_fca; (void)_fcb;
    #define fp_push(v) do { double _fp_value = (v); \
        g_fp_top = (g_fp_top + 7u) & 7u; \
        g_fp_stack[g_fp_top] = _fp_value; } while (0)
    #define fp_pop() (g_fp_top = (g_fp_top + 1u) & 7u)
    #define fp_top() g_fp_stack[g_fp_top]
    #define fp_st(i) g_fp_stack[(g_fp_top + (i)) & 7u]
    #define fp_st1() fp_st(1)
    ebp = g_seh_ebp; /* fpo_leaf: inherit caller's frame */

loc_002216B0: ;
    _fb = (uint32_t)(8) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* sub source, before the write */
    esp = esp - 8;
    _fa = (uint32_t)(esp) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); /* sub result */
    PUSH32(esp, ebx);
    PUSH32(esp, ebp);
    ebp = MEM32(esp + 0x18);
    PUSH32(esp, edi);
    edi = eax;
    eax = MEM32(edi);
    ebx = ecx;
    PUSH32(esp, 0x002216C5u); RECOMP_ABI_CALL(0x0021A960u, sub_0021A960); /* call 0x0021A960 */

loc_002216C5: ;
    _fa = (uint32_t)(eax) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(0) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* cmp eax, 0 (32-bit) */
    if (CMP_EQ(_fa, _fb)) goto loc_00221C61; /* je: equal / zero */

loc_002216CD: ;
    ecx = MEM32(eax + 0x10);
    if (ecx >= PT_TEX && ecx < PT_TEX + PT_N && s_ready == 1) { /* Settings: ours */
        ecx = s_entries + (ecx - PT_TEX) * 8;
        goto pt_entry;
    }
    if (ecx == DLG_TEX && s_dlg_entry) {               /* Settings: the box's */
        ecx = s_dlg_entry;
        goto pt_entry;
    }
    if (ecx == OV_TEX && s_ov_entry) {                 /* Settings: the Controls panel's */
        ecx = s_ov_entry;
        goto pt_entry;
    }
    if (ecx >= CP_TEX && ecx < CP_TEX + 3 && s_cp_entry[ecx - CP_TEX]) {   /* Settings: an extra costume's */
        ecx = s_cp_entry[ecx - CP_TEX];
        goto pt_entry;
    }
    if (ecx == TK_TEX && s_tk_entry) {                 /* Settings: the Q and E keys' */
        ecx = s_tk_entry;
        goto pt_entry;
    }
    _fa = (uint32_t)(ecx) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(0x516) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* cmp ecx, 0x516 (32-bit) */
    if (CMP_AE(_fa, _fb)) goto loc_00221C61; /* jae: above or equal (unsigned >=) */

loc_002216DC: ;
    ecx = ecx * 8 + 0x8DBB28;
pt_entry: ;
    _fa = (uint32_t)(ecx) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(0) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* cmp ecx, 0 (32-bit) */
    if (CMP_EQ(_fa, _fb)) goto loc_00221C61; /* je: equal / zero */

loc_002216EB: ;
    edx = MEM32(ecx);
    _fa = (uint32_t)(edx) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(0) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* cmp edx, 0 (32-bit) */
    MEM32(ebx) = edx;
    if (CMP_EQ(_fa, _fb)) goto loc_00221C61; /* je: equal / zero */

loc_002216F7: ;
    _fa = (uint32_t)(ebp) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(0) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* cmp ebp, 0 (32-bit) */
    ecx = MEM32(ecx + 4);
    MEM32(ebx + 4) = ecx;
    edx = MEM32(edi + 0x10);
    MEM32(ebx + 8) = edx;
    ecx = (uint32_t)(int32_t)SMEM16(edi + 4);
    edx = (uint32_t)(int32_t)SMEM16(edi + 6);
    SET_LO16(ebx, MEM16(eax + 0x14));
    xmm4.f[0] = (float)(int32_t)ecx; /* cvtsi2ss */
    SET_LO16(ecx, MEM16(eax + 0x16));
    xmm5.f[0] = (float)(int32_t)edx; /* cvtsi2ss */
    edx = (uint32_t)(int32_t)SMEM8(edi + 0xB);
    MEM16(esp + 0xC) = LO16(ecx);
    ecx = (uint32_t)(int32_t)SMEM8(edi + 0xC);
    if (CMP_NE(_fa, _fb)) goto loc_002217BD; /* jne: not equal / not zero */

loc_00221730: ;
    _fa = (uint32_t)(edx) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(0xFFFFFFFFu) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* cmp edx, 0xFFFFFFFFu (32-bit) */
    if (CMP_NE(_fa, _fb)) goto loc_00221740; /* jne: not equal / not zero */

loc_00221735: ;
    xmm3 = XMM_SCALAR(MEMF(eax + 8)); /* movss */
    xmm1 = XMM_SCALAR(MEMF(eax)); /* movss */
    goto loc_00221749;

loc_00221740: ;
    xmm3 = XMM_SCALAR(MEMF(eax)); /* movss */
    xmm1 = XMM_SCALAR(MEMF(eax + 8)); /* movss */

loc_00221749: ;
    _fa = (uint32_t)(ecx) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(0xFFFFFFFFu) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* cmp ecx, 0xFFFFFFFFu (32-bit) */
    if (CMP_NE(_fa, _fb)) goto loc_0022175A; /* jne: not equal / not zero */

loc_0022174E: ;
    xmm0 = XMM_SCALAR(MEMF(eax + 4)); /* movss */
    xmm2 = XMM_SCALAR(MEMF(eax + 0xC)); /* movss */
    goto loc_00221764;

loc_0022175A: ;
    xmm0 = XMM_SCALAR(MEMF(eax + 0xC)); /* movss */
    xmm2 = XMM_SCALAR(MEMF(eax + 4)); /* movss */

loc_00221764: ;
    MEMF(esi + 0x18) = xmm2.f[0]; /* movss */
    MEMF(esi + 0x30) = xmm1.f[0]; /* movss */
    MEMF(esi + 0x34) = xmm2.f[0]; /* movss */
    MEMF(esi + 0x50) = xmm0.f[0]; /* movss */
    MEMF(esi + 0x68) = xmm1.f[0]; /* movss */
    MEMF(esi + 0x6C) = xmm0.f[0]; /* movss */
    MEMF(esi + 0x14) = xmm3.f[0]; /* movss */
    MEMF(esi + 0x4C) = xmm3.f[0]; /* movss */
    xmm0 = XMM_SCALAR(MEMF(eax + 8)); /* movss */
    xmm0.f[0] = xmm0.f[0] - MEMF(eax); /* subss */
    xmm0.f[0] = xmm0.f[0] * MEMF(edi + 0x14); /* mulss */
    edx = ZX16(LO16(ebx));
    xmm1.f[0] = (float)(int32_t)edx; /* cvtsi2ss */
    xmm0.f[0] = xmm0.f[0] * xmm1.f[0]; /* mulss */
    xmm1 = XMM_SCALAR(MEMF(eax + 0xC)); /* movss */
    xmm1.f[0] = xmm1.f[0] - MEMF(eax + 4); /* subss */
    eax = ZX16(MEM16(esp + 0xC));
    xmm2.f[0] = (float)(int32_t)eax; /* cvtsi2ss */
    goto loc_00221850;

loc_002217BD: ;
    _fa = (uint32_t)(edx) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(0xFFFFFFFFu) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* cmp edx, 0xFFFFFFFFu (32-bit) */
    xmm2 = XMM_SCALAR(MEMF(ebp)); /* movss */
    xmm3 = XMM_SCALAR(MEMF(ebp + 4)); /* movss */
    xmm0 = XMM_SCALAR(MEMF(ebp + 8)); /* movss */
    xmm1 = XMM_SCALAR(MEMF(ebp + 0xC)); /* movss */
    if (CMP_NE(_fa, _fb)) goto loc_00221805; /* jne: not equal / not zero */

loc_002217D6: ;
    MEMF(esi + 0x68) = xmm2.f[0]; /* movss */
    MEMF(esi + 0x4C) = xmm0.f[0]; /* movss */
    MEMF(esi + 0x30) = xmm2.f[0]; /* movss */
    MEMF(esi + 0x14) = xmm0.f[0]; /* movss */

loc_002217EA: ;
    _fa = (uint32_t)(ecx) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(0xFFFFFFFFu) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* cmp ecx, 0xFFFFFFFFu (32-bit) */
    if (CMP_NE(_fa, _fb)) goto loc_0022181B; /* jne: not equal / not zero */

loc_002217EF: ;
    MEMF(esi + 0x18) = xmm1.f[0]; /* movss */
    MEMF(esi + 0x34) = xmm1.f[0]; /* movss */
    MEMF(esi + 0x50) = xmm3.f[0]; /* movss */
    MEMF(esi + 0x6C) = xmm3.f[0]; /* movss */
    goto loc_0022182F;

loc_00221805: ;
    MEMF(esi + 0x68) = xmm0.f[0]; /* movss */
    MEMF(esi + 0x4C) = xmm2.f[0]; /* movss */
    MEMF(esi + 0x30) = xmm0.f[0]; /* movss */
    MEMF(esi + 0x14) = xmm2.f[0]; /* movss */
    goto loc_002217EA;

loc_0022181B: ;
    MEMF(esi + 0x18) = xmm3.f[0]; /* movss */
    MEMF(esi + 0x34) = xmm3.f[0]; /* movss */
    MEMF(esi + 0x50) = xmm1.f[0]; /* movss */
    MEMF(esi + 0x6C) = xmm1.f[0]; /* movss */

loc_0022182F: ;
    edx = ZX16(MEM16(esp + 0xC));
    xmm0.f[0] = xmm0.f[0] - xmm2.f[0]; /* subss */
    xmm0.f[0] = xmm0.f[0] * MEMF(edi + 0x14); /* mulss */
    ecx = ZX16(LO16(ebx));
    xmm2.f[0] = (float)(int32_t)ecx; /* cvtsi2ss */
    xmm0.f[0] = xmm0.f[0] * xmm2.f[0]; /* mulss */
    xmm1.f[0] = xmm1.f[0] - xmm3.f[0]; /* subss */
    xmm2.f[0] = (float)(int32_t)edx; /* cvtsi2ss */

loc_00221850: ;
    eax = MEM32(esp + 0x18);
    _fa = (uint32_t)(eax) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(0) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* cmp eax, 0 (32-bit) */
    xmm1.f[0] = xmm1.f[0] * MEMF(edi + 0x18); /* mulss */
    xmm0.f[0] = xmm0.f[0] * MEMF(0x43B494); /* mulss */
    xmm1.f[0] = xmm1.f[0] * xmm2.f[0]; /* mulss */
    if (CMP_EQ(_fa, _fb)) goto loc_0022189B; /* je: equal / zero */

loc_00221869: ;
    ecx = MEM32(eax);
    fp_push((double)SMEM32(eax)); /* fild */
    _fa = (uint32_t)(ecx) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(0) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* cmp ecx, 0 (32-bit) */
    if (CMP_GE(_fas, _fbs)) goto loc_00221877; /* jge: greater or equal (signed >=) */

loc_00221871: ;
    fp_top() = RECOMP_FP_PC(fp_top() + MEMF(0x4148E4)); /* fadd dword ptr [0x4148e4] */

loc_00221877: ;
    edx = MEM32(eax + 4);
    MEMF(esp + 0xC) = (float)fp_top(); fp_pop(); /* fstp */
    _fa = (uint32_t)(edx) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fb = (uint32_t)(0) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* cmp edx, 0 (32-bit) */
    fp_push((double)SMEM32(eax + 4)); /* fild */
    if (CMP_GE(_fas, _fbs)) goto loc_0022188B; /* jge: greater or equal (signed >=) */

loc_00221885: ;
    fp_top() = RECOMP_FP_PC(fp_top() + MEMF(0x4148E4)); /* fadd dword ptr [0x4148e4] */

loc_0022188B: ;
    xmm0 = XMM_SCALAR(MEMF(esp + 0xC)); /* movss */
    MEMF(esp + 0x10) = (float)fp_top(); fp_pop(); /* fstp */
    xmm1 = XMM_SCALAR(MEMF(esp + 0x10)); /* movss */

loc_0022189B: ;
    xmm6 = XMM_ZERO(); /* xorps self = zero */
    _fca = xmm6.f[0]; _fcb = xmm0.f[0]; /* comiss */
    if ((_fca >= _fcb)) goto loc_00221C61; /* jae: above or equal (unsigned >=) (xmm6.f[0] vs xmm0.f[0]) */

loc_002218A7: ;
    _fca = xmm6.f[0]; _fcb = xmm1.f[0]; /* comiss */
    if ((_fca >= _fcb)) goto loc_00221C61; /* jae: above or equal (unsigned >=) (xmm6.f[0] vs xmm1.f[0]) */

loc_002218B0: ;
    eax = 0; /* xor self */
    _fa = (uint32_t)(eax) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); /* xor result */
    SET_LO8(eax, MEM8(edi + 0xA));
    eax = eax & 0xF;
    _fa = (uint32_t)(eax) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); /* and result */
    _fb = (uint32_t)(0) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fbs = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fb); /* sub source, before the write */
    eax = eax - 0;
    _fa = (uint32_t)(eax) & 0xFFFFFFFFu; _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); /* sub result */
    if ((_fa == 0)) goto loc_002218EE; /* je: equal / zero */

loc_002218BD: ;
    eax--;
    _fa = (uint32_t)(eax) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fb = (_fa == 0x7FFFFFFFu); /* dec result/SF/OF; CF unchanged */
    if ((_fa == 0)) goto loc_002218D5; /* je: equal / zero */

loc_002218C0: ;
    eax--;
    _fa = (uint32_t)(eax) & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    _fas = (int32_t)(int32_t)(_fa); _fb = (_fa == 0x7FFFFFFFu); /* dec result/SF/OF; CF unchanged */
    xmm3 = XMM_SCALAR(MEMF(0x4148C0)); /* movss */
    if ((_fa != 0)) goto loc_00221918; /* jne: not equal / not zero */

loc_002218CB: ;
    xmm4.f[0] = xmm4.f[0] - xmm0.f[0]; /* subss */
    xmm4.f[0] = xmm4.f[0] - xmm3.f[0]; /* subss */
```

`src/pc_menu.c`:

```c
/*
 * pc_menu.c -- the PC settings in the game's own Options menu.
 *
 * Ninja Gaiden Black's Options menu is data driven: a table of pages
 * (0x429CD0, 0x18 bytes each: id, first and last row, wrap, ..., row table)
 * whose rows (0x1C bytes: index, action -- a page to open, 0xFF a value,
 * 0xFC defaults, 0xFD exit -- type, range, page handler) the menu engine
 * moves the cursor over and reports value changes for. The text comes from
 * a table per category (0x436240, counts at 0x43626C; entries of id,
 * English, Japanese). What is page specific is code: each page draws its
 * rows from its own list of text ids, handles its own values, and the
 * information line picks a description by page and row.
 *
 * The main menu's RECOMP SETTINGS (src/main_menu.c) opens this menu as
 * OPTIONS does, but on pages of ours: page 0's categories become
 * Graphics, Display and Startup Settings and Exit, opening pages 10-12 --
 * the recomp's settings as rows with values, like Video Settings' -- and
 * the header and category words are pictures of ours (src/pause_tab.c)
 * while it is open. The page and row tables and the text table are
 * extended in guest memory at first use, and the page table pointer is
 * swapped for ours while RECOMP SETTINGS is open; the four functions below
 * are the lifted ones (listed in src/manual_functions.json so the
 * pipeline leaves them out) with the changes marked "PC:".
 */
#define RECOMP_GENERATED_CODE

/* Settings, from src/ingame_menu.c: 0 render scale (1-8), 1 smooth
 * texture filtering, 2 shadow map scale (1, 2, 4, 8), 3 fullscreen,

void ngb_pc_set_setting(int which, int value);

#define MENU_STATE 0xDA41D0       /* the Options menu: page, row, ... */

#define PAGE_DISP  11
#define PAGE_START 12
#define PAGE_CHEAT 13
#define PAGE_CTRL  14             /* Controls: the bindings' panel (src/pause_tab.c) over it */

#define PC_RAISE   30             /* a page of more than seven rows: higher */
#define PC_CLOSER  8              /* and closer, clear of the information line */

       ROW_RENDER, ROW_TEXTURE, ROW_SHADOW, ROW_DISPLAY, ROW_VSYNC, ROW_FPS, ROW_WINDOW, ROW_ASPECT, ROW_BACK,

};

static int is_ours(int page) { return page >= PAGE_GFX && page < PAGE_GFX + N_OURS; }

static int s_ready;
static uint32_t s_labels_ws, s_labels_std;               /* guest: text ids */
static uint32_t s_labels_ours[N_OURS];
static uint32_t s_highlight;                              /* guest: a byte per row */
static uint32_t s_pages_recomp;                           /* guest: RECOMP SETTINGS' page table */

static uint32_t guest_string(const char *t)
{
    uint32_t n = (uint32_t)strlen(t) + 1, va = xbox_HeapAlloc(n, 4);
    if (va)
        memcpy((void *)XBOX_PTR(va), t, n);
    return va;
}

/* A row table, from the original rows (page 4's at 0x429968: Screen
 * Adjustment, Movie Display Ratio, Default Settings, Exit), ending as the
 * engine expects with an 0xFF row. */
static uint32_t make_rows(const uint8_t *kinds, int n)
{
    uint32_t va = xbox_HeapAlloc(0x1C * (n + 1), 4);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint32_t e = va + 0x1C * i, src;
        int max = 1;
        switch (kinds[i]) {
        case ROW_SCREEN:  src = 0x429968; break;
        case ROW_PC:      src = 0x429968; break;
        case ROW_DEFAULT: src = 0x4299A0; break;
        case ROW_EXIT:
        case ROW_BACK:    src = 0x4299BC; break;
        case ROW_RENDER:  src = 0x429984; max = 9; break;
        case ROW_TEXTURE: src = 0x429984; max = 4; break;
        case ROW_MSAA:    src = 0x429984; max = 3; break;
        case ROW_SHADOW:  src = 0x429984; max = 4; break;
        case ROW_VSYNC:   src = 0x429984; max = 3; break;
        case ROW_WINDOW:  src = 0x429984; max = 6; break;
        case ROW_ASPECT:  src = 0x429984; max = 3; break;
        case ROW_EXTRACOST: src = 0x429984; max = 3; break;
        default:          src = 0x429984; break;          /* a value, 0-1 */
        }
        memcpy((void *)XBOX_PTR(e), (void *)XBOX_PTR(src), 0x1C);
        MEM8(e) = (uint8_t)i;                              /* row */
        if (src == 0x429984)
            MEM32(e + 0xC) = (uint32_t)max;                /* value range */
    }
    memset((void *)XBOX_PTR(va + 0x1C * n), 0, 0x1C);
    MEM8(va + 0x1C * n) = 0xFF;
    return va;
}

static uint32_t make_labels(const uint8_t *kinds, int n)
{
    static const uint32_t id[] = { 0x20011, 0x20015, T_PC, 0x20004, 0x20005,
                                   T_RENDER, T_TEXTURE, T_SHADOW, T_DISPLAY, T_VSYNC,
                                   T_FPS, T_WINDOWSZ, T_ASPECT, 0x20005, T_SKIP, T_LAUNCHER, T_MSAA,
                                   T_HEALTH, T_NINPO, T_ESSENCE, T_ALLDIFF, T_SCARABS, T_ALLCOST, T_EXTRACOST };
    uint32_t va = xbox_HeapAlloc(4 * n, 4);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        MEM32(va + 4 * i) = id[kinds[i]];
    return va;
}

/* Once, before the Options menu is drawn: the text, the rows, our page. */
static void pc_menu_init(void)
{
    if (s_ready)
        return;
    s_ready = 1;

    /* Category 2's text table with ours after it. */
    uint32_t old = MEM32(0x436240 + 2 * 4);
    uint32_t count = MEM16(0x43626C + 2 * 2);
    uint32_t add = sizeof s_text / sizeof s_text[0], extra = 4 * 8;
    uint32_t tab = xbox_HeapAlloc(12 * (count + add + extra), 4);
    memcpy((void *)XBOX_PTR(tab), (void *)XBOX_PTR(old), 12 * count);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < add + extra; i++) {
        char sz[24];
        const char *text = i < add ? s_text[i].text : "";
        uint32_t id = i < add ? s_text[i].id : T_WSIZE0 + (i - add);
        if (i >= add) {                                /* a window size, by aspect and place */
            int w, h, a = (int)(i - add) / 8, k = (int)(i - add) % 8;
            if (k < ngb_settings_size_count(a)) {
                ngb_settings_size_at(a, k, &w, &h);
                snprintf(sz, sizeof sz, "%d x %d", w, h);
                text = sz;
            } else {
                text = "-";
            }
        }
        uint32_t str = guest_string(text), e = tab + 12 * (count + i);
        MEM32(e) = id;
        MEM32(e + 4) = str;           /* English */
        MEM32(e + 8) = str;           /* and in the Japanese text too */
    }
    MEM32(0x436240 + 2 * 4) = tab;
    MEM16(0x43626C + 2 * 2) = (uint16_t)(count + add + extra);

    /* Pages 4 (0x429D18) and 6 (0x429D48): last row, row table. */
    MEM8(0x429D18 + 2) = N_WS - 1;
    MEM32(0x429D18 + 0xC) = make_rows(s_rows_ws, N_WS);
    MEM8(0x429D48 + 2) = N_STD - 1;
    MEM32(0x429D48 + 0xC) = make_rows(s_rows_std, N_STD);

    /* RECOMP SETTINGS' page table: the game's (0x429CB8: pages 0-9 of 0x18
     * bytes, then 0xFF) with page 0's categories ours -- rows opening pages
     * 10-12, and Exit -- and our pages 10-12, copies of Screen Adjustment's
     * (page 9: a page of Video Settings) going back to their category. */
    uint32_t pages = xbox_HeapAlloc(0x18 * (10 + N_OURS + 1), 4);
    memcpy((void *)XBOX_PTR(pages), (void *)XBOX_PTR(0x429CB8), 0x18 * 10);
    {
        uint32_t src = MEM32(0x429CB8 + 0xC), rows = xbox_HeapAlloc(0x1C * (N_OURS + 2), 4);
        for (int i = 0; i <= N_OURS; i++) {               /* page 0's rows: a category's, Exit's last */
            uint32_t e = rows + 0x1C * i;
            memcpy((void *)XBOX_PTR(e), (void *)XBOX_PTR(src + 0x1C * (i < N_OURS ? i : 5)), 0x1C);
            MEM8(e) = (uint8_t)i;
            MEM8(e + 1) = i < N_OURS ? (uint8_t)(PAGE_GFX + i) : 0xFD;
        }
        memset((void *)XBOX_PTR(rows + 0x1C * (N_OURS + 1)), 0, 0x1C);
        MEM8(rows + 0x1C * (N_OURS + 1)) = 0xFF;
        MEM32(pages + 0xC) = rows;
        MEM8(pages + 2) = N_OURS;                          /* the last row */
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < N_OURS; i++) {
        uint32_t pg = pages + 0x18 * (10 + i);
        memcpy((void *)XBOX_PTR(pg), (void *)XBOX_PTR(0x429D90), 0x18);
        MEM8(pg) = (uint8_t)(PAGE_GFX + i);
        MEM8(pg + 2) = (uint8_t)(s_ours[i].n - 1);
        MEM8(pg + 6) = 0;                                  /* back to page 0, */
        MEM8(pg + 7) = (uint8_t)i;                         /* its category's row */
        MEM32(pg + 0xC) = make_rows(s_ours[i].kinds, s_ours[i].n);
        s_labels_ours[i] = make_labels(s_ours[i].kinds, s_ours[i].n);
    }
    memset((void *)XBOX_PTR(pages + 0x18 * (10 + N_OURS)), 0, 0x18);
    MEM8(pages + 0x18 * (10 + N_OURS)) = 0xFF;
    s_pages_recomp = pages;

    s_labels_ws = make_labels(s_rows_ws, N_WS);
    s_labels_std = make_labels(s_rows_std, N_STD);
    s_highlight = xbox_HeapAlloc(16, 4);
}

/* At startup, before the game runs: the Options menu reads the page table
 * once when it opens. */
void ngb_pause_tab_init(void);   /* src/pause_tab.c */
void ngb_general_page_init(void);   /* src/main_menu.c */
int ngb_general_no_flag(void);

/* The game's picture shape, while it runs or before it starts. The game has a widescreen mode
 * (the D3D present flags' bit 4, 0x9776A8, and the video flags' bit 0, 0xD21748): in it, it takes
 * its 3D's shape from 0x414AF8 (16:9) instead of 0x414AF4 (4:3) -- kept in 0x977EF8 as it set it
 * up -- and draws some of its 2D narrower for a widescreen TV to stretch (the title's logo, the
 * items' pictures, some bars), others not (the letters, the menus' plates). The renderer draws the
 * 2D in its own 4:3 shape on a wider screen (ngb_hud_shape, src/d3d/vk/backend.cpp), alike for
 * every piece, which those already narrower would be twice: so on a wider screen the game is kept
 * in its 4:3 mode -- its 2D as for 4:3 -- with both constants the screen's shape, its 3D drawn for
 * it. NGB_GAME_WIDESCREEN=1 keeps the game's own widescreen mode instead. */
extern uint32_t xbox_XcVideoFlags;

/* The constants are in .rdata (read-only): written through /proc/self/mem, and tried again from the
 * per-frame hook until the image is mapped. */
static double s_aspect_a;      /* the screen's shape to give the game, 0 none pending */
static float s_orig_43;        /* 0x414AF4 as the game has it */

static int patch_float(uint32_t va, float f)
{
    return ngb_mem_write((void *)XBOX_PTR(va), &f, sizeof f);
}

/* (fails, rather than faulting, while the image is not mapped) */
static int read_float(uint32_t va, float *f)
{
    return ngb_mem_read((const void *)XBOX_PTR(va), f, sizeof *f);
}

static int game_widescreen_mode(void)
{
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0)
        on = getenv("NGB_GAME_WIDESCREEN") != NULL;
    return on;
}

static int patch_constant(double a)
{
    if (!s_orig_43) {
        float f;
        if (!read_float(0x414AF4, &f) || !(f > 1.2f && f < 1.5f))
            return 0;                                  /* not mapped yet */
        s_orig_43 = f;
    }
    int wide = a > 1.34;
    return patch_float(0x414AF8, (float)a) &&
           patch_float(0x414AF4, wide && !game_widescreen_mode() ? (float)a : s_orig_43);
}

void ngb_game_set_aspect_constant(double a)
{
    s_aspect_a = patch_constant(a) ? 0 : a;
}

/* The flags as wanted on a wide screen: in play the game's 4:3 mode (its HUD and words, drawn for 4:3,
 * are narrowed to their own shape by the renderer) -- but its widescreen mode, the console's 16:9
 * look, for its 2D screens: while a menu runs (marked as it runs, so from its first frame), when
 * the frame before drew next to no 3D (the title, chapter cards, loading screens), while a movie
 * plays and until the title (the boot movie: a wide one is chosen). There it draws its pictures
 * narrower for the screen to stretch, and the renderer draws them as they are, stretched
 * (ngb_2d_stretched) -- no wider than 16:9. NGB_GAME_WIDESCREEN=1: the widescreen mode throughout;
 * NGB_MENUS_43=1: the 4:3 mode on the 2D screens too, narrowed as the HUD. */
static int s_flags_wide = -1, s_screen_wide, s_boot = 1, s_menu_now, s_menu_last, s_screen_2d;
static uint64_t s_movie_ms;
static uint64_t now_ms(void)
{
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000 + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec / 1000000;
}
/* The movie player's state, polled each frame while a movie is up: playing (the first ends the boot,
 * whose wide mode is only for choosing the wide boot movie), or ended (4:3 again at once, so the title
 * after it is never drawn a frame in the wide mode). */
void ngb_movie_playing(int playing)
{
    s_movie_ms = playing ? now_ms() : 0;
    if (playing)
        s_boot = 0;
}
void ngb_boot_over(void) { s_boot = 0; }   /* the title is up */

/* NGB_MENUS_43=1: on a wide screen the 2D screens in the game's 4:3 mode too, the console's 4:3 picture
 * in the middle of the screen (debugging; they follow the aspect ratio otherwise). */
static int menus_43(void)
{
    static int env = -1;
    if (env < 0)
        env = getenv("NGB_MENUS_43") != NULL;
    return env;
}

void ngb_aspect_tick(void);

/* A menu runs (src/menu_mouse.c, each frame it does): the widescreen mode from now. */
void ngb_aspect_menu_running(void)
{
    if (!s_menu_now) {
        s_menu_now = 1;
        ngb_aspect_tick();
    }
}

/* Each frame's end (src/cheats.c, at Swap): the next frame's mode -- a menu marks itself again; a
 * frame of next to no 3D (the renderer's count, src/d3d/vk/backend.cpp) is a 2D screen. */
extern int ngb_frame_draws, ngb_frame_3d_draws;
void ngb_aspect_frame_end(void)
{

    s_menu_last = s_menu_now;   /* a menu last frame: the mode kept, so it never flips within a frame */
    s_menu_now = 0;
    s_screen_2d = ngb_frame_draws > 0 && ngb_frame_3d_draws < 30;
}

/* For the renderer and the mouse: the game is in its widescreen mode on a wide screen, its 2D drawn
 * as it is, stretched. */
int ngb_2d_stretched(void)
{
    /* The renderer asks from its first present, which can come before the guest's memory is mapped:
     * the flag read at 0 + 0xD21748 crashed a slow first start (Windows, just after a reboot). */
    return s_screen_wide && g_xbox_mem_offset && (MEM32(0xD21748) & 1) != 0;
}

/* For the renderer: a 2D screen (a menu, the title, a chapter card) on a wide screen, in whichever mode. */
int ngb_2d_screen(void)
{
    return s_screen_wide && (s_menu_now || s_menu_last || s_screen_2d);
}

/* The same, knowing the 3D this frame has drawn so far (the renderer's count): a frame that has drawn
 * the game's 3D, with no menu running in it, is play -- the first frame after a menu closes too, which
 * the frame before (a 2D screen) would otherwise have drawn in the menus' layout, the HUD jumping for
 * that one frame. */
int ngb_2d_screen_frame(int threed)
{
    return s_screen_wide && (s_menu_now || ((s_menu_last || s_screen_2d) && threed < 30));
}
/* Before the game runs: the screen's shape (the flags are the game's to set up, then kept by the tick). */
void ngb_game_aspect_init(int widescreen)
{
    s_screen_wide = widescreen;
    s_flags_wide = widescreen && game_widescreen_mode();
}
static void set_flags(int wide)
{
    MEM32(0x9776A8) = wide ? MEM32(0x9776A8) | 0x10 : MEM32(0x9776A8) & ~0x10u;
    MEM32(0xD21748) = wide ? MEM32(0xD21748) | 1 : MEM32(0xD21748) & ~1u;
    if (wide)
        xbox_XcVideoFlags |= 1;
    else
        xbox_XcVideoFlags &= ~1u;
}

int ngb_menu_up(void);   /* src/menu_mouse.c */
static int page_now(void);
static int s_recomp;

void ngb_aspect_tick(void)
{
    if (getenv("NGB_ASPECT_LOG")) {
        static unsigned n;
        if (n++ % 20000 == 0)
            fprintf(stderr, "[ASPECT] tick: constants %.4f %.4f 977EF8 %.4f flags %X\n", MEMF(0x414AF4), MEMF(0x414AF8),
                    MEMF(0x977EF8), MEM32(0x9776A8));
    }
    if (s_aspect_a > 0 && patch_constant(s_aspect_a))
        s_aspect_a = 0;
    if (s_flags_wide >= 0) {
        /* a movie in the game's widescreen mode: it follows its own Movie Display Ratio there, 16:9
         * across the screen or 4:3 with bars at the sides (its 4:3 mode as well narrowed that to 9/16, #28) */
        int movie = s_movie_ms && now_ms() - s_movie_ms < 200;
        /* On a wide screen the game's widescreen mode throughout -- its own 16:9 look, every screen as it
         * draws it (src/d3d/vk/backend.cpp stretches its 2D, no wider than 16:9). NGB_HUD_FIXED=1: the earlier way, play in the 4:3 mode with the HUD
         * drawn in its own shape and the 16:9 mode for the menus it can tell. */
        static int hud_fixed = -1;
        if (hud_fixed < 0)
            hud_fixed = getenv("NGB_HUD_FIXED") != NULL;
        int two_d = hud_fixed ? !menus_43() && (s_menu_now || s_menu_last || s_screen_2d) : !menus_43();
        int want = s_flags_wide || (s_screen_wide && (s_boot || movie || two_d));
        if ((MEM32(0x9776A8) >> 4 & 1) != (uint32_t)want || (MEM32(0xD21748) & 1) != (uint32_t)want)
        {
            set_flags(want);   /* the game sets them again from its video settings */
            if (want && getenv("NGB_MENU_MODE_LOG"))
                fprintf(stderr, "[MENUMODE] wide: menu %d 2d %d movie %d boot %d\n", s_menu_now, s_screen_2d, movie, s_boot);
            static unsigned n;
            if (getenv("NGB_ASPECT_LOG") && n++ % 60 == 0)
                fprintf(stderr, "[ASPECT] flags set to %d (%u times)\n", want, n);
        }
    }
}

/* While it runs. */
void ngb_game_set_aspect(int widescreen, double a)
{
    if (!widescreen)
        a = 4.0 / 3;
    ngb_game_set_aspect_constant(a);
    s_flags_wide = widescreen && game_widescreen_mode();
    s_screen_wide = widescreen;
    set_flags(s_flags_wide || (widescreen && s_boot));
    MEMF(0x977EF8) = (float)a * MEMF(0x4148D0);
    if (getenv("NGB_ASPECT_LOG"))
        fprintf(stderr, "[ASPECT] widescreen %d a %.4f: constants %.4f %.4f (pending %.4f), 977EF8 %.4f\n", widescreen,
                a, MEMF(0x414AF4), MEMF(0x414AF8), s_aspect_a, MEMF(0x977EF8));
}

void ngb_pc_menu_init(void)
{
    pc_menu_init();
    ngb_pause_tab_init();
    ngb_general_page_init();
}

static int page_now(void)
{
    return MEM8(MENU_STATE);
}

/* ---------- RECOMP SETTINGS ---------- */

/* From the main menu's choice until the main menu is back: our page table
 * in the Options menu's place (both of the menus that use the game's). */
static int s_recomp_seen;
static uint32_t s_saved_tables[2];
void ngb_recomp_pictures_off(void);   /* src/pause_tab.c */

void ngb_recomp_menu_enter(void)
{
    pc_menu_init();
    s_saved_tables[0] = MEM32(0x42A28C);
    s_saved_tables[1] = MEM32(0x42A2AC);
    MEM32(0x42A28C) = s_pages_recomp;
    MEM32(0x42A2AC) = s_pages_recomp;
    s_recomp = 1;
    s_recomp_seen = 0;
}

int ngb_recomp_menu_active(void) { return s_recomp; }
void ngb_recomp_menu_seen(void) { s_recomp_seen = s_recomp; }

/* The main menu again (its drawer, each frame): the game's tables back. */
void ngb_recomp_menu_tick(void)
{
    if (!s_recomp || !s_recomp_seen)
        return;
    MEM32(0x42A28C) = s_saved_tables[0];
    MEM32(0x42A2AC) = s_saved_tables[1];
    s_recomp = s_recomp_seen = 0;
    ngb_recomp_pictures_off();
}

/* The row kinds of the page on screen: page 4/6 by the widescreen flag,
 * or ours. */
static const uint8_t *page_rows(int *n)
{
    if (is_ours(page_now())) {
        *n = s_ours[page_now() - PAGE_GFX].n;
        return s_ours[page_now() - PAGE_GFX].kinds;
    }
    if (MEM8(0xD21748) & 1)   { *n = N_WS; return s_rows_ws; }
    *n = N_STD;
    return s_rows_std;
}

static int row_kind(int row)
{
    int n;
    const uint8_t *k = page_rows(&n);
    return row >= 0 && row < n ? k[row] : -1;
}


/* The value text of a row, or 0: Movie Display Ratio's is the page's own
 * (movie_id). */
static uint32_t pc_value_id(int row, uint32_t movie_id)
{
    switch (row_kind(row)) {
    case ROW_MOVIE:   return movie_id;
    case ROW_RENDER:  return T_SCALE0 + (uint32_t)(ngb_pc_setting(0) - 1);
    case ROW_TEXTURE: {
        int v = ngb_pc_setting(1);
        return T_ANISO0 + (v >= 16 ? 4 : v >= 8 ? 3 : v >= 4 ? 2 : v >= 2 ? 1 : 0);
    }
    case ROW_MSAA: {
        int v = ngb_pc_setting(10);
        return T_MSAA0 + (v >= 8 ? 3 : v >= 4 ? 2 : v >= 2 ? 1 : 0);
    }
    case ROW_SHADOW: {
        int v = ngb_pc_setting(2);
        return v >= 10 ? T_SHADOW10 : T_SHADOW0 + (v >= 8 ? 3 : v >= 4 ? 2 : v >= 2 ? 1 : 0);
    }
    case ROW_DISPLAY: return ngb_pc_setting(3) == 2 ? T_BORDERLESS : ngb_pc_setting(3) ? T_FULL : T_WINDOW;
    case ROW_VSYNC: {
        int v = ngb_pc_setting(4);
        return v == 1 ? T_MAILBOX : v == 2 ? T_ADAPTIVE : v == 3 ? T_FIFO : T_OFF;
    }
    case ROW_FPS:     return ngb_pc_setting(5) ? T_ON : T_OFF;
    case ROW_WINDOW:  return T_WSIZE0 + (uint32_t)ngb_pc_setting(6);
    case ROW_ASPECT:  return T_ASPECT0 + (uint32_t)ngb_pc_setting(7);
    case ROW_SKIP:    return ngb_pc_setting(8) ? T_YES : T_NO;
    case ROW_LAUNCHER: return ngb_pc_setting(9) ? T_YES : T_NO;
    case ROW_HEALTH:  return ngb_pc_setting(11) ? T_ON : T_OFF;
    case ROW_NINPO:   return ngb_pc_setting(12) ? T_ON : T_OFF;
    case ROW_ESSENCE: return ngb_pc_setting(13) ? T_ON : T_OFF;
    case ROW_ALLDIFF: return ngb_pc_setting(14) ? T_YES : T_NO;
    case ROW_SCARABS: return ngb_pc_setting(15) ? T_ON : T_OFF;
    case ROW_ALLCOST: return ngb_pc_setting(16) ? T_YES : T_NO;
    default:          return 0;
    }
}

/* Left/right on a PC row (delta from the menu engine); false for the
 * page's own rows. */
static int pc_value_change(int row, int delta)
{
    int kind = row_kind(row);
    int step = delta > 0 ? 1 : -1;
    if ((kind < ROW_RENDER || kind > ROW_ASPECT) && (kind < ROW_SKIP || kind > ROW_EXTRACOST))
        return 0;
    if (!delta)
        return 1;
    switch (kind) {
    case ROW_RENDER: {
        int v = ngb_pc_setting(0) + step;
        ngb_pc_set_setting(0, v < 1 ? 10 : v > 10 ? 1 : v);
        break;
    }
    case ROW_SHADOW: {
        static const int steps[] = { 1, 2, 4, 8, 10 };
        int v = ngb_pc_setting(2), i = 0;
        while (i < 4 && steps[i] != v) i++;
        ngb_pc_set_setting(2, steps[(i + step + 5) % 5]);
        break;
    }
    case ROW_TEXTURE: {
        static const int steps[] = { 0, 2, 4, 8, 16 };
        int v = ngb_pc_setting(1), i = 0;
        while (i < 4 && steps[i] != v) i++;
        ngb_pc_set_setting(1, steps[(i + step + 5) % 5]);
        break;
    }
    case ROW_MSAA: {
        static const int steps[] = { 1, 2, 4, 8 };
        int v = ngb_pc_setting(10), i = 0;
        while (i < 3 && steps[i] != v) i++;
        ngb_pc_set_setting(10, steps[(i + step + 4) % 4]);
        break;
    }
    case ROW_DISPLAY: ngb_pc_set_setting(3, (ngb_pc_setting(3) + (step > 0 ? 1 : 2)) % 3); break;
    case ROW_VSYNC:   ngb_pc_set_setting(4, ngb_vsync_step(ngb_pc_setting(4), step)); break;
    case ROW_FPS:     ngb_pc_set_setting(5, !ngb_pc_setting(5)); break;
    case ROW_SKIP:    ngb_pc_set_setting(8, !ngb_pc_setting(8)); break;
    case ROW_LAUNCHER: ngb_pc_set_setting(9, !ngb_pc_setting(9)); break;
    case ROW_ALLDIFF: ngb_pc_set_setting(14, !ngb_pc_setting(14)); break;
    case ROW_SCARABS: ngb_pc_set_setting(15, !ngb_pc_setting(15)); break;
    case ROW_ALLCOST: ngb_pc_set_setting(16, !ngb_pc_setting(16)); break;
    case ROW_HEALTH:
    case ROW_NINPO:
    case ROW_ESSENCE: {
        int which = 11 + kind - ROW_HEALTH;
        ngb_pc_set_setting(which, !ngb_pc_setting(which));
        break;
    }
    case ROW_ASPECT:  ngb_pc_set_setting(7, (ngb_pc_setting(7) + (step > 0 ? 1 : 3)) % 4); break;
    case ROW_WINDOW: {
        int v = ngb_pc_setting(6), a = v / 8, n = ngb_settings_size_count(a);
        ngb_pc_set_setting(6, a * 8 + (v % 8 + step + n) % n);
        break;
    }
    }
    return 1;
}

/**
 * sub_00220870
 * Original: 0x00220870 - 0x00220A5A (490 bytes, 106 insns)
 * CC: cdecl, 0 params, returns int_or_void
 * Frame: fpo_leaf
 */
void sub_00220870(void)
{
    /* PC: the original, in C, with the PC rows' descriptions. The page
     * level (0 the tabs, 1 a tab's rows, 2 a page of its own), the tab and
     * the row pick a description text id (category 2) into [ecx]. */
    static const uint16_t tabs[] = { 0x48, 0x32, 0x33, 0x34, 0x35, 0x36 };
    static const uint16_t general_all[] = { 0x49, 0x37, 0x38, 0x39, 0x4A, 0x3A, 0x3B };
    static const uint16_t general_noflag[] = { 0x49, 0x37, 0x38, 0x39, 0x3A, 0x3B, 0x3B };
    const uint16_t *general = ngb_general_no_flag() ? general_noflag : general_all;
    static const uint16_t audio[] = { 0x3C, 0x3D, 0x3E, 0x3F, 0x3A, 0x3B };
    static const uint16_t control[] = { 0x40, 0x43, 0x44, 0x45, 0x3A, 0x3B };
    static const uint16_t video_kind[] = { 0x46, 0x47, D_PC & 0xFFFF, 0x3A, 0x3B,
                                           D_RENDER & 0xFFFF, D_TEXTURE & 0xFFFF,
                                           D_SHADOW & 0xFFFF, D_DISPLAY & 0xFFFF,
                                           D_VSYNC & 0xFFFF, D_FPS & 0xFFFF,
                                           D_WINDOWSZ & 0xFFFF, D_ASPECT & 0xFFFF, D_BACK & 0xFFFF,
                                           D_SKIP & 0xFFFF, D_LAUNCHER & 0xFFFF, D_MSAA & 0xFFFF,
                                           D_HEALTH & 0xFFFF, D_NINPO & 0xFFFF, D_ESSENCE & 0xFFFF,
                                           D_ALLDIFF & 0xFFFF, D_SCARABS & 0xFFFF, D_ALLCOST & 0xFFFF,
                                           D_EXTRACOST & 0xFFFF };
    RECOMP_ENTRY(0x00220870u);
    uint32_t out = ecx;
    uint32_t level = MEM16(0x8DE430), tab = MEM16(0x8DE4CC), row = MEM16(0x8DE468);
    uint16_t id = 0;

    pc_menu_init();
    {   /* PC: the Controls panel (src/pause_tab.c) over RECOMP SETTINGS' Controls page (the game's own
         * Button Settings is left as it is: over it, leaving it showed its page and moved its cursor;
         * NGB_CONTROLS_IN_OPTIONS=1 puts it there too) */
        extern void ngb_controls_panel_tick(int want);
        int ours = s_recomp && page_now() == PAGE_CTRL;
        int game = !s_recomp && level == 2 && tab == 2 && getenv("NGB_CONTROLS_IN_OPTIONS");
        ngb_controls_panel_tick(ours || game);
        if (ours || game) {
            MEM16(out) = (uint16_t)(D_CONTROLS & 0xFFFF);   /* the panel's line */
            esp += 4; return;
        }
    }
    if (s_recomp && is_ours(page_now())) {
        int kind = row_kind((int)row);
        if (kind >= 0)
            id = video_kind[kind];
    } else if (s_recomp && level == 0) {                /* RECOMP SETTINGS' categories */
        id = tab == PAGE_CHEAT - PAGE_GFX ? (uint16_t)(D_CHEATS & 0xFFFF)
           : tab == PAGE_CTRL - PAGE_GFX ? (uint16_t)(D_CONTROLS & 0xFFFF)
           : tab < N_OURS ? (uint16_t)((D_CAT0 + tab) & 0xFFFF) : 0x36;
    } else if (level == 0) {
        if (tab < 6)
            id = tabs[tab];
    } else if (level == 1) {
        if (tab == 0 && row < 7) id = general[row];
        else if (tab == 1 && row < 6) id = audio[row];
        else if (tab == 2 && row < 6) id = control[row];
        else if (tab == 3) {
            int kind = row_kind((int)row);
            if (kind >= 0)
                id = video_kind[kind];
        }
    } else if (level == 2) {
        if (MEM16(0x8DE4CC) == 2)
            id = row < 0xA ? 0x41 : 0x3A;
    }
    MEM16(out) = id;
    esp += 4; return; /* ret */
}

/* The menus' and HUD's narrowing: the game lays them out for 4:3 and draws
 * them over the 3D whatever the screen's shape, stretched at 16:9. The
 * Direct3D renderer draws its screen-space draws into the back buffer
 * (the menus, the HUD, the words) narrowed by this about the middle, in a
 * 4:3 area there (src/d3d/vk/backend.cpp); what spans the screen spans it
 * still. 4:3 over the screen's shape; 1 at 4:3, or with NGB_HUD_STRETCH=1
 * (the console's way). */
float ngb_hud_shape(void)
{
    static int stretch = -1;
    if (stretch < 0)
        stretch = getenv("NGB_HUD_STRETCH") != NULL;
    if (stretch)
        return 1.0f;
    int a = ngb_pc_setting(7);
    return a == 1 ? 0.75f : a == 2 ? 0.8333333f : a == 3 ? 0.5625f : 1.0f;
}
```

```c
/*
 * playtime.c -- Total Play Time, kept sane.
 *
 * The game keeps the time played as milliseconds at 0xD7D2C0 (loaded from
 * the save, 0xDB9380) and reports it (sub_001DB330) as that plus the
 * kernel tick count, capped at 999:59. Builds before the tick count started
 * at the console's boot handed the game the PC's uptime, so saves made with
 * them hold the cap, and the game shows 999:59 for ever after. A total at
 * the cap is taken for that and started again from 0; no real save gets
 * there (the lifted function is renamed playtime_get, behind a wrapper).
 */
#define RECOMP_GENERATED_CODE
#include "recomp_funcs.h"
#include <stdio.h>

#define PLAYTIME_CAP 3599940000u          /* 999:59 in ms */

static void playtime_get(void);

void sub_001DB330(void)
{
    if (MEM32(0xD7D2C0) >= PLAYTIME_CAP) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[PLAYTIME] the saved total was the 999:59 cap (an old build's): from 0\n");
        MEM32(0xD7D2C0) = 0;
        if (MEM32(0xDB9380) >= PLAYTIME_CAP)
            MEM32(0xDB9380) = 0;
    }
    playtime_get();
}
```

```h
/*
 * port.h -- the few host calls that differ between hosts, for the hand-written code.
 *
 * ngb_mkdir: make a directory (0 on success). ngb_exe_path: the running program's path, with '/'
 * separators (its length, or -1). ngb_home: the user's home ($HOME; on Windows %USERPROFILE%, else $HOME).
 * ngb_mem_write/ngb_mem_read: this process's memory, whatever its protection; 0 when the address is
 * not mapped (the game's read-only constants, before its image is). On Windows also setenv and
 * unsetenv, which its C runtime does not have.
 */
#ifndef NGB_PORT_H
#define NGB_PORT_H

#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <direct.h>
#include <unistd.h>   /* (mingw's: usleep, access) */
#include <windows.h>

static inline int ngb_mkdir(const char *path) { return _mkdir(path); }

static inline long ngb_exe_path(char *out, size_t n)
{
    DWORD len = GetModuleFileNameA(NULL, out, (DWORD)n);
    if (!len || len >= n)
        return -1;
    for (DWORD i = 0; i < len; i++)
        if (out[i] == '\\')
            out[i] = '/';
    return (long)len;
}

static inline const char *ngb_home(void)
{
    /* %USERPROFILE% first: a HOME there can be a Unix path (Proton passes Linux's through) */
    const char *h = getenv("USERPROFILE");
    return h && *h ? h : getenv("HOME");
}

static inline int ngb_mem_write(void *addr, const void *src, size_t len)
{
    SIZE_T done = 0;
    return WriteProcessMemory(GetCurrentProcess(), addr, src, len, &done) && done == len;
}

static inline int ngb_mem_read(const void *addr, void *dst, size_t len)
{
    SIZE_T done = 0;
    return ReadProcessMemory(GetCurrentProcess(), addr, dst, len, &done) && done == len;
}

#ifndef __cplusplus
static inline int setenv(const char *name, const char *value, int overwrite)
{
    if (!overwrite && getenv(name))
        return 0;
    return _putenv_s(name, value);
}

static inline int unsetenv(const char *name) { return _putenv_s(name, ""); }

#endif

#elif defined(__APPLE__)
#include <mach/mach.h>
#include <mach/mach_vm.h>
#include <mach-o/dyld.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>
static inline int ngb_mkdir(const char *path) { return mkdir(path, 0755); }
static inline long ngb_exe_path(char *out, size_t n)
{
    uint32_t size = (uint32_t)n;
    return _NSGetExecutablePath(out, &size) == 0 ? (long)strlen(out) : -1;
}
static inline const char *ngb_home(void) { return getenv("HOME"); }

static inline void ngb_macos_dir(char *out, size_t n, const char *name, int make)
{
    const char *home = ngb_home();
    snprintf(out, n, "%s/Library/Application Support/NinjaGaidenBlack", home ? home : ".");
    if (make)
        ngb_mkdir(out);
    size_t len = strlen(out);
    snprintf(out + len, n - len, "/%s", name);
    if (make)
        ngb_mkdir(out);
}

static inline int ngb_mem_read(const void *addr, void *dst, size_t len)
{
    mach_vm_size_t done = 0;
    return mach_vm_read_overwrite(mach_task_self(), (mach_vm_address_t)addr, len,
                                  (mach_vm_address_t)dst, &done) == KERN_SUCCESS
        && done == len;
}
static inline int ngb_mem_write(void *addr, const void *src, size_t len)
{
    mach_vm_address_t region = (mach_vm_address_t)addr;
    mach_vm_size_t span = 0;
    vm_region_basic_info_data_64_t info;
    mach_msg_type_number_t count = VM_REGION_BASIC_INFO_COUNT_64;
    mach_port_t object = MACH_PORT_NULL;
    if (mach_vm_region(mach_task_self(), &region, &span, VM_REGION_BASIC_INFO_64,
                       (vm_region_info_t)&info, &count, &object) != KERN_SUCCESS)
        return 0;
    if (object)
        mach_port_deallocate(mach_task_self(), object);
    if ((mach_vm_address_t)addr < region || (mach_vm_address_t)addr + len > region + span)
        return 0;
    if (!(info.protection & VM_PROT_WRITE) &&
        mach_vm_protect(mach_task_self(), (mach_vm_address_t)addr, len, FALSE,
                        info.protection | VM_PROT_WRITE | VM_PROT_COPY) != KERN_SUCCESS)
        return 0;
    int ok = mach_vm_write(mach_task_self(), (mach_vm_address_t)addr, (vm_offset_t)src,
                           (mach_msg_type_number_t)len) == KERN_SUCCESS;
    if (!(info.protection & VM_PROT_WRITE))
        mach_vm_protect(mach_task_self(), (mach_vm_address_t)addr, len, FALSE, info.protection);
    return ok;
}
#else /* Linux */
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>

static inline int ngb_mkdir(const char *path) { return mkdir(path, 0755); }

static inline long ngb_exe_path(char *out, size_t n)
{
    ssize_t len = readlink("/proc/self/exe", out, n - 1);
    if (len <= 0)
        return -1;
    out[len] = 0;
    return (long)len;
}

static inline const char *ngb_home(void) { return getenv("HOME"); }

static inline int ngb_mem_fd(void)
{
    static int fd = -2;
    if (fd == -2)
        fd = open("/proc/self/mem", O_RDWR);
    return fd;
}

static inline int ngb_mem_write(void *addr, const void *src, size_t len)
{
    return ngb_mem_fd() >= 0 && pwrite(ngb_mem_fd(), src, len, (off_t)(uintptr_t)addr) == (ssize_t)len;
}

static inline int ngb_mem_read(const void *addr, void *dst, size_t len)
{
    return ngb_mem_fd() >= 0 && pread(ngb_mem_fd(), dst, len, (off_t)(uintptr_t)addr) == (ssize_t)len;
}
#endif

/* The settings' folder, made if make: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME or ~/.config, on Windows %APPDATA%, then
 * NinjaGaidenBlack. */
static inline void ngb_config_dir(char *out, size_t n, int make)
{
    const char *xdg = getenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME"), *own = getenv("NGB_CONFIG_DIR");
    if (own && *own) {   /* the folder itself (portable mode, src/main.c) */
        snprintf(out, n, "%s", own);
        if (make)
            ngb_mkdir(out);
        return;
    }
#ifdef _WIN32
    const char *appdata = getenv("APPDATA");
    if ((!xdg || !*xdg) && appdata && *appdata) {
        snprintf(out, n, "%s/NinjaGaidenBlack", appdata);
        if (make)
            ngb_mkdir(out);
        return;
    }
#endif
    if (xdg && *xdg) {
        snprintf(out, n, "%s/NinjaGaidenBlack", xdg);
    } else {
#ifdef __APPLE__
        ngb_macos_dir(out, n, "config", make);
#else
        const char *home = ngb_home();
        snprintf(out, n, "%s/.config", home ? home : ".");
        if (make)
            ngb_mkdir(out);
        snprintf(out, n, "%s/.config/NinjaGaidenBlack", home ? home : ".");
#endif
    }
    if (make)
        ngb_mkdir(out);
}

#endif
```

`src/recomp_manual.c`:

```c
/**
 * Manual function overrides and ICALL diagnostics
 *
 * This file provides:
 *   - recomp_lookup_manual()  : intercept specific Xbox VAs with hand-written code
 *   - recomp_icall_fail_log() : log when an indirect call target can't be resolved
 *   - ICALL trace ring buffer  : globals used by the RECOMP_ICALL macro
 *
 * The recomp pipeline generates an auto-dispatch table (recomp_lookup) that
 * resolves most function addresses. recomp_lookup_manual() is called FIRST,
 * giving you a chance to override any function with a custom implementation.
 *
 * Common reasons to add manual overrides:
 *   - Trace a function to understand call flow (wrap the generated version)
 *   - Fix a function the lifter translated incorrectly
 *   - Stub out a function that crashes (return early, set eax to a safe value)
 *   - Redirect a function to a native implementation (e.g., skip CRT init)
 *   - Intercept D3D/audio calls for custom rendering or sound
 */

#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

/* ── ICALL trace ring buffer ───────────────────────────────── */

/*
 * These globals are written by the RECOMP_ICALL macro (defined in
 * recomp_types.h) every time an indirect call is dispatched. When a
 * crash occurs, the VEH handler or recomp_icall_fail_log() can dump
 * the last 16 call targets to help you trace what happened.
 *
 * The runtime owns them: xbox_kernel defines all three in
 * src/kernel/xbox_memory_layout.c, and recomp_types.h declares them extern.
 * Declare, do not define -- a definition here as well is a duplicate symbol,
 * and a project copied from this template failed to link on all three:
 *
 *   xbox_memory_layout.obj : error LNK2005: g_icall_count already defined
 *                            in recomp_manual.obj
 */
extern volatile uint32_t g_icall_trace[16];
extern volatile uint32_t g_icall_trace_idx;
extern volatile uint64_t g_icall_count;

typedef void (*recomp_func_t)(void);

/* ── Register state (defined in xbox_memory_layout.c) ──────── */

extern ptrdiff_t g_xbox_mem_offset;

/* ── Manual function overrides ─────────────────────────────── */

/*
 * Return a function pointer to override the given Xbox VA, or NULL
 * to fall through to the auto-generated dispatch table.
 *
 * This is called on every indirect call (RECOMP_ICALL) and every
 * direct call through the dispatch table, so keep it fast. A chain
 * of if-statements on uint32_t compiles to a simple comparison
 * sequence; for large override tables, consider a sorted array
 * with binary search.
 *
 * Examples of common override patterns:
 *
 *   // Trace wrapper: log entry/exit around the generated function
 *   extern void sub_00012345(void);
 *   static void traced_sub_00012345(void) {
 *       fprintf(stderr, "[TRACE] sub_00012345 entered, eax=0x%08X\n", g_eax);
 *       sub_00012345();
 *       fprintf(stderr, "[TRACE] sub_00012345 returned, eax=0x%08X\n", g_eax);
 *   }
 *
 *   // Stub: skip a function entirely (return 0 in eax)
 *   static void stub_00067890(void) {
 *       g_eax = 0;
 *   }
 *
 *   // Fix: replace a broken lifted function with correct C
 *   static void fixed_sub_000ABCDE(void) {
 *       // Read arguments from stack/registers per calling convention
 *       uint32_t arg1 = g_ecx;
 *       uint32_t arg2 = MEM32(g_esp + 4);
 *       // ... correct implementation ...
 *       g_eax = result;
 *   }
 */
/* NGB_ICALL_HIST=1: count indirect-call targets and print the most frequent
 * every 5 s -- which vtable methods (scene, task, effect) the title runs. */
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <time.h>
#define HIST_SLOTS 8192
static uint32_t s_hist_va[HIST_SLOTS];
static uint32_t s_hist_n[HIST_SLOTS];

static void icall_hist(uint32_t va)
{
    static int on = -1;
    static time_t last;
    uint32_t h;

    if (on < 0)
        on = getenv("NGB_ICALL_HIST") != NULL;
    if (!on)
        return;
    h = (va * 2654435761u) & (HIST_SLOTS - 1);
    while (s_hist_va[h] && s_hist_va[h] != va)
        h = (h + 1) & (HIST_SLOTS - 1);
    s_hist_va[h] = va;
    __atomic_fetch_add(&s_hist_n[h], 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (time(NULL) - last >= 5) {
        last = time(NULL);
        fprintf(stderr, "[ICALLS] last 5 s:\n");
        for (int k = 0; k < 30; k++) {
            uint32_t best = 0, bi = 0;
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < HIST_SLOTS; i++)
                if (s_hist_n[i] > best) { best = s_hist_n[i]; bi = i; }
            if (!best) break;
            fprintf(stderr, "  %8u  0x%08X\n", best, s_hist_va[bi]);
            s_hist_n[bi] = 0;
        }
        memset(s_hist_n, 0, sizeof(s_hist_n));
    }
}

recomp_func_t recomp_lookup_manual(uint32_t xbox_va)
{
    icall_hist(xbox_va);
    /*
     * TODO: Add your overrides here. Examples:
     *
     * if (xbox_va == 0x00012345) return traced_sub_00012345;
     * if (xbox_va == 0x00067890) return stub_00067890;
     * if (xbox_va == 0x000ABCDE) return fixed_sub_000ABCDE;
     */

    (void)xbox_va;
    return (recomp_func_t)0;
}

/* ── ICALL failure logging ─────────────────────────────────── */

/*
 * Called when RECOMP_ICALL cannot resolve a target address.
 * This usually means one of:
 *   - A vtable dispatch to an address not in the dispatch table
 *   - A function pointer loaded from uninitialized or corrupt memory
 *   - A kernel thunk address that the bridge doesn't handle
 *
 * During early bring-up you will see many of these. Most are harmless
 * (the ICALL macro pops the dummy return address and continues).
 * Focus on the ones that cause crashes or incorrect behavior.
 */
void recomp_icall_fail_log(uint32_t va)
{
    fprintf(stderr, "[ICALL] Failed to resolve VA 0x%08X (total calls: %llu)\n",
            va, (unsigned long long)g_icall_count);

    /* Dump last 16 call targets from the ring buffer */
    fprintf(stderr, "  Recent ICALL targets:\n");
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        int idx = (g_icall_trace_idx - 16 + i) & 15;
        if (g_icall_trace[idx])
            fprintf(stderr, "    [%2d] 0x%08X\n", i, g_icall_trace[idx]);
    }
    fflush(stderr);
}

/* An indirect call whose target is not code: a null or wild function pointer.
 *
 * Skipping these is right -- calling a data address is worse -- but skipping
 * them *silently* is not. They almost always arrive inside a loop, so the
 * symptom is a hang with no output rather than a diagnosable null vtable call.
 *
 * Rate-limited per address: a spin can produce millions of these, and the
 * useful information is which addresses occur, not how often.
 */
void recomp_icall_not_code_log(uint32_t va)
{
    enum { SLOTS = 16 };
    static uint32_t seen[SLOTS];
    static uint64_t hits[SLOTS];
    static int count;
    int i;

    for (i = 0; i < count; i++)
        if (seen[i] == va)
            break;
    if (i == count) {
        if (count == SLOTS)
            return;
        seen[count] = va;
        hits[count] = 0;
        count++;
    }
    hits[i]++;
    /* Report at 1, 10, 100, 1000 ... rather than once. A single line says a
     * wild pointer was skipped; the progression says it is being skipped in a
     * loop, which is the difference between a curiosity and the reason the
     * title is hung. */
    {
        uint64_t n = hits[i];
        while (n >= 10 && n % 10 == 0)
            n /= 10;
        if (n != 1)
            return;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "[ICALL] target 0x%08X is not code -- skipped %llu time(s) "
                    "(null or wild function pointer, at call #%llu)\n",
            va, (unsigned long long)hits[i],
            (unsigned long long)g_icall_count);
    fflush(stderr);
}

/* ── Untranslated instructions ───────────────────────────────────────────
 *
 * The lifter emits RECOMP_UNIMPL(text, va) at every instruction it has no
 * translation for, in place of the bare comment it used to leave. The
 * instruction is still a no-op; this only stops the omission being silent.
 * RECOMP_UNIMPL_TRAP=1 aborts at the first hit, at the guest address of the
 * cause rather than wherever the damage surfaces. */
#include <stdlib.h>

void recomp_unimpl(const char *text, uint32_t va)
{
    static int printed, stop = -1;
    if (stop < 0) {                       /* (once: getenv takes the C runtime's lock) */
        const char *trap = getenv("RECOMP_UNIMPL_TRAP");
        stop = trap && *trap && *trap != '0';
    }

    if (printed < 50 || stop) {
        printed++;
        fprintf(stderr,
                "[UNIMPL] untranslated instruction REACHED: `%s` at 0x%08X"
                " (a no-op; set RECOMP_UNIMPL_TRAP=1 to stop here)\n",
                text, va);
        fflush(stderr);
    }
    if (stop) abort();
}
```
