```c
            SurfaceBinding *other = (color ? r->zeta_binding
                                           : r->color_binding);
            if (surface == other) {
                NV2A_UNIMPLEMENTED("Same color & zeta surface offset");
                unbind_surface(d, !color);
            }
        }

        trace_nv2a_pgraph_surface_target(
            color ? "COLOR" : "ZETA", target.vram_addr,
            target.swizzle ? "sz" : "ln",
            pg->surface_shape.anti_aliasing,
            pg->surface_shape.clip_x,
            pg->surface_shape.clip_width, pg->surface_shape.clip_y,
            pg->surface_shape.clip_height);

        bool should_create = true;

        if (surface != NULL) {
            bool is_compatible =
                check_surface_compatibility(surface, &target, false);

            void (*trace_fn)(uint32_t addr, uint32_t width, uint32_t height,
                             const char *layout, uint32_t anti_aliasing,
                             uint32_t clip_x, uint32_t clip_width,
                             uint32_t clip_y, uint32_t clip_height,
                             uint32_t pitch) =
                surface->color ? trace_nv2a_pgraph_surface_match_color :
                               trace_nv2a_pgraph_surface_match_zeta;

            trace_fn(surface->vram_addr, surface->width, surface->height,
                     surface->swizzle ? "sz" : "ln", surface->shape.anti_aliasing,
                     surface->shape.clip_x, surface->shape.clip_width,
                     surface->shape.clip_y, surface->shape.clip_height,
                     surface->pitch);

            assert(!(target.swizzle && pg->clearing));

#if 0
            if (surface->swizzle != target.swizzle) {
                // Clears should only be done on linear surfaces. Avoid
                // synchronization by allowing (1) a surface marked swizzled to
                // be cleared under the assumption the entire surface is
                // destined to be cleared and (2) a fully cleared linear surface
                // to be marked swizzled. Strictly match size to avoid
                // pathological cases.
                is_compatible &= (pg->clearing || surface->cleared) &&
                    check_surface_compatibility(surface, &target, true);
                if (is_compatible) {
                    trace_nv2a_pgraph_surface_migrate_type(
                        target.swizzle ? "swizzled" : "linear");
                }
            }
#endif

            if (is_compatible && color &&
                !check_surface_compatibility(surface, &target, true)) {
                SurfaceBinding zeta_entry;
                populate_surface_binding_target_sized(
                    d, !color, surface->width, surface->height, &zeta_entry);
                hwaddr color_end = surface->vram_addr + surface->size;
                hwaddr zeta_end = zeta_entry.vram_addr + zeta_entry.size;
                is_compatible &= surface->vram_addr >= zeta_end ||
                                 zeta_entry.vram_addr >= color_end;
            }

            if (is_compatible && !color && r->color_binding) {
                is_compatible &= (surface->width == r->color_binding->width) &&
                                 (surface->height == r->color_binding->height);
            }

            if (is_compatible) {
                // FIXME: Refactor
                pg->surface_binding_dim.width = surface->width;
                pg->surface_binding_dim.clip_x = surface->shape.clip_x;
                pg->surface_binding_dim.clip_width = surface->shape.clip_width;
                pg->surface_binding_dim.height = surface->height;
                pg->surface_binding_dim.clip_y = surface->shape.clip_y;
                pg->surface_binding_dim.clip_height = surface->shape.clip_height;
                surface->upload_pending |= mem_dirty;
                pg->surface_zeta.buffer_dirty |= color;
                should_create = false;
            } else {
                trace_nv2a_pgraph_surface_evict_reason(
                    "incompatible", surface->vram_addr);
                compare_surfaces(surface, &target);
                pgraph_vk_surface_download_if_dirty(d, surface);
                invalidate_surface(d, surface);
            }
        }

        if (should_create) {
            surface = get_any_compatible_invalid_surface(r, &target);
            if (surface) {
                migrate_surface_image(&target, surface);
            } else {
                surface = g_malloc(sizeof(SurfaceBinding));
                create_surface_image(pg, &target);
            }

            *surface = target;
            set_surface_label(pg, surface);
            surface_put(d, surface);

            // FIXME: Refactor
            pg->surface_binding_dim.width = target.width;
            pg->surface_binding_dim.clip_x = target.shape.clip_x;
            pg->surface_binding_dim.clip_width = target.shape.clip_width;
            pg->surface_binding_dim.height = target.height;
            pg->surface_binding_dim.clip_y = target.shape.clip_y;
            pg->surface_binding_dim.clip_height = target.shape.clip_height;

            if (color && r->zeta_binding &&
                (r->zeta_binding->width != target.width ||
                 r->zeta_binding->height != target.height)) {
                pg->surface_zeta.buffer_dirty = true;
            }
        }

        void (*trace_fn)(uint32_t addr, uint32_t width, uint32_t height,
                         const char *layout, uint32_t anti_aliasing,
                         uint32_t clip_x, uint32_t clip_width, uint32_t clip_y,
                         uint32_t clip_height, uint32_t pitch) =
            color ? (should_create ? trace_nv2a_pgraph_surface_create_color :
                                     trace_nv2a_pgraph_surface_hit_color) :
                    (should_create ? trace_nv2a_pgraph_surface_create_zeta :
                                     trace_nv2a_pgraph_surface_hit_zeta);
        trace_fn(surface->vram_addr, surface->width, surface->height,
                 surface->swizzle ? "sz" : "ln", surface->shape.anti_aliasing,
                 surface->shape.clip_x, surface->shape.clip_width,
                 surface->shape.clip_y, surface->shape.clip_height, surface->pitch);

        bind_surface(r, surface);
        pg_surface->buffer_dirty = false;
    }

    if (!upload && pg_surface->draw_dirty) {
        SurfaceBinding *s = color ? r->color_binding : r->zeta_binding;
        if (!tcg_enabled() && lazy_enabled()) {
            /* xboxrecomp: written back when the CPU first touches it. */
            if (s && s->draw_dirty && !s->lazy_owned) {
                s->lazy_owned = true;
                nv2a_dirty_gpu_own(s->vram_addr, s->size);
            }
        } else if (!tcg_enabled()) {
            // FIXME: Cannot monitor for reads/writes; flush now
            download_surface(d, s, true);
        }

        pg_surface->write_enabled_cache = false;
        pg_surface->draw_dirty = false;
    }
}

// FIXME: Move to common?
void pgraph_vk_surface_update(NV2AState *d, bool upload, bool color_write,
                              bool zeta_write)
{
    PGRAPHState *pg = &d->pgraph;
    PGRAPHVkState *r = pg->vk_renderer_state;

    if (nv2a_vk_draws_off())
        return;
    pg->surface_shape.z_format =
        GET_MASK(pgraph_reg_r(pg, NV_PGRAPH_SETUPRASTER),
                 NV_PGRAPH_SETUPRASTER_Z_FORMAT);

    color_write = color_write &&
            (pg->clearing || pgraph_color_write_enabled(pg));
    zeta_write = zeta_write && (pg->clearing || pgraph_zeta_write_enabled(pg));

    if (upload) {
        bool fb_dirty = framebuffer_dirty(pg);
        if (fb_dirty) {
            /* xboxrecomp: the render scale applies to display-sized targets
             * only. A title computing on the GPU -- Ninja Gaiden Black
             * simulates Ryu's scarf by rendering into small texture targets
             * and sampling the result -- needs those passes at native size:
             * at 3x each sample landed a third of a pixel off, was filtered
             * with its neighbours, and the cloth broke (a rigid plank, like
             * the stale-vertex bug). Small or swizzled targets stay at 1x. */
            {
                unsigned int user = g_config.display.quality.surface_scale;
                bool big = pg->surface_shape.clip_width >= 640 &&
                           pg->surface_shape.clip_height >= 448 &&
                           pg->surface_type != NV097_SET_SURFACE_FORMAT_TYPE_SWIZZLE;
                unsigned int want = (big && user > 1) ? user : 1;
                /* xboxrecomp: a small depth-only target is a shadow map
                 * (Ninja Gaiden Black renders Ryu's shadow into 128x128);
                 * NV2A_SHADOW_SCALE renders it at that multiple. */
                if (!big && !color_write && zeta_write) {
                    if (pgraph_vk_shadow_scale < 1) {
                        const char *e = getenv("NV2A_SHADOW_SCALE");
                        int v = e ? atoi(e) : 1;
                        pgraph_vk_shadow_scale = v < 1 ? 1 : v > 10 ? 10 : v;
                    }
                    want = pgraph_vk_shadow_scale;
                }
                if (want != pg->surface_scale_factor) {
                    pgraph_vk_ensure_not_in_render_pass(pg);
                    pg->surface_scale_factor = want;
                    pg->surface_color.buffer_dirty = true;
                    pg->surface_zeta.buffer_dirty = true;
                }
            }
            memcpy(&pg->last_surface_shape, &pg->surface_shape,
                   sizeof(SurfaceShape));
            pg->surface_color.buffer_dirty = true;
            pg->surface_zeta.buffer_dirty = true;
        }

        if (pg->surface_color.buffer_dirty) {
            unbind_surface(d, true);
        }

        if (color_write) {
            update_surface_part(d, true, true);
        }

        if (pg->surface_zeta.buffer_dirty) {
            unbind_surface(d, false);
        }

        if (zeta_write) {
            update_surface_part(d, true, false);
        }
    } else {
        if ((color_write || pg->surface_color.write_enabled_cache)
            && pg->surface_color.draw_dirty) {
            update_surface_part(d, false, true);
        }
        if ((zeta_write || pg->surface_zeta.write_enabled_cache)
            && pg->surface_zeta.draw_dirty) {
            update_surface_part(d, false, false);
        }
    }

    if (upload) {
        pg->draw_time++;
    }

    bool swizzle = (pg->surface_type == NV097_SET_SURFACE_FORMAT_TYPE_SWIZZLE);

    if (r->color_binding) {
        r->color_binding->frame_time = pg->frame_time;
        if (upload) {
            pgraph_vk_upload_surface_data(d, r->color_binding, false);
            r->color_binding->draw_time = pg->draw_time;
            r->color_binding->swizzle = swizzle;
        }
    }

    if (r->zeta_binding) {
        r->zeta_binding->frame_time = pg->frame_time;
        if (upload) {
            pgraph_vk_upload_surface_data(d, r->zeta_binding, false);
            r->zeta_binding->draw_time = pg->draw_time;
            r->zeta_binding->swizzle = swizzle;
        }
    }

    // Sanity check color and zeta dimensions match
    if (r->color_binding && r->zeta_binding) {
        assert(r->color_binding->width == r->zeta_binding->width);
        assert(r->color_binding->height == r->zeta_binding->height);
    }

    expire_old_surfaces(d);
    prune_invalid_surfaces(r, num_invalid_surfaces_to_keep);
}

static bool check_format_and_usage_supported(PGRAPHVkState *r, VkFormat format,
                                             VkImageUsageFlags usage)
{
    VkPhysicalDeviceImageFormatInfo2 pdif2 = {
        .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_IMAGE_FORMAT_INFO_2,
        .format = format,
        .type = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D,
        .tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL,
        .usage = usage,
    };
    VkImageFormatProperties2 props = {
        .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_FORMAT_PROPERTIES_2,
    };
    VkResult result = vkGetPhysicalDeviceImageFormatProperties2(
        r->physical_device, &pdif2, &props);
    return result == VK_SUCCESS;
}

static bool check_surface_internal_formats_supported(
    PGRAPHVkState *r, const SurfaceFormatInfo *fmts, size_t count)
{
    bool all_supported = true;
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const SurfaceFormatInfo *f = &fmts[i];
        if (f->host_bytes_per_pixel) {
            all_supported &=
                check_format_and_usage_supported(r, f->vk_format, f->usage);
        }
    }
    return all_supported;
}

void pgraph_vk_init_surfaces(PGRAPHState *pg)
{
    PGRAPHVkState *r = pg->vk_renderer_state;

    if (lazy_enabled())
        nv2a_dirty_set_gpu_fault_handler(lazy_fault);

    // Make sure all surface format types are supported. We don't expect issue
    // with these, and therefore have no fallback mechanism.
    bool color_formats_supported = check_surface_internal_formats_supported(
        r, kelvin_surface_color_format_vk_map,
        ARRAY_SIZE(kelvin_surface_color_format_vk_map));
    assert(color_formats_supported);

    // Check if the device supports preferred VK_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT
    // format, fall back to D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT otherwise.
    r->kelvin_surface_zeta_vk_map[NV097_SET_SURFACE_FORMAT_ZETA_Z16] = zeta_d16;
    if (check_surface_internal_formats_supported(r, &zeta_d24_unorm_s8_uint,
                                                 1)) {
        r->kelvin_surface_zeta_vk_map[NV097_SET_SURFACE_FORMAT_ZETA_Z24S8] =
            zeta_d24_unorm_s8_uint;
    } else if (check_surface_internal_formats_supported(
                   r, &zeta_d32_sfloat_s8_uint, 1)) {
        r->kelvin_surface_zeta_vk_map[NV097_SET_SURFACE_FORMAT_ZETA_Z24S8] =
            zeta_d32_sfloat_s8_uint;
    } else {
        assert(!"No suitable depth-stencil format supported");
    }

    QTAILQ_INIT(&r->surfaces);
    QTAILQ_INIT(&r->invalid_surfaces);

    r->downloads_pending = false;
    qemu_event_init(&r->downloads_complete, false);
    qemu_event_init(&r->dirty_surfaces_download_complete, false);

    r->color_binding = NULL;
    r->zeta_binding = NULL;
    r->framebuffer_dirty = true;

    pgraph_vk_reload_surface_scale_factor(pg); // FIXME: Move internal
}

void pgraph_vk_finalize_surfaces(PGRAPHState *pg)
{
    pgraph_vk_surface_flush(container_of(pg, NV2AState, pgraph));
}

void pgraph_vk_surface_flush(NV2AState *d)
{
    PGRAPHState *pg = &d->pgraph;
    PGRAPHVkState *r = pg->vk_renderer_state;

    // Clear last surface shape to force recreation of buffers at next draw
    pg->surface_color.draw_dirty = false;
    pg->surface_zeta.draw_dirty = false;
    memset(&pg->last_surface_shape, 0, sizeof(pg->last_surface_shape));
    unbind_surface(d, true);
    unbind_surface(d, false);

    SurfaceBinding *s, *next;
    QTAILQ_FOREACH_SAFE(s, &r->surfaces, entry, next) {
        // FIXME: We should download all surfaces to ram, but need to
        //        investigate corruption issue
        pgraph_vk_surface_download_if_dirty(d, s);
        invalidate_surface(d, s);
    }
    prune_invalid_surfaces(r, 0);

    pgraph_vk_reload_surface_scale_factor(pg);
}

```

`xboxrecomp/src/nv2a_vk/xemu/pgraph/vk/texpack.c`:

```c
/*
 * texpack.c -- dumping a title's textures and replacing them (xboxrecomp).
 *
 *   NV2A_TEX_DUMP=dir      write each texture the title uploads, once, as
 *                          dir/<id>.png (the top level, as the shader sees
 *                          it: RGBA after the format's swizzle)
 *   NV2A_TEX_DUMP_RAW=1    with NV2A_TEX_DUMP, also the texture's bytes as
 *                          they are in guest memory (<id>.raw), to find
 *                          where a texture comes from in the title's files
 *   (and pgraph_vk_texpack_register: a replacement made by the program)
 *   NV2A_TEX_REPLACE=dir   where dir/<id>.png exists, use it instead of the
 *                          title's texture: any size with the same aspect
 *                          ratio, mipmapped on upload
 *
 * <id> is 16 hex digits: a hash of the texture's bytes in guest memory (and
 * its palette), its format and size. A pack is a folder of such files, made
 * from a dump: edit or upscale the PNGs, keep the names. Nothing of the
 * title's need ship with the program.
 */
#include "renderer.h"
#include <dirent.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <xxhash.h>

#define STB_IMAGE_IMPLEMENTATION
#define STBI_ONLY_PNG
#define STBI_NO_STDIO_WRITE
#include "stb_image.h"
#define STB_IMAGE_WRITE_IMPLEMENTATION
#include "stb_image_write.h"

static char s_dump_dir[1024], s_repl_dir[1024];

/* Replacements given at run time (pgraph_vk_texpack_register): the texture
 * at a guest address, while its bytes are still the ones given. */
typedef struct {
    uint64_t addr, hash, id;
    uint32_t len;
    int w, h;
    uint8_t *rgba;
} MemRepl;
static MemRepl s_mem[96];
static int s_mem_n;
static GMutex s_mem_lock;
#define MEM_ID_BASE 0xFE00000000000000ull
static int s_init;
static GHashTable *s_have;      /* ids with a replacement file */
static GHashTable *s_dumped;    /* ids written or queued this run */
static GAsyncQueue *s_queue;    /* dumps for the writer thread */

typedef struct {
    uint64_t id;
    int w, h;
    uint8_t *rgba;
} DumpJob;

static void *dump_writer(void *arg)
{
    (void)arg;
    for (;;) {
        DumpJob *j = g_async_queue_pop(s_queue);
        char path[1100];
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%016" PRIx64 ".png", s_dump_dir, j->id);
        stbi_write_png(path, j->w, j->h, 4, j->rgba, j->w * 4);
        g_free(j->rgba);
        g_free(j);
    }
    return NULL;
}

static guint id_hash(gconstpointer k)
{
    uint64_t v = *(const uint64_t *)k;
    return (guint)(v ^ (v >> 32));
}

static gboolean id_equal(gconstpointer a, gconstpointer b)
{
    return *(const uint64_t *)a == *(const uint64_t *)b;
}

static void texpack_init(void)
{
    const char *e;

    if (s_init)
        return;
    s_init = 1;
    s_have = g_hash_table_new_full(id_hash, id_equal, g_free, NULL);
    s_dumped = g_hash_table_new_full(id_hash, id_equal, g_free, NULL);

    if ((e = getenv("NV2A_TEX_REPLACE")) && *e) {
        DIR *dir = opendir(e);
        struct dirent *de;
        int n = 0;
        snprintf(s_repl_dir, sizeof s_repl_dir, "%s", e);
        while (dir && (de = readdir(dir))) {
            uint64_t id;
            char tail[8];
            if (sscanf(de->d_name, "%16" SCNx64 "%7s", &id, tail) == 2 &&
                !strcmp(tail, ".png")) {
                uint64_t *k = g_new(uint64_t, 1);
                *k = id;
                g_hash_table_add(s_have, k);
                n++;
            }
        }
        if (dir)
            closedir(dir);
        fprintf(stderr, "nv2a: %d replacement textures in %s\n", n, e);
    }
    if ((e = getenv("NV2A_TEX_DUMP")) && *e) {
        snprintf(s_dump_dir, sizeof s_dump_dir, "%s", e);
        g_mkdir_with_parents(s_dump_dir, 0755);
        s_queue = g_async_queue_new();
        g_thread_new("texdump", dump_writer, NULL);
        fprintf(stderr, "nv2a: dumping textures to %s\n", e);
    }
}

static pgraph_vk_texgen_fn s_gen;

/* A program's own maker of replacements: shown every texture the title
 * uses, as its contents change (the format is the NV2A's texture format
 * number, the palette that of an indexed one); it registers any it makes
 * with pgraph_vk_texpack_register. */
void pgraph_vk_texpack_set_generator(pgraph_vk_texgen_fn fn)
{
    __atomic_store_n(&s_gen, fn, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
}

void pgraph_vk_texpack_generate(uint32_t addr, const void *bytes, uint32_t len,
                                unsigned format, int w, int h, const void *palette)
{
    pgraph_vk_texgen_fn fn = __atomic_load_n(&s_gen, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (fn)
        fn(addr, bytes, len, format, w, h, palette);
}

bool pgraph_vk_texpack_active(void)
{
    texpack_init();
    return s_repl_dir[0] || s_dump_dir[0] || __atomic_load_n(&s_mem_n, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) ||
           __atomic_load_n(&s_gen, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
}

void memory_region_set_client_dirty(MemoryRegion *mr, hwaddr addr, hwaddr size,
                                    unsigned client);

/* Any thread: from now on the texture whose bytes are at guest physical
 * addr (len bytes, as they are now) is drawn from rgba (w x h, RGBA rows,
 * the same aspect ratio), until those bytes change. Again for the same
 * address replaces it. */
void pgraph_vk_texpack_register(uint32_t addr, const void *bytes, uint32_t len,
                                const uint8_t *rgba, int w, int h)
{
    uint64_t hash = XXH3_64bits(bytes, len);
    texpack_init();
    g_mutex_lock(&s_mem_lock);
    int i = 0;
    while (i < s_mem_n && s_mem[i].addr != addr)
        i++;
    if (i == (int)(sizeof s_mem / sizeof s_mem[0])) {   /* full: the oldest goes */
        static int next;
        i = next++ % (int)(sizeof s_mem / sizeof s_mem[0]);
    }
    {
        MemRepl *m = &s_mem[i];
        uint8_t *copy = g_malloc((size_t)w * h * 4);
        memcpy(copy, rgba, (size_t)w * h * 4);
        g_free(m->rgba);
        m->addr = addr;
        m->len = len;
        m->hash = hash;
        m->w = w;
        m->h = h;
        m->rgba = copy;
        m->id = MEM_ID_BASE | ((uint64_t)i << 48) | (hash & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFull);
        if (i == s_mem_n)
            __atomic_store_n(&s_mem_n, i + 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    }
    g_mutex_unlock(&s_mem_lock);
    /* Seen again at its next use, even where page tracking says clean. */
    memory_region_set_client_dirty(NULL, addr, len, DIRTY_MEMORY_NV2A_TEX);
}

/* The replacement for the texture at addr with these bytes, or 0. */
uint64_t pgraph_vk_texpack_mem_id(uint64_t addr, const void *bytes, uint32_t len)
{
    uint64_t id = 0;
    int n = __atomic_load_n(&s_mem_n, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    for (int i = 0; i < n && !id; i++) {
        if (s_mem[i].addr != addr || s_mem[i].len != len)
            continue;
        g_mutex_lock(&s_mem_lock);
        if (XXH3_64bits(bytes, len) == s_mem[i].hash)
            id = s_mem[i].id;
        g_mutex_unlock(&s_mem_lock);
    }
    return id;
}

static MemRepl *mem_find(uint64_t id)
{
    if ((id & 0xFF00000000000000ull) != MEM_ID_BASE)
        return NULL;
    int i = (int)(id >> 48 & 0xFF);
    return i < __atomic_load_n(&s_mem_n, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) && s_mem[i].id == id
           ? &s_mem[i] : NULL;
}

uint64_t pgraph_vk_texpack_id(uint64_t content_hash, const TextureShape *s)
{
    uint64_t v[4] = { content_hash, s->color_format, s->width, s->height };
    return XXH3_64bits(v, sizeof v);
}

bool pgraph_vk_texpack_has(uint64_t id)
{
    texpack_init();
    if (mem_find(id))
        return true;
    return s_repl_dir[0] && g_hash_table_contains(s_have, &id);
}

uint8_t *pgraph_vk_texpack_load(uint64_t id, int *w, int *h)
{
    g_mutex_lock(&s_mem_lock);
    MemRepl *m = mem_find(id);
    if (m) {
        uint8_t *px = malloc((size_t)m->w * m->h * 4);
        memcpy(px, m->rgba, (size_t)m->w * m->h * 4);
        *w = m->w;
        *h = m->h;
        g_mutex_unlock(&s_mem_lock);
        return px;
    }
    g_mutex_unlock(&s_mem_lock);
    char path[1100];
    int n;
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%016" PRIx64 ".png", s_repl_dir, id);
    uint8_t *px = stbi_load(path, w, h, &n, 4);
    if (!px)
        fprintf(stderr, "nv2a: cannot read %s: %s\n", path, stbi_failure_reason());
    return px;
}

void pgraph_vk_texpack_free(uint8_t *px)
{
    stbi_image_free(px);
}

/* One component of a texel through the view's swizzle. */
static uint8_t swz(VkComponentSwizzle s, int self, const uint8_t c[4])
{
    switch (s) {
    case VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_ZERO: return 0;
    case VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_ONE:  return 255;
    case VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_R:    return c[0];
    case VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_G:    return c[1];
    case VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_B:    return c[2];
    case VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_A:    return c[3];
    default:                        return c[self];
    }
}

static inline uint8_t x5(unsigned v) { return (uint8_t)((v << 3) | (v >> 2)); }
static inline uint8_t x6(unsigned v) { return (uint8_t)((v << 2) | (v >> 4)); }
static inline uint8_t x4(unsigned v) { return (uint8_t)(v * 17); }

void pgraph_vk_texpack_dump(uint64_t id, const void *data, int w, int h,
                            VkFormat fmt, VkComponentMapping map)
{
    texpack_init();
    if (!s_dump_dir[0] || w <= 0 || h <= 0 || g_hash_table_contains(s_dumped, &id))
        return;

    const uint8_t *p = data;
    uint8_t *out = g_malloc((size_t)w * h * 4);
    for (int i = 0; i < w * h; i++) {
        uint8_t c[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 255 };
        switch (fmt) {
        case VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM:
            memcpy(c, p + i * 4, 4);
            break;
        case VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM:
            c[0] = p[i * 4 + 2]; c[1] = p[i * 4 + 1]; c[2] = p[i * 4]; c[3] = p[i * 4 + 3];
            break;
        case VK_FORMAT_R5G6B5_UNORM_PACK16: {
            unsigned v = ((const uint16_t *)p)[i];
            c[0] = x5(v >> 11); c[1] = x6((v >> 5) & 63); c[2] = x5(v & 31);
            break;
        }
        case VK_FORMAT_A1R5G5B5_UNORM_PACK16: {
            unsigned v = ((const uint16_t *)p)[i];
            c[0] = x5((v >> 10) & 31); c[1] = x5((v >> 5) & 31); c[2] = x5(v & 31);
            c[3] = (v & 0x8000) ? 255 : 0;
            break;
        }
        case VK_FORMAT_A4R4G4B4_UNORM_PACK16: {
            unsigned v = ((const uint16_t *)p)[i];
            c[0] = x4((v >> 8) & 15); c[1] = x4((v >> 4) & 15); c[2] = x4(v & 15);
            c[3] = x4(v >> 12);
            break;
        }
        case VK_FORMAT_R8_UNORM:
            c[0] = p[i];
            break;
        case VK_FORMAT_R8G8_UNORM:
            c[0] = p[i * 2]; c[1] = p[i * 2 + 1];
            break;
        default:
            g_free(out);
            return;
        }
        out[i * 4 + 0] = swz(map.r, 0, c);
        out[i * 4 + 1] = swz(map.g, 1, c);
        out[i * 4 + 2] = swz(map.b, 2, c);
        out[i * 4 + 3] = swz(map.a, 3, c);
    }

    uint64_t *k = g_new(uint64_t, 1);
    *k = id;
    g_hash_table_add(s_dumped, k);
    DumpJob *j = g_new(DumpJob, 1);
    j->id = id;
    j->w = w;
    j->h = h;
    j->rgba = out;
    g_async_queue_push(s_queue, j);
}

/* Formats a dump can be written from (as decoded for upload). */
bool pgraph_vk_texpack_format_ok(VkFormat fmt)
{
    switch (fmt) {
    case VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM:
    case VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM:
    case VK_FORMAT_R5G6B5_UNORM_PACK16:
    case VK_FORMAT_A1R5G5B5_UNORM_PACK16:
    case VK_FORMAT_A4R4G4B4_UNORM_PACK16:
    case VK_FORMAT_R8_UNORM:
    case VK_FORMAT_R8G8_UNORM:
        return true;
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

void pgraph_vk_texpack_dump_raw(uint64_t id, const void *data, size_t len)
{
    static int on = -1;
    static GHashTable *done;
    char path[1100];
    FILE *f;

    if (on < 0) {
        texpack_init();
        on = s_dump_dir[0] && getenv("NV2A_TEX_DUMP_RAW") != NULL;
        done = g_hash_table_new_full(id_hash, id_equal, g_free, NULL);
    }
    if (!on || g_hash_table_contains(done, &id))
        return;
    uint64_t *k = g_new(uint64_t, 1);
    *k = id;
    g_hash_table_add(done, k);
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%016" PRIx64 ".raw", s_dump_dir, id);
    if ((f = fopen(path, "wb"))) {
        fwrite(data, 1, len, f);
        fclose(f);
    }
}
```

```c
static void texture_cache_release_node_resources(PGRAPHVkState *r, TextureBinding *snode);

static const VkImageType dimensionality_to_vk_image_type[] = {
    0,
    VK_IMAGE_TYPE_1D,
    VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D,
```
