`xboxrecomp/src/platform/mmio_decode.h`:

```h
/*
 * mmio_decode.h -- one x86-64 instruction decoder for trapped MMIO.
 *
 * A device whose registers need semantics cannot be plain memory: the reads
 * have to be answered and the writes have to be seen. The way that works here
 * is to leave the page PAGE_NOACCESS, catch the access in a vectored handler,
 * decode the faulting instruction, service it against the device model, and
 * step over it.
 *
 * That decoder existed twice before this file -- once in nv2a_mmio_hook.c and
 * once in apu_mmio_hook.c -- as the same opcode table written out against two
 * different pairs of accessors. This is the same logic with the accessors
 * passed in, so a third device does not need a third copy. The two originals
 * still carry their own and can move onto this whenever they are next touched.
 *
 * Header-only and static inline: one function, one caller per device, and a
 * library for it would be more build wiring than code.
 *
 * The instructions covered are what the XDK device code actually emits against
 * registers -- moves both ways, the immediate forms, the zero-extending loads,
 * and the read-modify-write and flag-setting forms a poll loop is built from.
 * Anything outside that set returns 0 rather than guessing: stepping over an
 * instruction that was not understood corrupts the guest silently, which is
 * far worse than a fault naming the opcode.
 */
#ifndef MMIO_DECODE_H
#define MMIO_DECODE_H

#include <stdint.h>
#include "xbox_winnt.h"

#if RECOMP_HAS_VEH
#if defined(_WIN32)
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include "win32_compat.h"
#endif

/* Service one register access. dev is passed straight back to the callbacks. */
typedef uint64_t (*mmio_read_fn)(void *dev, uint32_t off, int size);
typedef void     (*mmio_write_fn)(void *dev, uint32_t off, uint64_t val, int size);

#if defined(__APPLE__) && defined(__aarch64__)
#include "mmio_decode_a64.h"
static inline int mmio_emulate(PCONTEXT ctx, uint32_t off, void *dev,
                               mmio_read_fn rd, mmio_write_fn wr)
{
    ucontext_t *uc = ctx->native_context;
    int ok = mmio_emulate_a64(uc, off, dev, rd, wr);
    ctx->Rip = A64_CTX_PC(uc);
    return ok;
}
#else
static inline uint64_t *mmio_ctx_reg(PCONTEXT c, int reg)
{
    switch (reg & 0xF) {
    case 0:  return (uint64_t *)&c->Rax;   case 1:  return (uint64_t *)&c->Rcx;
    case 2:  return (uint64_t *)&c->Rdx;   case 3:  return (uint64_t *)&c->Rbx;
    case 4:  return (uint64_t *)&c->Rsp;   case 5:  return (uint64_t *)&c->Rbp;
    case 6:  return (uint64_t *)&c->Rsi;   case 7:  return (uint64_t *)&c->Rdi;
    case 8:  return (uint64_t *)&c->R8;    case 9:  return (uint64_t *)&c->R9;
    case 10: return (uint64_t *)&c->R10;   case 11: return (uint64_t *)&c->R11;
    case 12: return (uint64_t *)&c->R12;   case 13: return (uint64_t *)&c->R13;
    case 14: return (uint64_t *)&c->R14;   case 15: return (uint64_t *)&c->R15;
    default: return NULL;
    }
}

static inline int mmio_modrm_len(const uint8_t *ip, int rex_b)
{
    uint8_t modrm = *ip;
    int mod = (modrm >> 6) & 3;
    int rm  = (modrm & 7) | (rex_b ? 8 : 0);
    int len = 1;

    if (mod == 3) return 1;
    if ((rm & 7) == 4) len += 1;                    /* SIB    */
    if (mod == 0 && (rm & 7) == 5) len += 4;        /* disp32 */
    else if (mod == 1) len += 1;
    else if (mod == 2) len += 4;
    return len;
}

/* Flags after a compare-shaped operation, so a poll loop branches correctly.
 * ZF, SF and CF only: those are what jz/jnz, js and jb/jae read, and inventing
 * an overflow flag nothing here sets is worse than leaving it alone. */
static inline void mmio_set_flags(PCONTEXT ctx, uint64_t result, int size,
                                  int carry)
{
    ctx->EFlags &= ~(0x0001u | 0x0040u | 0x0080u | 0x0800u);
    if (size < 8)
        result &= (1ULL << (size * 8)) - 1;
    if (result == 0)
        ctx->EFlags |= 0x0040u;                                   /* ZF */
    if (result & (1ULL << (size * 8 - 1)))
        ctx->EFlags |= 0x0080u;                                   /* SF */
    if (carry)
        ctx->EFlags |= 0x0001u;                                   /* CF */
}

/* 1 if the instruction at ctx->Rip was serviced and Rip advanced past it. */
static inline int mmio_emulate(PCONTEXT ctx, uint32_t off, void *dev,
                               mmio_read_fn rd, mmio_write_fn wr)
{
    const uint8_t *ip = (const uint8_t *)ctx->Rip;
    int prefix = 0, has66 = 0, rex = 0, has_rex = 0;
    const uint8_t *op;
    int size, rex_w, rex_r, rex_b, mlen, reg;

    if (!rd || !wr)
        return 0;

    for (;;) {
        uint8_t b = ip[prefix];
        if (b == 0x66)                   { has66 = 1; prefix++; }
        else if (b == 0xF2 || b == 0xF3) { prefix++; }
        else if (b >= 0x40 && b <= 0x4F) { rex = b; has_rex = 1; prefix++; }
        else break;
    }
    rex_w = has_rex && (rex & 0x08);
    rex_r = has_rex && (rex & 0x04);
    rex_b = has_rex && (rex & 0x01);

    op   = ip + prefix;
    size = has66 ? 2 : (rex_w ? 8 : 4);

    switch (op[0]) {
    case 0x88: case 0x89:                            /* MOV r/m, r   (write) */
        if (op[0] == 0x88) size = 1;
        mlen = mmio_modrm_len(op + 1, rex_b);
        reg  = ((op[1] >> 3) & 7) | (rex_r ? 8 : 0);
        wr(dev, off, *mmio_ctx_reg(ctx, reg), size);
        ctx->Rip += prefix + 1 + mlen;
        return 1;

    case 0xC7:                                       /* MOV r/m, imm32       */
        mlen = mmio_modrm_len(op + 1, rex_b);
        wr(dev, off, *(const uint32_t *)(op + 1 + mlen), size);
        ctx->Rip += prefix + 1 + mlen + 4;
        return 1;

    case 0xC6:                                       /* MOV r/m8, imm8       */
        mlen = mmio_modrm_len(op + 1, rex_b);
        wr(dev, off, op[1 + mlen], 1);
        ctx->Rip += prefix + 1 + mlen + 1;
        return 1;

    case 0x8A: case 0x8B: {                          /* MOV r, r/m   (read)  */
        uint64_t v, *dst;
        if (op[0] == 0x8A) size = 1;
        mlen = mmio_modrm_len(op + 1, rex_b);
        reg  = ((op[1] >> 3) & 7) | (rex_r ? 8 : 0);
        v    = rd(dev, off, size);
        dst  = mmio_ctx_reg(ctx, reg);
        if (size == 1)      *dst = (*dst & ~0xFFULL)   | (v & 0xFF);
        else if (size == 2) *dst = (*dst & ~0xFFFFULL) | (v & 0xFFFF);
        else if (size == 4) *dst = v & 0xFFFFFFFFULL;  /* 32-bit clears high */
        else                *dst = v;
        ctx->Rip += prefix + 1 + mlen;
        return 1;
    }

    case 0x84: case 0x85: {                          /* TEST r/m, r          */
        uint64_t m, r;
        if (op[0] == 0x84) size = 1;
        mlen = mmio_modrm_len(op + 1, rex_b);
        reg  = ((op[1] >> 3) & 7) | (rex_r ? 8 : 0);
        m    = rd(dev, off, size);
        r    = *mmio_ctx_reg(ctx, reg);
        mmio_set_flags(ctx, m & r, size, 0);
        ctx->Rip += prefix + 1 + mlen;
        return 1;
    }

    case 0x38: case 0x39: {                          /* CMP r/m, r           */
        uint64_t m, r, mask;
        if (op[0] == 0x38) size = 1;
        mlen = mmio_modrm_len(op + 1, rex_b);
        reg  = ((op[1] >> 3) & 7) | (rex_r ? 8 : 0);
        m    = rd(dev, off, size);
        r    = *mmio_ctx_reg(ctx, reg);
        mask = (size < 8) ? ((1ULL << (size * 8)) - 1) : ~0ULL;
        m &= mask; r &= mask;
        mmio_set_flags(ctx, m - r, size, m < r);
        ctx->Rip += prefix + 1 + mlen;
        return 1;
    }

    case 0x08: case 0x09:                            /* OR  r/m, r           */
        if (op[0] == 0x08) size = 1;
        mlen = mmio_modrm_len(op + 1, rex_b);
        reg  = ((op[1] >> 3) & 7) | (rex_r ? 8 : 0);
        wr(dev, off, rd(dev, off, size) | *mmio_ctx_reg(ctx, reg), size);
        ctx->Rip += prefix + 1 + mlen;
        return 1;

    case 0x20: case 0x21:                            /* AND r/m, r           */
        if (op[0] == 0x20) size = 1;
        mlen = mmio_modrm_len(op + 1, rex_b);
        reg  = ((op[1] >> 3) & 7) | (rex_r ? 8 : 0);
        wr(dev, off, rd(dev, off, size) & *mmio_ctx_reg(ctx, reg), size);
        ctx->Rip += prefix + 1 + mlen;
        return 1;

    case 0x0F:
        if (op[1] == 0xB6 || op[1] == 0xB7) {        /* MOVZX r32, r/m8|16   */
            int s = (op[1] == 0xB6) ? 1 : 2;
            mlen  = mmio_modrm_len(op + 2, rex_b);
            reg   = ((op[2] >> 3) & 7) | (rex_r ? 8 : 0);
            *mmio_ctx_reg(ctx, reg) = rd(dev, off, s) & ((1ULL << (s * 8)) - 1);
            ctx->Rip += prefix + 2 + mlen;
            return 1;
        }
        return 0;

    /* ALU r, r/m: the register is the destination, the device only read. */
    case 0x02: case 0x03: case 0x0A: case 0x0B: case 0x22: case 0x23:
    case 0x2A: case 0x2B: case 0x32: case 0x33: case 0x3A: case 0x3B: {
        uint64_t m, r, res, mask, *dst;
        int cf = 0, write = 1;
        if (!(op[0] & 1)) size = 1;
        mlen = mmio_modrm_len(op + 1, rex_b);
        reg  = ((op[1] >> 3) & 7) | (rex_r ? 8 : 0);
        dst  = mmio_ctx_reg(ctx, reg);
        mask = (size < 8) ? ((1ULL << (size * 8)) - 1) : ~0ULL;
        m    = rd(dev, off, size) & mask;
        r    = *dst & mask;
        switch (op[0] & 0xF8) {
        case 0x00: res = r + m; cf = (res & mask) < r; break;     /* ADD */
        case 0x08: res = r | m; break;                            /* OR  */
        case 0x20: res = r & m; break;                            /* AND */
        case 0x28: res = r - m; cf = r < m; break;                /* SUB */
        case 0x30: res = r ^ m; break;                            /* XOR */
        default:   res = r - m; cf = r < m; write = 0; break;     /* CMP */
        }
        if (write) {
            res &= mask;
            if (size == 1)      *dst = (*dst & ~0xFFULL) | res;
            else if (size == 2) *dst = (*dst & ~0xFFFFULL) | res;
            else                *dst = res;    /* 32-bit clears the top half */
        }
        mmio_set_flags(ctx, res, size, cf);
        ctx->Rip += prefix + 1 + mlen;
        return 1;
    }

    case 0xF6: case 0xF7: {                          /* TEST r/m, imm (/0,/1) */
        uint64_t m, imm;
        int isz;
        if (((op[1] >> 3) & 7) > 1)
            return 0;          /* NOT/NEG/MUL/DIV on a register: not seen */
        if (op[0] == 0xF6) size = 1;
        mlen = mmio_modrm_len(op + 1, rex_b);
        isz  = size == 1 ? 1 : size == 2 ? 2 : 4;
        imm  = isz == 1 ? op[1 + mlen]
             : isz == 2 ? *(const uint16_t *)(op + 1 + mlen)
             : (uint64_t)(int64_t)*(const int32_t *)(op + 1 + mlen);
        m    = rd(dev, off, size);
        mmio_set_flags(ctx, m & imm, size, 0);
        ctx->Rip += prefix + 1 + mlen + isz;
        return 1;
    }

    case 0x80: case 0x81: case 0x83: {              /* ALU r/m, imm         */
        uint64_t m, imm, r, mask;
        int sub = (op[1] >> 3) & 7, isz, write = 1, cf = 0;
        if (op[0] == 0x80) size = 1;
        mlen = mmio_modrm_len(op + 1, rex_b);
        isz  = op[0] == 0x81 ? (size == 2 ? 2 : 4) : 1;
        if (op[0] == 0x80)
            imm = op[1 + mlen];
        else if (op[0] == 0x83)                      /* sign-extended imm8   */
            imm = (uint64_t)(int64_t)(int8_t)op[1 + mlen];
        else if (isz == 2)
            imm = *(const uint16_t *)(op + 1 + mlen);
        else
            imm = (uint64_t)(int64_t)*(const int32_t *)(op + 1 + mlen);
        mask = (size < 8) ? ((1ULL << (size * 8)) - 1) : ~0ULL;
        m    = rd(dev, off, size) & mask;
        imm &= mask;
        switch (sub) {
        case 0: r = m + imm; cf = (r & mask) < m; break;          /* ADD */
        case 1: r = m | imm; break;                                /* OR  */
        case 4: r = m & imm; break;                                /* AND */
        case 5: r = m - imm; cf = m < imm; break;                  /* SUB */
        case 6: r = m ^ imm; break;                                /* XOR */
        case 7: r = m - imm; cf = m < imm; write = 0; break;       /* CMP */
        default: return 0;     /* ADC/SBB need the incoming carry */
        }
        if (write)
            wr(dev, off, r & mask, size);
        mmio_set_flags(ctx, r, size, cf);
        ctx->Rip += prefix + 1 + mlen + isz;
        return 1;
    }

    default:
        return 0;
    }
}

#endif /* host architecture */
#endif /* RECOMP_HAS_VEH */
#endif /* MMIO_DECODE_H */

```

`xboxrecomp/src/platform/mmio_decode_a64.h`:

```h
/*
 * mmio_decode_a64.h -- the AArch64 twin of mmio_decode.h, for trapped MMIO on
 * POSIX hosts (macOS arm64, Linux arm64).
 *
 * The device page is PROT_NONE; the access arrives as SIGBUS (Darwin) or
 * SIGSEGV (Linux) with the faulting data address in si_addr and the thread
 * state in the ucontext. Unlike x86-64, the decoder never has to work out the
 * address: si_addr is exact for a data abort, so every addressing mode is
 * served by the same code. What it decodes from the instruction word is the
 * direction, the width, the destination/source register, sign extension and
 * any base-register writeback; the instruction is always 4 bytes.
 *
 * Covered: LDR/STR, LDRB/STRB, LDRH/STRH, LDRSB/LDRSH/LDRSW in the unsigned
 * immediate, unscaled (LDUR/STUR), pre/post-index and register-offset forms;
 * the SIMD&FP LDR/STR of B/H/S/D/Q; LDP/STP/LDPSW (int and S/D). Exclusive,
 * acquire/release, atomic and unprivileged forms return 0 -- stepping an
 * instruction that was not understood corrupts the guest silently, which is
 * worse than a fault naming the opcode.
 *
 * Clang emits exactly these for a `volatile` MEM32()/MEM16()/MEM8() in lifted
 * code (volatile accesses are never merged into pairs, so LDP/STP is a
 * backstop, not the common case).
 */
#ifndef MMIO_DECODE_A64_H
#define MMIO_DECODE_A64_H

#include <stdint.h>

#if defined(__aarch64__) && !defined(_WIN32)

#if defined(__APPLE__)
#include <sys/ucontext.h>
#if defined(__DARWIN_OPAQUE_ARM_THREAD_STATE64) && __DARWIN_OPAQUE_ARM_THREAD_STATE64
/* arm64e: pc/lr/sp/fp are ptrauth-signed opaque fields; use the
 * __darwin_arm_thread_state64_{get,set}_* accessors there. This runtime is
 * built arm64 (unsigned), so the plain fields are what the kernel reads back. */
#error "mmio_decode_a64.h: arm64e opaque thread state not handled"
#endif
#define A64_CTX_PC(uc)   ((uc)->uc_mcontext->__ss.__pc)
#define A64_CTX_X(uc, n) ((uc)->uc_mcontext->__ss.__x[(n)])
#define A64_CTX_FP(uc)   ((uc)->uc_mcontext->__ss.__fp)
#define A64_CTX_LR(uc)   ((uc)->uc_mcontext->__ss.__lr)
#define A64_CTX_SP(uc)   ((uc)->uc_mcontext->__ss.__sp)
#define A64_CTX_HAS_V 1
#define A64_CTX_V(uc, n) ((uc)->uc_mcontext->__ns.__v[(n)])
#elif defined(__linux__)
#include <ucontext.h>
#include <asm/sigcontext.h>      /* struct _aarch64_ctx, fpsimd_context */
#define A64_CTX_PC(uc)   ((uc)->uc_mcontext.pc)
#define A64_CTX_X(uc, n) ((uc)->uc_mcontext.regs[(n)])
#define A64_CTX_FP(uc)   ((uc)->uc_mcontext.regs[29])
#define A64_CTX_LR(uc)   ((uc)->uc_mcontext.regs[30])
#define A64_CTX_SP(uc)   ((uc)->uc_mcontext.sp)
/* The FP/SIMD file is a record in uc_mcontext.__reserved: a chain of
 * _aarch64_ctx headers (magic, size), the fpsimd_context among them and a
 * zero magic at the end. rt_sigreturn restores the V registers from it, so
 * writing there is how a load lands. Streaming-SVE state, which an SVE
 * record would supersede, does not arise in lifted code: clang's volatile
 * MEM32() accesses are plain LDR/STR. */
static inline __uint128_t *mmio_a64_linux_vregs(ucontext_t *uc)
{
    unsigned char *p = (unsigned char *)uc->uc_mcontext.__reserved;
    unsigned char *end = p + sizeof(uc->uc_mcontext.__reserved);
    while (p + sizeof(struct _aarch64_ctx) <= end) {
        struct _aarch64_ctx *h = (struct _aarch64_ctx *)p;
        if (h->magic == 0 || h->size < sizeof(*h))
            break;
        if (h->magic == FPSIMD_MAGIC) {
            if (p + sizeof(struct fpsimd_context) > end) return 0;
            return ((struct fpsimd_context *)p)->vregs;
        }
        p += h->size;
    }
    return 0;
}
#define A64_CTX_HAS_V 1
#define A64_CTX_V_OK(uc) (mmio_a64_linux_vregs(uc) != 0)
#define A64_CTX_V(uc, n) (mmio_a64_linux_vregs(uc)[(n)])
#endif
#ifndef A64_CTX_V_OK
#define A64_CTX_V_OK(uc) 1
#endif

typedef uint64_t (*mmio_a64_read_fn)(void *dev, uint32_t off, int size);
typedef void     (*mmio_a64_write_fn)(void *dev, uint32_t off, uint64_t val, int size);

/* x0..x28, then fp (x29), lr (x30); 31 is SP when used as a base. */
static inline uint64_t *mmio_a64_xreg(ucontext_t *uc, int r)
{
    if (r < 29) return (uint64_t *)&A64_CTX_X(uc, r);
    if (r == 29) return (uint64_t *)&A64_CTX_FP(uc);
    if (r == 30) return (uint64_t *)&A64_CTX_LR(uc);
    return (uint64_t *)&A64_CTX_SP(uc);
}

/* 1 if the instruction at pc was serviced against (rd, wr) and pc advanced.
 * off is the device offset of the faulting data address (from si_addr). */
static inline int mmio_emulate_a64(ucontext_t *uc, uint32_t off, void *dev,
                                   mmio_a64_read_fn rd, mmio_a64_write_fn wr)
{
    uint32_t insn = *(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)A64_CTX_PC(uc);
    uint32_t op29_27 = (insn >> 27) & 7;
    int V = (insn >> 26) & 1;

    if (!rd || !wr)
        return 0;
    if (V && !A64_CTX_V_OK(uc))                  /* no FP/SIMD record to edit */
        return 0;

    if (op29_27 == 7) {                          /* load/store register */
        int size = (insn >> 30) & 3;
        int opc  = (insn >> 22) & 3;
        int rt   = insn & 31, rn = (insn >> 5) & 31;
        int form = (insn >> 24) & 3;             /* 01 unsigned imm, 00 other */
        int bytes, is_load, sext64 = 0, sext32 = 0, wb = 0;
        int64_t wb_imm = 0;
        uint64_t v;

        if (form == 0) {
            int bit21 = (insn >> 21) & 1, sub = (insn >> 10) & 3;
            if (bit21 == 0) {
                /* 00 unscaled, 01 post-index, 10 unprivileged, 11 pre-index */
                if (sub == 2) return 0;
                if (sub == 1 || sub == 3) {
                    wb = 1;
                    wb_imm = (int64_t)(int32_t)(((insn >> 12) & 0x1FFu) << 23) >> 23;
                }
            } else if (sub != 2) {
                return 0;                        /* only register offset */
            }
        } else if (form != 1) {
            return 0;
        }

        if (V) {
#if A64_CTX_HAS_V
            if (opc & 2) { if (size != 0) return 0; bytes = 16; }
            else bytes = 1 << size;
            is_load = opc & 1;
            if (is_load) {
                if (bytes == 16) {
                    __uint128_t lo = rd(dev, off, 8), hi = rd(dev, off + 8, 8);
                    A64_CTX_V(uc, rt) = lo | (hi << 64);
                } else {
                    A64_CTX_V(uc, rt) = rd(dev, off, bytes);
                }
            } else {
                __uint128_t q = A64_CTX_V(uc, rt);
                if (bytes == 16) {
                    wr(dev, off, (uint64_t)q, 8);
                    wr(dev, off + 8, (uint64_t)(q >> 64), 8);
                } else {
                    wr(dev, off, (uint64_t)q, bytes);
                }
            }
#else
            return 0;
#endif
        } else {
            bytes = 1 << size;
            switch (opc) {
            case 0: is_load = 0; break;
            case 1: is_load = 1; break;
            case 2:                              /* LDRS* to 64-bit        */
                if (size == 3) return 0;         /* PRFM                    */
                is_load = 1; sext64 = 1; break;
            default:                             /* LDRS* to 32-bit (B, H) */
                if (size >= 2) return 0;
                is_load = 1; sext32 = 1; break;
            }
            if (is_load) {
                v = rd(dev, off, bytes);
                if (sext64) {
                    int sh = 64 - bytes * 8;
                    v = (uint64_t)(((int64_t)(v << sh)) >> sh);
                } else if (sext32) {
                    int sh = 32 - bytes * 8;
                    v = (uint32_t)(((int32_t)((uint32_t)v << sh)) >> sh);
                } else if (size != 3) {
                    v &= (1ULL << (bytes * 8)) - 1;   /* W write zeroes 63:32 */
                }
                if (rt != 31) *mmio_a64_xreg(uc, rt) = v;
            } else {
                v = rt == 31 ? 0 : *mmio_a64_xreg(uc, rt);
                wr(dev, off, v, bytes);
            }
        }
        if (wb) *mmio_a64_xreg(uc, rn) += (uint64_t)wb_imm;
        A64_CTX_PC(uc) += 4;
        return 1;
    }

    /* LDP/STP: bits 25:23 are 001 post-index, 010 signed offset, 011
     * pre-index; 000 is LDNP/STNP and 1xx is not a pair. */
    if (op29_27 == 5 && ((insn >> 23) & 7) >= 1 && ((insn >> 23) & 7) <= 3) {
        int opc = (insn >> 30) & 3, L = (insn >> 22) & 1;
        int mode = (insn >> 23) & 3;             /* 1 post, 2 offset, 3 pre */
        int rt = insn & 31, rt2 = (insn >> 10) & 31, rn = (insn >> 5) & 31;
        int64_t imm7 = (int64_t)(int32_t)(((insn >> 15) & 0x7Fu) << 25) >> 25;
        int bytes, sext = 0;

        if (V) {
#if A64_CTX_HAS_V
            bytes = 4 << opc;
            if (bytes > 8) return 0;        /* Q pairs; opc 3 is unallocated */
#else
            return 0;
#endif
        } else if (opc == 0) bytes = 4;
        else if (opc == 1) {                /* LDPSW; the store form is STGP */
            if (!L) return 0;
            bytes = 4; sext = 1;
        }
        else if (opc == 2) bytes = 8;
        else return 0;

        if (L) {
            uint64_t a = rd(dev, off, bytes), b = rd(dev, off + bytes, bytes);
            if (sext) {
                a = (uint64_t)(int64_t)(int32_t)a;
                b = (uint64_t)(int64_t)(int32_t)b;
            }
#if A64_CTX_HAS_V
            if (V) { A64_CTX_V(uc, rt) = a; A64_CTX_V(uc, rt2) = b; } else
#endif
            {
                if (rt != 31) *mmio_a64_xreg(uc, rt) = a;
                if (rt2 != 31) *mmio_a64_xreg(uc, rt2) = b;
            }
        } else {
            uint64_t a, b;
#if A64_CTX_HAS_V
            if (V) { a = (uint64_t)A64_CTX_V(uc, rt); b = (uint64_t)A64_CTX_V(uc, rt2); } else
#endif
            {
                a = rt == 31 ? 0 : *mmio_a64_xreg(uc, rt);
                b = rt2 == 31 ? 0 : *mmio_a64_xreg(uc, rt2);
            }
            wr(dev, off, a, bytes);
            wr(dev, off + bytes, b, bytes);
        }
        if (mode == 1 || mode == 3)
            *mmio_a64_xreg(uc, rn) += (uint64_t)(imm7 * bytes);
        A64_CTX_PC(uc) += 4;
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

#endif /* __aarch64__ && !_WIN32 */
#endif /* MMIO_DECODE_A64_H */

```

`xboxrecomp/src/platform/vcpu.c`:

```c
/*
 * vcpu: one virtual CPU for guest threads (see vcpu.h).
 *
 * State lives under one mutex: who holds the CPU and who is ready for it.
 * A thread waiting for the CPU sleeps on its own condition variable and is
 * handed the CPU directly (holder = it) by whoever releases, so there is no
 * thundering herd and no window where a lower-priority thread can grab it.
 *
 * Preemption is a signal to the holder. In guest code (host depth 0) the
 * handler yields on the spot -- guest code holds no host locks, so blocking
 * there is safe. In host code it leaves a note that compat_host_leave reads.
 */
#if !defined(_WIN32)
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#endif
#include "vcpu.h"
#if XBOX_HAS_VCPU
#if defined(_WIN32)
/* Windows: the host's own threads, the waits wrapped by win32_vcpu.h (not in
 * this file), and in place of a signal the holder is suspended and sent
 * through vcpu_win_trampoline (below) to yield. */
#include <windows.h>
int compat_host_depth(void);
volatile int *compat_host_depth_ptr(void);
void compat_park_if_pending(void);
#else
#include "win32_compat.h"
#include <signal.h>
#endif

#include <errno.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define VCPU_MAX_THREADS 256
#define VCPU_QUANTUM_MS  10
/* A thread ready this long without the CPU gets it for one quantum, whatever
 * its priority: NT-family schedulers boost starved threads the same way, and
 * titles that spin at raised priority on work a lower thread has to finish
 * depend on it. */
#define VCPU_STARVE_MS   (vcpu_starve_ms())
#if !defined(_WIN32)
#ifdef __APPLE__
#define SIG_PREEMPT SIGVTALRM
#else
#define SIG_PREEMPT (SIGRTMIN + 4)
#endif
#endif

struct vcpu_thread {
    pthread_t thread;
    pthread_cond_t cv;
    int priority;
    int ready;              /* waiting for the CPU */
    unsigned long seq;      /* FIFO order among equal priorities */
    int64_t ready_ms;       /* when it became ready */
    volatile int preempt;   /* asked to yield at the next safe point */
    int in_vcpu;            /* inside this file: a preempt signal must wait */
    int held_blocked;       /* released the CPU in vcpu_block_begin */
    int detached;
#if defined(_WIN32)
    HANDLE host;            /* this thread, for suspending it */
    DWORD tid;
    volatile int *depth;    /* its compat_host_depth */
    int suspended;          /* SuspendThread count: no CPU for it meanwhile */
    int stolen;             /* lost the CPU suspended: get it back before guest code */
    volatile int redirected;   /* on its way through vcpu_win_trampoline */
    volatile int64_t in_exception; /* when it entered a runtime exception handler (vcpu_win_unredirect), or 0 */
    int self_susp;          /* suspended by itself: its count, waited out on self_cv */
    int resume_early;       /* resumed while running: its next self-suspension returns at once */
    pthread_cond_t self_cv;
#endif
};

static pthread_mutex_t s_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static vcpu_thread *s_holder;
static vcpu_thread *s_threads[VCPU_MAX_THREADS];
static unsigned long s_seq;
static int64_t s_holder_since_ms;
static int s_enabled = -1;
static __thread vcpu_thread *t_self;


int vcpu_enabled(void)
{
    if (s_enabled < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("RECOMP_VCPU");
        s_enabled = !(e && !strcmp(e, "0"));
    }
    return s_enabled;
}

vcpu_thread *vcpu_self(void)
{
    return t_self;
}

int vcpu_busy(void)
{
    return t_self && t_self->in_vcpu;
}

static int64_t now_ms(void)
{
#if defined(_WIN32)
    return (int64_t)GetTickCount64();
#else
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (int64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000 + ts.tv_nsec / 1000000;
#endif
}

static int64_t now_ms(void);

static int vcpu_starve_ms(void)
{
    static int v = -1;
    if (v < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("RECOMP_VCPU_STARVE_MS");
        v = e ? atoi(e) : 50;
    }
    return v;
}

#if defined(_WIN32)
static int win_suspended(vcpu_thread *t) { return t->suspended > 0; }
static void win_preempt(vcpu_thread *h);
#else
static int win_suspended(vcpu_thread *t) { (void)t; return 0; }
#endif

/* The longest-starved ready thread, if any has waited past VCPU_STARVE_MS. */
static vcpu_thread *starved_ready(void)
{
    vcpu_thread *st = NULL;
    int64_t now = now_ms();
    for (int i = 0; i < VCPU_MAX_THREADS; i++) {
        vcpu_thread *t = s_threads[i];
        if (t && t->ready && !win_suspended(t) && now - t->ready_ms >= VCPU_STARVE_MS &&
            (!st || t->ready_ms < st->ready_ms))
            st = t;
    }
    return st;
}

/* The best ready thread, or NULL. Caller holds s_lock. */
static vcpu_thread *best_ready(void)
{
    vcpu_thread *best = starved_ready();
    if (best)
        return best;
    for (int i = 0; i < VCPU_MAX_THREADS; i++) {
        vcpu_thread *t = s_threads[i];
        if (!t || !t->ready || win_suspended(t))
            continue;
        if (!best || t->priority > best->priority ||
            (t->priority == best->priority && t->seq < best->seq))
            best = t;
    }
    return best;
}

/* Hand the CPU to the best ready thread. Caller holds s_lock, and the CPU is
 * free. */
static void dispatch(void)
{
    vcpu_thread *next = best_ready();
    if (next) {
        next->ready = 0;
        s_holder = next;
        s_holder_since_ms = now_ms();
        pthread_cond_signal(&next->cv);
    }
}

static void request_preempt(vcpu_thread *h)
{
#ifdef __APPLE__
    /* A prior signal may have landed in libc and deferred. Do not leave a
     * guest spin loop holding the CPU forever with preempt already set. */
    if (h && h->preempt && !pthread_equal(h->thread, pthread_self())) {
        pthread_kill(h->thread, SIG_PREEMPT);
        return;
    }
#endif
#if defined(_WIN32)
    /* Asked again while a preemption is pending but the thread was never
     * sent through the trampoline: try again. A redirect fails while the
     * thread is in a DLL the guest called (memcpy), in a handler, or in host
     * code; the flag stays up for the next safe point, and a holder spinning
     * in guest code never reaches one. Asked only once, it kept the CPU from
     * every thread -- the interrupt thread included, so no vblank, and the
     * game polling its disc read for 10 s ("There's a problem with the
     * disc"). The quantum timer asks every few milliseconds. */
    if (h && h->preempt && !h->redirected && h != t_self) {
        win_preempt(h);
        return;
    }
#endif
    if (h && !h->preempt) {
        h->preempt = 1;
        /* Not to oneself: the handler would take s_lock, which is held. The
         * flag is read at the next safe point instead. */
#if defined(_WIN32)
        if (h != t_self)
            win_preempt(h);
#else
        if (!pthread_equal(h->thread, pthread_self()))
            pthread_kill(h->thread, SIG_PREEMPT);
#endif
    }
}

/* Wait for the CPU. Caller holds s_lock and does not hold the CPU.
 * polite: do not preempt the holder (it was just handed the CPU by this
 * thread's yield); the quantum timer brings the CPU back. */
static void acquire_locked_ex(vcpu_thread *t, int polite)
{
    t->ready = 1;
    t->seq = ++s_seq;
    t->ready_ms = now_ms();
    if (!s_holder) {
        dispatch();
    } else if (!polite && t->priority > s_holder->priority) {
        request_preempt(s_holder);
    }
    while (s_holder != t)
        pthread_cond_wait(&t->cv, &s_lock);
    t->preempt = 0;
}

static void acquire_locked(vcpu_thread *t)
{
    acquire_locked_ex(t, 0);
}

static void release_locked(vcpu_thread *t)
{
    if (s_holder == t) {
        s_holder = NULL;
        dispatch();
    }
}

static void yield_now(vcpu_thread *t)
{
    t->in_vcpu = 1;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&s_lock);
    t->preempt = 0;
    if (s_holder == t) {
        vcpu_thread *b = best_ready();
        if (b && (b->priority >= t->priority || starved_ready())) {
            release_locked(t);
            acquire_locked_ex(t, 1);
        }
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&s_lock);
    t->in_vcpu = 0;
}

#if !defined(_WIN32)
#ifdef __APPLE__
#include <mach-o/dyld.h>
#include <mach-o/getsect.h>
#include <sys/ucontext.h>
static uintptr_t s_text_lo, s_text_hi;
static void preempt_signal(int sig, siginfo_t *si, void *opaque)
#else
static void preempt_signal(int sig)
#endif
{
    vcpu_thread *t = t_self;
    int saved = errno;

    (void)sig;
#ifdef __APPLE__
    (void)si;
    uintptr_t pc = ((ucontext_t *)opaque)->uc_mcontext->__ss.__pc;
    /* Darwin libc uses locks even in getenv. Yielding while it holds one
     * can strand the next guest thread in that same lock. Retry next quantum
     * when the interrupted PC is back in the executable. */
    if (pc < s_text_lo || pc >= s_text_hi)
        return;
#endif
    if (t && !t->in_vcpu && compat_host_depth() == 0) {
        yield_now(t);
        /* A suspension that arrived while this thread waited for the CPU
         * has to take effect before it runs more guest code. */
        compat_park_if_pending();
    }
    /* else: compat_host_leave sees t->preempt */
    errno = saved;
}
#endif

/* Time-slices equal priorities: a holder that has run a whole quantum while a
 * peer of the same (or higher) priority waits is asked to yield. */
static void *quantum_thread(void *unused)
{
    (void)unused;
    for (;;) {
        usleep(VCPU_QUANTUM_MS * 1000 / 2);
        pthread_mutex_lock(&s_lock);
        if (s_holder && now_ms() - s_holder_since_ms >= VCPU_QUANTUM_MS) {
            vcpu_thread *b = best_ready();
            if (b && (b->priority >= s_holder->priority || starved_ready()))
                request_preempt(s_holder);
        }
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&s_lock);
    }
    return NULL;
}

#if defined(_WIN32)
static LONG CALLBACK vcpu_win_continue(PEXCEPTION_POINTERS ep);
#endif

static void vcpu_init_once(void)
{
    pthread_t th;
#if !defined(_WIN32)
    struct sigaction sa;

    memset(&sa, 0, sizeof(sa));
#ifdef __APPLE__
    unsigned long text_size = 0;
    const uint8_t *text = getsegmentdata((const struct mach_header_64 *)_dyld_get_image_header(0), "__TEXT", &text_size);
    s_text_lo = (uintptr_t)text;
    s_text_hi = s_text_lo + text_size;
    sa.sa_sigaction = preempt_signal;
    sa.sa_flags = SA_RESTART | SA_SIGINFO;
#else
    sa.sa_handler = preempt_signal;
    sa.sa_flags = SA_RESTART;
#endif
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sigaction(SIG_PREEMPT, &sa, NULL);
#else
    AddVectoredContinueHandler(0, vcpu_win_continue);
#endif
    pthread_create(&th, NULL, quantum_thread, NULL);
    pthread_detach(th);
}

vcpu_thread *vcpu_attach(int priority)
{
    static pthread_once_t once = PTHREAD_ONCE_INIT;
    vcpu_thread *t;

    if (!vcpu_enabled() || t_self)
        return t_self;
    pthread_once(&once, vcpu_init_once);

    t = calloc(1, sizeof(*t));
    t->thread = pthread_self();
#if defined(_WIN32)
    DuplicateHandle(GetCurrentProcess(), GetCurrentThread(), GetCurrentProcess(), &t->host,
                    THREAD_SUSPEND_RESUME | THREAD_GET_CONTEXT | THREAD_SET_CONTEXT |
                    THREAD_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, 0);
    t->tid = GetCurrentThreadId();
    pthread_cond_init(&t->self_cv, NULL);
    t->depth = compat_host_depth_ptr();
#endif
    t->priority = priority;
    pthread_cond_init(&t->cv, NULL);
    t_self = t;

    t->in_vcpu = 1;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&s_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < VCPU_MAX_THREADS; i++)
        if (!s_threads[i]) {
            s_threads[i] = t;
            break;
        }
    acquire_locked(t);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&s_lock);
    t->in_vcpu = 0;
    return t;
}

void vcpu_detach(void)
{
    vcpu_thread *t = t_self;
    if (!t)
        return;
    t->in_vcpu = 1;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&s_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < VCPU_MAX_THREADS; i++)
        if (s_threads[i] == t)
            s_threads[i] = NULL;
    release_locked(t);
    t->detached = 1;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&s_lock);
    t_self = NULL;
    /* The record is leaked on purpose: a racing preempt signal may still
     * name it, and threads are few. */
}

void vcpu_block_begin(void)
{
    vcpu_thread *t = t_self;
    if (!t)
        return;
    t->in_vcpu = 1;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&s_lock);
    if (s_holder == t) {
        release_locked(t);
        t->held_blocked++;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&s_lock);
    t->in_vcpu = 0;
}

/* Windows: the CPU taken while suspended is to be had back (and the note
 * cleared). Caller holds s_lock. */
static int win_stolen(vcpu_thread *t)
{
#if defined(_WIN32)
    if (t->stolen) {
        t->stolen = 0;
        return 1;
    }
#else
    (void)t;
#endif
    return 0;
}

void vcpu_block_end(void)
{
    vcpu_thread *t = t_self;
    if (!t)
        return;
    t->in_vcpu = 1;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&s_lock);
    if (t->held_blocked > 0 || win_stolen(t)) {
        if (t->held_blocked > 0)
            t->held_blocked--;
        if (s_holder != t)
            acquire_locked(t);
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&s_lock);
    t->in_vcpu = 0;
}

void vcpu_yield(void)
{
    if (t_self)
        yield_now(t_self);
}

/* NtYieldExecution / SwitchToThread: hand the CPU to any ready thread, lower
 * priority included -- unlike Sleep(0), which only lets equal or higher
 * priorities in. A thread spinning on a lock held by a lower-priority one
 * depends on that. The lower thread keeps the CPU until it blocks or a
 * quantum passes. */
void vcpu_yield_any(void)
{
    vcpu_thread *t = t_self;
    if (!t)
        return;
    t->in_vcpu = 1;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&s_lock);
    t->preempt = 0;
    if (s_holder == t && best_ready()) {
        release_locked(t);
        acquire_locked_ex(t, 1);
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&s_lock);
    t->in_vcpu = 0;
}

void vcpu_check_preempt(void)
{
    vcpu_thread *t = t_self;
#if defined(_WIN32)
    if (t && t->stolen && !t->in_vcpu) {   /* resumed in host code: the CPU first */
        t->in_vcpu = 1;
        pthread_mutex_lock(&s_lock);
        if (win_stolen(t) && s_holder != t)
            acquire_locked(t);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&s_lock);
        t->in_vcpu = 0;
    }
#endif
    if (t && t->preempt && !t->in_vcpu)
        yield_now(t);
}

void vcpu_set_priority(vcpu_thread *t, int priority)
{
    if (!t)
        return;
    if (t_self) t_self->in_vcpu = 1;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&s_lock);
    t->priority = priority;
    /* A ready thread raised above the holder runs now; a holder lowered
     * below a ready thread gives way. */
    if (s_holder) {
        vcpu_thread *b = best_ready();
        if (b && b->priority > s_holder->priority)
            request_preempt(s_holder);
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&s_lock);
    if (t_self) {
        t_self->in_vcpu = 0;
        vcpu_check_preempt();   /* lowered itself below a ready thread */
    }
}

void vcpu_nap_us(unsigned us)
{
#if defined(_WIN32)
#ifndef CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION
#define CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION 0x00000002
#endif
    static __thread HANDLE timer;
    static __thread int tried;
    LARGE_INTEGER due;
    if (!tried) {
        tried = 1;
        timer = CreateWaitableTimerExW(NULL, NULL, CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION,
                                       TIMER_ALL_ACCESS);
    }
    if (!timer) {   /* (before Windows 10 1803) */
        if (us >= 1000) Sleep(us / 1000); else SwitchToThread();
        return;
    }
    due.QuadPart = -(LONGLONG)us * 10;   /* 100 ns units, relative */
    if (SetWaitableTimer(timer, &due, 0, NULL, NULL, FALSE))
        WaitForSingleObject(timer, INFINITE);
#else
    struct timespec ts = { us / 1000000, (long)(us % 1000000) * 1000 };
    while (nanosleep(&ts, &ts) == -1 && errno == EINTR) { }
#endif
}

int vcpu_holds_cpu(void)
{
    return t_self && s_holder == t_self;
}

int vcpu_get_priority(vcpu_thread *t)
{
    return t ? t->priority : VCPU_PRIO_NORMAL;
}

#if defined(_WIN32)
/* ---- Windows: preemption by redirection --------------------------------
 *
 * No signals: the thread to preempt is suspended, and if it is in guest code
 * -- host depth 0, executing this program's own image (not a system DLL,
 * which may hold a loader or heap lock) -- its context is changed to call
 * vcpu_win_trampoline on the way, which saves every register the C ABI lets
 * a call clobber (and the x87/SSE state), yields, and returns where it was.
 * Anywhere else the flag stays set for compat_host_leave, as on POSIX. */
void vcpu_win_trampoline(void);
void vcpu_win_preempt_point(void);
__asm__(
    ".text\n"
    ".globl vcpu_win_trampoline\n"
    "vcpu_win_trampoline:\n"
    "    pushfq\n"
    "    pushq %rax\n"
    "    pushq %rcx\n"
    "    pushq %rdx\n"
    "    pushq %r8\n"
    "    pushq %r9\n"
    "    pushq %r10\n"
    "    pushq %r11\n"
    "    pushq %rbp\n"
    "    movq %rsp, %rbp\n"
    "    andq $-64, %rsp\n"
    "    subq $576, %rsp\n"            /* shadow space, then 512 for fxsave */
    "    fxsave64 64(%rsp)\n"
    "    cld\n"
    "    call vcpu_win_preempt_point\n"
    "    fxrstor64 64(%rsp)\n"
    "    movq %rbp, %rsp\n"
    "    popq %rbp\n"
    "    popq %r11\n"
    "    popq %r10\n"
    "    popq %r9\n"
    "    popq %r8\n"
    "    popq %rdx\n"
    "    popq %rcx\n"
    "    popq %rax\n"
    "    popfq\n"
    "    ret\n"
    ".globl vcpu_win_trampoline_end\n"
    "vcpu_win_trampoline_end:\n");
extern char vcpu_win_trampoline_end[];

void vcpu_win_preempt_point(void)
{
    vcpu_thread *t = t_self;
    if (!t)
        return;
    t->redirected = 0;
    vcpu_check_preempt();
    compat_park_if_pending();
}

static int in_image(DWORD64 ip)
{
    static DWORD64 lo, hi;
    if (!lo) {
        const unsigned char *base = (const unsigned char *)GetModuleHandleA(NULL);
        const IMAGE_NT_HEADERS *nt =
            (const IMAGE_NT_HEADERS *)(base + ((const IMAGE_DOS_HEADER *)base)->e_lfanew);
        hi = (DWORD64)base + nt->OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage;
        lo = (DWORD64)base;
    }
    return ip >= lo && ip < hi;
}

/* Debugging (NGB_HANG_DUMP): who holds the CPU, how long, and who waits for it. Into a buffer:
 * the caller prints it, as a thread holding stdio's lock may be suspended. */
void vcpu_debug_state(char *buf, int n)
{
    vcpu_thread *h;
    int len;

    pthread_mutex_lock(&s_lock);
    h = s_holder;
    len = snprintf(buf, (size_t)n, "[VCPU] holder tid %lu prio %d for %lld ms, preempt %d "
                   "redirected %d in_exception %d depth %d\n", h ? h->tid : 0,
                   h ? h->priority : 0, h ? (long long)(now_ms() - s_holder_since_ms) : 0,
                   h ? h->preempt : 0, h ? h->redirected : 0, h ? h->in_exception != 0 : 0,
                   h && h->depth ? *h->depth : 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < VCPU_MAX_THREADS && len > 0 && len < n; i++)
        if (s_threads[i] && s_threads[i]->ready)
            len += snprintf(buf + len, (size_t)(n - len), "[VCPU]   ready tid %lu prio %d for %lld ms\n",
                            s_threads[i]->tid, s_threads[i]->priority,
                            (long long)(now_ms() - s_threads[i]->ready_ms));
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&s_lock);
}

/* Send a suspended thread through the trampoline, if it is somewhere that
 * may yield. The return address goes on its stack, which must be committed
 * and not the guard page (touched from here, the guard would fault here). */
static int redirect(vcpu_thread *t)
{
    CONTEXT c;
    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi;

    /* In a handler: not while it may hold a lock -- for a few milliseconds at most. Wine does not run
     * the vectored continue handler that clears the mark, which left it set after the first exception
     * and the thread never preempted again: under Proton the game hung loading again ("There's a
     * problem with the disc", as in v0.9.4-0.9.7). Handlers finish in microseconds. */
    if (t->in_vcpu || (t->in_exception && now_ms() - t->in_exception < 50) || *t->depth != 0)
        return 0;
    memset(&c, 0, sizeof c);
    c.ContextFlags = CONTEXT_CONTROL | CONTEXT_INTEGER;
    if (!GetThreadContext(t->host, &c) || !in_image(c.Rip))
        return 0;
    if (t->redirected) {
        /* Pending only while the thread is still in the trampoline (vcpu_win_preempt_point
         * clears the flag). Anywhere else the redirect was lost -- a SetThreadContext that
         * Windows dropped, as it does while dispatching an exception to the thread (see
         * vcpu_win_unredirect) -- and the thread is redirected afresh. With the flag left up
         * nothing could preempt it again. (Found by Manuel Flores as well, PR #9.) */
        if (c.Rip >= (DWORD64)vcpu_win_trampoline && c.Rip < (DWORD64)vcpu_win_trampoline_end)
            return 0;
        t->redirected = 0;
    }
    if (!VirtualQuery((LPCVOID)(c.Rsp - 8), &mbi, sizeof mbi) || mbi.State != MEM_COMMIT ||
        (mbi.Protect & (PAGE_GUARD | PAGE_NOACCESS)))
        return 0;
    c.Rsp -= 8;
    *(DWORD64 *)c.Rsp = c.Rip;
    c.Rip = (DWORD64)vcpu_win_trampoline;
    c.ContextFlags = CONTEXT_CONTROL;
    if (!SetThreadContext(t->host, &c))
        return 0;
    t->redirected = 1;
    return 1;
}

/* After a handler has dealt with an exception: preemption may come again. */
static LONG CALLBACK vcpu_win_continue(PEXCEPTION_POINTERS ep)
{
    (void)ep;
    if (t_self)
        t_self->in_exception = 0;
    return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
}

int vcpu_win_unredirect(void *exception_pointers)
{
    EXCEPTION_POINTERS *ep = exception_pointers;
    EXCEPTION_RECORD *er = ep->ExceptionRecord;
    CONTEXT *c = ep->ContextRecord;
    DWORD64 back;

    /* No preemption from here until the exception is done (vcpu_win_continue): a handler
     * holding a lock (the dirty tracker's spinlock) and sent to yield would leave the next
     * thread to want it spinning, and the game waiting on its disc read forever. On POSIX the
     * handlers run in signal handlers, where the preemption signal waits. */
    if (t_self)
        t_self->in_exception = now_ms() | 1;
    if (c->Rip != (DWORD64)vcpu_win_trampoline) {
        /* A redirect still pending, but not in the context this exception resumes: Windows
         * dropped it. The thread was suspended after the kernel had captured the fault's
         * context, and redirect() changed a trap frame that the dispatch then overwrote. It
         * never passes the trampoline, and with `redirected` up nothing redirects it again --
         * the main thread spinning on a disc read kept the CPU from the interrupt thread
         * for good (no vblank: "There's a problem with the disc"). A later preemption
         * request redirects it afresh (request_preempt). */
        if (t_self)
            t_self->redirected = 0;
        return 0;
    }
    back = *(DWORD64 *)c->Rsp;                /* where redirect() sent it from */
    if (!in_image(back))
        return 0;
    /* The trampoline's own first instruction (pushfq) can fault only on the stack. */
    if (er->ExceptionCode == EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION && er->NumberParameters >= 2 &&
        er->ExceptionInformation[1] >= c->Rsp - 16 && er->ExceptionInformation[1] < c->Rsp + 8)
        return 0;
    /* Windows took the fault's address from the redirected context too (the thread was
     * suspended before it built the exception), so both are put back. */
    c->Rip = back;
    c->Rsp += 8;
    if ((DWORD64)er->ExceptionAddress == (DWORD64)vcpu_win_trampoline)
        er->ExceptionAddress = (PVOID)back;
    if (t_self)
        t_self->redirected = 0;
    return 1;
}

/* Caller holds s_lock. */
static void win_preempt(vcpu_thread *h)
{
    if (!h->host || h->in_vcpu || h->suspended)
        return;
    if (SuspendThread(h->host) == (DWORD)-1)
        return;
    redirect(h);   /* (GetThreadContext also waits for the suspension) */
    ResumeThread(h->host);
}

vcpu_thread *vcpu_win_find(unsigned long tid)
{
    vcpu_thread *found = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < VCPU_MAX_THREADS && !found; i++)
        if (s_threads[i] && s_threads[i]->tid == tid)
            found = s_threads[i];
    return found;
}

/* SuspendThread for any thread: a guest thread's CPU goes to the next. */
/* NGB_SUSPEND_LOG=1 (debugging): each guest suspend and resume, with the counts. */
static int susp_log(void)
{
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0)
        on = getenv("NGB_SUSPEND_LOG") != NULL;
    return on;
}

unsigned long vcpu_win_suspend_thread(void *h)
{
    DWORD tid = GetThreadId(h), prev;
    vcpu_thread *t;

    if (tid == GetCurrentThreadId()) {   /* itself: give the CPU up meanwhile */
        t = t_self;
        if (!t) {
            prev = SuspendThread(h);
            return prev;
        }
        /* Counted before the CPU is given up, as the console's one CPU does it: no other thread
         * runs between a thread deciding to suspend itself and being suspended, so the resume
         * meant to wake it never comes first. With the OS's own SuspendThread the CPU was given
         * up first, a resume could come in between and be lost (the thread not suspended yet),
         * and the thread then slept for good -- Ninja Gaiden Black's loader, at "the disc is
         * dirty or damaged". The waking is vcpu_win_resume_thread's. */
        pthread_mutex_lock(&s_lock);
        if (t->resume_early > 0) {        /* the wake-up came first (vcpu_win_resume_thread) */
            t->resume_early--;
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&s_lock);
            if (susp_log())
                fprintf(stderr, "[SUSP] %llu self-suspend %lu: early resume taken\n",
                        (unsigned long long)GetTickCount64(), tid);
            return 0;
        }
        prev = (DWORD)t->self_susp++;
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&s_lock);
        if (susp_log())
            fprintf(stderr, "[SUSP] %llu self-suspend %lu: sleeping (count %lu)\n",
                    (unsigned long long)GetTickCount64(), tid, prev + 1);
        vcpu_block_begin();
        pthread_mutex_lock(&s_lock);
        while (t->self_susp > 0)
            pthread_cond_wait(&t->self_cv, &s_lock);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&s_lock);
        vcpu_block_end();
        return prev;
    }
    if (t_self) t_self->in_vcpu = 1;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&s_lock);
    prev = SuspendThread(h);
    if (susp_log())
        fprintf(stderr, "[SUSP] %llu suspend %lu by %lu: os prev %ld\n",
                (unsigned long long)GetTickCount64(), tid, GetCurrentThreadId(), (long)prev);
    t = prev == (DWORD)-1 ? NULL : vcpu_win_find(tid);
    if (t) {
        CONTEXT c;
        c.ContextFlags = CONTEXT_CONTROL;
        GetThreadContext(h, &c);   /* the suspension done */
        t->suspended++;
        if (s_holder == t) {
            t->stolen = 1;
            s_holder = NULL;
            dispatch();
        }
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&s_lock);
    if (t_self) t_self->in_vcpu = 0;
    return prev;
}

/* ResumeThread: the last resume of a thread that lost the CPU sends it to
 * wait for it before it runs more guest code. */
unsigned long vcpu_win_resume_thread(void *h)
{
    DWORD tid = GetThreadId(h), prev;
    vcpu_thread *t;

    if (t_self) t_self->in_vcpu = 1;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&s_lock);
    t = vcpu_win_find(tid);
    if (t && t->self_susp > 0) {         /* suspended by itself (vcpu_win_suspend_thread) */
        prev = (DWORD)t->self_susp--;
        if (t->self_susp == 0)
            pthread_cond_broadcast(&t->self_cv);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&s_lock);
        if (susp_log())
            fprintf(stderr, "[SUSP] %llu resume %lu by %lu: woken (count was %lu)\n",
                    (unsigned long long)GetTickCount64(), tid, GetCurrentThreadId(), prev);
        if (t_self) t_self->in_vcpu = 0;
        return prev;
    }
    if (t && t->suspended == 1 && t->stolen)
        redirect(t);   /* else compat_host_leave or a wait takes it back */
    prev = ResumeThread(h);
    /* A guest thread resumed while it was not suspended: a worker about to suspend itself, its
     * queue found empty, and the thread that has just queued work waking it -- in between, on
     * this host, as the console's one CPU would never let happen (Ninja Gaiden Black's loader,
     * then asleep for good: "the disc is dirty or damaged"). Kept for its next self-suspension. */
    if (t && prev == 0 && t->suspended == 0 && t->resume_early < 1)
        t->resume_early++;
    if (susp_log())
        fprintf(stderr, "[SUSP] %llu resume %lu by %lu: os prev %ld, vcpu thread %d, early %d\n",
                (unsigned long long)GetTickCount64(), tid, GetCurrentThreadId(), (long)prev, t != NULL,
                t ? t->resume_early : -1);
    if (t && prev != (DWORD)-1 && t->suspended > 0 && --t->suspended == 0 && !s_holder)
        dispatch();
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&s_lock);
    if (t_self) t_self->in_vcpu = 0;
    if (t_self) vcpu_check_preempt();   /* a resumed thread above this one */
    return prev;
}

#endif

#endif /* XBOX_HAS_VCPU */

```

`xboxrecomp/src/platform/vcpu.h`:

```h
/*
 * vcpu: one virtual CPU for guest threads.
 *
 * The Xbox has a single CPU and a priority scheduler: when a thread makes a
 * higher-priority thread ready (sets its event, resumes it), that thread runs
 * at once and the first one does not continue until it blocks. Titles depend
 * on it -- CRI's middleware resumes its server thread and reads the result
 * straight back -- and running guest threads truly in parallel turns those
 * assumptions into races that hang at random.
 *
 * So guest threads share one token. A thread holds it while it runs guest
 * code and gives it up when it blocks (compat waits, sleeps, contended locks,
 * suspension); the token goes to the highest-priority ready thread, first come
 * first served among equals. A thread that becomes ready above the holder's
 * priority preempts it: at once if the holder is in guest code, else when its
 * current kernel call returns. Equal priorities are time-sliced (10 ms), so a
 * spin-wait on a peer still lets the peer run.
 *
 * Host threads (GPU, audio, timers) never attach and are unaffected; every
 * function here is a no-op on a thread that has not attached.
 */
#ifndef VCPU_H
#define VCPU_H

/* Built on POSIX, and on Windows when the build asks for it (XBOX_WIN_VCPU,
 * the CMake option XBOXRECOMP_WIN_VCPU): there the waits of the Win32 API go
 * through win32_vcpu.h's wrappers and preemption redirects the running thread
 * (vcpu.c), where POSIX has the compat layer and a signal. */
#if !defined(_WIN32) || defined(XBOX_WIN_VCPU)
#define XBOX_HAS_VCPU 1
#else
#define XBOX_HAS_VCPU 0
#endif

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

typedef struct vcpu_thread vcpu_thread;

/* Priorities: Xbox base priority increments are -15..15 (XAPI's
 * THREAD_PRIORITY_*); interrupt and DPC delivery sits above all of them. */
#define VCPU_PRIO_NORMAL     0
#define VCPU_PRIO_INTERRUPT  64

/* Make the calling thread a guest thread and wait for the CPU. */
vcpu_thread *vcpu_attach(int priority);
/* Give the CPU up for good (thread exit). */
void vcpu_detach(void);
vcpu_thread *vcpu_self(void);

/* Around anything that can block: the CPU goes to someone else meanwhile. */
void vcpu_block_begin(void);
void vcpu_block_end(void);
/* Let a ready thread of equal or higher priority run first. */
void vcpu_yield(void);
/* Let any ready thread run, lower priorities included (NtYieldExecution). */
void vcpu_yield_any(void);

void vcpu_set_priority(vcpu_thread *t, int priority);
int  vcpu_get_priority(vcpu_thread *t);
int  vcpu_holds_cpu(void);   /* diagnostics */

/* Called by compat_host_leave: honour a preemption deferred while the thread
 * was in host code. */
void vcpu_check_preempt(void);
/* The calling thread is inside the scheduler (signals must defer). */
int vcpu_busy(void);

/* On by default; RECOMP_VCPU=0 runs guest threads in parallel as before,
 * for comparison. */
int vcpu_enabled(void);

/* Sleep about us microseconds (a spin-wait's pause; the caller gives the CPU
 * up around it). Windows sleeps in whole milliseconds, coarser still before
 * timeBeginPeriod: there a high-resolution waitable timer. */
void vcpu_nap_us(unsigned us);

#if defined(_WIN32) && XBOX_HAS_VCPU
/* Windows: SuspendThread/ResumeThread for guest threads (win32_vcpu.h routes
 * them here). A suspended thread gets no CPU, and one that held it gives it
 * up; resumed, it waits for it before running more guest code. */
unsigned long vcpu_win_suspend_thread(void *thread);
unsigned long vcpu_win_resume_thread(void *thread);
/* The record of the guest thread with this thread id, or NULL. */
vcpu_thread *vcpu_win_find(unsigned long tid);
/* An exception handler's first step (its EXCEPTION_POINTERS): a thread suspended while Windows was
 * delivering it an exception may have been sent through the preemption trampoline, so the context
 * the handler sees is the trampoline's, not the faulting instruction's. Undone here (the preemption
 * is tried again later); 1 when it was. Until the exception is done the thread is not preempted
 * (a handler may hold a lock). */
int vcpu_win_unredirect(void *exception_pointers);
/* Debugging: the CPU's holder and the threads waiting for it, as text into buf. */
void vcpu_debug_state(char *buf, int n);
#endif

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
#endif
```
