```c
VOID RaiseException(DWORD code, DWORD flags, DWORD nargs, const ULONG_PTR *args)
{
    (void)flags; (void)nargs; (void)args;
    fprintf(stderr, "[win32_compat] RaiseException(0x%08X): SEH not emulated\n", code);
    /* TODO: on Windows this does not return; SEH dispatch unimplemented. */
}

#if RECOMP_HAS_VEH
#ifdef __APPLE__
#include <sys/ucontext.h>
#else
#include <ucontext.h>
#endif

/* Vectored exception handlers over sigaction.
 *
 * The list is a fixed array published with release stores and read without a
 * lock, because the reader is a signal handler: it can interrupt a thread that
 * is itself registering a handler, and taking a mutex there would deadlock.
 * Registration happens during bring-up, so the array never needs to grow. */
#define VEH_MAX 32
static PVECTORED_EXCEPTION_HANDLER s_veh[VEH_MAX];
static int                         s_veh_count;
static pthread_mutex_t             s_veh_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;

static const int s_veh_signals[] = { SIGSEGV, SIGBUS, SIGTRAP, SIGILL, SIGFPE };
#define VEH_NSIG ((int)(sizeof(s_veh_signals) / sizeof(s_veh_signals[0])))
static struct sigaction s_veh_prev[VEH_NSIG];

static void veh_ctx_from(CONTEXT *c, const ucontext_t *uc)
{
#if defined(__APPLE__) && defined(__aarch64__)
    memset(c, 0, sizeof(*c));
    c->Rip = uc->uc_mcontext->__ss.__pc;
    c->Rsp = uc->uc_mcontext->__ss.__sp;
    c->Rbp = uc->uc_mcontext->__ss.__fp;
    c->native_context = (void *)uc;
#else
    const greg_t *g = uc->uc_mcontext.gregs;
    c->Rax = (uint64_t)g[REG_RAX]; c->Rcx = (uint64_t)g[REG_RCX];
    c->Rdx = (uint64_t)g[REG_RDX]; c->Rbx = (uint64_t)g[REG_RBX];
    c->Rsp = (uint64_t)g[REG_RSP]; c->Rbp = (uint64_t)g[REG_RBP];
    c->Rsi = (uint64_t)g[REG_RSI]; c->Rdi = (uint64_t)g[REG_RDI];
    c->R8  = (uint64_t)g[REG_R8];  c->R9  = (uint64_t)g[REG_R9];
    c->R10 = (uint64_t)g[REG_R10]; c->R11 = (uint64_t)g[REG_R11];
    c->R12 = (uint64_t)g[REG_R12]; c->R13 = (uint64_t)g[REG_R13];
    c->R14 = (uint64_t)g[REG_R14]; c->R15 = (uint64_t)g[REG_R15];
    c->Rip = (uint64_t)g[REG_RIP];
    c->EFlags = (uint32_t)g[REG_EFL];
#endif
}

static void veh_ctx_to(ucontext_t *uc, const CONTEXT *c)
{
#if defined(__APPLE__) && defined(__aarch64__)
    /* The ARM64 decoder updates the native context directly. */
    (void)uc;
    (void)c;
#else
    greg_t *g = uc->uc_mcontext.gregs;
    g[REG_RAX] = (greg_t)c->Rax; g[REG_RCX] = (greg_t)c->Rcx;
    g[REG_RDX] = (greg_t)c->Rdx; g[REG_RBX] = (greg_t)c->Rbx;
    g[REG_RSP] = (greg_t)c->Rsp; g[REG_RBP] = (greg_t)c->Rbp;
    g[REG_RSI] = (greg_t)c->Rsi; g[REG_RDI] = (greg_t)c->Rdi;
    g[REG_R8]  = (greg_t)c->R8;  g[REG_R9]  = (greg_t)c->R9;
    g[REG_R10] = (greg_t)c->R10; g[REG_R11] = (greg_t)c->R11;
    g[REG_R12] = (greg_t)c->R12; g[REG_R13] = (greg_t)c->R13;
    g[REG_R14] = (greg_t)c->R14; g[REG_R15] = (greg_t)c->R15;
    g[REG_RIP] = (greg_t)c->Rip;
    g[REG_EFL] = (greg_t)c->EFlags;
#endif
}

static DWORD veh_code(int sig, const siginfo_t *si)
{
    switch (sig) {
    case SIGSEGV: case SIGBUS: return EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION;
    /* A TF step reports TRAP_TRACE; int3 reports SI_KERNEL or TRAP_BRKPT. */
    case SIGTRAP: return si->si_code == TRAP_TRACE ? EXCEPTION_SINGLE_STEP
                                                   : EXCEPTION_BREAKPOINT;
    case SIGILL:  return si->si_code == ILL_PRVOPC ? EXCEPTION_PRIV_INSTRUCTION
                                                   : EXCEPTION_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION;
    case SIGFPE:  return si->si_code == FPE_INTDIV ? EXCEPTION_INT_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO
                                                   : EXCEPTION_FLT_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO;
    }
    return 0;
}

static void veh_signal(int sig, siginfo_t *si, void *uc_)
{
    ucontext_t *uc = (ucontext_t *)uc_;
    EXCEPTION_RECORD rec;
    CONTEXT ctx;
    EXCEPTION_POINTERS ep = { &rec, &ctx };
    int saved_errno = errno;
    int i, n;

    veh_ctx_from(&ctx, uc);
    memset(&rec, 0, sizeof(rec));
    rec.ExceptionCode = veh_code(sig, si);
    /* A step can also arrive without TRAP_TRACE -- gdb re-injects a passed
     * SIGTRAP as a plain one -- but the saved flags still have TF set, which
     * an int3 never does. */
    if (sig == SIGTRAP && (ctx.EFlags & 0x100))
        rec.ExceptionCode = EXCEPTION_SINGLE_STEP;
    rec.ExceptionAddress = (PVOID)(uintptr_t)ctx.Rip;
    if (sig == SIGSEGV || sig == SIGBUS) {
        rec.NumberParameters = 2;
#if defined(__APPLE__) && defined(__aarch64__)
        rec.ExceptionInformation[0] = (uc->uc_mcontext->__es.__esr >> 6) & 1;
#else
        /* Page-fault error code bit 1 is set for a write. */
        rec.ExceptionInformation[0] = (uc->uc_mcontext.gregs[REG_ERR] & 2) ? 1 : 0;
#endif
        rec.ExceptionInformation[1] = (ULONG_PTR)si->si_addr;
    }

    /* Handlers take runtime locks (the GPU model's, for one): a suspension
     * arriving now waits until the handler is done. */
    t_host_depth++;
    n = __atomic_load_n(&s_veh_count, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        PVECTORED_EXCEPTION_HANDLER h = __atomic_load_n(&s_veh[i], __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
        if (h && h(&ep) == EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION) {
            veh_ctx_to(uc, &ctx);
            compat_host_leave();
            errno = saved_errno;
            return;
        }
    }
    t_host_depth--;

    /* Nobody took it: hand it to whoever had the signal before us, or restore
     * the default and return so the instruction faults again and the process
     * dies with the right signal (and a core) instead of looping here. */
    for (i = 0; i < VEH_NSIG; i++) {
        if (s_veh_signals[i] != sig)
            continue;
        if (s_veh_prev[i].sa_flags & SA_SIGINFO) {
            if (s_veh_prev[i].sa_sigaction) {
                s_veh_prev[i].sa_sigaction(sig, si, uc_);
                return;
            }
        } else if (s_veh_prev[i].sa_handler != SIG_DFL
                   && s_veh_prev[i].sa_handler != SIG_IGN) {
            s_veh_prev[i].sa_handler(sig);
            return;
        }
        break;
    }
    signal(sig, SIG_DFL);
    /* SIGTRAP from a step does not re-fault on return; raise it instead. */
    if (sig == SIGTRAP)
        raise(sig);
}

static void veh_install(void)
{
    struct sigaction sa;
    int i;

    memset(&sa, 0, sizeof(sa));
    sa.sa_sigaction = veh_signal;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    /* SA_NODEFER: a handler that touches a trapped page itself (a nested MMIO
     * access) must be able to take the fault rather than be killed by it. */
    sa.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO | SA_NODEFER | SA_ONSTACK;
    for (i = 0; i < VEH_NSIG; i++)
        sigaction(s_veh_signals[i], &sa, &s_veh_prev[i]);
}

PVOID AddVectoredExceptionHandler(ULONG First, PVECTORED_EXCEPTION_HANDLER Handler)
{
    PVOID ret = NULL;

    if (!Handler)
        return NULL;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&s_veh_lock);
    if (s_veh_count < VEH_MAX) {
        if (s_veh_count == 0)
            veh_install();
        if (First) {
            /* Shift right from the top so each slot is copied before it is
             * overwritten. A fault racing this on another thread can see a
             * handler twice, which is harmless; handlers are registered during
             * bring-up, before guest threads exist. */
            int i;
            for (i = s_veh_count; i > 0; i--)
                __atomic_store_n(&s_veh[i], s_veh[i - 1], __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
            __atomic_store_n(&s_veh[0], Handler, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        } else {
            __atomic_store_n(&s_veh[s_veh_count], Handler, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        }
        __atomic_store_n(&s_veh_count, s_veh_count + 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        ret = (PVOID)Handler;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&s_veh_lock);
    return ret;
}

ULONG RemoveVectoredExceptionHandler(PVOID h)
{
    ULONG found = 0;
    int i;

    pthread_mutex_lock(&s_veh_lock);
    for (i = 0; i < s_veh_count; i++) {
        if ((PVOID)s_veh[i] != h)
            continue;
        for (; i + 1 < s_veh_count; i++)
            __atomic_store_n(&s_veh[i], s_veh[i + 1], __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        __atomic_store_n(&s_veh[s_veh_count - 1], NULL, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        __atomic_store_n(&s_veh_count, s_veh_count - 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        found = 1;
        break;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&s_veh_lock);
    return found;
}
#else
PVOID AddVectoredExceptionHandler(ULONG First, PVECTORED_EXCEPTION_HANDLER Handler)
{ (void)First; (void)Handler; return NULL; }   /* not wired off Linux x86-64 */
ULONG RemoveVectoredExceptionHandler(PVOID h) { (void)h; return 1; }
#endif

#endif /* !_WIN32 */

```

```h
 * win32_compat.h - POSIX implementation of generic Win32 host primitives
 *
 * The Xbox kernel HLE (src/kernel) is built on top of a handful of *generic*
 * OS primitives -- threads, events, mutexes, semaphores, interlocked atomics,
 * a heap, timers, time queries. These are NOT Xbox semantics; they are host
 * services that any emulator needs. This layer implements that exact subset

/* Win32 VEH over sigaction. SIGSEGV/SIGBUS become access violations (with
 * ExceptionInformation[0] = 1 for a write, [1] = the faulting address),
 * SIGTRAP after a TF step becomes EXCEPTION_SINGLE_STEP, and SIGILL/SIGFPE
 * map to their Win32 codes. Handlers run in registration order (FirstHandler
 * puts one at the front); EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION resumes with whatever
 * the handler wrote into the CONTEXT, and an exception nobody takes falls back
 * to the signal's previous disposition, so it still crashes with a core. */

    PEXCEPTION_RECORD ExceptionRecord;
    PCONTEXT          ContextRecord;
```

`xboxrecomp/src/platform/win32_host.c`:

```c
/*
 * win32_host.c -- Windows with the virtual CPU (XBOX_WIN_VCPU): what the
 * POSIX compat layer (win32_compat.c) adds around the host's primitives for
 * vcpu.c, over the real Win32 API.
 *
 *   - host depth: compat_host_enter/leave bracket runtime code (a kernel
 *     call, the D3D layer), where a thread is never preempted or parked;
 *   - the thread records: a guest thread's vcpu record by its host thread;
 *   - the wrappers win32_vcpu.h routes the runtime's calls to: anything that
 *     can block gives the CPU up while it does (vcpu_block_begin/end), as
 *     the POSIX waits do, and a thread that ends leaves the CPU.
 *
 * Built with XBOX_VCPU_WRAP_IMPL, so the calls here are the real ones.
 */
#if defined(_WIN32) && defined(XBOX_WIN_VCPU)
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#include "vcpu.h"

static __thread volatile int t_host_depth;

void compat_host_enter(void)
{
    t_host_depth++;
}

void compat_host_leave(void)
{
    if (--t_host_depth == 0)
        vcpu_check_preempt();
}

int compat_host_depth(void)
{
    return t_host_depth;
}

volatile int *compat_host_depth_ptr(void)
{
    return &t_host_depth;
}

/* Guest code called from inside runtime code (the boot thread's main
 * routine, run from a kernel call): preemptible again until it returns. */
int compat_guest_enter(void)
{
    int depth = t_host_depth;
    t_host_depth = 0;
    vcpu_check_preempt();
    return depth;
}

void compat_guest_leave(int saved_depth)
{
    t_host_depth = saved_depth;
}

/* Suspension acts at once here (vcpu_win_suspend_thread): nothing deferred. */
void compat_park_if_pending(void)
{
}

/* The kernel's scheduler record of a thread is its vcpu record. */
void compat_thread_set_user(void *user)
{
    (void)user;
}

void *compat_thread_user(HANDLE h)
{
    DWORD tid = GetThreadId(h);
    return tid ? (void *)vcpu_win_find(tid) : NULL;
}

int compat_is_thread(HANDLE h)
{
    return GetThreadId(h) != 0;
}

/* ---- the wrappers (win32_vcpu.h) ---- */

DWORD vw_WaitForSingleObjectEx(HANDLE h, DWORD ms, BOOL alertable);
DWORD vw_WaitForMultipleObjectsEx(DWORD n, const HANDLE *h, BOOL all, DWORD ms, BOOL alertable);

VOID vw_EnterCriticalSection(LPCRITICAL_SECTION cs)
{
    if (TryEnterCriticalSection(cs))
        return;
    vcpu_block_begin();
    EnterCriticalSection(cs);
    vcpu_block_end();
}

VOID vw_AcquireSRWLockExclusive(PSRWLOCK l)
{
    if (TryAcquireSRWLockExclusive(l))
        return;
    vcpu_block_begin();
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(l);
    vcpu_block_end();
}

VOID vw_AcquireSRWLockShared(PSRWLOCK l)
{
    if (TryAcquireSRWLockShared(l))
        return;
    vcpu_block_begin();
    AcquireSRWLockShared(l);
    vcpu_block_end();
}

BOOL vw_SleepConditionVariableCS(PCONDITION_VARIABLE cv, PCRITICAL_SECTION cs, DWORD ms)
{
    BOOL r;
    vcpu_block_begin();
    r = SleepConditionVariableCS(cv, cs, ms);
    vcpu_block_end();
    return r;
}

BOOL vw_SleepConditionVariableSRW(PCONDITION_VARIABLE cv, PSRWLOCK l, DWORD ms, ULONG flags)
{
    BOOL r;
    vcpu_block_begin();
    r = SleepConditionVariableSRW(cv, l, ms, flags);
    vcpu_block_end();
    return r;
}

DWORD vw_WaitForSingleObject(HANDLE h, DWORD ms)
{
    return vw_WaitForSingleObjectEx(h, ms, FALSE);
}

DWORD vw_WaitForSingleObjectEx(HANDLE h, DWORD ms, BOOL alertable)
{
    /* Already satisfied: no reason to give the CPU up. */
    DWORD r = WaitForSingleObjectEx(h, 0, alertable);
    if (r != WAIT_TIMEOUT || ms == 0)
        return r;
    vcpu_block_begin();
    r = WaitForSingleObjectEx(h, ms, alertable);
    vcpu_block_end();
    return r;
}

DWORD vw_WaitForMultipleObjects(DWORD n, const HANDLE *h, BOOL all, DWORD ms)
{
    return vw_WaitForMultipleObjectsEx(n, h, all, ms, FALSE);
}

DWORD vw_WaitForMultipleObjectsEx(DWORD n, const HANDLE *h, BOOL all, DWORD ms, BOOL alertable)
{
    DWORD r = WaitForMultipleObjectsEx(n, h, all, 0, alertable);
    if (r != WAIT_TIMEOUT || ms == 0)
        return r;
    vcpu_block_begin();
    r = WaitForMultipleObjectsEx(n, h, all, ms, alertable);
    vcpu_block_end();
    return r;
}

DWORD vw_SignalObjectAndWait(HANDLE sig, HANDLE wait, DWORD ms, BOOL alertable)
{
    DWORD r;
    vcpu_block_begin();
    r = SignalObjectAndWait(sig, wait, ms, alertable);
    vcpu_block_end();
    return r;
}

VOID vw_Sleep(DWORD ms)
{
    if (ms == 0) {
        if (vcpu_self())
            vcpu_yield();
        else
            Sleep(0);
        return;
    }
    vcpu_block_begin();
    Sleep(ms);
    vcpu_block_end();
}

DWORD vw_SleepEx(DWORD ms, BOOL alertable)
{
    DWORD r;
    if (ms == 0 && !alertable) {
        vw_Sleep(0);
        return 0;
    }
    vcpu_block_begin();
    r = SleepEx(ms, alertable);
    vcpu_block_end();
    return r;
}

BOOL vw_SwitchToThread(void)
{
    if (vcpu_self()) {
        vcpu_yield_any();
        return TRUE;
    }
    return SwitchToThread();
}

DWORD vw_SuspendThread(HANDLE h)
{
    return (DWORD)vcpu_win_suspend_thread(h);
}

DWORD vw_ResumeThread(HANDLE h)
{
    return (DWORD)vcpu_win_resume_thread(h);
}

VOID vw_ExitThread(DWORD code)
{
    vcpu_detach();
    ExitThread(code);
}

/* A thread's routine returned: it leaves the CPU, as one that calls
 * ExitThread does. */
struct vw_start { LPTHREAD_START_ROUTINE fn; LPVOID arg; };

static DWORD WINAPI vw_thread_main(LPVOID p)
{
    struct vw_start s = *(struct vw_start *)p;
    DWORD rc;
    free(p);
    rc = s.fn(s.arg);
    vcpu_detach();
    return rc;
}

HANDLE vw_CreateThread(LPSECURITY_ATTRIBUTES sa, SIZE_T stack, LPTHREAD_START_ROUTINE fn,
                       LPVOID arg, DWORD flags, LPDWORD tid)
{
    struct vw_start *s = malloc(sizeof *s);
    HANDLE h;
    if (!s)
        return NULL;
    s->fn = fn;
    s->arg = arg;
    h = CreateThread(sa, stack, vw_thread_main, s, flags, tid);
    if (!h)
        free(s);
    return h;
}
#endif
```

```h
/*
 * win32_vcpu.h -- on Windows with the virtual CPU (XBOX_WIN_VCPU), the Win32
 * calls that can block a guest thread give the CPU up meanwhile, as the POSIX
 * compat layer's do (win32_compat.c): waits, sleeps, contended critical
 * sections and SRW locks, condition variables. Thread suspension keeps the
 * CPU off a suspended thread, and a thread that ends leaves it.
 *
 * Included ahead of every file of the runtime and the title (CMake: the
 * platform target's -include), after <windows.h> so its declarations keep
 * their names. win32_host.c and vcpu.c, which call the real functions, are
 * built with XBOX_VCPU_WRAP_IMPL.
 */
#ifndef XBOX_WIN32_VCPU_H
#define XBOX_WIN32_VCPU_H

#if defined(_WIN32) && defined(XBOX_WIN_VCPU) && !defined(XBOX_VCPU_WRAP_IMPL)
#include <windows.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

VOID   vw_EnterCriticalSection(LPCRITICAL_SECTION cs);
VOID   vw_AcquireSRWLockExclusive(PSRWLOCK l);
VOID   vw_AcquireSRWLockShared(PSRWLOCK l);
BOOL   vw_SleepConditionVariableCS(PCONDITION_VARIABLE cv, PCRITICAL_SECTION cs, DWORD ms);
BOOL   vw_SleepConditionVariableSRW(PCONDITION_VARIABLE cv, PSRWLOCK l, DWORD ms, ULONG flags);
DWORD  vw_WaitForSingleObject(HANDLE h, DWORD ms);
DWORD  vw_WaitForSingleObjectEx(HANDLE h, DWORD ms, BOOL alertable);
DWORD  vw_WaitForMultipleObjects(DWORD n, const HANDLE *h, BOOL all, DWORD ms);
DWORD  vw_WaitForMultipleObjectsEx(DWORD n, const HANDLE *h, BOOL all, DWORD ms, BOOL alertable);
DWORD  vw_SignalObjectAndWait(HANDLE sig, HANDLE wait, DWORD ms, BOOL alertable);
VOID   vw_Sleep(DWORD ms);
DWORD  vw_SleepEx(DWORD ms, BOOL alertable);
BOOL   vw_SwitchToThread(void);
DWORD  vw_SuspendThread(HANDLE h);
DWORD  vw_ResumeThread(HANDLE h);
DECLSPEC_NORETURN VOID vw_ExitThread(DWORD code);
HANDLE vw_CreateThread(LPSECURITY_ATTRIBUTES sa, SIZE_T stack, LPTHREAD_START_ROUTINE fn,
                       LPVOID arg, DWORD flags, LPDWORD tid);

/* The host side of the virtual CPU, as win32_compat.h declares it on POSIX
 * (win32_host.c). */
void  compat_host_enter(void);
void  compat_host_leave(void);
int   compat_guest_enter(void);

#ifdef __cplusplus

#endif

#define WaitForSingleObjectEx(h, ms, a)          vw_WaitForSingleObjectEx(h, ms, a)
#define WaitForMultipleObjects(n, h, all, ms)    vw_WaitForMultipleObjects(n, h, all, ms)
#define WaitForMultipleObjectsEx(n, h, all, ms, a) vw_WaitForMultipleObjectsEx(n, h, all, ms, a)
#define SignalObjectAndWait(s, w, ms, a)         vw_SignalObjectAndWait(s, w, ms, a)
#define Sleep(ms)                                vw_Sleep(ms)
#define SleepEx(ms, a)                           vw_SleepEx(ms, a)
#define SwitchToThread()                         vw_SwitchToThread()
#define SuspendThread(h)                         vw_SuspendThread(h)
```

`xboxrecomp/src/platform/xbox_winnt.h`:

```h
/*
 * xbox_winnt.h - Portable Win32 / NT type vocabulary
 *
 * The Xbox kernel API is a derivative of the Windows NT kernel API, so its
 * public signatures legitimately speak in NT types (NTSTATUS, HANDLE, ULONG,
 * LARGE_INTEGER, ...). On Windows this header is just <windows.h>. On
 * Linux/Debian there is no Win32 SDK, so we define the exact same type
 * vocabulary on top of <stdint.h>.
 *
 * IMPORTANT: this header declares TYPES ONLY. It contains no Win32 functions.
 * The Xbox kernel HLE (.c files under src/kernel) implements behaviour
 * directly against POSIX -- that is the whole point of building Linux-first:
 * there is no Win32 to silently fall through to.
 *
 * Notes on the Linux definitions:
 *   - Calling-convention macros (__stdcall/__cdecl/__fastcall/WINAPI) expand
 *     to nothing: x86-64 has a single calling convention.
 *   - WCHAR is uint16_t (UTF-16), matching the Xbox -- NOT the 32-bit Linux
 *     wchar_t. Do not feed L"..." literals to WCHAR* APIs in ported code.
 */

#ifndef XBOX_WINNT_H
#define XBOX_WINNT_H

/* Thread-local storage qualifier (portable). By compiler, not system: clang
 * targeting MinGW accepts __declspec(thread) and makes an ordinary global of
 * it -- every thread then shared one IRQL, and the title bug-checked. */
#if defined(_MSC_VER)
#define XBOX_THREAD_LOCAL __declspec(thread)
#else
#define XBOX_THREAD_LOCAL __thread
#endif

/* Vectored exception handlers: native on Windows, emulated over sigaction
 * on Linux x86-64 and macOS arm64 (win32_compat.c). Code that traps
 * device registers by faulting on them needs this, not Win32 as such. */
#if defined(_WIN32) || (defined(__linux__) && defined(__x86_64__)) || (defined(__APPLE__) && defined(__aarch64__))
#define RECOMP_HAS_VEH 1
#else
#define RECOMP_HAS_VEH 0
#endif

/* In-place backslash -> forward-slash normaliser for hard-coded Windows
 * paths embedded in the game and asset loaders. No-op on Windows. */
static inline void xbox_path_normalize(char *p)
{
#if !defined(_WIN32)
    for (; p && *p; p++) if (*p == '\\') *p = '/';
#else
    (void)p;
#endif
}

/* MSVC's __debugbreak() intrinsic -> gcc/clang equivalent on POSIX.
 *
 * The guard has to exclude every _WIN32 host, not just _MSC_VER. MinGW is
 * neither: it defines _WIN32 but not _MSC_VER, and <_mingw.h> -- reached
 * through the <windows.h> below -- declares a real __debugbreak(), an inline
 * that emits int3. Defining a function-like macro of that name first turns
 * that declaration into an expansion, and the (void) parameter list is read
 * as an argument: "macro '__debugbreak' passed 1 arguments, but takes just 0".
 *
 * Where a Windows SDK exists its own __debugbreak is the better one anyway --
 * it traps to a debugger, where __builtin_trap() raises SIGILL. */
#if !defined(_MSC_VER) && !defined(_WIN32)
#define __debugbreak() __builtin_trap()
#endif

#if defined(_WIN32)

/* ---- Windows host: use the real SDK ------------------------------------- */
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>

/* Wide-string helpers: map to the real CRT functions on Windows. */
#define xbox_wcslen  wcslen
#define xbox_wcsncmp wcsncmp
#define xbox_wcscat  wcscat
#define xbox_wcscpy  wcscpy

#else /* !_WIN32 */

/* ---- Linux / POSIX host: define the NT type vocabulary ------------------ */

#include <stdint.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <string.h>   /* windows.h users relied on string.h being visible */

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/* Calling conventions: x86-64 SysV has a single convention. GCC accepts and
 * ignores these attributes on 64-bit, but expanding to nothing is cleaner and
 * avoids -Wattributes noise. */
#define __stdcall
#define __cdecl
#define __fastcall
#define __thiscall
#ifndef WINAPI
#define WINAPI
#endif
#ifndef APIENTRY
#define APIENTRY
#endif
#ifndef CALLBACK
#define CALLBACK
#endif
#ifndef CONST
#define CONST const
#endif

/* Parameter annotation macros (no-ops, used in NT-style prototypes). */
#ifndef IN
#define IN
#endif

#define OPTIONAL

/* ---- Fundamental integer types ----------------------------------------- */
typedef int32_t            LONG,  *PLONG,  *LPLONG;
typedef uint32_t           ULONG, *PULONG;
typedef uint32_t           DWORD, *PDWORD, *LPDWORD;
typedef int16_t            SHORT, *PSHORT;
typedef uint16_t           USHORT, *PUSHORT;
typedef uint16_t           WORD,  *PWORD;
typedef uint8_t            UCHAR, *PUCHAR;
typedef uint8_t            BYTE,  *PBYTE, *LPBYTE;
typedef uint8_t            BOOLEAN, *PBOOLEAN;
typedef char               CHAR,  *PCHAR;
typedef char               CCHAR;

typedef float              FLOAT;

/* void aliases */
typedef void               VOID;
typedef void              *PVOID, *LPVOID;
typedef const void        *PCVOID, *LPCVOID;

/* Handles -- opaque pointers */
typedef void              *HANDLE;
typedef void             **PHANDLE, **LPHANDLE;
typedef void              *HMODULE, *HINSTANCE, *HKEY, *HLOCAL, *HGLOBAL;
typedef void              *HWND, *HDC, *HBITMAP, *HICON, *HMENU, *HCURSOR;

/* PCONTEXT: Windows VEH register state. On POSIX the vectored handlers are
 * driven from sigaction (win32_compat.c), which copies the ucontext_t into
 * this and back, so handlers written against the Win32 CONTEXT -- the MMIO
 * decoders, the single-step traps -- run unchanged. Only the integer state is
 * carried: nothing in the runtime reads or edits the vector registers. */
typedef struct _CONTEXT {
    uint64_t Rax, Rcx, Rdx, Rbx, Rsp, Rbp, Rsi, Rdi;
    uint64_t R8, R9, R10, R11, R12, R13, R14, R15;
    uint64_t Rip;
    uint32_t EFlags;
#if defined(__APPLE__) && defined(__aarch64__)
    void *native_context;
#endif
} CONTEXT, *PCONTEXT;

/* Xbox/UTF-16 wide char is 16-bit, unlike the 32-bit Linux wchar_t. */
typedef uint16_t           WCHAR, *PWCHAR, *LPWSTR, *PWSTR;
typedef const uint16_t    *LPCWSTR, *PCWSTR;

/* Narrow string pointers */
typedef char              *LPSTR,  *PSTR;
typedef const char        *LPCSTR, *PCSTR;

/* Pointer-sized integers */
typedef intptr_t           INT_PTR,  LONG_PTR,  *PLONG_PTR;
typedef uintptr_t          UINT_PTR, ULONG_PTR, *PULONG_PTR;
typedef intptr_t           SSIZE_T;
typedef uintptr_t          SIZE_T,  *PSIZE_T;
typedef intptr_t           DWORD_PTR;
typedef uintptr_t          HALF_PTR;

/* NT-flavoured aliases */
typedef ULONG              ACCESS_MASK, *PACCESS_MASK;
typedef DWORD              COLORREF;

/* Win32 message types (LRESULT/WPARAM/LPARAM are pointer-sized) */
typedef LONG_PTR           LRESULT;
typedef UINT_PTR           WPARAM;
typedef LONG_PTR           LPARAM;
typedef LONG               HRESULT;
typedef LONG               NTSTATUS;

/* ---- LARGE_INTEGER / ULARGE_INTEGER ------------------------------------ */
typedef union _LARGE_INTEGER {
    struct { DWORD LowPart; LONG  HighPart; };
    struct { DWORD LowPart; LONG  HighPart; } u;
    LONGLONG QuadPart;
} LARGE_INTEGER, *PLARGE_INTEGER;

    struct { DWORD LowPart; DWORD HighPart; };
    struct { DWORD LowPart; DWORD HighPart; } u;
    ULONGLONG QuadPart;

/* ---- GUID -------------------------------------------------------------- */
typedef struct _GUID {
    uint32_t Data1;
    uint16_t Data2;
    uint16_t Data3;
    uint8_t  Data4[8];
} GUID, *LPGUID, *PGUID;
typedef GUID IID, CLSID;

/* ---- Critical section --------------------------------------------------- */
/* Opaque, deliberately sized generously: ported code embeds this in its own
 * structs. Backed by a pthread_mutex_t inside the kernel HLE. */
typedef struct _RTL_CRITICAL_SECTION {
    void     *DebugInfo;
    LONG      LockCount;
    LONG      RecursionCount;
    void     *OwningThread;
    void     *LockSemaphore;
    ULONG_PTR SpinCount;
    uint8_t   _backing[40];   /* room for a pthread_mutex_t */
} RTL_CRITICAL_SECTION, *PRTL_CRITICAL_SECTION,
  CRITICAL_SECTION,     *PCRITICAL_SECTION, *LPCRITICAL_SECTION;

/* CONDITION_VARIABLE: same single-pointer layout as Win32 (Ptr is a
 * pthread_cond_t* on POSIX). */
typedef struct { PVOID Ptr; } CONDITION_VARIABLE, *PCONDITION_VARIABLE;
#define CONDITION_VARIABLE_INIT { NULL }

/* SRWLOCK / INIT_ONCE: same single-pointer layout as Win32, and like it both
 * are usable from a static initialiser with no explicit Initialize* call.
 * Ptr is a pthread_rwlock_t* on POSIX. */

typedef struct { PVOID Ptr; } INIT_ONCE, *PINIT_ONCE, *LPINIT_ONCE;

/* ---- Common small structs ---------------------------------------------- */
typedef struct _FILETIME   { DWORD dwLowDateTime; DWORD dwHighDateTime; }
        FILETIME, *PFILETIME, *LPFILETIME;

    WORD wYear, wMonth, wDayOfWeek, wDay, wHour, wMinute, wSecond, wMilliseconds;
} SYSTEMTIME, *PSYSTEMTIME, *LPSYSTEMTIME;

/* ---- Boolean / null / misc constants ----------------------------------- */
#ifndef TRUE

#endif

#endif

#endif

/* MAKE/LOWORD/HIWORD helpers used pervasively in Win32-style code. */
#ifndef LOWORD
```
